items.en: maintained that anti-fraud rhetoric often disguised ideological opposition
items.why: 这个写法用“maintained that [论点]”清晰表达某方坚持的观点，且用“disguised ideological opposition”精准描述修辞背后的真实意图，中国人常写“said that anti-fraud words hide real opposition”，表述不够正式且精准，适合报告中引用观点的场合。
items.when: 撰写报告时，引用某方坚持的论点并点明其背后真实意图的场合。
items.slot: maintained that […] often disguised ideological opposition
swap: argued that anti-fraud rhetoric masked ideological opposition（语气更强，适合争议性话题）
asserted that anti-fraud rhetoric concealed ideological opposition（更正式，适合政策分析报告）

items.en: I am a Ph.D. candidate studying fiscal and social policy
items.why: 用“Ph.D. candidate”正式说明身份，搭配现在分词后置修饰研究领域，比中式的“I am a student who is studying for Ph.D. in...”更简洁专业，符合学术写作规范
items.when: 学术报告、简历或正式自我介绍场合
items.slot: I am a Ph.D. candidate studying […]
swap: I am a doctoral candidate researching […]（更正式，用于学术论文）
I am a PhD student focusing on […]（更常用，语气稍轻）

items.en: Since the effects of shocks are uncertain in real time
items.why: 中文正式报告常直接用"Because"引导原因，此处用"Since"更贴合财经/政策报告的正式语气，且"in real time"是专业领域精准表达"实时"的固定搭配，避免中式英语生硬翻译
items.when: 适合正式报告中引出因果关系的论述，尤其是涉及专业领域时效性分析时
items.slot: Since the effects of […] are uncertain in real time
swap: As the effects of shocks are uncertain in real time（语气更柔和，适合缓和论证）
Because the effects of shocks are uncertain in real time（更直接，适合强调因果逻辑）

items.en: policymakers must draw conclusions about their nature based on analysis of data
items.why: 中文写报告常拆分冗余从句如"policymakers must draw conclusions about their nature because they analyze data"，此处用"based on"的分词结构作后置定语，避免冗余，符合英文正式报告的简洁性要求，且"draw conclusions"是财经领域固定表达
items.when: 适合正式报告中描述决策/结论的依据时使用
items.slot: […] must draw conclusions about their nature based on analysis of […]
swap: policymakers should draw conclusions about their nature on the basis of analysis of data（"on the basis of"更正式，适合学术类报告）
policymakers need to draw conclusions about their nature through analysis of data（"through"更强调方式，语气稍弱）

items.en: whose relative importance and interactions must be assessed
items.why: 中文写报告常重复名词如"overlapping shocks, and their relative importance..."，此处用"whose"引导非限制性定语从句，指代明确，避免名词重复，让句子更连贯紧凑，符合正式写作要求
items.when: 适合正式报告中对前文提到的复数名词（如多个因素、冲击）的补充说明时使用
items.slot: […] overlapping shocks, whose relative importance and interactions must be assessed
swap: […] overlapping shocks, and their relative importance and interactions must be evaluated（用and连接，语气稍口语化，正式度略低）
[…] overlapping shocks, the relative importance and interactions of which must be assessed（用"of which"替代"whose"，更书面化，适合严谨学术写作）

items.en: make it difficult to convince national brands to return or invest in Detroit for the first time
items.why: 用形式主语it替代冗长的真正不定式短语，避免句子头重脚轻，中文常直接写“很难说服”，显得生硬不流畅。
items.when: 用于正式报告中表达“做某事存在困难”的语境
items.slot: make it difficult to convince […] to return or invest in […] for the first time
swap: make it hard to persuade national brands to return or invest in Detroit for the first time（hard比difficult语气更随意，persuade侧重行动说服）
pose a challenge to convincing national brands to return or invest in Detroit for the first time（更正式，强调挑战属性）

items.en: increase the cost of moving goods and maintaining retail inventory
items.why: 用两个动名词moving和maintaining构成平行结构，清晰对应成本的两项具体内容，比中国人易犯的不定式不平行错误更符合英文正式写作的严谨规范，逻辑清晰
items.when: 财经报告中阐述成本对应的具体活动内容时套用
items.slot: increase the cost of moving […] and maintaining […]
swap: raise the cost of transporting goods and keeping retail inventory（transporting侧重货运，keeping偏口语，适配性窄）
boost the cost of moving goods and to maintain retail inventory（不定式破坏平行结构，不符合正式写作要求）

items.en: The rules governing these banks were first established in 1993.
items.why: 用现在分词"governing"作后置定语修饰"rules"，简洁紧凑，避免了冗余的定语从句，中国人常习惯写"the rules which govern these banks"，表述更冗长。
items.when: 用于正式财经或监管报告中，修饰规章制度、条款等名词的场合。
items.slot: The rules governing […] were first established in […].
swap: The rules that govern these banks were first set in 1993.（用定语从句替代现在分词，语气稍正式但表述更冗长）
The rules governing these banks were initially set in 1993.（用"initially"替换"first"，强调初始性，语气略有差异）

items.en: represented 80%, 79% and 80% of our total revenues for 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively.
items.why: 用respectively精准匹配多组对应数据（百分比与年份），避免分述每年占比的冗余，中国人常直接罗列各年占比，结构松散
items.when: 正式财务报告（如SEC 10-K）中披露多组对应量化数据的场合
items.slot: represented […], […], and […] of our total revenues for […], […], and […], respectively.
swap: accounted for 80%, 79% and 80% of our total revenues for 2025, 2024, and 2023, correspondingly（correspondingly语气模糊，不如respectively精准对应）
made up 80%, 79% and 80% of our total revenues for 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively（made up偏口语化，不如represented正式）

items.en: Revenues derived directly, as a prime contractor, or indirectly, as a subcontractor, from contracts with the U.S. government
items.why: 用derived from明确收入来源，用as修饰身份（主承包商/分包商），结构清晰正式，中国人常写“revenues from direct contracts as prime and indirect as subcontractor”，缺少规范来源表述结构
items.when: 正式财务报告中界定收入来源及对应合作身份的场合
items.slot: Revenues derived […], as a […], or […], as a […], from contracts with […]
swap: Revenues generated directly, as a prime contractor, or indirectly, as a subcontractor, from contracts with the U.S. government（generated侧重创造，不如derived侧重来源精准）
Revenues coming directly, as a prime contractor, or indirectly, as a subcontractor, from contracts with the U.S. government（coming偏口语，不符合正式报告措辞）

items.en: Our U.S. government sales are concentrated with the DoW, which constitutes the majority of our U.S. government revenue for any given year.
items.why: 用定语从句which补充核心客户（DoW）的收入占比地位，紧凑且信息完整，中国人常拆成两句，逻辑衔接弱、正式度不足
items.when: 正式财务报告中披露客户集中度及核心客户地位的场合
items.slot: Our […] sales are concentrated with the […], which constitutes the majority of our […] revenue for any given year.
swap: Our U.S. government sales are concentrated with the DoW, and it constitutes the majority of our U.S. government revenue for any given year.（用and连接，逻辑紧凑度弱于定语从句）
Our U.S. government sales are concentrated with the DoW, which forms the majority of our U.S. government revenue for any given year.（forms语气稍弱，不如constitutes正式）

items.en: based on the competitive dynamics of each opportunity
items.why: 该写法用具体维度明确决策依据，避免模糊空泛，中文常写笼统表述，不够严谨
items.when: 说明业务角色、合作模式等决策依据的正式报告场景
items.slot: based on the competitive dynamics of […]
swap: in light of the competitive dynamics of […]（更正式，适合监管类报告）
depending on the competitive dynamics of […]（更灵活，适合内部分析）

items.en: derive a significant portion of our revenue from
items.why: 精准量化核心收入的来源占比，符合英文财经报告的正式书面表达习惯，中文常笼统写“我们的大部分收入来自”，缺少正式性与精准占比表述
items.when: 在财务报告中说明核心收入的主要来源场景时套用
items.slot: We derive a significant portion of our revenue from […]
swap: generate a large share of our revenue from（语气偏向市场份额视角，原句侧重来源的持续性）
obtain a substantial part of our revenue from（语气更正式，适合监管类文件）

items.en: A significant percentage of our revenue is derived from
items.why: 用被动语态客观表述收入结构占比，符合英文正式报告的中立性要求，中文常直接写“我们的很大一部分收入来自”，缺少被动语态带来的客观性
items.when: 在财务报告中客观说明收入的结构占比时套用
items.slot: A significant percentage of our revenue is derived from […]
swap: A large proportion of our revenue is generated from（更偏向运营视角，原句侧重来源的根源性）
A substantial percentage of our revenue is obtained from（更正式，适合SEC类监管文件）

items.en: had fallen to 2.3 percent from 2.8 percent a year earlier
items.why: 这个量化对比写法清晰严谨，符合财经报告的正式风格，中国人常直接写“decreased from X to Y”，缺少时态和具体时间参照，不够精准
items.when: 用于财务报告中描述指标同比变化的幅度
items.slot: had fallen to […] percent from […] percent a year earlier
swap: declined to […] percent from […] percent a year earlier（语气更中性，适合非紧急类报告）
decreased to […] percent from […] percent a year earlier（更简洁，适合短篇幅报告）

items.en: But, ultimately, the decision of when and how to innovate rests with each bank and its management.
items.why: 用「rests with」清晰表达责任归属，比中国人常用的「is the responsibility of」更简洁正式，符合财经报告的严谨性。
items.when: 用于财务尽职调查或审计报告中明确责任主体的场合。
items.slot: But, ultimately, the decision of when and how to […] rests with […]
swap: ultimately, the responsibility for deciding when and how to innovate lies with each bank and its management.（用「lies with」替换「rests with」，语气更中性）
ultimately, it is the responsibility of each bank and its management to decide when and how to innovate.（用形式主语it结构，更书面化，增强正式感）

items.en: Our job is to set clear expectations, be transparent, and not micromanage individual business decisions.
items.why: 用并列结构（set clear expectations, be transparent, not micromanage）清晰罗列职责，比中国人常用的「our responsibilities include」更简洁有力，符合报告凝练要求。
items.when: 用于财务尽职调查或审计报告中明确自身职责的场合。
items.slot: Our job is to set clear expectations, be transparent, and not micromanage individual […] decisions.
swap: Our responsibilities include establishing clear expectations, maintaining transparency, and avoiding micromanagement of individual business decisions.（用「establishing」「maintaining」「avoiding」替换动词短语，更书面化）
We are tasked with setting clear expectations, being transparent, and refraining from micromanaging individual business decisions.（用「are tasked with」替换「Our job is to」，语气更正式）

items.en: We can create a supportive regulatory environment by being receptive to new ideas and technologies.
items.why: 用「being receptive to」表达开放接纳的态度，比中国人常用的「accept」更委婉专业，符合财经报告中对创新的中立立场表达。
items.when: 用于财务尽职调查或审计报告中描述对新事物（如新技术、新方法）态度的场合。
items.slot: We can create a supportive […] environment by being receptive to […]
swap: We can foster a supportive regulatory environment by being open to new ideas and technologies.（用「foster」替换「create」，更具动态感；「open to」替换「receptive to」，语气更直接）
We can build a supportive environment by being amenable to new ideas and technologies.（用「build」替换「create」，「amenable to」替换「receptive to」，更强调愿意协商）

items.en: While the ballot box can’t change the risk of floods or hurricanes
items.why: 中文常生硬写“虽然投票箱不能改变…”，此用“While”引导让步状语，结构清晰衔接自然，符合英文正式文本逻辑连接习惯。
items.when: 撰写带有转折、让步逻辑的财经分析报告时。
items.slot: While the […] can’t change the risk of […]
swap: Although the ballot box cannot alter flood or hurricane risks（更书面化，适合学术报告）
Even though voting cannot change flood/hurricane risks（更强调程度，适合风险分析）

items.en: represented 56%, 26% and 18%, respectively, of our total service revenue
items.why: 中文常省略「respectively」导致多组占比对应关系模糊，该写法明确区分各项目占比，避免歧义，表述精准简洁。
items.when: 财务报告中列示多项指标对应占比时套用。
items.slot: represented […], […], and […], respectively, of our total service revenue
swap: corresponded to […], […], and […], respectively, of our total service revenue（对应，语气稍正式）
accounted for […], […], and […], respectively, of our total service revenue（占，更常用在收入占比场景）

items.en: compared to 61%, 25% and 14%, respectively, of our total service revenue of $995.0 million for the year ended December 31, 2024
items.why: 中文常分开表述两个期间指标，英文用compared to直接衔接对比项，结构紧凑，逻辑清晰，避免重复，提升阅读效率。
items.when: 财务报告中对比两个期间的指标结构时套用。
items.slot: compared to […], […], and […], respectively, of our total service revenue of $ [… million] for the year ended [Month Day, Year]
swap: as opposed to […], […], and […], respectively, of our total service revenue of $ [… million] for the year ended [Month Day, Year]（与…相对，语气更侧重差异对比）
versus […], […], and […], respectively, of our total service revenue of $ [… million] for the year ended [Month Day, Year]（vs，更简洁，常用于财务数据快速对比）

items.en: This corresponds with property taxes of just over $3,000 annually.
items.why: 中文常写冗余的连词衔接，此写法用动词直接关联两个对应指标，简洁正式，符合财经报告书面语要求
items.when: 用于报告中衔接存在对应关系的财务/市场指标，如资产价值与税费、售价与成本等
items.slot: […] corresponds with […]
swap: is linked to（侧重关联关系，弱化数值对应感）
aligns with（侧重一致性，适配合规类报告）
matches with（侧重匹配度，不如此写法自然）

items.en: increase the current homeowner’s homestead tax exemption to $150,000
items.why: 用具体数字明确量化调整幅度，中国人常写“increase the homestead tax exemption”，缺少具体数值，不够专业严谨。
items.when: 用于财务报告中说明政策调整的具体金额或指标。
items.slot: increase the current […]’s homestead tax exemption to $[…]0,000
swap: raise the current homeowner’s homestead tax exemption to $150,000（语气更正式，适合官方政策报告）
boost the current homeowner’s homestead tax exemption to $150,000（语气侧重提升动作，适合财务分析报告）

items.en: officially known as the Homestead Tax Exemptions, Property Assessments, and Spending Restrictions Amendment
items.why: 用“officially known as”明确标注官方正式名称，中国人常直接写名称，缺少正式性，不符合财经报告的规范表述。
items.when: 用于财务或政策报告中标注正式的法案或条款名称。
items.slot: officially known as the […] Amendment
swap: formally referred to as the Homestead Tax Exemptions, Property Assessments, and Spending Restrictions Amendment（更侧重正式指代，适合法律相关报告）
officially designated as the Homestead Tax Exemptions, Property Assessments, and Spending Restrictions Amendment（侧重官方指定，适合政策类报告）

items.en: The U.S. dollar continues to occupy a central role
items.why: 这个写法用“continues to occupy a central role”替代中国人常写的“is very important”，更具动态性和正式性，符合财经报告的严谨性，避免空泛的形容词堆砌
items.when: 用于财务尽职调查报告、审计报告中描述某核心主体（如货币、市场）的长期核心地位
items.slot: […] continues to occupy a central role
swap: […] remains a central player

[…] holds a pivotal position
前者侧重占据的状态，后者侧重关键作用，更正式

items.en: the potential to transform lives and the U.S. economy
items.why: 用名词化结构“the potential to...”替代直接主谓结构，更符合正式财经写作的客观正式风格，中国人常直接用“AI can transform...”，不够正式

the likelihood of transforming lives（更侧重概率）

items.en: Since we don't know which of these futures will come about
items.why: 用“Since”引出原因，比“Because”更委婉正式，符合财经报告的严谨语气，中国人常直接用“Because”，语气太直接
items.when: 用于正式报告中引出某个结论的原因
items.slot: Since we don't know which of these […] will come about
swap: Given that we cannot predict which of these futures will materialize（更正式，用materialize替代come about）

items.en: such as income and identity verification and homeowners and title insurance
items.why: 用and衔接列举项，正式且逻辑清晰，中国人常直接罗列或用顿号，不符合英文正式报告的列举规范。
items.when: 列举业务类型、服务范围等场合
items.slot: such as […] and […] and […]
swap: like […] or […]（更口语化，不适合正式报告）
including […] and […]（侧重包含关系，语气略弱）

items.en: even though they cause us to incur costs
items.why: 用even though引导让步状语，正式且自然衔接逻辑，中国人常生硬用but/however，破坏正式文本的流畅性。
items.when: 表达转折让步的正式说明场合
items.slot: even though […] cause us to […]
swap: despite the fact that […] result in us […]（更冗长，正式报告中略繁琐）
although […] lead to us […]（语气稍弱）

items.en: We focus our go-to-market strategy on financial services firms.
items.why: 用“focus...on...”精准点明市场策略的核心聚焦方向，符合正式报告的专业表述；中国人常直接写“我们的市场策略针对金融服务公司”，过于直白，缺乏英文商务写作的凝练感。

We direct our go-to-market strategy toward […]（更侧重方向指引）

items.en: identified stablecoins and advances in cross-border payment systems as among the innovations
items.why: 这个结构比中国人常写的“think […] are the innovations”更严谨，“identified as among”明确是从众多创新中筛选出的，符合财经报告的客观性要求。

items.slot: identified […] as among the innovations
swap: categorized […] as among the innovations（更侧重分类动作，少了原搭配的发现属性）
labeled […] as among the innovations（偏向定性归类，正式程度稍弱）

items.en: it helps to break income into its components
items.why: 用it作形式主语避免主观主语，更符合英文报告的客观正式语气；中国人常直接写“we should break income into its components”，显得主观随意
items.when: 用于英文报告中引出分析思路、拆解核心概念的场合
items.slot: it helps to break […] into its components
swap: It is useful to break […] into its components（语气更平实，适合正式报告）
This approach helps to break […] into its components（更强调方法的作用，适合审计报告）

items.en: reflect the supply of and demand for their skills
items.why: 用“reflect”清晰建立“现象→驱动因素”的逻辑关联，比“show”更具学术严谨性；中国人常写“show the supply and demand of their skills”，不够专业
items.when: 用于英文报告中说明某一结果背后的驱动因素的场合
items.slot: reflect the supply of and demand for […]
swap: indicate the supply of and demand for […]（语气更客观中立，适合审计报告）
demonstrate the supply of and demand for […]（更具说服力，适合分析类报告）

items.en: as our competitors invest more in their digital capabilities
items.why: 中文常直接写“竞争对手加大数字能力投入”，该写法简洁专业，明确了投入的具体方向，符合财经报告的规范表达
items.when: 用于描述竞争对手的战略动作，如市场竞争分析、业务展望部分
items.slot: as our competitors invest more in their […]
swap: as rivals increase spending on their digital tools (用词偏向工具，而非整体能力)
as competitors allocate more resources to their digital functions (更强调资源分配，而非投入动作)

items.en: Our ability to remain competitive will depend on our ongoing efforts
items.why: 中文常直接写“保持竞争力取决于持续努力”，该写法更正式，用“ability”明确主体能力维度，“ongoing efforts”强调持续性，符合SEC报告的书面要求
items.when: 用于正式报告中描述核心能力与关键动作的依赖关系，如风险因素、业务策略部分
items.slot: Our ability to remain competitive will depend on our […]
swap: Our capacity to stay competitive relies on our continuous efforts (用词用capacity而非ability，语气稍弱)
Our competitiveness will hinge on our ongoing initiatives (用hinge更强调核心依赖，initiative偏向项目而非努力)

items.en: including network optimization, advanced data analytics for operational and profitability insights, customer service enhancements, training and streamlined business processes
items.why: 用“including”引导平行结构的名词短语列举，结构清晰严谨，避免中文常出现的杂糅或非平行列举，符合专业报告的可读性要求。
items.when: 用于财务报告中陈述投资覆盖的具体细分领域的场合。
swap: such as […], […], […], […], and […]（语气更口语化，适合非监管类的业务报告）
namely […], […], […], […], and […]（更限定列举范围，适合明确覆盖全部领域的披露）

items.en: incentivized farmers to shift away from routine spraying toward a more watchful management approach
items.why: 用“incentivized sb to shift away from A toward B”清晰表达利益驱动下的行为转变，比中国人常用的“made sb change from A to B”更有逻辑层次，专业感强
items.when: 财务或行业报告中描述主体因激励发生行为转变的情况
items.slot: incentivized […] to shift away from […] toward a more […] approach
swap: encouraged farmers to move from routine spraying to a more attentive management approach（语气更温和，不如incentivized体现利益驱动的核心）
motivated farmers to switch from routine spraying to a more careful management approach（侧重内在动机，不如incentivized体现外部激励的动因）

items.en: have long been a focus of academics and policymakers alike
items.why: 正式表达某事物长期被两类主体共同关注，比中国人常写的被动式表述更符合学术报告书面语，且'alike'强调主体平等，避免生硬
items.when: 用于学术或政策报告中，介绍某议题长期受多类主体关注的情况
items.slot: The cross-border spillover effects of shifts in U.S. monetary policy have long been a focus of […] and […] alike
swap: have long drawn attention from academics and policymakers（更主动，适合非开篇场景）
have long been the focus of academics as well as policymakers（去掉alike，弱化主体平等强调）

items.en: depend both on the context in which the monetary policy changes are occurring
items.why: 用'in which'引导定语从句修饰'context'，比中国人常用的'where'更正式，'occurring'比'happen'更客观，符合财经报告规范
items.when: 用于分析政策影响的依赖条件，介绍某变量作用取决于具体语境的场景
items.slot: depend both on the context in which […] are occurring
swap: depend both on the context where monetary policy changes take place（用take place替换occur，更中性）
depend both on the context in which monetary policy shifts are happening（用shifts替换changes，更贴合政策术语）

items.en: sizable effects on economic activity and financial markets
items.why: 用'sizable'表示可观的规模影响，比中国人常用的'big'更专业，符合财经/学术报告术语习惯，精准体现影响程度
items.when: 用于描述变量对经济或金融领域的影响程度时
items.slot: sizable effects on […] and […]
swap: significant effects on economic activity and financial markets（significant侧重统计显著性，sizable侧重实际规模）
considerable effects on economic activity and financial markets（considerable侧重程度可观，适用范围更宽）

items.en: annual fee of 0.25% to 0.50% of assets under management
items.why: 中文直接表述费率，英文用“X% of Y”结构清晰量化费用与基数的对应关系，避免歧义，符合审计报告的精准性
items.when: 撰写财务收费标准、费率说明时套用
items.slot: [...] fee of [...] to [...] of assets under management
swap: annual charge ranging from 0.25% to 0.50% of AUM（用charge替换fee，AUM替换assets under management，更简洁专业）
yearly fee amounting to 0.25% up to 0.50% of managed assets（用yearly替换annual，侧重费用总额）

items.en: the value of human advice shows up as lower financial anxiety
items.why: 中国人易写“human advice’s value is lower financial anxiety”，这里用名词化主语（the value）搭配“shows up as”，结构更凝练，避免主动语态的生硬，适合研究发现的陈述。
items.when: 在研究报告中陈述某一因素的具体表现结果时使用。
items.slot: the value of […] shows up as […]
swap: the value of human advice appears as lower financial anxiety. （appears更正式，适配学术写作）
the value of human advice manifests as lower financial anxiety. （manifests更具学术性，强调现象的显现）

items.en: detailed attention across estate, investment, retirement, risk management and tax questions
items.why: 中国人常写“detailed attention in estate, investment...”，这里用“across”清晰覆盖多个领域，准确表达范围的广度，比“in”更贴合原文跨领域覆盖的含义。
items.when: 在财务报告中列举覆盖的多个业务领域时使用。
items.slot: detailed attention across […]
swap: detailed attention in estate, investment, retirement, risk management and tax questions. （in侧重单个领域，across侧重跨领域，适配原文范围）
comprehensive attention across estate, investment, retirement, risk management and tax questions. （comprehensive比detailed更强调全面性，适配不同语境）

items.en: exiting certain lower margin, non-strategic categories and channels
items.why: 用动名词短语直接列举业务剥离动作，比中文“退出某些低毛利、非核心品类和渠道”更简洁，省略冗余主语，符合英文正式报告的动作说明习惯。中国人常写带主语的完整句，这里结构更紧凑。
items.when: 在撰写业务调整、资产剥离的具体动作时套用，适合写战略执行的措施部分。
items.slot: exiting certain lower margin, non-strategic […] and […]
swap: discontinuing certain lower-margin, non-strategic lines and channels（discontinuing更侧重停止产品线运营，适合品类调整，语气更精准）
ceasing operations of certain low-margin, non-core categories and channels（更正式，适合审计报告的业务变动说明，语气更严谨）

items.en: optimizing our cost structure by rightsizing selling, general and administrative expenses
items.why: 用by引导方式状语说明成本优化手段，且使用专业术语rightsizing（合理调整规模），比中文“通过调整销售、一般及管理费用优化成本结构”更专业精准，符合财经报告术语规范。中国人常写“通过…来…”的结构，这里更紧凑地道。
items.when: 在撰写成本优化、费用管控的具体措施时套用，适合写企业运营效率提升的部分。
items.slot: optimizing our cost structure by rightsizing […] expenses
swap: reducing our cost structure by adjusting selling, general & administrative expenses（reducing更侧重成本缩减结果，比optimizing更强调目标，适合写成本控制目标）
streamlining our cost structure by aligning selling, general and administrative expenses（streamlining更侧重流程精简，适合运营效率优化，语气偏向流程调整）

items.en: soft costs are where a large share of the cost difference originates.
items.why: 这个用名词性从句作表语，精准点明成本差异的核心来源，正式且简洁，中国人常写“成本差异主要来自软成本”，表述啰嗦且未突出逻辑关联。
items.when: 撰写财经报告中分析两类项目成本构成差异的核心原因时使用。
items.slot: […] are where a large share of the cost difference originates.
swap: soft costs account for a large share of the cost difference（更直白，少了强调来源的正式语气）
soft costs are the main source of the cost difference（用名词短语更直接，正式感稍弱）

items.en: even when the buildings themselves are similar .
items.why: 用“even when”引导让步状语从句，精准衔接“建筑本身相似”的前提与“软成本仍高”的转折逻辑，正式且贴合语境，中国人常写“even though the buildings are similar”，少了对特定条件的强调，逻辑衔接稍弱。
items.when: 撰写报告中说明结论在特定条件下仍成立的情况时使用。
items.slot: even when the […] themselves are similar
swap: even though the buildings are similar（语气更弱，侧重让步而非特定条件）
even if the buildings are similar（偏向假设，不符合原文的事实语境）

items.en: much of what makes an affordable apartment expensive isn’t the building
items.why: 用“much of what...”作主语，清晰指代“导致保障房昂贵的核心因素”，正式紧凑，中国人常写“most of the reasons why an affordable apartment is expensive are not the building”，表述啰嗦且不够凝练。
items.when: 撰写报告中分析某类事物的核心驱动因素时使用。
items.slot: much of what makes […] expensive isn’t the […]
swap: most of the factors that make an affordable apartment expensive are not the building（更直白，少了指代性的紧凑感）
a large part of why an affordable apartment is expensive is not the building（稍口语化，不够正式）

items.en: Additional obligations regarding privacy, data protection, content, intellectual property, distribution, electronic contracts and other communications
items.why: 中文常写“还有关于隐私、数据保护等的额外义务”，此用法用“Additional obligations regarding + 并列名词短语”结构，正式且并列清晰，避免冗余连接词，符合英文财经报告书面规范，比中文写法更紧凑严谨。
items.when: 撰写合规义务、法规要求相关的正式报告，如财务尽职调查报告、SEC备案文件时套用。
items.slot: Additional obligations regarding […]
swap: Further requirements concerning [X]（更侧重监管要求，语气更正式，适用于监管相关报告）
Additional duties related to [X]（侧重职责层面的义务，适用于内部合规报告）

items.en: See the section titled "Risk Factors – Risks Related to Legal and Governmental Regulation" for additional information about the laws and regulations to which we may become subject and about the risks to our business associated with such laws and regulations.
items.why: 中文常写“更多信息请看风险因素部分”，此用法明确标注章节标题，交叉引用清晰，避免读者误解，符合正式报告索引规范，比省略章节标题的中文写法更严谨。
items.when: 正式报告中需交叉引用其他章节时套用，如审计报告、上市公司披露文件。
items.slot: See the section titled "[…]" for additional information about […]
swap: Refer to the section named "[…]" for further details on […]（“Refer to”更书面，“further details”侧重细节补充，语气更正式）
Please consult the section entitled "[…]" for more information regarding […]（“Please consult”更礼貌，适合向监管方/投资者提供指引的报告）

items.en: We aim to differentiate ourselves from other PEOs
items.why: 用“differentiate ourselves from”精准表达差异化定位，符合财经报告正式性；中国人常直译“make ourselves different from”，冗长且不够专业紧凑。
items.when: 用于企业在正式报告（如SEC 10-K）中介绍自身与同行差异的场合。
items.slot: We aim to differentiate ourselves from other […]
swap: distinguish ourselves from other PEOs：更侧重区分的明确性，比differentiate更正式
set ourselves apart from other PEOs：语气更口语化，适合非正式业务沟通

items.en: focus on improving our client and WSE experience
items.why: 中文常写'关注提升客户和WSE体验'，英文用'focus on improving [X] experience'的结构，比直白表达更符合商务写作的正式规范，逻辑清晰。
items.when: 用于描述客户服务、体验优化的业务方向时。
items.slot: focus on improving our […] experience
swap: concentrate on enhancing our client and WSE experience：更强调集中资源投入，语气更聚焦
prioritize improving our client and WSE experience：突出该事项的优先级，适合强调重点工作的报告

items.en: international operations are sometimes in countries with unstable governments
items.why: 中国人常写“overseas businesses are in some countries where governments are unstable”，此处用“international operations”更正式，“sometimes in countries with”比“in some countries where”更简洁，符合专业报告的表达习惯
items.when: 描述海外业务所在国家的环境风险时套用
items.slot: [international operations] are sometimes in countries with [unstable governments; economic or fiscal challenges; military or political conflicts; ...]
swap: overseas businesses are occasionally located in countries that have unstable governments：“overseas businesses”不如“international operations”正式，“occasionally located in countries that have”比原文表达更啰嗦
global operations are at times situated in countries with unstable governments：“global operations”范围过广，原文特指跨国运营，“at times situated”不如“sometimes in”简洁

items.en: Our channel partners include distributors, resellers, managed service providers, telcos, and global systems integrators.
items.why: 用“include”引出合作伙伴类型，比中文常用的生硬分类表述更自然正式，清晰列举不同主体，避免重复冗余。
items.when: 在正式财务报告中列举业务相关主体类型（如合作伙伴、供应商）时套用。
items.slot: Our [channel partners/key stakeholders] include [distributors/resellers/managed service providers/telcos/global systems integrators/…].
swap: Our channel partners consist of distributors, resellers, managed service providers, telcos, and global systems integrators. （语气偏向说明组成结构，灵活性弱于include）
Our channel partners are made up of distributors, resellers, managed service providers, telcos, and global systems integrators. （口语化较强，不适合正式报告）

items.en: Our renewals are associated with lower sales costs as compared to landing new customers
items.why: 用“as compared to”明确对比不同客户动作的成本差异，中国人常直接用“than”，但此处对比不同业务动作，“as compared to”更贴合正式报告的对比逻辑
items.when: 用于业务成本对比分析的场合
items.slot: Our […] are associated with lower […] as compared to […]
swap: Our renewals entail lower sales costs in comparison to acquiring new customers（更侧重成本的产生）
Our renewals come with lower sales costs relative to onboarding new customers（更侧重成本的附带属性）

items.en: Substantially all of the assets, liabilities and operations
items.why: 中文常写“几乎所有的”，但“Substantially all of”更符合SEC报告的正式严谨性，比“almost all”更具专业属性，避免口语化。
items.when: 正式财务报告中描述主体核心资产、负债及业务归属范围的场合。
items.slot: Substantially all of the [assets/liabilities/operations/…]
swap: Virtually all of the assets, liabilities and operations（Virtually更侧重实际层面，Substantially更侧重实质合规层面，更符合财务报告要求）
Nearly all of the assets, liabilities and operations（Nearly更口语化，不如Substantially正式）

items.en: we believe the world’s reliance on hydrocarbons will not disappear
items.why: 中文常直接用绝对化的“我们认为”表达，此处用believe的委婉措辞，符合正式报告的谨慎性，避免武断，更具说服力
items.when: 正式商业报告中表达非绝对化观点时
items.slot: we believe the world’s reliance on […] will not disappear
swap: We are of the view that the world’s reliance on […] will not vanish（语气更正式，学术感更强）
It is our view that the world’s reliance on […] will not cease to exist（更客观，弱化主语的主观感）

items.en: it is critical that we understand not only our current ESG positioning in the market
items.why: 中文常直接用生硬的“我们必须了解”，此处用it is critical that的强调结构，更正式严谨，突出事项的核心重要性，贴合SEC报告规范
items.when: 正式报告中强调某项核心工作必要性时
items.slot: it is critical that we understand not only our current […] in the market
swap: it is essential that we grasp our current […] in the market（语气稍弱，侧重基础重要性）
it is imperative that we comprehend our current […] in the market（语气更强，侧重紧迫性）

items.en: integrate a broader sustainability view to all of our activities
items.why: 中文常直接用普通的“融入”，此处用integrate sth to的专业正式搭配，比常用词更贴合财经报告语境，精准表达深度整合的动作
items.when: 正式报告中表达将某理念/视角整合到所有工作环节时
items.slot: integrate a broader […] view to all of our activities
swap: incorporate a wider […] perspective into all of our operations（搭配更常用，侧重主动纳入）
embed a more comprehensive […] approach into all of our activities（更强调深度嵌入，而非表面融合）

items.en: See “Commercial Agreements—Other Agreements with Third Parties—West Texas.”
items.why: 用“See + 具体章节引用”的方式清晰指引读者查阅相关内容，中国人常写“you can refer to the part about...”，不够简洁专业
items.when: 在报告中引用其他章节内容的场合
swap: Refer to “[…]”（语气更正式）
Consult “[…]”（更偏向专业报告的正式指引）

items.en: pair our hardware offerings with our remote manager device management platforms
items.why: 中文常写“将硬件产品与平台结合”，英文用pair...with...更简洁专业，符合财务报告正式性，避免口语化表达
items.when: 描述产品服务组合搭配策略时套用
items.slot: pair our […] with our […] platforms
swap: combine our hardware offerings with our remote manager platforms（语气侧重融合，原句侧重配对搭配）
link our hardware offerings with our device management platforms（语气侧重关联，原句侧重配对组合）

items.en: geographic diversity allows us to meet demand on a worldwide basis
items.why: 采用名词化主语（geographic diversity）作正式陈述，比中文常用的“因为地域多样化，我们能满足全球需求”更简洁专业，符合英文正式报告的书面表达习惯，中国人常写的句式更啰嗦。
items.when: 正式报告中阐述业务布局带来的核心能力优势的场合。
items.slot: […] allows us to meet demand on a worldwide basis
swap: geographic diversity enables us to satisfy global demand（更简洁直接，语气偏正式干练）
having a presence across regions helps us meet worldwide demand（更口语化，适合非正式报告）

items.en: For the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024
items.why: 中文财务报告常直接写“截至2025年和2024年12月31日的年度”，而该写法是SEC报告的标准正式表述，更简洁规范，符合专业报告写作惯例
items.when: 年度财务报告开头说明报告覆盖的时间范围时使用
items.slot: For the years ended […], […].
swap: During the fiscal years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024（语气偏向日常表述，正式程度略低于原句）
For the 12-month periods ended December 31, 2025 and 2024（更侧重期间属性，与原句年度属性略有差异）

items.en: due to one property sale in July 2025
items.why: 中文常直接用“因为”解释数据变动，而due to更适配正式财务报告，避免口语化，符合SEC正式写作要求
items.when: 解释财务指标变动的具体原因时使用
swap: as a result of one property sale in July 2025（语气更强调因果直接性，正式程度接近原句）
owing to one property sale in July 2025（书面化程度更高，适合更严谨报告场景）

items.en: mainly due to a reduction in headcount and a decrease in property related management expenses
items.why: 用“due to”明确原因，并列结构对称清晰，中国人常写“because we cut headcount and property management costs”，口语化且不专业。
items.when: 用于财务报告中解释费用或数据变动的主要原因。
items.slot: mainly due to a reduction in […] and a decrease in […]
swap: primarily attributable to a decrease in […] and a reduction in […]（同义，attributable更正式）
largely because of a cut in […] and a drop in […]（同义，语气稍随意）

items.en: These expenses represent direct payments to third parties for legal and filing fees, direct administrative costs, outside audit costs, taxes, insurance and other property costs
items.why: 用“represent”明确指代费用的性质，列举清晰有条理，中国人常写“these are money we paid to others for…”，不够正式严谨。
items.when: 用于财务报告中解释某项费用的构成和支付对象。
items.slot: These expenses represent direct payments to third parties for […]
swap: These costs constitute direct payments to external parties for […]（同义，constitute更正式）
These expenditures are direct payments to third parties for […]（同义，expenditures更强调支出属性）

items.en: Properties are carried at original cost, less accumulated depreciation and amortization.
items.why: 这是财务报告中资产计量的标准专业表述，符合SEC报告的正式规范，中国人常直译“资产按原始成本减去累计折旧和摊销计量”，用“carried at”的被动结构更贴合财务术语的正式性，避免口语化直译
items.when: 用于财务报告中表述资产初始及后续计量基础的场合，如SEC 10-K、财务报表附注等
items.slot: […] are carried at original cost, less accumulated depreciation and amortization.
swap: Assets are recorded at original cost, net of accumulated depreciation and amortization. （用recorded替代carried，语气稍弱，适用于非监管类财务说明）
Assets are stated at historical cost, less accumulated depreciation and amortization. （用stated替代carried，更侧重准则合规性，适用于正式报告）

items.en: comparing the property’s probability-weighted future undiscounted cash flows to its current carrying value
items.why: 用“probability-weighted”精准限定未来现金流的计算逻辑，符合财务减值测试的专业严谨性，中国人常省略该修饰，导致表述缺乏专业细节，不够精准
items.when: 用于财务减值测试、资产估值等需要量化表述的专业场合
items.slot: comparing the […] future undiscounted cash flows to its current carrying value
swap: comparing the property’s estimated future undiscounted cash flows to its current carrying value. （用estimated替代probability-weighted，语气偏向估算，适用于初步分析）
comparing the property’s weighted-average future undiscounted cash flows to its current carrying value. （用weighted-average替代probability-weighted，侧重平均权重，适用于简化分析）

items.en: an impairment loss is recorded to reduce the carrying value of the property to its net realizable value
items.why: 用被动语态+“recorded to”的结构明确财务处理的动作与目的，符合监管报告的正式性要求，中国人常主动表述“我们记录减值损失以…”，不符合SEC报告的正式规范
items.when: 用于财务减值损失确认、资产账面价值调整的表述场合
items.slot: an impairment loss is recorded to reduce the carrying value of the […] to its net realizable value
swap: an impairment charge is recorded to adjust the carrying value of the property to its net realizable value. （用charge替代loss，适用于非重大减值的表述）
an impairment loss is recognized to bring the carrying value of the property to its net realizable value. （用recognized替代recorded，更侧重准则确认，适用于正式报告）

items.en: maintain minimum ratios of common equity tier 1 capital ("CET1"), tier 1 capital, and total capital to total risk-weighted assets
items.why: 中文常直接用“保持最低比率”，此写法用正式结构明确监管指标的对应关系，更符合官方报告的严谨性，避免模糊表达
items.when: 撰写金融监管类英文报告，说明资本要求相关内容时
items.slot: maintain minimum ratios of […] to […]
swap: hold minimum required ratios of […] to […]（更强调监管的强制性要求）
keep minimum capital adequacy ratios of […] relative to […]（侧重资本充足性的表述）

items.en: consists primarily of common stock instruments (that meet the Basel III eligibility criteria)
items.why: 中文常省略条件直接写“主要由…组成”，此写法补充定语从句明确组成部分的资格条件，逻辑更清晰，符合专业报告精准性
items.when: 在金融监管报告中说明资本构成的组成及条件时
items.slot: consists primarily of […] (that meet […] criteria)
swap: is composed mainly of […] satisfying […] criteria（用更书面化的“composed”替代“consists”）
is made up primarily of […] that fulfill […] eligibility requirements（侧重“满足资格要求”的表述）

items.en: See "Part I, Item 1A. Risk Factors" for a discussion of
items.why: 中文常写“详见XX部分”，此处用“See […] for a discussion of”符合英文正式报告的交叉引用规范，明确指引到具体章节的讨论内容，衔接更自然。
items.when: 正式报告中指引读者到特定章节获取详细讨论内容。
items.slot: See "[…]" for a discussion of
swap: Refer to "[…]" for details on（更简洁，细节指向更明确）
Consult "[…]" for a discussion regarding（语气更正式，适合法律合规类文件）

items.en: We offer a competitive suite of treasury management services to meet the needs of our commercial customers.
items.why: 用"competitive suite"精准描述服务组合，比中国人常用的"many competitive services"更专业简洁，避免冗余。
items.when: 介绍公司核心服务或产品组合的场合。
items.slot: We offer a competitive suite of […] services to meet the needs of our […].
swap: We provide a competitive set of treasury management services to meet the needs of our commercial customers.（"set"侧重单个服务集合，语气比"suite"稍弱）
We offer a range of competitive treasury management services to meet the needs of our commercial customers.（"range"更宽泛，不如"suite"体现整合性）

items.en: We listen to the needs of our commercial clients that utilize these services
items.why: 用定语从句限定特定客户，避免重复指代，逻辑紧密，中国人常写"who use these services"或拆分句子，此写法更流畅自然。
items.when: 描述针对特定客户群体的服务反馈的场合。
items.slot: We listen to the needs of our commercial clients that […].
swap: We listen to the needs of our commercial clients who use these services.（"who"更侧重人，此处用"that"更中性，适合企业报告）
We listen to the needs of our commercial clients utilizing these services.（用现在分词简化，更紧凑，适合短报告）

items.en: tasked with growing the deposit base within the small business customer segment
items.why: 用过去分词短语后置修饰团队，简洁明确职责，中国人常加冗余的系动词"are"，此写法更精炼专业。
items.when: 介绍团队或岗位核心职责的场合。
items.slot: tasked with […] within the […] segment
swap: responsible for growing the deposit base within the small business customer segment.（"responsible for"更侧重责任归属，语气稍正式）
assigned to growing the deposit base within the small business customer segment.（"assigned to"更侧重任务分配，语气稍弱）

items.en: IWS focuses exclusively on the automotive finance market with its core VSA and related product offerings
items.why: 用副词 exclusively 精确限定专注范围，比中国人常用的 only focuses on 更正式且无歧义；with 结构带出核心产品，使句子紧凑
items.when: 在报告中描述公司业务聚焦或核心市场时
items.slot: [...] focuses exclusively on [...] with [...]
swap: concentrates solely on - 同样强调唯一性，但 concentrates 比 focuses 略重，适合书面
is dedicated exclusively to - 强调奉献，更表达战略承诺，不如 focuses 中性
specializes only in - 较口语，不够正式

items.en: much of its competition in the credit union channel has a less targeted product approach
items.why: 'much of its competition' 用抽象名词 competition 代指竞争对手群体，比 'most competitors' 更具报告语感；'less targeted' 准确指出针对性不足，避免模糊的 'broad'
items.when: 对比竞争对手的策略差异，尤其说明对方不够聚焦时
items.slot: much of [...] has a less [...] approach
swap: a majority of rivals adopt a more generalized approach - 同义但 generalize 更泛，未强调 focus 缺失
most other players take a scattergun approach - scattergun 比喻随意性，偏口语
the bulk of its competitors use a diffuse strategy - diffuse 偏向分散，不如 targeted 直观

items.en: They might be unable to deliver specialty expertise on par with IWS and may not give VSA products the attention they require for healthy profitability and strong risk management.
items.why: 连续使用 might 和 may 传达不确定的推测语气，避免断言；'on par with' 习语表达同等水平，精炼；中国学习者易用 cannot 或 be inferior to 等生硬表达
items.when: 分析竞争对手潜在不足或风险时，用于表达合理推测而非绝对判断
items.slot: [...] might be unable to [verb] on par with [noun] and may not [verb] the [noun] they require for [noun]
swap: could fall short of matching the specialized skills of - fall short 表达达不到，稍弱于 unable to
may lack the expertise comparable to - comparable to 替代 on par with，较直白
might not reach the same level of professional competency as - 冗长，不如 on par 简洁

items.en: Each one hundred basis point increase in CME Term SOFR, SOFR or the Prime Rate would result in
items.why: 用金融专业术语“基点（basis point）”量化利率变动，比百分比表述更精准专业；中文常直接说“利率上升X%”，缺少金融报告的专业细节
items.when: 用于金融报告中描述利率变动对财务影响的量化说明时
items.slot: Each one hundred basis point increase in […] would result in
swap: Every 1% increase in […] would lead to… 通俗化表述，专业度不足
A 100bp rise in […] would cause… 更简洁但正式度稍弱

items.en: assumes risk in professional, financial and personal lines of insurance
items.why: 用专业财经术语“assumes risk”精准表达再保险中主动承担风险的动作，中国人常使用普通动词如“takes”，此写法更符合SEC报告的专业语境。
items.when: 撰写保险、再保险业务中风险承担相关表述时套用。
items.slot: assumes risk in […] lines of insurance
swap: bears risk in professional, financial and personal insurance lines（bears侧重被动承受，assumes侧重主动承接，语义有细微差异）
undertakes risk in professional, financial and personal lines of coverage（undertakes更正式，coverage侧重保障范围，与insurance略有不同）

items.en: These initiatives and legislation include tort reform proposals, proposals addressing natural catastrophe exposures, terrorism risk mechanisms, federal financial services reforms, various tax proposals affecting insurance companies
items.why: 用平行名词短语列举相关事项，避免重复且逻辑清晰，中国人写正式报告时常直接罗列或用重复结构，此写法更显专业严谨
items.when: 用于正式报告中列举与主题相关的具体事项
items.slot: These […] include […]
swap: These […] encompass […]（更正式，强调涵盖范围更广）
These […] consist of […]（侧重说明组成部分，语气更客观）

items.en: unless prior approval is granted by a two-thirds vote of the Board of Directors, in which case the limit is increased to 15% of unimpaired capital
items.why: 用 unless... in which case... 形成紧凑的条件回指，比中国人常用的“if... not..., then...”更书面且逻辑严密，in which case 明确指代前述条件。
items.when: 需要表达“除非满足某先决条件，否则适用另一处理”的正式文件，如豁免审批条款。
items.slot: unless [...] is granted by [...], in which case [...] is increased to [...]
swap: unless ... is obtained through ..., in which case ... is raised to ... (obtained 比 granted 稍显主动，但仍正式)
except when ... is approved by ..., whereupon ... becomes ... (whereupon 较老旧，适合极正式法律文本)

items.en: restricts the Bank's permissible lending limits to one borrower to 10% of unimpaired capital
items.why: restrict ... to ... 两个 to 分别引出对象和幅度，精准简练；permissible lending limits 比 loan limits 更显合规意味。中国人容易写成 limit the bank’s loan to one borrower to no more than 10%，重复且松散。
items.when: 描述监管、政策对某项指标的精确限制时，如资本充足率、大额风险暴露。
items.slot: restricts [...] to [...] to [...]
swap: limits ... to ... to ... (limits 与 restricts 互换，语感稍弱但常见)
caps ... at ... for ... (caps 更口语化，常用于内部制度，正式程度略低)

items.en: The Board approved the increased loan limits to 15% of unimpaired capital in 2024.
items.why: 直接用 approved the increased loan limits 突出已调整后的限额作宾语，比 approved to increase... 更符合英文名词偏好的表达，in 2024 置于句末干净利落。中国学习者常直译“approved to raise the limit”，显得生硬。
items.when: 报告董事会或管理层对已生效调整的批准时，如新费率、修订后的政策。
items.slot: The Board approved the [modified/increased] [...] to [...] in [year].
swap: The Board authorized the raised limits... (authorized 比 approved 更强调授权动作，语气略官方)
The Board gave approval for the higher limits... (gave approval 偏口语化，正式报告中需谨慎使用)

items.en: Although consumer loans typically involve a higher level of risk than residential mortgage loans
items.why: 用Although引导让步状语从句衔接两类贷款的风险对比，逻辑严谨，结构清晰；中国人常写“Consumer loans have higher risk than residential mortgage loans”，缺少让步逻辑层次，不够专业。
items.when: 对比两类金融产品的风险、收益等属性时使用。
items.slot: Although […] typically involve a higher level of risk than […]
swap: While consumer loans generally carry greater risk than residential mortgage loans（更口语化，适合非正式说明）
Even though consumer loans usually entail higher risk than residential mortgage loans（语气更强，适合强调风险差异）

items.en: At December 31, 2025 , the Bank had $43.0 million in outstanding HELOCs
items.why: 用“At + 特定日期”明确财报数据的时点，“in + 产品”清晰指涉资产类型，符合SEC财报规范；中国人常写“On Dec 31,2025, the Bank had $43 million HELOCs outstanding”，语序混乱，不够正式。
items.when: 披露特定时点的资产余额（如贷款、证券）时使用。
items.slot: At […] , the Bank had $ […] million in outstanding […]
swap: As of December 31, 2025, the Bank held $43.0 million in outstanding HELOCs（财报标准表述，符合监管要求）
On December 31, 2025, the Bank had $43.0 million worth of outstanding HELOCs（更口语化，适合内部报告）

items.en: For a more detailed discussion of our credit quality measures
items.why: 用介词短语引出补充说明内容，正式报告中用于指引读者查看更多细节，比生硬引用更自然
items.when: SEC报告、年度报告中引用附注内容的场合
items.slot: For a more detailed discussion of our […] measures
swap: For further discussion of our credit quality measures（更简洁，适合篇幅有限的报告）
For a comprehensive discussion of our credit quality measures（强调全面性，适合深度说明的场合）

items.en: We have not generated positive cash flow from operations
items.why: 用现在完成时明确动作的持续影响，搭配状语from operations限定现金流类型，比中文常漏状语的写法更精准严谨，避免歧义
items.when: 撰写财务报告说明现金流状况时使用
items.slot: We have not generated positive cash flow from […]
swap: We have failed to generate positive operating cash flow（语气更负面，强调动作未达成的结果）
We have not succeeded in generating positive cash flow from operations（更正式，用succeeded体现尝试未成功）

items.en: If we are unable to generate positive cash flow or obtain sufficient capital when needed
items.why: 用省略式when needed替代完整从句，避免重复主语和谓语，比中文常写的冗余条件句更简洁紧凑，符合正式报告的简洁要求
items.when: 撰写报告中假设性条件条款时使用
items.slot: If we are unable to generate […] or obtain […] when needed
swap: If we cannot generate […] or secure […] when required（secure更正式，required比needed更书面化）
In the event we are unable to generate […] or obtain […] as needed（In the event比if更正式，as needed和when needed同义）

items.en: our business and future prospects will be adversely affected
items.why: 用被动语态弱化主观主语，搭配adversely精准限定影响性质，比中文常写的模糊表述“会受影响”更专业客观，符合正式报告的严谨性
items.when: 撰写报告中负面假设后果条款时使用
items.slot: […] will be adversely affected
swap: our business and future prospects will be negatively impacted（impacted侧重冲击感，语气比affected稍重）
our business and future prospects will suffer adverse effects（用suffer更具动态，effects更名词化）

items.en: range from 0% for low-risk assets such as U.S. Treasury securities and GNMA securities to 1,250% for various types of loans
items.why: 用"range from...to..."清晰绑定不同资产类别的数值范围，正式严谨，中国人常直接写"0% to 1250%"，缺少对资产类别的精准对应说明
items.when: 正式财务报告中描述不同类别的数值区间时套用
items.slot: range from […] for […] such as […] and […] to […] for […]
swap: vary between […] for […] such as […] and […] for […]（语气更灵活，适合内部报告）
fall within the range of […] to […] for […]（语气更保守，适合审计文件）

items.en: low-risk assets such as U.S. Treasury securities and GNMA securities
items.why: 用"such as"举例说明资产类型，正式规范，符合SEC报告书面语要求，中国人常使用"like"举例，不够正式
items.when: 正式报告中列举同类事物举例时套用
items.slot: low-risk assets such as […] and […]
swap: low-risk assets including […] and […]（强调包含关系，适合说明整体范畴）
low-risk assets like […] and […]（口语化，不适合正式报告）

items.en: Company and the Bank are required to have
items.why: 用被动语态的“are required to”正式表达合规要求，比中国人常用的主动“must have”更符合SEC报告的正式严谨语气，弱化强制感更显客观
items.when: 撰写金融监管合规条款的正式报告场合
items.slot: [Entity] are required to have […]
swap: must have 语气过于强硬，不符合正式报告的中立性
shall have 更偏向法律合同文本，不适合常规监管报告

items.en: equity Tier 1 risk-based ratio, an 8.0% Tier 1 risk-based capital ratio and a 10.0% total risk-based capital ratio
items.why: 用逗号分隔前两个并列项，最后用and连接最后一项，符合英文正式列表的规范，中国人常直接用逗号连接所有项，结构不清晰。
items.when: 撰写正式报告中多个并列指标列举的场合。
items.slot: […], an [….] Tier 1 risk-based capital ratio and a [….] total risk-based capital ratio
swap: equity Tier 1 risk-based ratio, an 8.0% Tier 1 risk-based capital ratio, a 10.0% total risk-based capital ratio（缺少and连接最后项，不符合正式英文列表规范）
equity Tier 1 risk-based ratio, 8.0% Tier 1 risk-based capital ratio and 10.0% total risk-based capital ratio（省略冠词an/a，正式度不足）

items.en: Forward-looking statements may be identified by reference to a future period or periods or by the use of terms such as "anticipates," "believes," "could," "estimates," "expects," "forecasts," "goals," "guidance," "intends," "may," "objectives," "plans," "possible," "potential," "projects," "seeks," "should," "targets," "will," or variations of these terms
items.why: 用被动语态加"may be identified by"的正式表述，清晰说明识别前瞻性陈述的标准，同时列举术语的方式规范；中国人常直接写"You can tell forward-looking statements by words like…"，太口语化且不符合正式报告的被动规范
items.when: 在定义前瞻性陈述的识别方法时使用
items.slot: [Type of statements] may be identified by reference to a future period or periods or by the use of terms such as "[Term1]," "[Term2]," …, or variations of these terms
swap: Forward-looking statements can be identified by reference to a future period or periods or by the use of terms such as …（用"can"替换"may"，正式性稍弱，"may"更符合法规语境的委婉性）
Forward-looking statements are identifiable by reference to a future period or periods or by the use of terms such as …（用"are identifiable"替换"may be identified"，语气更绝对，不符合SEC风险表述的委婉要求）

items.en: could, among other things, cause our actual results to differ from those expressed in forward-looking statements
items.why: 用插入语"among other things"软化绝对因果，避免断言唯一影响因素，中国人常直接写"will cause"，表述生硬且不够严谨
items.when: 撰写风险披露、前瞻性声明等需避免绝对化的正式报告场合
items.slot: [...] could, among other things, cause our actual results to differ from those expressed in forward-looking statements
swap: might, among other factors, lead to our actual outcomes differing from those stated in forward-looking statements（语气更委婉，弱化影响的确定性）
may, inter alia, result in our actual results varying from those conveyed in forward-looking statements（用inter alia替换among other things，更正式）

items.en: become subject to decreased sales volumes, progressive price reductions, or both
items.why: 中文常直接写“销量下降、价格降低”，英文用“become subject to + 并列影响，加or both覆盖两种情况同时发生的可能，表述更审慎严谨，符合正式报告要求。
items.when: 描述业务可能面临的潜在负面影响时套用。
items.slot: become subject to […], progressive price reductions, or both
swap: face lower sales volumes, gradual price cuts, or a combination （替换后用更口语化的face，适配内部报告）
be exposed to reduced sales volumes, sequential price decreases, or both （替换后用exposed to，语气更正式）

items.en: These statements are "forward-looking statements" within the meaning of Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and Section 21E of the Exchange Act.
items.why: 该写法是正式合规报告中明确定义术语的标准表述，中国人常直接使用术语而不标注法规来源，显得不够严谨合规。
items.when: 适用于SEC filings、年报等正式合规报告中定义专业术语的场合。
items.slot: These statements are "[…]" within the meaning of Section […] of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and Section […] of the Exchange Act.
swap: These statements constitute "forward-looking statements" under Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and Section 21E of the Exchange Act. （差在“constitute”比“are”更具法律正式性，适合法规语境）

The statements herein are "forward-looking statements" pursuant to Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and Section 21E of the Exchange Act. （差在“pursuant to”比“within the meaning of”更书面，符合法律文书的严谨风格）

items.en: Readers are cautioned not to place undue reliance on these forward-looking statements.
items.why: 该写法用被动语态“are cautioned”中立提醒读者，避免主观表述，中国人常直接说“we caution readers”，显得不够客观正式。
items.when: 适用于正式报告中提示投资者注意事项、避免过度依赖表述的场合。
items.slot: Readers are cautioned not to place undue reliance on these […] statements.
swap: Investors are advised not to place excessive reliance on such forward-looking statements. （差在“Investors”更精准指向报告受众，“advised”语气比“cautioned”稍弱，“excessive”比“undue”更口语化）
Users of this report are warned not to place unwarranted reliance on these forward-looking statements. （差在“Users of this report”涵盖所有报告使用者，“warned”语气更强，“unwarranted”比“undue”更强调不合理性）

items.en: due to higher sales to commercial and industrial customers
items.why: 用due to衔接原因，比中国人常用的because更正式，避免口语化，符合专业报告要求。
items.when: 撰写财务报告时说明事项发生的原因。
items.slot: […] due to […]
swap: as a result of […]（更正式，适合正式报告）
because of […]（更口语化，不适合正式报告）

items.en: materially and adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations
items.why: 中文常直接写「严重影响」，此处用两个专业副词修饰动词，符合英文正式报告的严谨性，避免口语化表达
items.when: 撰写风险影响类正式报告的场合
items.slot: […] our financial condition and results of operations
swap: seriously and negatively impact（materially更符合SEC合规表述，seriously偏口语化）
severely and unfavorably affect（adversely比unfavorably更贴合财务报告语境）

items.en: due to economic downturns, competitive pressures or reduced demand
items.why: 中文常直接罗列原因，此处用due to引导正式原因，且采用平行列举结构，逻辑清晰专业
items.when: 分析事件发生原因的正式报告场合
items.slot: due to […] , competitive pressures or reduced demand
swap: as a result of economic recession, competitive pressures or lower demand（due to比as a result of更简洁正式）
owing to economic slumps, competitive pressures or decreased demand（downturns比slumps更贴合SEC常用表述）

items.en: demonstration of sufficient income to repay the principal and interest and the real estate taxes and insurance
items.why: 用名词化结构（demonstration）替代中文常用的动词开头表述，更正式简洁，符合财经报告的严谨性，中国人常写“需要证明有足够收入”，此写法更贴合英文专业写作习惯
items.when: 撰写财务尽职调查或审计报告中，明确某项业务的前提条件时使用
items.slot: demonstration of sufficient […] to repay the principal and interest and the real estate taxes and insurance
swap: proof of adequate income to repay：proof比demonstration更口语化，adequate比sufficient语气稍弱，适合非正式程度稍高的报告
evidence of enough income to repay：enough比sufficient更口语化，evidence侧重证据性，与demonstration的证明性略有差异

items.en: could in the future have a material impact
items.why: 用委婉的情态动词加未来时间限定，避免绝对化风险表述，符合英文财经报告的审慎语气，中国人常直接写“会有重大影响”，太生硬绝对。
items.when: 财务报告风险披露、业务影响分析的场合
items.slot: could in the future have a material impact on our […]
swap: may potentially have a significant effect（语气更弱，委婉度更高）
might in the coming period have a material influence（时间限定更具体，影响范围稍窄）

items.en: delays in new procurements, reductions in price and contract scope, and contract terminations
items.why: 用名词化并列结构替代动词短语，更简洁正式，符合英文财经写作的凝练风格，中国人常写“new procurements are delayed, prices are reduced”，太口语化不够正式。
items.when: 列举业务影响、风险表现的场合
items.slot: delays in […], reductions in […] and […]
swap: delays to new procurements, decreases in pricing and contract scope, and contract cancellations（用词更正式，terminations换为cancellations更书面）
postponements of new procurements, cuts in pricing and contract scope, and contract terminations（postponements比delays更强调推迟，语气稍重）

items.en: which contains about 10% alcohol and 90% water
items.why: 用定语从句补充说明前文的“beer”成分，结构紧凑符合英文正式报告风格；中国人常拆成两个独立短句，零散不够凝练
items.when: 用于正式报告中补充说明前文提及的具体物质的成分特征
items.slot: which contains about […]% alcohol and […]% water
swap: that contains about 10% alcohol and 90% water（用that替代which，正式度略低，适合稍灵活的正式语境）
with about 10% alcohol and 90% water（用介词短语作定语，更简洁适合紧凑文本）

items.en: We do not have sufficient revenue to pay our operating expenses at this time
items.why: 该句用do not have sufficient...to...结构，正式准确陈述当前资源不足的情况，中国人常写的对应表达更口语化，此结构更贴合正式报告的陈述逻辑
items.when: 正式财务报告中陈述当前主体资源不足以覆盖某项支出时套用
items.slot: We do not have sufficient […] to pay our operating expenses at this time
swap: Our revenue is insufficient to cover our operating expenses now（更简洁但稍显生硬）
We lack enough revenue to pay our operating expenses currently（lack侧重缺失，语气不如原句正式）

items.en: Our net loss for the year ended November 30, 2025, was $2,279,604 compared to $47,945 for the year ended November 30, 2024.
items.why: 中国人常写成 'Our net loss was... and last year it was...'，显得业余。这里用 'for the year ended [Date]' 这一标准审计语言，并用 'compared to' 干净利落地在一句话中完成跨期对比，非常符合SEC披露规范。
items.when: 适用于审计报告或DD报告中，对比两个会计年度的财务数据（如净利润、营收、亏损等）。
items.slot: Our [...] for the year ended [...], was [...] compared to [...] for the year ended [...].
swap: Our net loss of [Amount] for the year ended [Date] represents an increase from [Amount] in the prior year. (更强调增长趋势，语调偏向客观财务分析)
We recorded a net loss of [Amount] for the fiscal year ended [Date], up from [Amount] in the previous year. (以第一人称主动语态开头，常用于管理层讨论与分析 MD&A，语气更具叙事性)

items.en: These losses were entirely attributable to operating expenses
items.why: 中国人解释原因常套用 'because of' 或 'due to'，显得单调。这里使用 'be entirely attributable to'（完全归因于），不仅用词专业，而且 'entirely' 展现了审计和DD中对资金流向和损益构成的绝对精确性。
items.when: 适用于分析亏损、费用激增或收入变动的根本原因，进行财务归因分析。
items.slot: These [...] were entirely attributable to [...]
swap: These losses were driven solely by operating expenses. (用 driven solely by，语气更具动态感，强调费用是亏损的唯一驱动力)
These losses resulted exclusively from operating expenses. (用 resulted exclusively from，语气更偏向因果结论，强调结果来源的排他性)

items.en: as the Company has not yet commenced principal operations and has not generated any operating revenues to date
items.why: 中国人常写 'because the company didn't start business and has no revenue now'。原文用 'commenced principal operations'（启动主营业务）和 'to date'（迄今为止），措辞极其严谨、专业，符合初创期或壳公司审计披露的标准法律语体。
items.when: 适用于尽调或审计中描述标的公司处于初创阶段、尚未产生营业收入的现状。
items.slot: as the Company has not yet commenced [...] and has not generated any [...] to date
swap: since the Company remains in the pre-revenue stage and has not initiated its core business activities to date. (使用 pre-revenue stage，语气更偏向投行和VC尽调风格)
inasmuch as the Company is still in its developmental phase with no operating revenues recorded to date. (使用 developmental phase，语气更为保守和法律化)

items.en: maximizes the use of observable inputs and minimizes the use of unobservable inputs
items.why: 中国人常写成 try to use observable data as much as possible and avoid unobservable data，显得口语化且缺乏规范感；动词 maximize/minimize 后接 the use of 构成平行动宾短语，是合规与审计语言中表达“优化使用原则”的标准书面表达。
items.when: 用于说明报告方法论、审计程序设计或定量模型建构中的优先使用原则。
items.slot: maximizes the use of […] and minimizes the use of […]
swap: prioritizes the use of […] over […]（更侧重表达优先次序而非极值控制）
optimizes the reliance on […] while reducing […]（语气稍软，侧重动态优化与削减依赖）

items.en: developed based on market data obtained from sources independent of our Company
items.why: 中国人容易写出 from third-party sources that are independent from...，造成形容词与从句堆叠；此句直接用后置形容词短语 sources independent of [entity]，搭配分词结构 obtained from，层层限定且极其紧凑严密。
items.when: 用于尽调报告或审计报告中说明数据源、评估依据或第三方证明的独立性与客观性。
items.slot: developed based on […] obtained from sources independent of […]
swap: derived from third-party data independent of […]（表达更紧凑，突出第三方数据属性）
compiled using information sourced independently from […]（强调信息获取过程的独立性）

items.en: reflect our Company’s assumptions about the factors that market participants would use in valuing the asset or liability
items.why: 中国人常直译为 show what market participants think，缺乏财会语言的严谨度；此句用 reflect assumptions about factors，配合条件虚拟语气 would use in，精准表达了主观估计与假设的严谨边界，既专业又留有合规回旋余地。
items.when: 用于尽调报告或估值复核中阐述管理层估计、不可观察参数及主观假设的合理性与依据。
items.slot: reflect […]’s assumptions about the factors that […] would use in […]
swap: incorporate management's expectations regarding key parameters that […] would consider when […]（更强调管理层预期与关键参数的纳入）
are based on internal estimates of how […] would evaluate […]（语气更直接，表明基于内部估计）

items.en: reflect our management's beliefs and views with respect to future events
items.why: 中国人常习惯用 about 或 regarding，表达较为单一。这里用 with respect to 替换 about，搭配 reflect management's beliefs and views，显得非常规范严谨，是审计与财报中标准的高阶书面语。
items.when: 用于在尽调报告或审计报告开头说明管理层对未来事项的评估依据与观点时。
items.slot: reflect […] beliefs and views with respect to […]
swap: express our views on […]（语气较为口语化，不如财报标准用词严谨）
represent management's position regarding […]（侧重表达立场而非信念与看法）

items.en: the extent to which any factor, or combination of factors, may cause actual results to differ materially from those contained in any forward-looking statements we may make
items.why: 中国人易写成 how much factors cause results different from...，既口语化又缺乏严密性。该句使用 the extent to which 精准界定影响程度，用 differ materially 限定“重大差异”，并以 combination of factors 囊括多因素叠加效应，极其严密。
items.when: 用于风险评估或尽调报告，分析单项或复合风险因素对财务预测或实际业绩可能产生的重大偏差时。
items.slot: the extent to which […], or combination of […], may cause actual results to differ materially from […]
swap: how much […] could lead to results different from […]（语言过于口语，缺少专业审计规范感）
the degree to which […] may result in material deviations from […]（同等严谨，deviations 侧重偏离程度）

items.en: you should not place undue reliance on these forward-looking statements
items.why: 中国人常写 you should not trust these statements too much，显得直白且缺乏专业度。place undue reliance on 是合规与法律文本的经典搭配，undue（不当的、过度的）比 too much 更精准，place reliance on 比 trust 正式得多。
items.when: 用于报告的免责声明或限定条件中，提醒报告使用者不要过度依赖未经审计的数据或前瞻性预测时。
items.slot: […] should not place undue reliance on […]
swap: you should not rely excessively on […]（用词略显生硬，表达不够地道）
readers are advised not to overly rely on […]（采用被动语气，警示力度弱于原句）

items.en: provides numerous competitive advantages that reduce overall costs
items.why: 中国人常直译“带来很多优势”（brings many advantages），而使用“provides numerous competitive advantages that...”结合关系代词从句，既显得严谨专业，又能无缝衔接具体的降本增效价值。
items.when: 撰写尽调报告或审计评价，说明某项技术或控制流程为企业带来多重竞争优势时套用。
items.slot: provides numerous competitive advantages that […]
swap: delivers several distinct operational edges that […]（语气更偏重运营落地维度的具体功效）
offers significant strategic benefits including […]（语气偏高管与战略分析视角）

items.en: improve marketing collaboration while increasing record label revenue and cash flow
items.why: 表达“在……的同时增加……”时，中国人容易写成冗长的 and at the same time it increases，用 while doing... 引导的伴随状语能极其精炼地表达双重协同效应。
items.when: 分析某项业务改进或合规措施同时带来正向双重效果（如增效与降本/控险并存）时套用。
items.slot: improve […] while increasing […]
swap: enhance […] while simultaneously boosting […]（语气更强，强调两端同步爆发的动作感）
optimize […] and concurrently drive […]（语气更书面严肃，常用于正式管理层分析）

items.en: We are unaware of any other service that provides these global distribution functions.
items.why: 表达独家性或缺乏替代品时，中国人极易写成过于绝对的 No other service provides，财报与审计中常使用 We are unaware of... 进行合规对冲，既陈述了市场优势又避免了绝对化的法律担保风险。
items.when: 在尽调报告中说明未发现替代供应商、未获悉合规违规风险或市场无同类竞争产品时套用。
items.slot: We are unaware of any […] that […]
swap: To the best of our knowledge, no other […] provides […]（语气带有法律声明色彩，强调基于目前已知信息）
We have not identified any alternative […] that offers […]（语气偏审计查验视角，强调经过排查未发现）

items.en: diversified our portfolio into a variety of niche markets
items.why: 中国人常直译为 expanded our business to many small markets，用词偏口语且平淡；用 diversified our portfolio into 搭配 niche markets，更能精准体现财报中对资产与业务组合的战略规划感。
items.when: 用于说明被投企业通过拓展细分市场来分散单一业务风险或优化收入结构时。
items.slot: diversified [...] portfolio into a variety of [...] markets
swap: expanded our business footprint into specialized segments（偏向说明业务足迹扩展，战略感略弱于 portfolio）
broadened our offering across distinct verticals（偏重产品或服务覆盖面的拓宽，而非资产配置）

items.en: vary in intensity and duration from that of the general economy
items.why: 中国人常写成 are different from the economy in intensity and duration，句式单调；原句用 vary in A and B from that of C，结构严谨，且用代词 that of 精准指代前面提到的名词，避免重复。
items.when: 用于尽调报告中对比目标公司业务周期、财务指标与宏观经济或同业大盘的差异维度。
items.slot: vary in [...] and [...] from that of [...]
swap: differ in [...] and [...] relative to that of [...]（表达较为日常，不如原句具有投行和审计报告的正式感）
deviate in [...] and [...] from baseline [...]（偏向强调偏离基准线或异常波动，语气更重）

items.en: Our footprint expansion includes locations dedicated to our ProSolutions and ProContractor business to better support our growing specialty equipment and services operations.
items.why: 用 footprint expansion 替代平庸的 expanding branch network，且用 locations dedicated to 表达“专门设立的业务点”，避免了中式英语 expanding locations to do... 的平铺直叙。
items.when: 报告中汇报公司线下渠道扩张、新设网点及其战略支撑作用时。
items.slot: Our footprint expansion includes locations dedicated to […] to better support […]
swap: Our geographic expansion involves facilities tailored to […] to support […] (偏向地理区域拓展，语调略微抽象)
We are adding new sites specifically for […] to better serve […] (口语化表达，不够正式和精炼)

items.en: We will continue to pursue initiatives that allow us to drive more volume through existing branches
items.why: 中国人常写 increase sales in branches，而原句用 drive more volume through 极为地道，生动表达“通过既有渠道吞吐并消化更多业务量”。
items.when: 尽调或审计报告中描述公司如何提升现有网点产能与存量渠道效率时。
items.slot: We will continue to pursue initiatives that allow us to drive more volume through […]
swap: We will sustain programs designed to boost throughput across […] (更偏向运营与系统产能的表达，强调效率)
We will keep trying to increase sales in […] (语言平铺直叙，缺乏管理层报告的战略修饰感)

items.en: and we will also take advantage of cross-selling opportunities to increase our share of our customers’ total rental spend.
items.why: 中国人易直白写成 make customers spend more，原文使用 increase our share of our customers' total spend（提高在客户总支出中的占比），体现了专业的钱包份额（share of wallet）商业量化视角。
items.when: 分析客户粘性、交叉销售潜力和客户钱包份额提升策略时。
items.slot: and we will also take advantage of […] opportunities to increase our share of our customers’ total […] spend.
swap: and we will leverage […] opportunities to capture a larger portion of client budgets. (投行咨询风格，用 capture budget 替换)
and we will aim to sell more services to clients to boost overall spend. (语言较为直白，缺少量化视角)

items.en: represented approximately 38% of our equipment rental revenue
items.why: 中国人常用 accounted for 或 made up，而用 represent 表达“占…的比重”最具 SEC 报告的高级文本质感，显得更加书面化与客观。
items.when: 在尽调或审计报告中描述某类客户、业务线或产品占总收入、总成本的比重时。
items.slot: represented approximately […]% of our […] revenue
swap: accounted for approximately 38% of our equipment rental revenue（更侧重数据核算与占比统计，属于最中规中矩的审计表述）
comprised approximately 38% of our equipment rental revenue（侧重描述整体结构中的组成部分）
made up approximately 38% of our equipment rental revenue（口语化和普通商务写作常见，但在 10-K 或高规格报告中专业感稍逊）

items.en: We serve various types of general contractors and subcontractors
items.why: 中国人容易写成 Our customers include many kinds of...，显得句式零散且偏被动。用 We serve + 客户类型，以主动语态简洁高效地展开客群分类，符合官方公告的简练风格。
items.when: 在尽调报告的业务概况或客户结构分析章节中引入服务对象时。
items.slot: We serve various types of […]
swap: We cater to a broad range of general contractors and subcontractors（语气更侧重满足不同客户群体的特定需求与偏好）
Our customer base consists of various types of general contractors and subcontractors（静态展示客群构成的名词化客观表述）
We focus on supplying various types of general contractors and subcontractors（更强调业务方向和资源倾斜的侧重点）

items.en: We serve industrial customers across a broad range of industries
items.why: 中国人常用 in many industries 或 covers various sectors，显得平铺直叙。用 across a broad range of 既地道又严谨，能精准表达业务覆盖面的跨度与广度。
items.when: 用于尽调报告或财报中描述目标公司的客户群分布、业务覆盖领域或市场范围时。
items.slot: We serve [...] customers across a broad range of [...]
swap: The company operates across a wide spectrum of [industries]（更强调行业跨度如同光谱般连续且广泛）
The business caters to clients across diverse [sectors]（语气略微平实，侧重客户类型的多元化）

items.en: We believe that key drivers of growth within the industrial market include increased levels of spending on industrial capital and maintenance, repairs and operations.
items.why: 中国人写归因分析常依赖 because 或 is caused by 等口语化连词。原文使用 key drivers of growth include + 名词短语（increased levels of spending），将复杂的因果逻辑提炼为专业的高阶财经名词表达。
items.when: 用于尽调报告或审计分析中归纳驱动业绩增长、利润率变动或行业需求的关键因素时。
items.slot: We believe that key drivers of [growth] within [the market] include [increased levels of spending on ...]
swap: Growth in [the market] is predominantly driven by [increased investments in ...]（被动语态，更突出背后的驱动力量）
The primary catalysts for growth in [the market] are [higher spending on ...]（使用 catalysts，语气更强，强调关键催化因素）

items.en: Industrial customers represented approximately 25% of our equipment rental revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025.
items.why: 中国人表达占比时极易套用 make up 25% 或 is 25%。在 SEC 文件和审计报告中，用 represented/accounted for approximately X% of revenue 才是合规且极为地道的标准财务规范。
items.when: 用于财务尽调、审计底稿或业绩汇报中核算收入结构、客户集中度或业务板块占比时。
items.slot: [...] represented approximately [25%] of [our equipment rental revenue] for the year ended [December 31, 2025]
swap: [Segment] accounted for approximately [25%] of total revenue for [the period]（审计报告中最常见的同等严谨替代写法）
[Segment] contributed approximately [25%] to total revenue for [the period]（更侧重强调该业务对总收入的贡献力度）

items.en: which incorporates certain investments that are currently recovered through the DIR
items.why: 中国人常习惯写 includes 或 contains，用 incorporates 显得更加专业，且强调将特定项目‘融为一体/纳入计算’；使用 recovered 表示费用或投资的‘收回’，比 collected 更符合专业财务语境。
items.when: 审计报告中解释某项收入要求或财务调整项中包含某些特定投资或费用补偿时套用。
items.slot: which incorporates certain […] that are currently recovered through […]
swap: which includes certain […] that are currently collected via […]（语气较为口语化，严谨度稍逊）
which reflects certain […] currently recouped through […]（语气同样专业，更侧重表达财务影响的体现）

items.en: a return on equity of 9.999% and a cost of long-term debt of 4.49% on a distribution rate base of $1.25 billion
items.why: 中国人常因连接多个比例和基数而把介词写混；此处用 of 紧跟具体百分比，再用 on 准确指向‘基于……基数’，结构极度紧凑且平行对仗。
items.when: 财务尽调或报告中需要同时列出多种收益率/成本率及其对应的计算基准金额时套用。
items.slot: a […] of […] and a […] of […] on a […] base of […]
swap: a […] of […] along with a […] of […] applied to a […] base of […]（语气稍微繁复，更侧重动作的应用过程）
a […] of […] and a […] of […] calculated on a […] base of […]（语气更显强调计算逻辑）

items.en: based on a capital structure of 53.87% equity and 46.13% long-term debt
items.why: 中国人常写成 which consists of...；这里直接用 of 加‘百分比+类别’的并列，干练无赘字，非常地道地呈现了资本结构的配比。
items.when: 尽调报告或估值模型中说明假设或实际资本构成比例时套用。
items.slot: based on a capital structure of […] equity and […] long-term debt
swap: based on a capital structure comprising […] equity and […] long-term debt（语气同样正式，强调包含关系）
with a capital structure split into […] equity and […] long-term debt（语气偏尽调简报风格，强调结构拆分）

items.en: receives revenue from the RTO related to AES Ohio’s transmission assets and incurs costs associated with its load obligations for retail customers
items.why: 表达收入与成本的双向匹配时，中国人常写 gets revenue and pays costs。原文使用会计地道表达 receives revenue... and incurs costs（产生/承担成本），并交替使用 related to 与 associated with，展现出高级财经写作的词汇丰富度与严谨性。
items.when: 尽调或审计报告中描述某项资产或业务同时产生收益与对应成本义务时。
items.slot: receives revenue from […] related to […] and incurs costs associated with […]
swap: generates income from […] and bears expenses relating to […]（语气更侧重经营成果与费用承受度）
recognizes revenue from […] and records costs incurred in connection with […]（语气更偏向会计核算与账单记载）

items.en: includes a provision that allows Ohio electric utilities to seek and obtain a reconcilable rider to recover RTO-related costs and credits
items.why: 说明法规依据时，中国人易写 rule says companies can get...。原文用 includes a provision that allows... 精确指明‘法规包含具体条款’，并用并列动词 seek and obtain（申请并获得）精准区分开‘提交申请’与‘最终取得’两个行政/法律阶段。
items.when: 报告中引用法律法规、行业政策或合同条款作为成本回收或机制申请依据时。
items.slot: includes a provision that allows […] to seek and obtain […] to recover […]
swap: contains a clause permitting […] to apply for and secure […]（侧重合同条款的许可与取得）
provides a statutory mechanism for […] to request and receive […]（侧重法定救济机制与程序正当性）

items.en: continues to recover non-market-based transmission and ancillary costs through its non-bypassable Transmission Cost Recovery Rider
items.why: 表达‘通过某种机制持续回收成本’时，中国人常写 keep getting back costs by using...。原文使用 continues to recover [...] through [...] 极其干练，配合精细的属性修饰词（如 non-market-based, non-bypassable），体现出专业披露的严密逻辑。
items.when: 说明企业如何利用特定收费机制、附加费（rider）或调价机制持续收回特定成本时。
items.slot: continues to recover […] through its […]
swap: remains entitled to recoup […] via […]（侧重法律权利与索偿资质）
persistently offsets […] by means of […]（侧重财务动作上的费用抵销）

items.en: The company exclusively operates within the realm of owning and managing Pismo Coast Village RV Resort.
items.why: 中国人常写 'The company only operates...' 或 'The company's business is only...'，显得口语且单薄。用 'exclusively operates within the realm of' 能极具法律和公文严肃感地界定业务边界，'realm' 一词比简单的 'field' 或 'area' 更显规范。
items.when: 用于尽调报告或审计报告开头明确标的公司的唯一主营业务范围与经营边界。
items.slot: The company exclusively operates within the realm of [owning and managing ...].
swap: The company's operations are strictly confined to [V-ing/NP]（语气更加强调受限与合规边界）
The entity operates solely in the business of [NP]（表述更为直接通用，侧重单一经营）

items.en: Pismo Coast Village RV Resort stands as a comprehensive, full-service facility featuring 400 spaces for recreational vehicles, as well as a video arcade, laundromat, restaurant and general store.
items.why: 中国人容易写成 'X is a big center with...'。原文用 'stands as' 替代平淡的 'is'，用现在分词 'featuring...' 挂接主要资产规模，再用 'as well as...' 自然过渡到次要配套，句式层次感强且极具说服力。
items.when: 用于审计或尽调报告中详细介绍公司核心重资产、项目场所的规模及配套全貌。
items.slot: [Company/Asset] stands as a [comprehensive, full-service facility] featuring [...], as well as [...].
swap: [Asset] serves as an integrated facility offering [...]（语气偏向强调功能性与服务供给）
[Asset] represents a premier facility equipped with [...]（语气偏向突出资产在行业中的地位与配置）

items.en: The Company has remained conservative when considering rates and rate increases.
items.why: 用 remain conservative 定性公司的经营风格与决策，比静态的 is cautious 更有动态延续感，能凸显公司长期的稳健策略。
items.when: 在财务尽调中归纳管理层经营风格、会计估计或定价政策时。
items.slot: The Company has remained conservative when considering […].
swap: The Management has consistently adopted a prudent approach toward […] - 语气更偏规范审计，凸显谨慎性原则
The Company has maintained a cautious posture regarding […] - 语气偏战略投研，强调对市场变化的防御姿态

items.en: As a result of experiencing increasing operational expenses and conducting a local comparative rate study,
items.why: 用介词短语接双动名词结构（experiencing... and conducting...）归纳复合原因，比用一连串 because 从句更具高级商务文本的严密逻辑感。
items.when: 在尽调或审计报告中说明某项经营决策或财务指标变动的多重前因时。
items.slot: As a result of experiencing […] and conducting […],
swap: Driven by ongoing […] and following […], - 语气更侧重于战略驱动力
In light of […] combined with […] - 语气更客观，强调多项事实叠加带来的影响

items.en: It is anticipated that these rate increases should not negatively impact the Company's ability to capture an optimum market share
items.why: 采用无人称被动句 It is anticipated 配合 should，做前瞻预测时留有余地，比直接用 We believe 或 will 更符合合规与风险对冲（hedging）的要求。
items.when: 在报告中评估某项财务或价格调整对未来市场份额/营收影响时。
items.slot: It is anticipated that […] should not negatively impact […]'s ability to […]
swap: It is expected that […] will have a negligible effect on […] - 语气确信度更高，表述更直接
Management reasonably believes that […] is unlikely to impair […] - 语气明确归因于管理层的判断，责任主体更清晰

items.en: To the extent that cash flow from operations is insufficient
items.why: 中国人习惯直接用 If 开头（如 If cash flow is insufficient），而用 To the extent that 能更精确地表达“在某种程度/范围内”的条件限定，是 10-K 和审计报告中严谨度极高的条件句表达。
items.when: 用于说明在特定程度或范围内出现某种不利财务状况（如现金流不足、债务违约）时的应对机制。
items.slot: To the extent that […] is insufficient
swap: If […] is insufficient（中规中矩的普通条件句，语气较平淡直白）
In the event that […] becomes insufficient（偏正式的法律文本语气，强调突发事件触发）
Should […] prove insufficient（商务书面倒装句，语气严谨高雅）

items.en: can be expected to cause quarterly fluctuations in our revenue
items.why: 中国人常直白写 will cause，语气过于绝对。用 can be expected to 留有余地，将“必然结果”转化为“合理预期”，体现审计与财务尽调所需的客观态度与免责意识。
items.when: 用于分析已知风险因素或季节性特征对财务指标（如收入、利润）可能带来的影响。
items.slot: can be expected to cause […] in […]
swap: will likely result in […]（表达概率高，但语气不如 expected 客观）
is anticipated to lead to […]（偏向预算与预测分析中的正式展望语气）
could potentially bring about […]（推测意味更重，对因果关系的确定性较低）

items.en: harmed the operating performance of the Central Coast leisure industry generally
items.why: 中国人表达负面影响时极易滥用 have a bad impact on 或 negatively affect，用动词 harm 结合 operating performance 可以更直接、简洁地定性经营业绩受到的直接损害。
items.when: 用于总结宏观环境、行业危机或突发事件对特定板块或目标公司经营业绩造成的负面打击。
items.slot: harmed the operating performance of […]
swap: adversely affected the financial results of […]（审计报告中最标准的严谨用词，语气中立书面）
had a negative impact on the operations of […]（较通俗的常见写法，表达较为平淡）
impaired the profitability of […]（更侧重于对盈利能力或资产价值造成实质性重创）

items.en: Should an uninsured loss or a loss in excess of insured limits occur, we could lose all or a portion of the capital we have invested in the Resort, as well as the anticipated future revenue from the Resort.
items.why: 中国人习惯用 If... 来引导条件句，这里使用虚拟倒装语序 Should... occur 显得极为正式严谨；且用 in excess of insured limits 表达“超额损失”，比常见的 more than... 更贴合金融法律规范。
items.when: 在尽调报告或审计风险提示中，针对极罕见但破坏力巨大的假设性风险进行严谨说明时。
items.slot: Should [...] occur, we could lose all or a portion of [...], as well as [...].
swap: If [...] occurs, we may lose all or part of [...] and [...] (普通条件句表达，专业严谨度与正式感稍逊)
In the event that [...] occurs, we risk losing [...] along with [...] (用 In the event that 引导，措辞较为平实繁琐)

items.en: In that event, we might nevertheless remain obligated for any notes payable or other financial obligations related to the property.
items.why: 中国人常写 we still need to pay，这里使用 might nevertheless 巧妙引入转折与语气软化，并用 remain obligated for 替换 be responsible for，瞬间提升审计报告的专业质感。
items.when: 说明即使发生极端资产损失或不可抗力，某方仍无法豁免后续财务债务或法律责任时。
items.slot: In that event, [...] might nevertheless remain obligated for [...].
swap: Even so, [...] would still be liable for [...] (常规商业书面语，语气较为直接硬梆)
Under such circumstances, [...] shall remain responsible for [...] (法律条款式表达，用于尽调报告分析时显得过于强硬)

items.en: Under these circumstances, the insurance proceeds we receive might be inadequate to restore our economic position on the damaged or destroyed property.
items.why: 中国人容易写成 not enough to pay for the loss，这里用 proceeds 精确指代“理赔款/收益”，并用 restore our economic position 将“弥补物理损失”提升至财务尽调高度的“恢复经济地位/财务状况”。
items.when: 评估赔款、追偿金或救济款项无法全额覆盖损失、无法重塑原有财务状况时。
items.slot: Under these circumstances, [...] might be inadequate to restore [...] economic position on [...].
swap: In such cases, [...] may not be sufficient to fully cover the financial damage to [...] (常见财务表述，侧重覆盖损失而非恢复财务地位)
Consequently, [...] could fall short of offsetting the total financial loss on [...] (侧重表达资金产生缺口，视角略有差异)

items.en: There is no deferred maintenance on any of the Resort's facilities.
items.why: 中国人常将“无欠修/无延期维护”错译为 no delayed repair。在固定资产尽调与财报中，deferred maintenance 是极标准的专业词汇，特指因资金或计划被推迟的必要维保，搭配介词 on。
items.when: 资产尽调评估 PPE（厂房设备）物理状态、预估后续 CapEx 或审计资产减值时。
items.slot: There is no deferred maintenance on any of […]'s facilities.
swap: No maintenance has been deferred for […]（更强调维护动作本身无拖欠，语气偏客观核查）
All facilities of […] are fully maintained with no backlog of repairs（侧重表达“无积压维修任务”，适合尽调简报）

items.en: The Company's facilities are in good condition and adequate to meet the needs of the shareholder users as well as the public users.
items.why: 中国人常写 The facilities are very good and can satisfy...。原文用 in good condition（物理状态良好）与 adequate to meet...（能力/产能充足）形成平行修饰，精准区分了“质量好”与“容量够”两个维度。
items.when: 审计或尽调报告中说明公司经营性资产的物理状态及其对业务履约的保障能力时。
items.slot: […]'s facilities are in good condition and adequate to meet the needs of […] as well as […].
swap: The facilities remain well-maintained and sufficient to satisfy […]（语言更平实，常见于日常尽调摘要）
The operational assets are in sound working order and fully capable of addressing […]（更强调资产运行正常，偏风控报告风格）

items.en: The Company continues to develop sufficient revenue from general public sites sales to support a continued positive maintenance program and to meet the demands of shareholders use of free sites.
items.why: 中国人习惯写 makes enough money to pay for...。原文用 develop revenue 表达“开拓/获取收益”，并用 to support... and to meet... 双不定式结构，极为清爽地串联起“造血来源”与“多项支出用途”。
items.when: 论述业务板块的自我造血能力能否持续覆盖运营成本及特定履约需求时。
items.slot: The Company continues to develop sufficient revenue from […] to support […] and to meet […].
swap: The Company generates adequate revenue from […] to fund […] and fulfill […]（财务分析师更习惯使用的标准动词搭配）
Cash flows derived from […] remain sufficient to sustain […] and satisfy […]（强调现金流视角，客观度更高）

items.en: strong price realization contributed to a 27% year-over-year net sales increase
items.why: 中国人常写 price increase，而 realization 体现了提价在市场端真正落地并转化为收入的专业财务视角。contributed to 比 simple led to 更具归因分析的严谨感。
items.when: 在分析收入增长驱动因素，特别是强调提价效应而非仅仅是销量增长时。
items.slot: strong price realization contributed to a […] % year-over-year […] increase
swap: led to a rise in (语气较平淡，缺乏财务专业度)
was the primary driver of (更强调该因素是首要驱动力)

items.en: growing at a double-digit rate year-over-year, excluding the impact of acquired backlog
items.why: 中国人常用 except for，而 excluding the impact of 是标准的审计/尽调语言，用于专业地剔除不可比因素或非经常性损益。
items.when: 在解释剔除非经常性项目、并购因素或汇率影响后的内生增长情况时。
items.slot: growing at a […] rate year-over-year, excluding the impact of […]
swap: net of the effect of (更偏向于净值计算的语境)
on an organic basis, which sets aside (强调内生增长，语气更委婉)

items.en: Consolidated operating income for the fourth quarter was $83.5 million
items.why: 中国人受中文思维影响常写成 In the fourth quarter, the income was...。原文采用 [科目] for [期间] was [数值] 的结构，将核心审计科目置于句首，重心更突出，符合专业报告的陈述逻辑。
items.when: 在审计报告或尽调报告中开门见山地陈述特定期间的财务指标数值。
swap: [...] for the [...] totaled [...] (强调总额或汇总数)
[...] for the [...] stood at [...] (语气较中性，常用于描述处于某一水平)

items.en: which applies to all of our directors, officers, and employees
items.why: 中国人常写 is applicable for 或 is for，而 applies to 直接用动词界定适用范围，是合规和政策文件中最标准、地道的写法。
items.when: 在尽调报告或审计说明中界定某项内控制度或会计准则的适用对象时。
items.slot: which applies to all of [our ...]
swap: is applicable to (语气更偏向静态描述，不如原句动词化地道)
covers (更强调覆盖面，常用于审计抽样或保险范围描述)

items.en: prohibits our directors, officers, and employees and any entities they control from
items.why: 中国人习惯用 cannot 或 are not allowed to，显得口语化。Prohibit... from 是典型的监管法律语言，且包含了“关联实体” (entities they control) 的严谨表述。
items.when: 在审计报告中描述被审计单位的禁止性规定或内控缺陷时。
items.slot: prohibits [...] and any entities they control from [doing something]
swap: precludes (侧重于从程序上排除可能性)
restricts (语气较轻，侧重于限制而非完全禁止)

items.en: In fiscal year 2025, the Company’s Adjusted EBITDA increased 127% compared to the prior year period.
items.why: 中国人习惯用 During... 或者把时间状语放在句末。这种以 In fiscal year [Year] 开头并紧跟“主体 + 指标 + 变动率”的结构，是 SEC 10-K 报告中最干练、最高效的陈述方式。
items.when: 在撰写审计总结或财务摘要，按年度概述核心经营指标的变动情况时。
items.slot: In fiscal year […], the Company’s […] increased […]% compared to the prior year period
swap: For the fiscal year 2025, Adjusted EBITDA grew by 127% (语气平缓，侧重于年度整体表现)
Fiscal year 2025 saw a 127% increase in Adjusted EBITDA (以年份为主语，更具叙述性和动感)

items.en: the non-PEO NEO CAP increased 30% compared to the prior period
items.why: 注意这里省略了 year。在同一段落已经建立年度背景后，使用 prior period 既能保持专业度，又能避免重复 prior year period 导致的行文啰嗦。中国人往往会死板地重复长词组。
items.when: 在同一段落中已经提及过年份，随后对比次要指标或补充数据时。
items.slot: […] increased […]% compared to the prior period
swap: rose 30% over the previous period (用 over 替换 compared to，表达更简洁)
represented a 30% increase from the prior period (强调该增幅在整体数据中的代表性)

items.en: Our healthcare provider solutions form the core of Veradigm offerings.
items.why: 中国人常写 is the main part 或 is the most important business，用 form the core of 显得更有结构感，能精准描述某项业务在整体商业版图中的“压舱石”地位。
items.when: 在财务尽调中描述目标公司的核心收入来源或核心资产构成时。
items.slot: […] form the core of […]
swap: constitute the backbone of (语气更强调支撑作用)
represent the primary driver of (语气更强调增长动力)

items.en: help healthcare provider practices of all sizes and specialties
items.why: 中国人习惯用 different sizes 或 various types，而 of all sizes and [specialties] 这种后置定语结构更符合地道商业公文的韵律，且覆盖面表达得更极致。
items.when: 描述客户群体的多样性、样本覆盖范围或被审计单位的分支机构分布时。
items.slot: […] of all sizes and […]
swap: across various scales and (更强调跨度)
regardless of size or (更强调无差别覆盖)

items.en: Since January 1, 2023, our business has been comprised of three business segments
items.why: 中国人习惯用 consist of 或 is divided into。comprised of 语气更正式、更具审计报告的法律严谨感；使用完成时态 has been 准确表达了自特定日期起状态的延续性。
items.when: 在尽调报告开头描述公司业务架构或组织变更时。
items.slot: Since […], our business has been comprised of […] business segments
swap: is structured into (强调组织架构的搭建)
consists of (较为通用但专业度略低)

items.en: Our revenue arrangements commonly include support and maintenance
items.why: 中国人常写 Our income comes from。revenue arrangements 是典型的会计语言，指代收入背后的合同安排；commonly include 这种概括性表述在审计中非常安全，避免了漏掉次要收入项的风险。
items.when: 在财务审计报告中描述收入确认政策或收入构成时。
items.slot: Our revenue arrangements commonly include […]
swap: revenue streams primarily consist of (侧重资金流向)
contractual frameworks typically involve (侧重合同框架)

items.en: improve the quality, efficiency and value of healthcare delivery
items.why: 中国人描述改进往往只说 improve the quality。这里采用“质量、效率、价值”三位一体的排比，从多维度量化了业务产出，是典型的 10-K 商业价值描述范式，能显著提升报告的专业深度。
items.when: 在尽调中评价标的公司的产品竞争力或技术优势时。
