items.slot: improve the quality, efficiency and value of […]
swap: enhance the performance and output of (侧重性能表现)
optimize the operational effectiveness of (侧重运营效能)

items.en: do not believe that the loss of any single customer would materially and adversely affect us
items.why: 使用了审计和法律报告中的标准双连词 materially and adversely。中国人常写 have a big impact，不如这个组合专业。materially 对应‘重要性’原则，精准界定了影响的性质。
items.when: 在尽职调查报告中评估潜在风险、合同违约或客户流失对公司经营的影响时。
items.slot: do not believe that the [...] would materially and adversely affect us
swap: would significantly impact us (语气较中性，缺乏审计报告的严谨感)
would have a detrimental effect on us (侧重于损害，不如 adversely 专业)

items.en: No single customer accounted for more than 10% of our revenue
items.why: accounted for 是描述财务占比的标配动词。中国人常误用 occupies 或 takes up，在财务语境下显得业余。此句用 No single... 开头，比 The revenue from any customer is less than... 更显干练。
items.when: 描述客户集中度、产品收入构成或资产占比时。
items.slot: No single [...] accounted for more than [...] of our [...]
swap: represented more than (同样地道，但在财务报表附注中 accounted for 更常见)
constituted more than (侧重于成分构成，常用于描述资产组合)

items.en: Substantially all of our revenue is generated from customers located in the United States
items.why: Substantially all 是极高频的专业术语，指‘绝大部分’（通常指90%以上）。中国人爱用 Almost all 或 Most of，前者太口语，后者界定模糊，不如 substantially 具有法律和会计上的分量。
items.when: 在审计报告中界定业务范围、地理来源或资产归属的集中度时。
items.slot: Substantially all of our [...] is generated from [...]
swap: The vast majority of (较通用，但不如 substantially 具有审计严谨性)
Nearly all (口语化，不建议出现在正式财务报告中)

items.en: Our Payer business addresses the core aspects of value-based care
items.why: 中国人常用 deals with 或 solves the problems of，显得口语化且生硬。addresses 语气更专业，搭配 core aspects 强调了业务触达了该领域最关键的维度。
items.when: 在审计报告或尽调报告中，描述被审计单位的业务职能如何应对特定行业挑战时。
items.slot: [Our business unit] addresses the core aspects of [...]
swap: tackles the fundamental issues of (语气更强，侧重于克服困难)
focuses on the primary elements of (中性描述，侧重于业务重心)

items.en: enables payers and providers to deliver improved patient outcomes at a lower cost
items.why: 中国人习惯用 helps ... get ... results，而 enables ... to deliver 体现了赋能与产出的专业逻辑，deliver outcomes 是典型的财经报告用词，比 get results 更具商业正式感。
items.when: 评价被审计单位的产品、服务或内控流程如何为利益相关方创造价值或优化成本时。
items.slot: enables [...] to deliver [...] at a [...]
swap: empowers [...] to achieve [...] (语气更积极，强调赋予对方能力)
facilitates the delivery of [...] (侧重于过程的简化和促进)

items.en: spanning analytics, clinical data exchange, provider engagement, and regulatory submissions
items.why: 中国人列举范围时几乎只会用 including 或 such as。使用 spanning 作后置定语，能体现出业务覆盖面广、具有跨度，增强了描述的全面性和专业深度。
items.when: 在尽调报告中界定业务范围、服务内容或风险检查点的覆盖领域时。
swap: encompassing [...] (强调包含在内，边界感更强)
covering a broad spectrum of [...] (强调多样性和广泛的覆盖面)

items.en: Bancorp became the 100% successor owner of a Nevada-based insurance captive
items.why: 使用 successor owner 极其专业地界定了“继受所有权”，比简单的 owner 更能体现法律和税务权利义务的承接关系。中国人常写成 acquired the company，无法体现法律上的连续性。
items.when: 在并购尽调或审计报告中，描述收购方承接被收购方特定资产或法律实体的地位时。
items.slot: [...] became the 100% successor owner of a [...]
swap: is the sole shareholder of (仅体现股权关系，不体现权利继承)
assumed full ownership of (侧重于承担/接管的动作，法律严谨度稍逊)

items.en: possibly disallow the related tax benefits, both prospectively and retroactively.
items.why: 这是法律和财务报告中描述效力的顶级副词对仗。中国人常说 in the future and the past，而专业报告用 prospectively（向后/未来生效）和 retroactively（追溯生效）。
items.when: 描述法规变更、准则调整或合同条款的追溯效力范围时。
items.slot: [...] both prospectively and retroactively.
swap: with both forward-looking and historical effect (表意尚可但不够地道)
applicable to future and prior periods (标准但不如副词对仗简洁有力)

items.en: there is no reserve for an uncertain tax position based on the final regulation.
items.why: there is no reserve for 是典型的审计语言，指“未计提准备金”。uncertain tax position 是会计准则（如 ASC 740）下的专有名词，比中国人爱用的 tax risk 专业得多。
items.when: 在审计报告或 DD 财务影响评估中，说明针对某项潜在合规风险是否进行了会计处理。
items.slot: there is no reserve for [...] based on [...]
swap: did not accrue any liability for (侧重于会计入账动作)
no provision was made for (英式会计常用，侧重于拨备)

items.en: is the difference between interest income earned on loans, investment securities and other interest earning assets less interest expense on deposit accounts and other interest bearing liabilities
items.why: 定义“净额”时，中国人习惯用 A minus B 或 A after deducting B。原文使用 the difference between [A] less [B] 结构，将“差额”作为名词核心，less 充当介词引导扣除项，这是会计定义中最高级且地道的写法。
items.when: 在财务报告或审计底稿中定义任何“净值”指标（如毛利、利差、净资产）的计算逻辑时。
items.slot: [指标名称] is the difference between [...] less [...]
swap: represents the excess of [...] over [...] (侧重于强调溢出或盈余部分)
is calculated as [...] net of [...] (更强调扣除后的结果状态)

items.en: New business volume is influenced by economic factors including market interest rates, business spending, consumer confidence and competitive conditions within the marketplace, as well as Bancorp’s strong sales focus
items.why: 在列举驱动因素时，中国人往往只会用 including... and...。原文先用 including 列出一系列外部客观因素，最后用 as well as 顺势引出内部主观因素，层次感极强，避免了长句列举的单调感。
items.when: 在管理层讨论与分析（MD&A）或 DD 报告中分析业绩变动的原因，且需要区分内外因时。
items.slot: [指标] is influenced by [...] including [...], as well as [...]
swap: is driven by a combination of [...] and [...] (强调内外因共同作用)
is attributable to [...] in addition to [...] (侧重于归因分析的补充)

items.en: demonstrating the value of the diversified revenue streams created by our broad product offerings
items.why: 使用现在分词引导结果状语，将枯燥的财务数据直接升华为战略意义。中国人常写 'This shows that...' 显得口语化且断句碎，不如用 demonstrating 衔接紧凑，显得逻辑性极强。
items.when: 在列举完增长或占比数据后，紧跟该数据背后的管理层意图或业务优势。
items.slot: demonstrating the value of […] created by […]
swap: underscoring the resilience of (更强调在压力下的稳健性)
reflecting the effectiveness of (更强调管理层决策的有效性)

items.en: constituted 44%, 45% and 43% of total non-interest income for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.
items.why: 'constituted' 是描述占比的高级词汇。使用 'respectively' 结尾是财报标准写法，能一次性清晰对应多个年份的数据，避免重复造句，符合审计报告的简洁要求。
items.when: 在审计报告或尽调报告中对比跨年度的财务指标占比时。
items.slot: constituted […] of [Total Category] for the years ended [Dates], respectively.
swap: accounted for (最常用的替代词)
represented (强调在整体中的代表性)

items.en: as well as retirement plan management for businesses and corporations in all markets in which Bancorp operates
items.why: 中国人常习惯用 and 或 also 简单罗列，该写法用 as well as 区分主次业务，并用 in all markets in which... operates 严谨界定业务覆盖的地理或行业范围，避免了表达单一。
items.when: 在描述公司业务范畴或服务覆盖的特定市场范围时。
items.slot: as well as [...] for [...] in all markets in which [...] operates
swap: including [...] across all regions where [...] has a presence (语气更偏向存在感而非经营活动)
alongside [...] within every territory where [...] conducts business (语气更正式，强调商业行为)

items.en: The magnitude of WM&T revenue distinguishes Bancorp from other community banks
items.why: 相比于 A is different from B because... 这种中式直译，该写法将“规模/量级(magnitude)”作为主语，用 distinguishes 动词直接驱动结论，显得更具分析深度和专业感。
items.when: 在财务分析中强调某项指标的规模是公司核心竞争优势或独特标志时。
items.slot: The magnitude of [...] distinguishes [...] from [...]
swap: The scale of [...] sets [...] apart from [...] (语气更具动感，强调脱颖而出)
The sheer volume of [...] differentiates [...] from [...] (语气更强烈，强调数量上的绝对优势)

items.en: may lead to a decline in these markets
items.why: 国人常写成 'may cause these markets to decline'。使用名词短语 a decline in... 将动作名词化，使句子结构更紧凑，符合审计报告中描述趋势变化的客观语感。
items.when: 描述市场需求或财务指标下滑的因果关系时使用。
items.slot: […] may lead to a decline in […]
swap: may result in a contraction of these markets (contraction 比 decline 更具专业深度)
may trigger a downturn in these market segments (trigger 强调触发性，语气更重)

items.en: may in turn result in fluctuations in our sales and results of operations
items.why: 国人常写成 'will make our sales change'。result in fluctuations 既专业又模糊了波动的方向性，符合审计中对不确定性描述的审慎原则，in turn 巧妙连接了前后因果。
items.when: 在风险因素章节解释某一事件如何导致财务数据波动时使用。
items.slot: […] may in turn result in fluctuations in […]
swap: may subsequently cause volatility in our financial performance (volatility 比 fluctuations 更具金融属性)
may lead to variability in our reported sales and earnings (variability 强调数据的不稳定性)

items.en: impose a number of restrictions on our operations
items.why: 中国人常写成 'have many restrictions on'，显得口语化且缺乏力度。'impose' 准确传达了合同条款的强制性和权威感，'a number of' 比 'many' 更具书面语的客观性。
items.when: 在尽职调查报告中描述合同、法律法规或合规要求对业务的限制时使用。
items.slot: impose a number of restrictions on […]
swap: place various constraints on (语气较温和，程度略轻)
subject our operations to certain limitations (强调业务处于被动受限状态，更正式)

items.en: adversely affect our ability to market and sell vehicles
items.why: 中国人常写成 'hurt our business' 或 'make it hard to sell'，显得口语化且缺乏专业度。'Adversely affect' 是审计和尽调报告中描述负面影响的标准用语，既客观又正式。
items.when: 在尽调报告中描述风险因素对公司业务能力或财务状况的负面冲击时使用。
items.slot: adversely affect our ability to […]
swap: negatively impact (语气略轻，较常用)
impair our ability to (强调受损程度，更具法律/财务严谨性)

items.en: as well as reduce our volume of business
items.why: 中国人常无脑用 and，导致长句逻辑平庸。as well as 在此处起到递进作用，将两个负面影响（成本增加、业务量减少）有机串联，使论证更有层次。
items.when: 在列举多个负面影响或风险因素，且想强调两者同等重要时使用。
items.slot: […] as well as […]
swap: and also [...] (过于口语化，缺乏正式书面语的节奏感)
together with [...] (侧重于伴随关系，不如 as well as 强调并列影响)

items.en: across regions, markets, asset classes and product structures
items.why: 用across串联多个维度，展现了业务的广度和覆盖面。中国人常写成in different regions, markets..., 缺乏动感和整体感。
items.when: 在陈述业务多元化或覆盖范围时使用。
items.slot: across […], […], and […]
swap: spanning […], […], and […], 强调跨度，气势更强
encompassing […], […], and […], 强调包含关系，更具包容性

items.en: are discussed or included in the Company's periodic reports
items.why: 使用了被动语态的组合，涵盖了信息披露的两种状态（讨论与包含）。中国人常写成 'we write these in reports'，显得口语化且缺乏专业报告的客观距离感。
items.when: 在正文中引导读者查阅其他详细披露文件时使用。
items.slot: are discussed or included in […]
swap: are detailed or referenced in [...] (用词更精准，强调细节与索引)
are set forth or incorporated into [...] (法律文书常用，语气更强硬)

items.en: is subject to, among others, the net capital rule
items.why: 准确表达监管约束关系。中国人常写成 'must follow' 或 'is regulated by'，前者太口语，后者太笼统，'is subject to' 强调了被动且受制于特定规则的法律严谨性。
items.when: 描述实体受到特定法律、条款或监管要求约束时使用。
items.slot: is subject to, among others, the […]
swap: is governed by: 侧重于被某法案管辖，语气更宏观
must comply with: 侧重于主动履行义务，不如 subject to 强调被动受制

items.en: must comply with applicable real estate, lending and insurance laws and regulations
items.why: 中国人常写成 'follow the laws'，显得口语化。'comply with' 是合规领域的标准搭配，搭配 'applicable' 显得严谨且具备法律效力。
items.when: 在审计或尽调报告中描述被审计单位的合规义务时使用。
items.slot: The company must comply with applicable […] laws and regulations.
swap: adhere to: 语气更强调对规则的坚持，但不如 comply with 正式
conform to: 侧重于一致性，在法律语境下不如 comply with 常用

items.en: speak only as of the date of this Annual Report
items.why: 用speak as of来限定陈述的时效性，比直接说this report is valid on...更符合SEC文件的文风，体现了对时间维度的严谨把控。
items.when: 在报告或声明的末尾，界定信息有效的时间范围时使用。
items.slot: these statements speak only as of the date of […]
swap: these statements are only valid on the date of (结构不够简洁，缺乏专业法律文书的凝练感)
these statements only reflect the situation on (表述较为模糊，不如speak as of具有法律约束力)

items.en: connecting 159 million fans to over 11,000 artists at 55,000 events
items.why: 此处使用现在分词短语作状语，将枯燥的数据动态化。中国人常写成 'Live Nation connected...'，显得句式单一，缺乏商业叙事的流畅感。
items.when: 在描述公司业务规模、覆盖面或影响力时使用。
items.slot: connecting […] to […] at […],
swap: linking […] with […] across […], (强调连接的广度)
engaging […] with […] through […], (强调互动与参与感)

items.en: owns, operates, has exclusive booking rights for or has an equity interest in
items.why: 清晰界定资产控制权范围。中国人常简单写 'manages' 或 'controls'，忽略了资产权属的细微差异，该写法精准覆盖了从所有权到运营权的多种法律状态。
items.when: 在尽职调查报告中描述资产组合或控制权边界时使用。
items.slot: owns, operates, has exclusive booking rights for or has an equity interest in […],
swap: holds title to, manages, or maintains an interest in […], (语气更偏向法律条文)
possesses ownership, operational control, or contractual rights over […], (语气更正式且强调权利归属)

items.en: four to eight months typically elapse between initially booking artists and the first performances
items.why: 中国人常写成 'There is a 4-8 month gap...'，使用 elapse 作为谓语动词能精准描述时间跨度，动词化表达比名词化更具动态美。
items.when: 在描述业务运营周期、供应链流程或审计时间跨度时使用。
items.slot: […] months typically elapse between [Event A] and [Event B]
swap: a period of […] months passes between (略显平淡，缺乏专业感)
there is a lag of […] months between (侧重于负面的延迟，而非正常的业务周期)

items.en: principally involves the global promotion of live music events
items.why: 中国人常写成 'mainly includes' 或 'is mainly about'，显得口语化且缺乏专业严谨度。'Principally involves' 精准界定了业务的核心范畴，用词更具法律与审计文件的正式感。
items.when: 在描述公司核心业务板块或主要职能时使用。
items.slot: […] principally involves the […]
swap: primarily comprises (语义更侧重构成部分，显得更客观)
is primarily focused on (语气较柔和，侧重于战略重心而非业务范围)

items.en: composed primarily of submersible motors, pumps, electronic controls, water treatment systems, and related parts and equipment
items.why: 中国人常写成 'consists of' 或 'includes'，用 'composed primarily of' 能体现出对构成主体的精准量化，强调核心成分，显得更具专业辨识度。
items.when: 在审计报告或尽调中描述业务板块、资产构成或产品组合时。
items.slot: composed primarily of […], […], and […].
swap: consisting mainly of (语气平淡，缺乏专业感)
which are primarily comprised of (冗长且语法容易出错)

items.en: Water Systems contributed about 60 percent of the Company’s total revenue
items.why: 用 contribute 表达部门对总营收的贡献，比简单的 'accounted for' 或 'made up' 更具财务分析的逻辑感，体现了各业务单元的贡献度。
items.when: 在财务分析中拆解各业务板块或产品线对整体业绩的贡献占比时使用。
items.slot: […] contributed [percentage] of the [Company/Group]’s total revenue
swap: accounted for (中性，无贡献感)
represented (客观陈述，缺乏动态感)
generated (侧重产出，与contribute略有重叠)

items.en: could adversely impact the demand for private and individual water wells
items.why: 这是财务写作中表达‘负面影响’的标准搭配。中国人常写成 negatively affect，虽然没错，但 adversely impact 在正式法律和财务文档中显得更专业、更有分量。
items.when: 在尽职调查或审计报告中描述风险因素或不利变动对业务的影响时使用。
items.slot: […] could adversely impact the demand for […]
swap: negatively affect (过于口语化)
have a detrimental effect on (过于冗长)
hinder (语气较重，强调阻碍而非影响)

items.en: Many economic and other factors outside the Company’s control
items.why: 这是界定风险边界的经典写法。中国人常写成 Many factors that the company cannot control，显得啰嗦且不够地道，用 outside the control 显得简洁且具有法律严谨性。
items.when: 在讨论外部风险因素时，用于明确责任归属或界定不可抗力范围。
items.slot: […] factors outside the Company’s control
swap: factors beyond the Company's control (同义，同样地道)
uncontrollable factors (过于简单，缺乏正式感)
factors not within the Company's control (略显拖沓)

items.en: one of the best uses of our liquidity
items.why: 将 liquidity 作为名词使用并搭配 best uses，体现了管理层对资金配置的专业视角。中国人常写成 'how to use our cash'，显得过于随意且缺乏机构投资者的专业度。
items.when: 在解释公司资本配置策略（Capital Allocation）或财务决策逻辑时使用。
items.slot: one of the best uses of our […]
swap: an optimal deployment of our […] (更正式，强调资源配置的科学性)
a priority for our […] (语气较弱，缺乏对资金效率的强调)

items.en: is a primary focus of our strategic plan
items.why: 中国人常写成is the most important part of our plan，显得口语化且平淡。primary focus体现了战略层面的权重感，比单纯用important更专业。
items.when: 在尽职调查报告或审计总结中，陈述公司核心战略目标时使用。
items.slot: […] is a primary focus of our […].
swap: is a key priority of our - 语气稍弱，不如primary focus正式
is central to our - 强调核心地位，语气更强硬

items.en: could have a material adverse effect on Adtalem’s business
items.why: 这是财务报告中的标准法律术语，精准界定了风险的严重程度。中国人常写成 'could hurt the business'，显得口语化且缺乏法律严谨性。
items.when: 在风险因素（Risk Factors）章节描述潜在负面影响时使用。
items.slot: could have a material adverse effect on […]
swap: could significantly impact the business (语气较轻，不够正式)
may cause a substantial negative impact on the business (词汇较冗长，不如原文地道)

items.en: Adtalem’s institutions are dependent upon the timely receipt of federal financial aid funds
items.why: dependent upon 比 dependent on 更正式，常用于财报。中国人常写成 'rely on'，在正式书面语中显得不够稳重。
items.when: 描述公司业务对特定资源、资金或合作伙伴的依赖性时使用。
items.slot: […] are dependent upon the […]
swap: are reliant on the […] (用词稍显生硬)
rely heavily on the […] (语气较口语，缺乏职场专业度)

items.en: in a manner that materially and adversely affects our business
items.why: 这是典型的长难句连接结构，用于精确限定动作的后果。中国人常写成 'which affects our business'，显得过于简单，无法体现出这种‘以某种特定方式导致’的因果逻辑深度。
items.when: 当需要详细解释某个行为或过程如何导致特定后果时使用。
items.slot: […] in a manner that […]
swap: so as to (过于简洁，缺乏对过程的描述感)
to the extent that (侧重于程度，而非方式，语义稍有偏差)

items.en: activities related to critical components of the F1 Championship
items.why: 用related to连接抽象名词（activities）和具体对象（components），能精确界定业务范围。中国人常喜欢用involving，但involving侧重于“包含”，而related to侧重于“关联性”，在审计界定业务边界时更准确。
items.when: 在描述公司业务范围、项目关联性或成本归集范围时使用。
items.slot: activities related to […]
swap: involving (侧重包含关系，不如related to界定边界清晰)
concerning (语气较重，通常用于议题或争议，不适合描述日常业务)

items.en: Braves Holdings derives revenue related to the Braves baseball franchise and Truist Park from
items.why: 中国人常写成 'gets money from' 或 'earns revenue by'，显得口语化且逻辑扁平。'derives revenue related to... from...' 明确区分了业务对象与收入来源，体现了专业报告的严谨性。
items.when: 在财务报告中描述特定业务板块的收入来源及其关联对象时套用。
items.slot: […] derives revenue related to […] from […].
swap: generates income associated with... through... (语气更正式，侧重创造价值)
earns revenue attributable to... by way of... (强调收入的归属关系，法律色彩更浓)

items.en: Braves Holdings manages its business based on the following reportable segments
items.why: 中国人常写成 'The business is divided into...'。'manages its business based on' 强调了管理层的主动决策视角，符合审计中对经营分部（operating segments）披露的惯用表达。
items.when: 在介绍公司组织架构或业务分部划分逻辑时使用。
items.slot: […] manages its business based on the following reportable segments: […].
swap: organizes its operations around the following reportable segments: (强调组织结构，语气较客观)
structures its business according to the following reportable segments: (强调架构设置，偏向战略描述)

items.en: attendance metrics help assist management in determining how best to allocate internal resources
items.why: 中国人常写成 'help management to decide'。'Assist management in doing' 结构更显正式，'determining how best to' 比 'deciding how to' 展现了对资源配置最优化的管理思考。
items.when: 在描述财务指标如何支持管理层决策或资源调度时使用。
items.slot: […] assist management in determining how best to […]
swap: help management decide how to (过于简单，缺乏职业感)
facilitate management's decision-making regarding (更书面，但略显臃肿)

items.en: comparing operating performance of Atlanta Braves Holdings and its subsidiaries on a consistent basis
items.why: 中国人常写成 'consistently'。使用 'on a consistent basis' 这一名词短语结构，能使句式重心更稳，在审计或财务报告中显得更加严谨、规范。
items.when: 在强调财务数据对比的口径一致性或方法论的稳定性时使用。
items.slot: […] on a consistent basis
swap: consistently (副词表达，在长句中显得单薄)
in a uniform manner (含义接近，但不如原句地道)

items.en: Consumer demand for increased internet speeds is accelerating
items.why: 中国人常写成 'The demand is getting higher'，用词平淡。'Accelerating' 准确刻画了需求增长的速度感和动态趋势，是财务报告中描述市场增长的常用高级词汇。
items.when: 在描述市场趋势、用户行为变化或业务增长动态时使用。
items.slot: Consumer demand for […] is accelerating
swap: is growing rapidly (较为平庸，缺乏加速的动态感)
is gaining momentum (强调增长的势头，比accelerating更具文学性)

items.en: more customers are opting for higher bandwidth solutions
items.why: 中国人常写成 'choosing'，显得口语化。'Opting for' 在商业语境下显得更正式、更具决策意味，暗示了客户在多种选择中做出了理性的商业决定。
items.when: 描述客户偏好、市场选择或公司战略决策时使用。
items.slot: more customers are opting for […]
swap: are selecting (中规中矩，缺乏opting for的主动选择感)
are gravitating toward (强调一种趋势性的倾向，语气稍弱)

items.en: The Company's data products include high-speed internet access
items.why: 中国人常写成 'The company's data products are...'，容易导致定义过于绝对。用 'include' 既简洁又留有余地，符合审计严谨性的要求，避免了穷举带来的合规风险。
items.when: 在列举产品线、服务范畴或资产组成时使用。
items.slot: The Company's […] include […]
swap: consist of (语气太绝对，暗示了穷举，审计中要慎用)
comprise (较正式，但同样带有完整包含的意味，不如include灵活)

items.en: improving the overall risk profile of our balance sheet
items.why: 用 'risk profile' 而不是笼统的 'risk'，显得非常专业且具动态视角。中国人在写财务报告时常写成 'improving the risk'，显得单薄。
items.when: 描述资产负债表、投资组合或业务条线风险结构优化时套用。
items.slot: improving the overall risk profile of our […]
swap: enhancing the risk structure of our balance sheet (强调结构而非轮廓)
optimizing the overall risk of our balance sheet (用词稍显平淡，缺乏 profile 的立体感)

items.en: reflecting disciplined leverage management and the use of equity capital to fund growth
items.why: 用分词短语 'reflecting...' 作结果状语，精准展示某项财务动作背后的管理哲学（disciplined leverage management）。中国会计通常只会写 'this shows we are disciplined'。
items.when: 解释某项财务决策体现了公司的某种管理纪律或战略定力时套用。
items.slot: reflecting disciplined […] management and the use of […] to fund growth
swap: demonstrating a strict control over leverage (略显啰嗦，没有 disciplined 凝练)
showing our disciplined approach to leverage (主语变成了人或泛指，不够客观)

items.en: ability to pay or increase dividends, repurchase shares, or take other capital actions
items.why: 在评估企业财务弹性时，中国人常写 'can pay dividends or buy back shares'，显得业余。此处用 'ability to + [动词并列]' 结构，将‘支付或增加分红、回购股份、进行其他资本操作’完美并列，且用 'repurchase shares' 而非口语化的 'buy back shares'，逻辑层次分明，尽显专业度。
items.when: 在财务尽调中评估目标公司的现金流分配限制、股东回报能力或债务契约（Covenants）约束时。
items.slot: ability to [...], [...], or take other [...] actions
swap: capacity to distribute dividends, buy back stock, or engage in other capital restructuring (capacity更侧重财务和资金上的实际承载能力，而非法律或监管上的可行性)
flexibility to pay dividends, repurchase shares, or execute other capital allocations (flexibility强调资金调配的自主权和灵活性)

items.en: These outcomes are central to driving improved profitability.
items.why: 中国人表达‘至关重要’常用 'is very important for'。原文用 'be central to doing' 将重要性具象为‘核心驱动力’，且搭配动名词 'driving' 极具动态感，比单纯用名词更显专业。
items.when: 用于分析某项财务指标、审计发现或管理举措对最终业绩、盈利能力的决定性影响。
items.slot: These [...] are central to driving [...]
swap: These factors are pivotal in achieving [...] (pivotal 强调枢纽、关键节点作用)
These measures are instrumental to enhancing [...] (instrumental 强调作为实现目标的工具和手段作用)

items.en: Refer to the sections titled “Forward-Looking Statements and Other Terms” and “Item 1A. Risk Factors” for examples of such challenges and events.
items.why: 中国人常写 Please read Section X to see... 或 Details are in...。原文用祈使句 Refer to ... for ...，直接高效，titled 精确指代章节名称，for examples of 明确了跳转阅读的目的，整体结构极具公文质感。
items.when: 在报告中需要引导读者跳转到其他章节、附录或披露项以获取详细支持材料时。
items.slot: Refer to the sections titled [...] for examples of [...]
swap: Please see the sections titled [...] for further details on [...] (语气较为温和，常用于普通报告或说明书)
Reference should be made to the sections titled [...] for a comprehensive list of [...] (被动语态，语气极度正式、严谨，多见于法律条款)

items.en: Following examinations, Truist and Truist Bank are assigned supervisory ratings.
items.why: 中国人习惯用主动语态写成 "After the regulator examines Truist, they give them ratings."。原文用 "Following [noun]" 代替 "After" 显得更正式，并采用被动语态 "are assigned" 隐去施动者（监管机构），使行文焦点集中在“被评估主体”和“结果”上，语气极其客观、专业。
items.when: 适用于描述审计、尽调或合规检查结束后，目标企业获得某种官方结论、评级或整改意见的场景。
items.slot: Following [...], [...] are assigned [...].
swap: Upon completion of the audit, the target company was issued a qualified opinion. (更强调审计程序的终结和正式意见的发布，语气官方)
Subsequent to the assessment, the entity was designated a high-risk rating. (Subsequent to 比 following 更书面化，用于强调后续的评级认定)

items.en: These ratings together with examination reports and findings, which are considered confidential supervisory information, can have a significant impact on our business, operations, growth, and profitability.
items.why: 中国人常写 "These ratings will affect our business very much."。原文的妙处在于：用 "together with" 优雅地并列多个主语；插入语 "which are considered..." 补充合规属性；用 "can have" 替代绝对化的 "will" 进行专业对冲（hedge）；最后用 "significant impact" 替代口语化的 "affect very much"，逻辑严密。
items.when: 用于在尽调报告中向委托人揭示某些潜在风险、监管合规问题对目标公司可能造成的全方位重大影响。
items.slot: [...] together with [...], which are considered [...], can have a significant impact on [...].
swap: These findings, coupled with the pending litigation, which is deemed material, could adversely affect the company's financial position. (coupled with 强调多重因素叠加，could adversely affect 语气更具警示性)
Such assessments, along with subsequent regulatory actions, which constitute non-public information, may materially impact the ongoing transaction. (may materially impact 是标准的审计与并购用语，语气客观克制)

items.en: subject Truist to formal or informal enforcement actions
items.why: 中国人常写 'punish Truist' 或 'take actions against Truist'。原文使用主动词 'subject [entity] to [consequence]'（使……遭受/服从于……），搭配 'enforcement actions'（执法/监管处罚行动），极其符合监管和法律文书的客观中立语气，避免了主观色彩浓厚的惩罚性词汇。
items.when: 在合规审计或尽调报告中，警告客户若不满足特定监管要求，可能会面临监管机构的处罚或强制措施。
items.slot: subject [...] to formal or informal enforcement actions
swap: expose [...] to regulatory sanctions (语气更侧重于暴露在监管处罚风险之中)
render [...] liable to regulatory intervention (语气更偏向法律责任判定，指使某主体在法律上有义务接受监管干预)

items.en: are subject to a range of prudential standards and requirements based on their size and complexity
items.why: 中国人常写 must follow 或 should comply with，显得生硬且带有主观义务感。are subject to 准确表达了“受制于/适用于”某种监管框架的客观状态；用 based on 引出分类标准，比 according to 更具书面质感。
items.when: 在审计报告或尽调中描述受访主体受何种监管准则、行业标准约束时。
items.slot: […] are subject to a range of […] based on their […]
swap: must comply with... (语气较强且偏向行动指令)
fall under the jurisdiction of... (更强调法律管辖权的覆盖范围)

items.en: which generally include BHCs with greater than $250 billion, but less than $700 billion, in total consolidated assets
items.why: 中国人描述财务区间常写 between X and Y。原文使用 greater than... but less than... 配合末尾的 in [metric]，能极其精确地界定数值所属的财务科目（如总资产、营收等），避免了将数值与科目混淆的语病。
items.when: 在尽调报告中定义筛选样本的标准，或解释某一财务分类的量化门槛时。
items.slot: which generally include […] with greater than […], but less than […], in […]
swap: ranging from [...] to [...] in terms of... (侧重于描述范围的跨度)
falling within the bracket of [...] to [...] for... (侧重于描述所属的数值组别)

items.en: primarily due to an 8.5% decrease in deliveries
items.why: 这是财务分析中归因的标准表达。中国人常写成 'The reason is...' 或 'caused by'，显得口语化且逻辑扁平，用 primarily due to 能精准界定核心驱动因素，体现专业客观性。
items.when: 在分析财务指标变动原因，需要区分主要因素和次要因素时使用。
items.slot: primarily due to […]
swap: driven primarily by [...], 语气更强调主动的驱动力
attributable primarily to [...], 语气更正式、更具法律与审计感

items.en: This was partially offset by a 7.2% increase
items.why: 这是财务报告中平衡叙事的经典写法。中国人倾向于用 'but' 或 'however' 连接两个句子，显得断裂；用 offset by 能体现财务数据的对冲逻辑，展现出对报表结构的整体掌控感。
items.when: 当财务报表中出现正负项抵消或部分对冲的情况时使用。
items.slot: This was partially offset by […]
swap: mitigated by [...], 强调负面影响被减弱，语气略微偏向风险管理
counterbalanced by [...], 强调两股力量的平衡，语义更中性

items.en: driven primarily by timing of their annual budget expenditures
items.why: 中国人常写成 'because of the timing...'，显得口语化且乏力。'driven by' 强调了因果的推动力和逻辑的必然性，'primarily' 则精准界定了主次因果，体现财务分析的严谨性。
items.when: 在财务报告中分析某项数据波动或业务行为的根本驱动因素时使用。
items.slot: [...] was driven primarily by […].
swap: caused by: 过于直白，缺乏因果逻辑的深度。
stemming from: 侧重于起源，不如 driven 强调影响力和推动力。

items.en: Additional information with respect to operations by geographic area appears in Note 2
items.why: 用 with respect to 代替关于某事的常规介词 about 或 regarding，显得非常正式且具法律效力。中国人容易机械套用 about，显得单薄。
items.when: 在财务报告、附注说明或合同中引出某个具体事项时套用。
items.slot: Additional information with respect to […] appears in Note […]
swap: additional information regarding [...] (较简练，略逊于原句正式)
further details on [...] (口语化色彩稍重，专业度不如原句)

items.en: Refer to Item 7A, Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures about Market Risk, for further discussion
items.why: 使用祈使句直接引导读者交叉索引报告的其他章节，干脆利落。中国人容易加上主语如 'You can refer to...'，不符合 SEC 报告客观、精炼的文风。
items.when: 在财报正文中需要交叉引用（Cross-reference）其他章节或附注时套用。
items.slot: Refer to Item […], […], for further discussion
swap: see Item [...] for details (过于简略，语气不够专业)
please check Item [...] (带有请求语气，不符合专业财经报告指令式的客观风格)

items.en: may impact our ability to compete for business
items.why: 用 abstract noun (ability) 替代动词 compete，符合 SEC 英文精炼、客观的特点。中国审计员常写成 may affect us to compete，显得生硬死板
items.when: 描述某项业务或举措对公司核心竞争力的负面牵制时
items.slot: may impact our ability to [...]
swap: may impair our capability to [...]（语气更重，强调能力受损）
may restrict our capacity for [...]（偏重资源和空间受限）

items.en: put the availability and/or value of our capital investments within these regions at risk
items.why: 用 put sth at risk 替代动词 endanger，并用 and/or 严谨界定范围。中国学生常直译为 risk our investment，缺乏专业法律文件的严密感
items.when: 评估特定区域或项目资产面临减值或流动性风险时
items.slot: put the availability and/or value of our [...] at risk
swap: jeopardize the realization of our [...]（强调资产变现受阻）
threaten the security of our [...]（偏重资金安全性受威胁）

items.en: failure to remain compliant with them could limit our ability
items.why: 用名词短语 failure to remain compliant 作主语，比写 if we fail to comply 更显正式和权威。中国职员常写 if we cannot comply，口语化较重
items.when: 警告未能遵守法律法规所导致的业务受限后果时
items.slot: failure to remain compliant with [...] could limit our ability to [...]
swap: non-compliance with [...] may restrict our capacity to [...]（更具法律专业感）
any breach of [...] might constrain our operations in [...]（强调运营受约束）

items.en: The professional audio and video (“AV”) market continues to expand
items.why: 用 continues to 替代简单的 keeps growing，显得客观且具有商业报告的正式感。中国人写财报常滥用 grow 或 develop，显得词汇贫乏。
items.when: 描述某个细分市场或业务板块持续增长时套用
items.slot: The […] market continues to expand as […]
swap: the [...] market keeps growing on [...]（用 keeps growing 偏口语化，缺乏财报的严肃性）
the [...] market is expanding continuously [...]（用进行时略显冗长，不如 continues to 简洁有力）

items.en: transitioning from legacy, matrix-based switching architectures to IP-based networking solutions
items.why: 用 transitioning from A to B 准确描述技术迭代路径，比单纯用 changing 或 moving 更具专业度。中国人容易写成 shifting from... to...，虽然也能用，但 transitioning 更符合SEC文件对产业升级的正式表述。
items.when: 描述行业从传统技术向新技术转型时套用
items.slot: transitioning from legacy, […] architectures to […] solutions
swap: moving away from old [...] into new [...]（moving away 过于口语化，不够严谨）
changing from traditional [...] to [...]（change 泛指改变，未体现出技术升级的演进感）

items.en: with inventory visibility to help maximize operational performance
items.why: 用 'with + 名词 + 不定式' 复合结构作伴随状语，紧凑且信息密度极高。中国人常写成分句 'because it has inventory visibility, which helps...'，完全失去了专业英文的干练。
items.when: 在解释某项功能或举措是如何达成目标时使用。
items.slot: with [...] to help [...]
swap: by offering visibility that helps (用 by 引导方式状语，稍显啰嗦)
featuring visibility to optimize (featuring 也是好词，但不如 with 客观)

items.en: based on improvements in the overall financial performance of
items.why: 中国人常写 "based on the better financial performance" 或 "because the company did better"。这里用 "improvements in the overall financial performance of [Entity]" 极其专业，"improvements in"（名词化）比形容词 "better" 更具客观感，"overall financial performance" 也是审计和尽调报告中描述业绩表现的标配词汇，显得非常中立、严谨。
items.when: 在尽调报告中撰写业绩归因分析、管理层薪酬与业绩挂钩说明，或分析子公司运营表现时。
items.slot: based on improvements in the overall financial performance of [...]
swap: driven by the enhanced financial results of [...] (更强调“驱动力”，语气比 based on 稍强)
contingent upon the financial upside of [...] (强调“以...为前提”，法律/契约感更强)

items.en: provide our executive officers with the opportunity to
items.why: 中国人写报告容易直译为 "allow executive officers to" 或 "enable them to"。用 "provide [someone] with the opportunity to" 显得极其委婉、客观，符合合规和披露文件的严谨调性，避免了过于绝对的因果关系表述，也体现了公司治理中‘提供机制’而非‘直接给予’的逻辑。
items.when: 适用于描述员工激励计划、期权方案、或协议中赋予某方的权利与机会。
items.slot: provide [...] with the opportunity to [...]
swap: enable [...] to [...] (更直接，但缺少了“提供机会”的合规委婉感)
entitle [...] to the right of [...] (语气极强，通常用于法定或合同刚性权利，不如 opportunity 灵活)

items.en: payable pursuant to the ROA Plan if a specified level of improvement in asset management relative to the comparable prior year quarter was achieved
items.why: 中国人写“根据该计划，如果比去年同期有一定改善就支付奖金”，常写成 "paid according to the plan if asset management is better than last year"。原文的 "payable pursuant to"（依据...是可支付的）是标准的法律/审计文本用语；"relative to the comparable prior year quarter"（相对于可比的上年同期）比简单的 "compared to last year" 严谨得多，符合审计对“可比期间”的定义。
items.when: 用于描述有条件触发的款项支付、业绩奖励、或合同义务的履行条件。
items.slot: payable pursuant to [...] if a specified level of improvement in [...] relative to the comparable prior year quarter was achieved
swap: disbursed in accordance with [...] upon achieving a designated threshold of improvement in [...] compared to the corresponding period of the previous year (同样正式，用 in accordance with 和 corresponding period 替换)
contingent upon [...] and triggered when [...] shows a defined advancement over the prior year's baseline (语气更侧重于“以...为条件”，强调触发机制)

items.en: was assessed using a two-quarter average of total assets divided by the trailing 12-month net sales, which we refer to as the 'performance percentage.'
items.why: 中国人定义财务指标时，常平铺直叙地写 "We calculate X by dividing A by B. We call X..."。原文使用被动语态 "was assessed using..." 突出评估过程的客观性，并用非限制性定语从句 "which we refer to as..." 优雅地引出专有名词，使复杂的公式计算与术语定义融为一体，非常适合写在尽调报告的“方法论”部分。
items.when: 用于在审计或尽调报告中，向读者解释某个特定财务指标、比率的计算公式及其中英文定义。
items.slot: was assessed using [...] divided by [...], which we refer to as the '[...]'
swap: is evaluated based on [...] divided by [...], hereinafter referred to as '[...]' (更具法律契约色彩，使用 hereinafter referred to as)
is measured by dividing [...] by [...], designated as '[...]' (更为精炼，用分词短语作修饰)

items.en: cause actual results to differ materially from our expectations
items.why: 中国人写审计或尽调报告时，常口语化地写成 "make the real results very different from what we expected"。而 "cause actual results to differ materially from..." 极其专业，"differ materially"（产生实质性差异）直接套用了审计中的“重要性（materiality）”概念，比 "different" 严谨得多。
items.when: 适用于分析实际业绩与预算/预测产生重大偏差、或评估潜在风险对财务数据影响的审计报告段落。
items.slot: cause [...] to differ materially from [...]
swap: lead to material deviations from [...] (语气更侧重于偏离标准或既定轨迹)
result in significant variances from [...] (语气更偏向财务数据上的数值差异分析)

items.en: greater propensity for these clients to leverage digital forms of service delivery
items.why: 用名词短语 propensity 代替动词倾向（如 tend to），使表达更正式、客观。中国人常写成 these clients are more likely to use，显得口语化且缺乏专业报告的凝练感。
items.when: 在分析客户行为模式或业务趋势时使用。
items.slot: greater propensity for […] to […]
swap: a higher likelihood of […] (较直接，语气稍显平淡)
a stronger inclination toward […] (侧重于主观意愿，不如 propensity 客观)

items.en: grown our footprint to nearly 682 MW of deployed systems
items.why: 中国人常写成 increase the installed capacity，用 footprint 显得更高级且形象，强调了市场影响力的扩张范围，而非仅仅是数字增加。
items.when: 在描述业务规模扩张、市场渗透或业务覆盖范围时使用。
items.slot: grown our footprint to […]
swap: increased our installed capacity to […] (过于平淡，缺乏商业战略感)
expanded our presence to […] (语气中规中矩，不如 footprint 形象)

items.en: Actual results and outcomes may differ materially from those expressed in forward-looking statements.
items.why: 这是财务报告中的标准用语，强调差异的显著性。中国人常写成 'may be very different'，显得口语化且不专业，用 materially 更能体现审计和法律上的严谨性。
items.when: 在陈述预测与实际结果可能存在偏差时使用。
items.slot: Actual results and outcomes may differ materially from those […].
swap: may vary significantly (语气稍弱，不够正式)
could deviate substantially (属于同义替换，但 materially 是 SEC 惯用词)

items.en: We have been subject to, and expect to continue to be subject to, claims and legal proceedings
items.why: 利用插入语结构将过去与未来的状态平滑衔接，体现了法律风险的持续性。中国人常写成 We have been subject to claims and we expect to be subject to them in the future，显得冗长且缺乏专业报告的紧凑感。
items.when: 在尽职调查或审计报告中描述持续存在的法律、财务或监管风险时使用。
items.slot: We have been subject to, and expect to continue to be subject to, […]
swap: We are currently facing and anticipate ongoing […] (用词更直接，但缺乏法律文书的严谨感)
We remain exposed to […] (更简洁，但丢失了时间维度的强调)

items.en: which provides for a highly diversified owner base
items.why: provide for 在此意为“导致、产生、确保”，比简单的 result in 更具商业正式感，体现了经营模式带来的结构性优势。
items.when: 在描述商业模式或合同条款带来的正面结果时使用。
items.slot: which provides for a […]
swap: which results in a […] (语气较平淡，缺乏商业逻辑的严谨感)
which ensures a […] (语气较强硬，不如 provides for 显得客观)

items.en: could have a material adverse effect on our business
items.why: 这是财务报告中的“标准术语”，精准定义了风险后果的严重程度。中国人常写成 'cause big problems' 或 'hurt our business'，显得口语化且不专业。
items.when: 在描述风险、诉讼或负面事件对公司业务的影响时使用。
items.slot: could have a material adverse effect on […]
swap: could significantly impact […] (语气较轻，缺乏法律严谨性)
may result in a substantial negative impact on […] (用词较冗长，不如 material adverse effect 凝练)

items.en: the risks and uncertainties we face are not limited to those set forth in the risk factors described below
items.why: 通过否定结构划定边界，既展示了严谨性又规避了法律责任。中国人常写成 'we face many risks, including...'，容易给人一种风险仅限于此的误导。
items.when: 在列举清单（如风险、假设、限制条件）之前，声明清单并非穷尽时使用。
items.slot: the […] we face are not limited to those set forth in […]
swap: the […] include, but are not limited to, […] (这是最常用的变体，但原句的结构更具强调感)
the […] are restricted to the following (错误，这会直接导致法律风险)

items.en: did not impact our operating (non-GAAP) earnings or cash flow results
items.why: 这是典型的排除法写作。通过明确指出哪些指标未受影响，消除了读者的疑虑。中国人常写成 'it has no impact on...'，但使用过去式 'did not impact' 配合具体的财务指标列举，更加精准地限定了影响范围。
items.when: 在解释某项非经常性损益对核心业务指标（如 GAAP 利润）的隔离影响时使用。
items.slot: As the charges were […], they did not impact our […].
swap: had no effect on (表达稍显平淡，impact 更有力度)
did not affect (affect 侧重于心理或状态影响，impact 在财务语境下更具量化色彩)

items.en: has direct oversight of our management of cybersecurity risks
items.why: 用名词短语 direct oversight 代替动词 oversee，显得更正式且具有权威感。中国人常写成 'is directly responsible for managing'，虽然意思对，但缺乏审计报告中那种强调‘监管职责’的专业语感。
items.when: 在描述公司治理结构、委员会职责或合规职能时使用。
items.slot: has direct oversight of our management of […]
swap: is primarily responsible for overseeing the management of [...] (语气较平淡，缺乏 oversight 的正式感)
maintains direct supervision over the management of [...] (用 supervision 略显生硬，oversight 更符合治理语境)

items.en: Under the direction and supervision of our Chief Financial Officer
items.why: 这是一个非常典型的法律/合规英语短语，用两个近义词叠加来强调权责清晰。中国人常写成 'Led by our CFO'，这太口语化，无法体现出企业内控流程的严谨性。
items.when: 在描述跨部门项目、年度审计或合规流程的启动和执行时使用。
items.slot: Under the direction and supervision of our […], we conduct […]
swap: Led by our [...] (过于简洁，缺乏流程控制的严肃感)
With the guidance and oversight of our [...] (guidance 语气偏软，不如 direction 具有执行力)

items.en: at least annually, and more frequently as relevant
items.why: 这是一组非常地道的合规措辞，既设定了最低频率（底线），又通过 as relevant 留出了灵活性。中国人常写成 at least once a year or more often，显得缺乏专业语境下的严谨性。
items.when: 在描述内部控制、风险评估或报告频率时，需要兼顾合规要求和实际灵活性时使用。
items.slot: […] at least annually, and more frequently as relevant
swap: on a regular basis (太模糊，失去了对最低频率的约束力)
annually or as needed (用词过于简单，缺乏法律文件的严谨气质)

items.en: provide a more complete understanding of our performance
items.why: 中国人常写 'help you understand our performance better'，过于口语。'provide a more complete understanding' 是典型的财报用语，将抽象的‘理解’名词化，显得客观且具有高度。
items.when: 在财务报告的‘管理层讨论与分析’(MD&A)章节，解释为何披露某项补充性财务数据时使用。
items.slot: We present these measures to provide a more complete understanding of […].
swap: give a clearer view of (显得过于主观，不如complete understanding客观)
offer a comprehensive insight into (insight较抽象，complete understanding更侧重于信息的完整度)

items.en: embedding GenAI/AI and intelligent process automation into existing operations
items.why: Embedding... into 表达了深度的融合与渗透，比简单的 use 或 apply 更具技术专业感，体现了系统架构的整合。中国人常写成 use AI in operations，显得平淡且缺乏技术深度。
items.when: 描述技术升级、系统集成或数字化转型方案时使用。
items.slot: embedding […] into [existing systems/workflows]
swap: integrating [...] into (更强调兼容性，但缺乏 embedding 的深度感)
incorporating [...] into (较通用，但语气较弱，不如 embedding 具有主动性)

items.en: are necessarily subject to a high degree of uncertainty and risk
items.why: 中国人常写成 'are very uncertain'，显得口语化且缺乏专业严谨度。用 subject to a high degree of 显得用词考究，且将不确定性量化为一种状态，符合审计报告的防御性写作风格。
items.when: 在财务报告中描述预测数据、市场估算或未来结果的不可控性时使用。
items.slot: […] are necessarily subject to a high degree of uncertainty and risk
swap: are inherently uncertain (语气较弱，缺乏专业感)
involve significant levels of estimation uncertainty (更偏向会计准则用语，语气更正式)

items.en: that we obtained from industry publications and third-party research
items.why: 中国人常写成 'that we got from industry reports'。'Obtained' 比 'got' 更正式，'industry publications' 和 'third-party research' 是财务尽职调查报告中引用外部数据的标准搭配，显得专业且中立。
items.when: 在报告中引用外部数据来源以支持论点时使用。
items.slot: data that we obtained from […], surveys and studies
swap: data we sourced from (略显生硬)
information gathered through (语气较轻，缺乏审计报告的权威感)

items.en: header bidding has led to a significant increase
items.why: 用 led to 表达因果关系比简单的 caused 更具职场专业感，significant increase 避免了使用简单的 much more，更符合审计报告对量化趋势的严谨描述。
items.when: 在财务报告中描述某种技术或市场趋势对业务指标（如成本、流量、收入）带来的影响时使用。
items.slot: […] has led to a significant increase in […]
swap: has resulted in a substantial rise (语气更正式，适合强调结果的严重性)
has driven a notable growth (语气更积极，适合描述业务扩张)

items.en: which in turn attracts more buyers and sellers
items.why: in turn 极其精准地表达了“连锁反应”或“随之而来”的逻辑关系。中国人常写成 consequently 或 as a result，但 in turn 更能体现这种循环往复的因果链条。
items.when: 在描述商业模式的良性循环或因果递进关系时使用。
items.slot: which in turn […]
swap: consequently... (侧重于结果，缺乏循环感)
thereby... (侧重于手段，不如 in turn 强调连锁反应)

items.en: Refer to “Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations—Key Factors and Trends Affecting Our Business”, for additional matters
items.why: 中国人常写成 'See Item 7...' 或 'Please look at...'。'Refer to... for...' 是专业文档中引导读者查阅交叉引用的正式惯用语，语气严谨且专业。
items.when: 在审计或尽调报告中需要引导读者查阅其他章节、附注或外部文件时使用。
items.slot: Refer to […] for […]
swap: See […] for […] (较为随意，通常用于简单的说明)
Please consult […] for […] (语气略显客气，不如 Refer to 简洁有力)

items.en: additional matters that affect our consumer products business
items.why: 中国人常写成 'other things that influence...'。'matters' 比 'things' 更正式，'affect' 比 'influence' 在财务语境下更强调因果影响，整体组合非常地道。
items.when: 在分析报告中提及除当前讨论点之外，其他可能影响业务表现的因素时使用。
items.slot: additional matters that affect our […]
swap: other factors influencing our […] (factor 较常用，但 matters 涵盖范围更广)
further issues impacting our […] (issue 带有负面含义，而 matters 中性且全面)

items.en: we specifically disclaim any obligation to do so
items.why: 中国人常写 'we don't have to update it'，过于口语化。'disclaim any obligation' 是标准的法律免责表达，精准界定了公司在更新信息方面的权利边界。
items.when: 在财务报告或合同中明确公司对未来变动不承担强制性更新责任时使用。
items.slot: we specifically disclaim any obligation to […], except as required by law.
swap: we are not required to do so (语气较弱，缺乏法律声明的力度)
we undertake no obligation to do so (这是另一种非常标准的法律术语，与 disclaim 效果相当)

items.en: put our business and our reputation and brand at risk
items.why: 地道的固定搭配，用put...at risk表达“使...处于风险之中”。中国人常写成make our business risky，显得口语化且缺乏专业力度。
items.when: 在描述内部控制缺陷、法律诉讼或运营风险时使用。
items.slot: put […] at risk
swap: jeopardize […], 语气更强，指危及核心利益
expose […] to risk, 更加正式，常用于合规性描述

items.en: some of which may be beyond our control
items.why: 中国人常写成 'some are out of our control'，显得随意。'Beyond our control' 是标准的风险披露措辞，体现了对不可抗力或外部环境的客观评估。
items.when: 在尽职调查报告中说明某些风险因素不受管理层主观意志影响时使用。
items.slot: factors, some of which may be beyond our control, could […]
swap: some of which are outside our influence (语气较弱，侧重于影响力而非控制力)
some of which are beyond management's control (更正式，强调管理层职责范围外)

items.en: Concurrent with the execution of the AR PENN Master Lease
items.why: 中国人常写成 'At the same time as...'，显得口语化。Concurrent with 是法律和审计报告中衔接多项同步行为的标准表达，显得专业且紧凑。
items.when: 在财务报告中描述两项法律文件或交易同步生效时使用。
items.slot: Concurrent with the [execution/signing/completion] of the [Agreement Name], the Company...
swap: Simultaneous with... (略显冗长)
In conjunction with... (侧重于关联性而非时间上的同步)

items.en: are expressly qualified in their entirety by this cautionary statement
items.why: 中国人常写成 'are limited by'，显得平淡且不够严谨。'Expressly qualified' 是法律英语中的地道表达，强调范围界定是明确且全面的，体现了严密的法律防卫心态。
items.when: 在披露前瞻性陈述或免责声明时，用于界定法律责任的边界。
items.slot: All forward-looking statements are expressly qualified in their entirety by […]
swap: are limited by (语气较弱，缺乏法律上的明确性)
are subject to (常用但略显笼统，缺乏对‘全面性’的强调)

items.en: global logistics enabled by our licensed container fleet
items.why: enabled by 巧妙地将“物流”与“硬件资产”连接，体现了硬件如何赋能服务，避免了使用简单的 with 或 through，更具逻辑深度。
items.when: 描述某种服务或能力是由特定的技术、资产或资质所支撑时使用。
items.slot: […] enabled by our […]
swap: global logistics supported by our licensed container fleet (supported 语气较弱，缺乏 enabled 的赋能感)
global logistics through our licensed container fleet (过于平铺直叙，缺乏因果逻辑)

items.en: Strong sales of DARZALEX (daratumumab) were driven by continued share gains and market growth.
items.why: 这是财务报告中解释业绩变动的标准句式。中国人常写成 'The sales increased because of...'，显得口语化且缺乏因果的专业力度，用 'be driven by' 能精准体现驱动因素与结果的逻辑关联。
items.when: 在审计或尽调报告中分析某项财务指标（如收入、毛利）的变动原因时使用。
items.slot: Strong sales of […] were driven by […] and […].
swap: were primarily attributable to (更正式，强调归因)
were bolstered by (更具动态感，强调支撑作用)
resulted from (较平淡，缺乏驱动力的强调)

items.en: representing an increase of 22.1% as compared to the prior year.
items.why: 这是连接数据与解释的经典结构。中国人常写成 'which increased by 22.1%...'，使用 'representing' 这种分词结构能让句子更紧凑，将数据点作为前文结论的佐证，符合专业报告的叙事逻辑。
items.when: 在陈述完一个财务数据后，需要紧接着进行同比或环比对比时使用。
items.slot: representing an increase of […] as compared to the prior year.
swap: marking a […] increase over the prior year (更具强调意味)
reflecting a […] rise compared to the previous year (更显客观)
which constitutes a […] increase (过于冗长)

items.en: These applications subject our products to normal wear and tear
items.why: 中国人常写成 'Our products get worn out easily'，显得口语化且被动。使用 'subject X to Y' 结构，将产品置于一种客观的、受控的商业逻辑中，体现了对产品生命周期的专业掌控。
items.when: 在审计或尽职调查中解释产品损耗、折旧或售后更换频率时使用。
items.slot: These […] subject our […] to […]
swap: Our products are prone to standard operational degradation (更书面，但略显生硬)
These environments cause inevitable wear and tear to our products (更直接，但丧失了'subject to'带来的逻辑严密性)

items.en: in connection with designing, building and launching new generations of our satellites
items.why: 中国人常写成 related to... 或 for...，显得口语化。in connection with 是法律和财务报告中的标准连接词，能体现出因果或关联的严谨性。
items.when: 在审计报告或尽调中描述某项支出或行为与特定业务活动的关系时使用。
items.slot: in connection with […]
swap: associated with (较为常用，但缺乏法律严谨感)
pertaining to (语气更正式，侧重于归属关系)

items.en: Revenues from the SDA contract contributed to our increasing engineering and support service revenue from 2023 to 2025, as well as associated expenses
items.why: 中国人常过度使用 'and' 连接所有并列项，导致句子平淡。'as well as' 能优雅地将次要信息（费用）附带在主要信息（收入）之后，突出重点。
items.when: 在财务报告中同时提及收入与相关成本，或资产与相关负债时。
items.slot: […], as well as […]
swap: along with (语气平淡，缺乏逻辑递进感)
in addition to (语气较重，通常用于句首或强调额外项)

items.en: we expect that higher level of revenues and expenses to continue throughout the life of the SDA contract
items.why: 中国人常写成 'during the contract period'，显得口语化。'throughout the life of' 显得专业且具有法律严谨性，涵盖了合同从签署到终止的全生命周期。
items.when: 描述合同、项目或资产在整个存续期内的财务趋势预测时。
items.slot: […] throughout the life of the […]
swap: over the duration of (较正式，但缺乏生命周期的动态感)
for the entire term of (法律色彩浓，适合描述合同期限)

items.en: accounted for approximately 29% of our total revenue
items.why: 这是描述财务占比最地道的动词短语。中国人常写成 'was 29% of'，显得口语化且缺乏专业感，用 'account for' 能精准表达构成比例的逻辑关系。
items.when: 在财务报告或尽职调查底稿中描述某项业务、成本或资产在总额中的占比时套用。
items.slot: […] accounted for approximately […] of our total […].
swap: represented: 语气更正式，侧重于代表性。
comprised: 侧重于构成，但通常用于描述整体由部分组成，不如 accounted for 灵活。

items.en: represents a very small fraction of this market opportunity
items.why: 中国人常写成 'is a very small part of'，'fraction' 在财务语境中显得更精确且专业，强调了整体市场份额的分割感。
items.when: 在尽职调查报告中讨论市场渗透率或可触达市场规模（TAM）时使用。
items.slot: represents a very small fraction of […]
swap: accounts for a minor portion of (用词平庸，缺乏精确度)
constitutes a negligible share of (语气过于消极，不够客观)

items.en: Human resource departments are faced with increasingly complex operational and regulatory requirements
items.why: 中国人常写成 Human resource departments meet/encounter...。使用 be faced with 能够客观地体现出主体处于一种被动应对压力或挑战的语境，更符合审计报告中描述风险背景的语气。
items.when: 描述客户或企业面临监管、市场或运营压力时使用。
items.slot: […] are faced with increasingly complex […]
swap: are confronted with: 语气更重，通常用于极大的危机或冲突。
encounter: 过于口语化，缺乏正式报告所需的客观状态感。

items.en: actual results could differ materially from those expressed or implied
items.why: 这是财务报告中描述预测偏差的标准表达。中国人常写成 'results will be different'，显得口语化且缺乏法律严谨性，使用 'differ materially' 准确界定了重大性原则。
items.when: 在披露财务预测、业绩指引或风险因素时，用于说明实际结果与预期可能存在的重大差异。
items.slot: […] could differ materially from those expressed or implied
swap: may vary significantly (语气稍轻，不够正式)
could deviate in a material respect (更加法律化，但略显冗长)

items.en: Demand for our sulfur products exists across the globe
items.why: 中国人常写 The demand is global，显得单薄。用 exists across the globe 强调了需求在地理空间上的广泛存在性，增加了陈述的客观性与广度。
items.when: 在尽调报告的行业概览或市场分析部分，描述产品市场覆盖范围时使用。
items.slot: Demand for our […] products exists across the globe
swap: There is a global demand for our […] products (句式平庸，缺乏原文的叙事感)
Our […] products enjoy global market demand (侧重于产品的受欢迎程度，而非客观存在)

items.en: is subject to building and health codes and fire regulations
items.why: 中国人常写成 must follow/obey，显得口语化且缺乏法律严谨性。subject to 准确表达了受制于某项法规或约束的状态，是法律和合规文档的标准用法。
items.when: 在描述公司业务受限于特定法律、法规、协议或监管要求时使用。
items.slot: […] is subject to […]
swap: must comply with (语气较强，强调义务而非被动状态)
is governed by (侧重于受某套规则体系管理)
is regulated by (侧重于受监管机构的直接管辖)

items.en: requires a number of licenses in order to operate
items.why: 中国人常写成 to operate，虽然没错，但 in order to 在正式文档中能起到强调目的性的作用，使句子节奏更从容，逻辑更清晰。
items.when: 在陈述某项行为的前提条件或目的时使用。
items.slot: […] requires […] in order to […]
swap: to (简洁，但缺乏正式感)
for the purpose of (过于冗长，且显得生硬)
with the aim of (通常用于描述战略目标，而非业务准入)

items.en: May Have a Material Negative Effect on Our Business
items.why: 中国人常写成 may hurt our business，显得非正式且缺乏量级感。material 是财务审计中的核心词汇，表示“重大”，能精准界定风险的影响程度。
items.when: 在风险披露或审计报告中描述潜在不利影响的严重性时使用。
items.slot: […] may have a material negative effect on […]
swap: could significantly harm (语气较重，但缺乏审计术语的精准度)
may adversely impact (较为正式，但 material 强调了影响的量级)
could result in a material adverse effect (更符合 SEC 惯用语，语气更严谨)

items.en: Substantially all of the backlog existing at December 31, 2025
items.why: 中国人常写 'almost all' 或 'most of'，显得不够正式。'Substantially all' 是财务审计中的标准用语，表示极高比例但非完全 100%，比 'almost' 更具法律严谨性。
items.when: 在审计报告或财务披露中描述资产、负债或订单的归属比例时使用。
items.slot: Substantially all of the […] existing at [Date] is expected to be [Action].
swap: The vast majority of (语气较口语化，不够专业)
Nearly all of (语气较随意，缺乏财务报告的严谨感)

items.en: in exchange for payment of royalties and other fees to us
items.why: 这是表达“交换条件”的极佳地道用法，强调了对价关系。中国人常写成 'in return for' 或简单的 'to get'，前者略显生硬，后者不够正式。
items.when: 在描述商业模式、合同条款或资源置换时使用。
items.slot: in exchange for […], we expect to […].
swap: in return for: 语气稍显正式，但不如 in exchange for 强调对等性。
as consideration for: 法律术语感极强，略显死板。

items.en: account for 50% or more of the consumption
items.why: account for 是描述市场份额或占比的标准表达，比 occupy 或 take up 更地道。中国人有时会用 make up 50% of the consumption，虽没错但不够正式。
items.when: 在分析行业数据、市场规模或成本构成时使用。
items.slot: […] account for [… ] of the […]
swap: constitute […]: 语气极度正式，常用于学术或法律定义，略显生硬。
make up […]: 较常用，但不如 account for 在财务报告中显得专业。

items.en: grown at an average annual growth rate of 12%
items.why: 很多中国人会写 'grown by 12% every year'。原文使用 'average annual growth rate' (AAGR) 是财务报告的标准术语，表达更正式，且能体现出这是跨年度的统计平均值。
items.when: 在审计或尽职调查中描述某项财务指标的历史增长趋势时使用。
items.slot: grown at an average annual growth rate of […]
swap: exhibited a compound annual growth rate of […] (CAGR 更精准，但若非复合增长则不适用)
experienced a steady annual growth of […] (侧重于描述增长的平稳性而非纯统计数据)

items.en: represents the primary source of our current revenue stream
items.why: 中国人常写 'is the main part of our income'。'Represents' 比 'is' 更具正式感，'primary source' 比 'main part' 更精准地界定了收入来源的地位，'revenue stream' 也是财务写作中的高频专业词汇。
items.when: 在分析公司收入结构或业务板块重要性时使用。
items.slot: represents the primary source of our […]
swap: constitutes the core component of our […] (语气更强，强调构成关系)
serves as the principal driver of our […] (侧重于该业务对收入增长的推动作用)

items.en: represent NHC's best judgment as of the date of this filing
items.why: 中国人常写成 are based on our current opinion。best judgment 强调了这是在现有信息下的‘最优判断’，既表达了专业性，又在预测失准时留出了合理的辩护空间。
items.when: 在陈述公司基于现有数据对未来做出的评估或假设时。
items.slot: […] represent […]'s best judgment as of the date of this filing
swap: reflect our current views as of today (缺乏 best judgment 传达出的审慎评估感)
are based on the latest information available (过于强调信息来源，忽略了管理层的主观判断过程)

items.en: these facilities offer an expansion of our continuum of care
items.why: 中国人常写成 'these facilities help us expand our care'。使用 'an expansion of our continuum of care' 这种名词化表达，将业务动作转化为战略资产，显得更专业、更具宏观视野。
items.when: 在解释某项业务增长如何契合公司长期战略布局时使用。
items.slot: these facilities offer an expansion of our […]
swap: these facilities represent a strategic extension of our service portfolio (强调战略层面的延伸)
these facilities broaden the scope of our integrated care model (强调服务模式的广度)

items.en: We are subject to a variety of risks and uncertainties
items.why: 中国人常写成 We have many risks，显得口语化且缺乏专业严谨性。使用 subject to 准确界定了被动承受的法律/财务地位，a variety of 比 many 更具书面感。
items.when: 在尽职调查或审计报告中描述公司面临的负面因素或外部制约时使用。
items.slot: We are subject to a variety of [risks/constraints/challenges], including […].
swap: We face numerous risks (过于直接，缺乏专业客观感)
We are exposed to various risks (语气稍弱，不如 subject to 强调强制性)

items.en: in order to increase brand awareness and loyalty
items.why: 中国人常直接用 'to increase'，但在正式报告中，'in order to' 能在长句中起到明确区分目的状语的作用，使长难句逻辑更清晰，不至于被前面的动作混淆。
items.when: 在陈述某项举措背后的战略目的或财务意图时使用。
items.slot: in order to [… ]
swap: with the aim of (更书面，强调目标导向，比in order to更正式)
so as to (语气较轻，在严谨的审计报告中不如in order to稳重)

items.en: resulting in full flavor non-genetically modified organism (GMO) tobacco strains and high yield
items.why: 这是财务和业务报告中连接‘动作’与‘结果’的高级用法。中国人倾向于用 'which leads to' 或 'and then'，显得口语化且逻辑松散，而 'resulting in' 能优雅地引出多项并列结果。
items.when: 在陈述某项战略举措、投资或技术研发所带来的具体业务产出时使用。
items.slot: […], resulting in […]
swap: yielding (简洁，但容易与句中其他 yield 混淆)
leading to (中规中矩，但不如 resulting in 显得专业)
thereby creating (强调过程的推导性)

items.en: seek to supplement traditional sources of tax revenue
items.why: 中国人常写成 try to increase/add，显得口语化。seek to 带有政策意图的正式感，supplement 比 add 更精准地表达了“作为补充”这一财务/政策语境。
items.when: 在描述公司、政府或机构为了解决财务缺口而采取特定策略时使用。
items.slot: seek to supplement […] with […]
swap: aim to augment (更强调目标感，但语义略显生硬)
endeavor to bolster (语气更正式，侧重于加强财务基础)

items.en: We place an emphasis on training and development
items.why: 比常用的 emphasize 更正式且具有强调感，避免了动词直接做谓语的平淡，体现了管理层的战略关注。
items.when: 在尽职调查报告或审计总结中，描述公司对某项业务、合规或风控的重视程度时使用。
items.slot: We place an emphasis on […]
swap: We emphasize […], 动词直接使用显得过于直接，缺乏专业报告的庄重感。
We attach great importance to […], 虽地道，但比 place an emphasis on 略显陈旧。

items.en: In keeping with the increased emphasis on cost-effectiveness
items.why: 这是地道的连接词，表示“与……保持一致/顺应……趋势”。中国人常写成 According to 或 Because of，显得单一且生硬，而 in keeping with 带有某种战略上的协同感。
items.when: 在分析宏观环境或行业趋势对公司业务的影响时使用。
items.slot: In keeping with the [increased emphasis on/growing trend of/shift toward] [noun phrase], ...
swap: Consistent with (较为平淡，缺乏动态感)
In alignment with (更强调策略上的匹配，语气较重)

items.en: In an effort to manage risk associated with raw materials and component supply
items.why: 这是比单纯使用 'to' 或 'in order to' 更具正式感和目的性的表达。中国人常写成 'To manage...'，显得过于直白，而 'In an effort to' 强调了公司为达成目标所付出的主动努力，符合审计报告中强调管理层尽职的语境。
items.when: 在描述公司采取某项行动的初衷或战略目的时使用。
items.slot: In an effort to [manage/mitigate/address] [specific risk/objective], we...
swap: To [manage]... (过于简单，缺乏正式公文的庄重感)
With the goal of [managing]... (稍显冗长，不如原句紧凑)

items.en: with respect to the qualification of any new or alternative supplier
items.why: 这是法律和审计英语中的经典介词短语，用于精确限定讨论范围。中国人常写成 'about...' 或 'regarding...'，显得不够严谨。'With respect to' 能将话题聚焦到某个具体的流程或环节，显得非常专业。
items.when: 在需要明确限定讨论对象或特定事项范围时使用。
items.slot: ..., including with respect to [the process/the implementation of X].
swap: Regarding... (语气较轻，缺乏法律文件的严密感)
About... (过于随意，不建议在正式报告中使用)

items.en: Driven by our mission to save and sustain lives
items.why: 这是典型的过去分词短语作状语，用以引出核心动因。中国人常写成 'Because our mission is to...'，显得过于口语且逻辑平铺直叙，而用 Driven by 则更具专业感和叙事张力。
items.when: 在报告开头或段落起始，阐述公司战略、决策或行为的根本驱动力时使用。
items.slot: Driven by our [mission/commitment/strategy] to [verb], [subject]...
swap: Motivated by... (语气较弱，侧重个人动机而非企业使命)
Guided by... (语感更温和，强调指导原则而非驱动力)

items.en: the 2025 increase to the regular dividend reflected confidence in our outstanding capital
items.why: 中国人常说 dividend increase shows that we are confident，显得逻辑平铺直叙。用 reflected confidence in 将动作本身作为一种信号，语言更精炼且具有专业权威感。
items.when: 解释某项财务决策（如提价、回购、扩张）背后的管理层意图时使用。
items.slot: The […] reflected confidence in our […], as well as […].
swap: demonstrated our confidence in (更强调向外界展示，语气略强)
was a testament to our confidence in (更书面化，强调证明作用)

items.en: In addition to regular dividends, strong capital and excellent company performance has provided opportunities to further reward shareholders.
items.why: 中国人写报告喜欢用 Also 或 Besides 开头，显得口语化且连接生硬。In addition to 能够自然地将“常规动作”与“额外动作”挂钩，逻辑衔接更平滑。
items.when: 在财务报告中，从常规业务过渡到额外举措或特殊事项时使用。
items.slot: In addition to […], [subject] has provided opportunities to […].
swap: Beyond our regular dividends (更强调超越常规，语气更进取)
Apart from regular dividends (中性连接，但不如 In addition to 正式)

items.en: representing a $449 million increase compared with net income for 2023
items.why: 中国人常写成‘which is a $449 million increase...’，显得啰嗦。用 representing 引导非限制性定语，能简洁地将财务数据与其对比基准挂钩，符合专业报告的紧凑感。
items.when: 在陈述核心财务指标（如营收、净利）的同比或环比变动时使用。
items.slot: representing a $[…] increase compared with […] for […]
swap: marking a $[…] increase (更具强调意味，像是在标注里程碑)
reflecting a $[…] increase (侧重于数据是对经营结果的反映)
amounting to a $[…] increase (侧重于总额的确认)

items.en: contemplates the realization of assets and the satisfaction of liabilities
items.why: 中国人常写成 'considers selling assets and paying debts'，显得口语化且不专业。用 'contemplate' 搭配 'realization' 和 'satisfaction' 是典型的会计准则书面语，精准体现了会计假设的逻辑严密性。
items.when: 在描述财务报表编制基础或会计假设时使用。
items.slot: the financial statements contemplate the […] of […] and the […] of […].
swap: assumes the liquidation of assets (语气更强，指代清算而非正常经营)
is based on the premise of converting assets (词汇较平庸，缺乏会计专业感)

items.en: raise significant doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern
items.why: 这是审计准则中的标准术语。中国人常写成 'make us uncertain about going concern'，显得主观且不够正式。'Raise significant doubt' 是审计报告中用于触发持续经营风险披露的固定搭配。
items.when: 在审计或尽调报告中提示公司存在重大经营风险时使用。
items.slot: these factors raise significant doubt about our ability to […].
swap: cast substantial doubt on our ability (这是审计准则中更地道的书面表达)
create uncertainty regarding our ability (语气较弱，缺乏审计风险提示的力度)

items.en: in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America
items.why: 这是财务报告的开篇标准句。中国人常写成 'according to US GAAP'，虽然没错但不够正式。使用 'in accordance with' 显得严谨，且完整拼写出会计准则全称是尽调报告中的规范做法。
items.when: 在陈述财务报表编制依据或合规性声明时使用。
items.slot: prepared in accordance with […].
swap: complying with the requirements of (侧重于合规性，但不如前者在报表开头常用)
following the rules of (显得过于随意，像是在写操作手册而非专业报告)

items.en: Should one or more of these risks or uncertainties materialize
items.why: 中国人常写 if these risks happen，显得口语化且生硬。materialize 是财务审计中的高频词，精准描述风险从‘潜在状态’变为‘现实损失’的过程，专业感极强。
items.when: 在风险披露或审计报告中，描述不确定性事件发生时使用。
items.slot: Should one or more of these […] materialize
swap: If these risks occur (语气过于平淡，缺乏专业严谨性)
In the event that these risks arise (略显繁琐，不如 materialize 简洁有力)

items.en: We refer to our towers, small cells and fiber assets collectively as "communications infrastructure,"
items.why: 中国人常写成 'We call them...' 或 'These are called...'。用 'refer to... collectively as' 能够清晰界定专业术语的定义范围，体现了报告对定义严谨性的把控。
items.when: 在报告中首次引入缩写或定义集合概念时使用。
items.slot: We refer to [A], [B] and [C] collectively as "[…]."
swap: We group these assets under the term: 语气较冗长，不如 refer to 简洁。
These are collectively known as: 缺乏主动语态的权威感。

items.en: In tandem, we have refined our eCommerce experience and segmentation strategy
items.why: 用 in tandem 开头展现组合拳式的战略协同，比中国人常用的同时做 A 和 B (at the same time and do A and B) 显得高级且富有商业质感。
items.when: 在财报或战略规划中描述多项同步推进的举措时套用。
items.slot: In tandem, we have [refined / optimized / upgraded] our [product line / operating model] and [strategy] to [prioritize / achieve] [...]
swap: At the same time, we have... - 略显口语化，缺乏财报的专业严谨感。
Simultaneously, we have... - 用词正确但稍显生硬，不如 in tandem 连贯自然。

items.en: positioning CarParts.com as a trusted destination for automotive parts and maintenance support
items.why: 用分词短语作结果状语，精准传达战略动作带来的自然延伸效果，避免了中国人常犯的主谓宾硬切 (and it positions... 或者 to make it...)。
items.when: 在描述业务动作的最终战略目的时套用。
items.slot: [action participle, e.g., expanding / launching] [...], positioning [company name] as a [trusted / premier] [destination / partner] for [...]
swap: and this positions the company as... - 句式松散，削弱了主句的冲击力。
to position the company as... - 表达目的尚可，但不如现在分词表达顺理成章的自然结果贴切。

items.en: rules intended to facilitate the rapid deployment of broadband services
items.why: 使用过去分词短语 'intended to' 作后置修饰，比中国人惯用的 'which are designed to' 或 'aiming to' 更加精炼；用 'facilitate the rapid deployment' 代替口语化的 'help quickly deploy'，极大地提升了报告的官方和专业质感。
items.when: 用于在尽调报告中描述某项监管政策、内部控制制度或审计程序的出台目的与预期效果。
items.slot: rules intended to facilitate the rapid deployment of [...]
swap: rules designed to accelerate the implementation of [...] (designed to 侧重于制度设计初衷，语气更具计划性)
rules aimed at promoting the swift rollout of [...] (aimed at 搭配动名词，rollout 偏向商业发布而非监管部署，语气稍显商业化)

items.en: which may make it more difficult to obtain access to poles in those states
items.why: 采用了经典且地道的 'make it + adj. + to do' 形式宾语结构，避免了中国人常写的 'make obtaining access more difficult' 这种臃肿句式；用 'obtain access to' 代替口语化的 'get'，并用 'may' 进行了恰当的风险对冲。
items.when: 用于分析外部政策、市场准入门槛或法律合规变化对目标企业运营造成的潜在阻碍。
items.slot: which may make it more difficult to obtain access to [...]
swap: which could hinder the acquisition of [...] (hinder 语气更强，直接表示阻碍，不确定性稍弱)
which might complicate the process of accessing [...] (complicate 侧重于流程变复杂，语气比 make it more difficult 更中性)

items.en: could significantly increase our annual pole attachment costs and materially negatively impact our operations, business, financial condition and results of operations
items.why: 这是 SEC 申报文件中最标准的风险揭示排比句。用 'significantly' 和 'materially negatively' 双重副词精准修饰，比中国人常写的 'badly affect' 专业得多，且完整列举了 operations, business, financial condition 等四个维度，格式极其严谨。
items.when: 在财务尽调或审计报告中，用于量化或定性评估某项重大潜在风险对客户公司财务和经营状况的灾难性后果。
items.slot: could significantly increase our [...] and materially negatively impact our operations, business, financial condition and results of operations
swap: could substantially raise our [...] and adversely affect our financial position and operating results (adversely affect 语气稍温和，financial position 偏向资产负债表表现)
may drastically escalate our [...] and severely impair our overall business performance and financial health (impair 侧重于减值、受损，语气比 impact 更有破坏性)

items.en: As a condition of membership, all members must purchase and maintain capital stock
items.why: 用名词短语 As a condition of 代替条件状语从句（如 If they want to be members...），极大地压缩了句幅，使得法规和契约类文书显得极为紧凑。中国人常写成条件从句，缺乏专业合规文件的严肃感。
items.when: 在审计报告或尽调中描述前置条件、合规硬性要求或契约限制条款时
items.slot: As a condition of [...], all [...] must [...]
swap: If they want to be members, they must... (从句太啰嗦，缺乏规则的严肃感)
Subject to membership requirements, they are required to... (略显被动和生硬)

items.en: we provide a readily available source of funding and liquidity to our member institutions
items.why: 用 readily available 这一高频商务副形容词组合来修饰 source，比用 and 连两个句子高效得多。中国人写财报常写成 we can provide funds easily，显得极口语化且不够专业。
items.when: 在描述企业能够持续稳定地提供某种资源、资金或服务时
items.slot: we provide a readily available source of [...] to [...]
swap: we can provide funds easily and quickly to... (副词位置不够地道，口语感重)
we supply continuous funds for... (搭配较单一，不如 source 稳健)

items.en: a reliable provider of funding, liquidity, and services
items.why: 用名词短语 provider 代替动词 provide，使得定语修饰更加紧凑专业。中国人在写尽调报告时常写成 'we reliably provide funding'，显得口语化且动词堆砌。
items.when: 在描述机构核心职能或业务定位时套用
items.slot: a reliable provider of [...]
swap: a trusted source of (...) (强调权威性和信任感)
we reliably provide (...) (用动词形式，显得主观而不够客观专业)

items.en: Actual results could differ materially from those expressed in the forward-looking statements
items.why: 用 'differ materially from' 比单纯用 'be different from' 更具法律效力和专业度，'materially' 精准界定了重大差异的标准。中国人写财报常写成 'will be very different'，显得口语化且绝对。
items.when: 在财报中披露实际表现与预测、估计或历史数据存在重大不符时套用。
items.slot: Actual results could differ materially from those expressed in […]
swap: vary significantly from (语气稍弱，不如 materially 贴合审计语境)
diverge substantially from (用词更重，强调分歧巨大)

items.en: financial statement readers should not regard those statements as a representation by us or any other person that the results expressed in the statements will be achieved
items.why: 使用 'regard ... as a representation' 进行法律责任切割，措辞极其地道和严密。中国人容易写成 'should not think we promise'，完全没有合规文书的专业质感。
items.when: 在免责声明或前瞻性陈述后，划清公司对未来预测不承担绝对保证责任时套用。
items.slot: financial statement readers should not regard those statements as a representation by us or any other person that […]
swap: should not construe those statements as a guarantee that (construes 略带法律解释意味)
should not view those statements as a warranty that (warranty 偏向商业合同保证)

items.en: It is difficult to predict the effect of known risk factors on future results
items.why: 使用 'It is difficult to predict' 比 'We cannot predict' 显得客观且留有余地。中国人常写 'It is hard to know'，缺乏商务文书的正式感。
items.when: 在分析风险不确定性、无法准确量化某些外部因素对业绩的影响时套用。
items.slot: It is difficult to predict the effect of […] on future results
swap: It remains challenging to forecast the impact of (challenging 强调挑战性，更显积极)
It is nearly impossible to ascertain the outcome of (nearly impossible 语气过重，可能引发监管过度关注)

items.en: We typically retain AgVantage securities in our portfolio
items.why: 用“typically”准确表达常规操作，“retain”比“keep”更专业，符合金融报告措辞，中国人常写“We usually keep AgVantage securities in our portfolio”，不够专业正式
items.when: 正式报告中说明常规业务操作的场合
items.slot: We typically retain […] in our portfolio
swap: We generally hold […] in our portfolio（“generally”与“typically”同义，“hold”更简洁）
We ordinarily maintain […] in our portfolio（“ordinarily”更正式，适合监管文件）

items.en: We earn revenue from our payment partners from
items.why: 用 earn revenue from 精准勾勒出收入的来源主体，比简单用 get money 或 receive income 专业得多。中国财务常写成 get income from 或 make money from。
items.when: 在财报附注或商业模式分析中描述特定业务线的收入来源时使用。
items.slot: We earn revenue from our [...] from [...]
swap: We generate revenue through our [...] via [...] (通过...产生收入，稍显生硬)
We derive revenue from our [...] based on [...] (源自...，更加学术和书面)

items.en: fees based on the dollar volume of spend
items.why: dollar volume of spend 是金融和支付行业的标准地道说法，精确指代交易金额规模。中国财务人员常直译为 amount of money 或 total spending，缺乏行业专业感。
items.when: 描述按交易规模、消费金额计费的商业条款时使用。
items.slot: fees based on the dollar volume of [...]
swap: fees determined by the transaction amount (用 transaction amount 代替，不如 dollar volume 行业化)
charges calculated on total spending (用 total spending 代替，显得不够精炼)

items.en: Refer to Liquidity and Capital Resources in Item 7
items.why: 极为地道的财报内部交叉索引祈使句。中国人容易写成冗长的 'You can see more information in...' 或 'Please turn to...'，而SEC直接用动词原形开头的祈使句，简洁有力且符合监管文件惯例。
items.when: 在正文各章节之间引导读者跳转查看相关财务报表附注或特定章节时。
items.slot: Refer to [...] in Item [...]
swap: Please check [...] in Item [...] (带有人称和礼貌用语，显得不够客观和职业)
You can find details in [...] (完全偏离了专业财报简明干练的风格)

items.en: These environmental laws and regulations can affect the cost and output of operations
items.why: 用动词 affect 直接连接 cost and output，简洁有力地概括了法规对成本和产出的双重影响。中国人写报告时容易啰嗦地写成 have an impact on the cost of operations and the output of operations，显得拖沓。
items.when: 评估外部因素、合规要求或市场波动对企业运营成本和产能的影响时
items.slot: These [...] can affect the cost and output of [...]
swap: impact the cost and performance of（侧重实质性冲击，较 affect 更强烈）
influence the expenditure and production of（词义偏书面，不如原句简练）

items.en: can lead to substantial administrative, civil and criminal fines and penalties for non-compliance
items.why: 用 lead to 顺畅衔接违规后果，并用 administrative, civil and criminal 穷尽了行政、民事和刑事三种法律责任，极具审计和合规专业度。中国人在写违规后果时常笼统地写成 cause serious punishments，缺乏法律层面的严谨分类。
items.when: 在合规风险提示或尽调报告中，列举违规行为可能导致的法律责任和财务罚款时
items.slot: can lead to substantial administrative, civil and criminal fines and penalties for [...]
swap: may result in severe regulatory, civil and criminal penalties（侧重监管机构层面的处罚）
expose the company to heavy statutory liabilities（侧重法定责任，语气更重）

items.en: we refer to our tenants as “clients” due to the many facets of our continuous engagements with them
items.why: 用due to清晰衔接术语替换的原因，比中式口语化表达更严谨，避免年报术语歧义
items.when: 年报中替换术语并说明理由的场合
items.slot: we refer to our […] as “[…]” due to the many facets of our continuous engagements with them
swap: we designate our […] as “[…]” because of the various aspects of our ongoing interactions with them（designate比refer更具正式指定性）
we term our […] as “[…]” given the multiple dimensions of our ongoing engagements with them（term比refer更侧重术语定义，given更简洁）

items.en: Additional information regarding our marketing activities can be found in
items.why: 用被动语态将读者引导至其他章节，避免了汉语中常见的'我们可以在...中找到'的主观表达，显得客观且专业。中国人写导引时常误用active voice的主谓结构。
items.when: 在财报或审计报告中指引读者查阅其他章节或附注时套用。
items.slot: Additional information regarding […] can be found in […]
swap: For more details about [...], see [...] (用祈使句，语气更直接但略显生硬)
We discuss [...] in [...] (主动语态，不够正式)

items.en: demand for new homes, retail, and office space to remain resilient
items.why: 用 remain resilient 替代简单的 will grow 或 keep good，既表达了看好，又暗示了能经受宏观经济波动考验。中国人写财报常纠结于 positive 或 stable，显得单一。
items.when: 描述资产类别、市场需求或业绩在逆风中表现坚挺时
items.slot: demand for […] to remain resilient
swap: continue to grow（过于激进，缺乏对下行风险的对冲意识）
stay strong（口语化色彩较重，缺乏财报的专业克制感）

items.en: supported by constrained inventories of existing homes, continued migration to our communities, and the quality and scale of our offerings
items.why: 用过去分词短语作后置状语引出多重驱动因素，层层递进（从宏观库存到微观产品力），比用 because of 引导的状语从句更干练。中国人常写成 because of A, B and C，结构松散。
items.when: 解释某项核心业务指标或预测数字背后的多重支撑逻辑时
items.slot: […], supported by […], […], and the quality and scale of our offerings
swap: driven by […]（侧重主动驱动力，少了一层市场客观支撑的意味）
due to […]（介词短语过于死板，无法体现因素的复合性）

items.en: In evaluating prospective investments, our advisor, New York City Advisors, LLC (our “Advisor”), considers relevant real estate and financial factors,
items.why: 中国人写这类状语常写成名词短语（如 In the evaluation of...），这里用介词 in 加动名词短语，既简洁又精准地表达了“在进行……的过程中”，比用 when/while 引导从句更加专业干练。
items.when: 在财报、尽调报告或审计底稿中描述某方在特定程序或阶段所采取的行动时。
items.slot: In evaluating [...], our [...], considers relevant [...] factors,
swap: When evaluating [...], our [...] considers [...] (显得口语化且拖沓)
To evaluate [...], our [...] will consider [...] (侧重未来目的，而非当前实操动作)

items.en: including the location of the property, the leases and other agreements affecting it, the creditworthiness of its major tenants, its income-producing capacity, its physical condition, its prospects for appreciation, its prospects for liquidity, tax considerations and other factors.
items.why: 通过 including 引导一长串排比的名词短语，把评估维度的颗粒度瞬间拉满。中国人写此类罗列往往用逗号强连或者用 and 连接，缺乏这种层层递进的专业财税审查视野。
items.when: 在财务报告或审计报告中需要细化列举评估标准、审计程序或尽调范围时。
items.slot: including the [...], the [...] and other agreements affecting it, the creditworthiness of its [...], its [...], and other factors.
swap: such as the location, leases, tenant credit, and other factors (过于简略，缺乏SEC级别的严谨度)
which include the location, leases, creditworthiness, etc. (用定语从句不够精炼)

items.en: Our Advisor has substantial discretion to select specific investments, subject to approval by our Board, including any related guidelines.
items.why: 用 subject to approval 精准限定了自由裁量权的边界，比用 which is subject to 更加地道紧凑。中国人常写成 under the approval of，介词搭配不够地道。
items.when: 描述管理层权限范围及其受到的治理约束（如董事会审批、监管限制）时。
items.slot: Our [...] has substantial discretion to [...], subject to approval by our [...], including [...]
swap: Our [...] can choose [...] if approved by our [...] (口语化，缺乏法律文件的严肃性)
Our [...] has the power to select [...] under the approval of [...] (under 搭配不如 subject to 精准)

items.en: we can give no assurance that such expectations or assumptions will be achieved
items.why: 用“can give no assurance”委婉表达不确定性，符合财务报告的谨慎性，中国人常直接写“we cannot guarantee”，语气生硬且不够正式
items.when: 用于正式报告中表述对未来预期的不确定性时
items.slot: we can give no assurance that […] will be achieved
swap: we do not guarantee that […] will be met（语气更弱，正式度稍低）
no assurance can be provided that […] will be realized（更书面，被动结构）

items.en: The statements in this Annual Report that are not historical information
items.why: 用定语从句后置修饰核心名词，避免前置定语冗长，结构清晰严谨，中国人常直接写“the non-historical statements in this Annual Report”，不够正式规范
items.when: 用于正式报告中修饰名词且定语较长时
items.slot: The statements in […] that are not historical information
swap: The non-historical statements in this Annual Report（更简洁，正式度稍降）
Statements in this Annual Report other than historical information（更口语化）

items.en: sources the majority of its raw materials from
items.why: 用动词 source 代替通常的 get 或 buy，搭配 the majority of 比写 most 显得更专业更有正式文件的质感，中国人常写成 gets most of。
items.when: 写供应链、采购来源或资源配置时
items.slot: [company name] sources the majority of its [assets/materials] from [...]
swap: buys most of its raw materials from (口语化，不够正式)
obtains a large portion of its raw materials from (稍显冗长)

items.en: relate to an existing condition caused by past operations
items.why: 用过去分词短语 caused by 后置修饰 condition，比写成 which is caused by 更加精炼紧凑。国人常习惯用从句，显得冗长。
items.when: 在审计或财报中描述某项资产、负债或风险的成因时。
items.slot: relate to an existing condition caused by [...]
swap: associated with an issue stemming from past operations（语气偏向法律合规，不如 relate to 简洁）
linked to a legacy condition resulting from previous activities（略显繁琐，不如原句直接）

items.en: We are presently unable to quantify this risk
items.why: 用 presently 替代 at present，用 unable to 替代 cannot，配合 quantify 精准锁定不确定性。国人常写成 We cannot estimate now，显得口语化且缺乏法律审慎感。
items.when: 在年报风险披露章节中，表达某项潜在影响暂时无法可靠计量时。
items.slot: We are presently unable to quantify [...]
swap: We cannot measure this risk at this time（at this time 略显拖沓，cannot 不够正式）
It is currently impossible for us to estimate this exposure（主语用 It 显得不够直接，不如 We 承担责任）

items.en: work closely with key tourism bureaus such as Shanxi Provincial Tourism Bureau, Lvliang Tourism Bureau and Jiaocheng County Tourism Bureau
items.why: 国人常写 cooperate with 或 connect with，显得生硬机械；而 work closely with 传达出紧密的业务协同感，常用于商务报告中描述合作伙伴关系。
items.when: 审计报告或商业计划书描述跨机构合作、供应商协同或政府关系时。
items.slot: work closely with key […] such as […], […] and […]
swap: cooperate with key [...] (听起来像是对等机构间的正式公文合作，缺乏业务紧密感)
collaborate closely with [...] (同样表达合作，但 work closely with 在商业文本中更口语化且高频)

items.en: assign dedicated personnel to manage website maintenance and updates
items.why: 国人容易写 arrange people to do，不仅动词用错，修饰语也匮乏；这里用 assign 搭配 dedicated personnel，精准表达了“指派专人”的行政与管理力度。
items.when: 在内控审计或资源配置（Resource Allocation）章节描述岗位职责与人员安排时。
items.slot: assign dedicated personnel to [...]
swap: arrange people to [...] (动词 arrange 极少用于指派具体员工岗位，极其不地道)
allocate specific staff for [...] (语法虽通，但 dedicate personnel 比 specific staff 更强调敬业和专职属性)

items.en: Factors that could cause such differences include, but are not limited to, those discussed in
items.why: 用 factors that could cause such differences 完美承接上文的差异，且 include, but are not limited to（包括但不限于）是法律和审计文件的标配，严谨无漏洞。中国人写“包括”常直接用 including，无法起到法律豁免和穷举提示的作用。
items.when: 在枚举风险因素、偏离原因或限制条件时套用。
items.slot: Factors that could cause such […] include, but are not limited to, those discussed in […]
swap: Reasons for this include […] (用reasons不够宏观，且缺乏法律严谨性)
Such differences are caused by […] (过于绝对，堵死了其他未提及的因素)

items.en: allow the contract holder to choose between a fixed interest crediting rate and an indexed interest crediting rate
items.why: 精准运用 allow... to choose between... 结构，比中国学习者常用的 give choices 或 let people select 更具正式的法律与金融合同文风。
items.when: 在财务报告中描述客户、投资者或交易方在两项资产、费率或方案间拥有选择权时。
items.slot: allow the […] to choose between a […] and an […]
swap: enable the [...] to select either a [...] or a [...] (显得略显冗长)
give the [...] the option of choosing a [...] or a [...] (不如原句主谓宾结构紧凑)

items.en: Changing interest rates could have a dampening effect on overall economic activity
items.why: 地道的财报倾向用抽象名词短语（have a dampening effect on）代替动词（reduce/dampen），语气更专业克制。中国人常写成 could dampen economic activity，略显生硬直接。
items.when: 在描述宏观因素、政策或市场变化对业务、需求或经济指标产生抑制、负面影响时使用。
items.slot: [...] could have a dampening effect on [...]
swap: could weigh heavily on [...]（语气更重，侧重沉重压力）
could exert downward pressure on [...]（偏向价格或指标下降的压力）

items.en: our net interest rate margin, i.e., the difference between the yield we earn on assets and the interest rates we pay
items.why: 利用 i.e. 紧跟一个破折号进行同位语精准定义，把复杂财务指标拆解得极其清晰。中国人常会用定语从句或者逗号堆砌，不如这种插入式解释干练。
items.when: 在财报或审计报告中首次提及专业财务指标需要准确定义或解释其构成时使用。
items.slot: [...], i.e., the difference between [...] and [...]
swap: [...], namely the spread between [...] and [...]（用 namely 显得更正式书面）
[...], defined as [...] minus [...]（过于直白，缺乏财报的润饰感）

items.en: Actions by credit rating agencies, such as downgrades or negative changes to ratings outlooks, can affect the availability and cost of funding
items.why: 主语用名词 actions 统领，后面通过 such as 举出具体行为，将复杂的外部机构行为概括得很严密。中国写作者常写成 when credit rating agencies downgrade us，主谓结构太口语化。
items.when: 在评估外部第三方机构（如评级机构、监管机构）的变动对企业融资和资本成本的影响时使用。
items.slot: Actions by [...], such as [...] or [...], can affect [...]
swap: Developments regarding [...], including [...] or [...], may impact [...]（用 developments 范围更宽泛）
Any rating agency actions like [...] can influence [...]（用 like 不如 such as 正式）

items.en: a topic that is central to the Federal Reserve's work
items.why: 用 central to 代替普通的 important to，显得立场更核心、权重更高。中国人写报告常说 be important for，略显平淡
items.when: 在审计或尽调报告中强调某项业务、风险或指标对整个公司至关重要时
items.slot: a topic that is central to the [...]'s work
swap: crucial to the company's core operations (语气更重，强调直接关系核心业务)
pivotal to the financial reporting process (强调其在财务流程中的关键转折意义)

items.en: how policymakers analyze and respond to economic shocks
items.why: 动词搭配精准，analyze 和 respond to 构成标准的专业应对闭环。中国职场英语常写成 look at and deal with，显得非常口语化
items.when: 在尽调报告中描述管理层如何识别并应对突发财务风险或市场波动时
items.slot: how [...] analyze and respond to [...]
swap: assess and mitigate financial risks (审计报告常用，偏重风险评估与减缓)
evaluate and react to market volatility (强调对市场波动的评估与反应)

items.en: Economic conditions also often reflect the effects of overlapping shocks
items.why: 用 reflect 代替简单的 show 或 display，形象地表现出经济现状是多重冲击‘折射’或‘映射’出的结果。中国写作者常写成 show the impact of，显得机械。
items.when: 在审计或尽调报告中分析某财务指标或现象背后的复杂成因时套用。
items.slot: [Financial metrics / Market conditions] also often reflect the effects of […]
swap: show the impact of (偏口语化，缺乏专业报告的质感)
are driven by (侧重因果驱动，不如 reflect 传神地表达出‘表象反映底层冲击’)

items.en: We examine the extent to which Chinese-owned firms benefited from the trade diversion
items.why: 用 'examine the extent to which...' 代替了平庸的 'look at how much...'，瞬间提升了财务尽职调查报告的学术感和严谨度。中国人写的时候容易用 'how much' 或 'to what degree' 引导，显得口语化。
items.when: 在审计或尽调报告中评估某个风险、收益或影响的程度时使用
items.slot: We examine the extent to which [...] benefited from [...]
swap: We assess how deeply [...] was affected by [...] (语气更为主观直接，缺乏客观程度上的度量感)
We investigate the degree to which [...] relied on [...] (动词用 investigate 略显沉重，但 extent 替换为 degree 意思相近)

items.en: This question has become increasingly important amid concerns that Chinese firms may be using third countries
items.why: 用 'amid concerns that...' 作状语前置，将背景和担忧自然地揉进主句，紧凑且高级。中国人写背景时喜欢用 'Under the background that...' 或者 'Because people are worried that...'，显得冗长且地道程度不足。
items.when: 在分析宏观环境或行业风险时，引述市场担忧或监管顾虑
items.slot: This question has become increasingly important amid concerns that [...]
swap: This question has become increasingly important under the background that [...] (中式英语痕迹重，'under the background' 搭配不自然)
This question has become increasingly important given worries that [...] (given worries 略显口语化，不如 concerns 正式)

items.en: In contrast, much less is known about the role of FDI and the relocation of production
items.why: 使用 'much less is known about...' 优雅地指出研究盲区或尽调发现的空白，比生硬的 'We don't know much about...' 或 'There is no research about...' 专业得多。中国人常写 'However, we know little about...'，略显单薄。
items.when: 在尽调报告中对比不同因素，指出某项关键信息或数据目前尚不明确时
items.slot: In contrast, much less is known about [...]
swap: However, very little information is available on [...] (强调信息可用性，语气更偏向数据搜集困难)
On the other hand, we still lack insight into [...] (使用 we 显得主观，且 lack insight 偏向定性评价)

items.en: how I am approaching the two significant developments affecting the current juncture
items.why: 用 'approach'（着手处理/应对）搭配 'developments'，精准展现专业人士的主动决策姿态。中国人在审计报告中常泛泛而谈 'how I am looking at these two things'，缺乏专业审慎感。
items.when: 在阐述如何评估当前复杂审计事项、宏观趋势或财务异常时套用。
items.slot: how I am approaching the two significant developments affecting the current juncture: […]
swap: how I am dealing with these two major changes — 'dealing with' 略显口语化，不够正式。
how I am analyzing these two trends — 词汇偏窄，未涵盖应对和处理的动作。

items.en: how both might affect monetary policy going forward
items.why: 用 'going forward' 取代略显陈旧的 'in the future'，且用 'might' 保持审慎。中国人在写财务展望时，极易滥用 'in the future will affect'，缺乏前瞻性商业文体感。
items.when: 在审计底稿总结或尽调报告中，推演某项风险或因素对未来财务表现的持续影响时套用。
items.slot: how both might affect […] going forward
swap: how both will influence […] in the future — 'in the future' 过于常规，缺乏专业财税文体感。
how both could impact […] down the road — 'down the road' 略带口语色彩，不适合严肃报告。

items.en: The demand side of the economy comprises household consumption, business investment, government expenditures, and net exports.
items.why: 用 comprises 精准列举四大组成部分，比中国人常用的 include 更具结构感和学术正式感。中国人常写 consist of 或 include，显得口语化且缺乏统领全局的专业度。
items.when: 在审计报告或尽调报告中梳理某体系、板块或成本构成的段落开头。
items.slot: The […] of the business comprises […], […], and […].
swap: consists of (偏口语且显得零散)
includes (语气较弱，无法体现构成全部)

items.en: without directly affecting the economy's underlying productive capacity
items.why: 用介词短语 without +副词+现在分词 结构作伴随状语，干净利落地表达出“不直接影响”的逻辑转折。中国人常习惯另起一个并列句或用 and not 来写，导致句子琐碎拖沓。
