items.when: 在尽调报告中阐述某项变动、调整或冲击未波及核心底层资产或指标时。
items.slot: without directly affecting the company's underlying […]
swap: and does not directly affect (割裂了主句的动作连贯性)
instead of affecting directly (副词位置不够地道)

items.en: These categories map closely to the sequence often associated with general-purpose technologies
items.why: 用 map closely to 来表达两个复杂体系或分类的高度契合，比中国职场人常用的 correspond to 或 fit with 更具画面感和专业度。closely 的副词修饰增强了学术和尽调报告的严谨性。
items.when: 在财务尽调或审计报告中，需要对比两套分类标准、财务指标与业务驱动因素、或历史阶段与当前趋势的对应关系时使用。
items.slot: These categories map closely to the sequence often associated with [...]
swap: These categories align well with... (语气稍平，缺少 closely 的紧密咬合感)
These categories correspond directly to... (过于绝对，不够审慎)

items.en: which in turn precede measurable aggregate productivity gains and labor market outcomes
items.why: 用 which in turn 串联链式反应，极其优雅地展现了多米诺骨牌式的经济传导机制。中国写作者常机械地用 and then 或 as a result，缺乏这种宏观逻辑推进的节奏感。
items.when: 在审计和尽调报告中描述风险传染路径、供应链传导效应或财务指标之间的因果时序时套用。
items.slot: [...] which in turn precede measurable aggregate [...]
swap: ..., leading subsequently to... (稍显冗长，没有 in turn 简洁)
..., and then cause... (口语化严重，缺乏专业财经报告的严密逻辑)

items.en: that researchers can draw on to assess economic developments
items.why: 用 draw on 比常见的use或utilize更高级，自带从资源库、数据库或历史经验中‘汲取、调动’的专业质感。中国作者极易滥用 rely on 或 use。
items.when: 在报告中提及调用某些审计工具、财务数据库、历史先例或行业基准来做评估时使用。
items.slot: [...] that researchers can draw on to assess [...]
swap: that researchers can utilize to evaluate... (utilize 过于生硬冷冰，缺乏自然流畅感)
that researchers can rely on to measure... (rely on 语义过重，偏向依赖而非调用)

items.en: Persistently elevated inflation imposes an unacceptable burden on American families
items.why: 用 imposes an unacceptable burden 代替常规的 causes bad effects，动宾搭配极具画面感且正式。中国人写财报常套用 hurts the economy，显得单薄。
items.when: 在尽调报告中指出某宏观因素或合规问题对特定群体或业务造成严重负面影响时。
items.slot: Persistently elevated […] imposes an unacceptable burden on […]
swap: causes severe economic harm to (过于直白，缺乏官方公文的严肃感)
places an undue financial strain on (语气略轻，偏向银行业务日常)

items.en: That is 1.7 percentage points above our 2 percent target
items.why: 准确使用 percentage points（百分点）而非 percent（百分比），在财务和审计报告中表述差异至关重要。中国人常因中英文混淆而误用 percent。
items.when: 在财务审计中对比实际指标与基准指标、预算或监管红线存在多少差距时。
items.slot: That is […] percentage points above our […] target
swap: That is 1.7 percent higher than our target (混淆了百分比与百分点，表意错误)
Exceeding the target by a margin of 1.7% (句式过长，且百分号符号感不如文字严谨)

items.en: remain concentrated in investment-led growth or whether transformative effects are starting to materialize
items.why: 用 'remain concentrated in' 替代常见的 'are still focused on'，显得更加学术和精准。中国人容易写成 'are still in' 或 'focus on'，缺乏严肃财报的客观质感。
items.when: 在审计或投研报告中描述某种经济效应或风险仍然局限于特定领域时套用。
items.slot: remain concentrated in […] or whether […] are starting to materialize
swap: stay focused on (口语化，不够正式严肃)
persist within (略显生硬，不如 remain concentrated 贴切)

items.en: much of the evidence points to an economy that is reorganizing around this new technology
items.why: 用 'points to an economy that is...' 替代主观断言，既显得谨慎又具动态感。中国人常直接写 'the evidence shows the economy is...'，缺乏专业审慎态度。
items.when: 在审计结论或宏观分析中，基于现有数据进行谨慎推断时套用。
items.slot: much of the evidence points to an economy that is […]
swap: strongly suggests that the economy is (语气更强，缺乏证据指向的客观感)
indicates that the economy is (略显平淡，不如 points to 生动)

items.en: We derive a significant portion of our revenue from
items.why: 用 derive... from 代替常见的 get 或 make，显得极具专业性和财报质感。中国人写财报常套用 get revenue from，显得口语化且单薄。
items.when: 在财报中描述公司各项收入来源时通用
items.slot: We derive a significant portion of our […] from […]
swap: We generate a substantial part of our income from (语气更正式但略显呆板)
A significant part of our revenue comes from (改用被动或主语前置，不如原句主动有力)

items.en: programs for which we are the incumbent supplier
items.why: 用介词提前的定语从句（for which）修饰 programs，精准引出现任供应商的身份优势。中国人极易写成两个短句或用错指代。
items.when: 在尽调报告或商业模式中描述竞争壁垒和客户粘性时
items.slot: […], for which we are the incumbent […]
swap: [...] where we act as the incumbent supplier (where 略显口语化，不够严谨)
[...] because we are the incumbent supplier (拆成原因状语从句，失去定语修饰的紧凑感)

items.en: tariffs pushing up prices of goods and energy markets swinging on geopolitical news
items.why: 用现在分词短语作独立主格或原因状语，比写成 because tariffs pushed up and energy markets swung 更加精炼紧凑。中国人常写成状语从句显得啰嗦。
items.when: 在审计或尽调报告中交代宏观背景或外部驱动因素时。
items.slot: [...] pushing up prices of [...] and [...] markets swinging on [...]
swap: as tariffs push up prices and energy markets swing (连词从句，稍显冗长)
with the rise of tariffs and the fluctuation of energy markets (名词化倾向太重，缺乏动态感)

items.en: concluded its July 2026 meeting with a contentious 9-3 vote
items.why: 动词 concluded 搭配 with a contentious... vote，极具财经新闻和官方公文的专业感。中国人常写成 finished the meeting by voting 3 to 9, 显得口语化且缺乏力度。
items.when: 描述董事会、审计委员会或监管机构做出某项艰难决议时。
items.slot: concluded its [...] meeting with a [...] vote to [...]
swap: finished the July 2026 meeting by voting 3 to 9 (过于口语化，缺乏正式公文感)
ended its meeting through a split decision of 9 to 3 (表达稍显平淡，不如 contentious 准确)

items.en: signaled unease by pushing for a rate hike
items.why: 用 signaled unease 抽象概括态度，再用 by pushing for 具象化行为，完美实现了财经写作中‘定性+证据’的专业表达。中国人常直接写 wanted to hike rates, 缺乏客观审慎的专业腔调。
items.when: 在尽调报告中分析管理层隐忧或市场潜在分歧时。
items.slot: signaled [...] by pushing for [...]
swap: showed worry by asking for a rate hike (showed worry 显得情绪化，不够专业)
expressed concern through requesting a rate increase (through requesting 搭配略显笨拙)

items.en: serve as a useful proxy for such input costs
items.why: 用 proxy（替代指标/代理变量）来连接两个经济现象，极为地道。中国人在写审计报告时经常直白地写 use this to estimate costs，缺乏专业金融报告的抽象概括能力。
items.when: 当某个财务数据无法直接获取，需要用关联指标来替代评估时套用。
items.slot: serve as a useful proxy for such [...]
swap: act as a helpful substitute for such costs
substitute 侧重消费替代品，不如 proxy 在财务分析中准确
work as an indicator for these expenses
indicator 泛指指标，未体现 proxy 的‘替代测算’含义

items.en: will be an important determinant of the pace of how quickly
items.why: determinant 比 factor 或 cause 更具决定性色彩，后面接 of the pace of 更是将定语从句收束为名词词组，极具书面语的精炼感。中国人常写成 will decide how fast，过于口语化。
items.when: 在预测某项宏观趋势或财务指标的变化速度与方向时套用。
items.slot: will be an important determinant of the pace of how […]
swap: will largely decide how fast
decide 过于直接且为主谓结构，降低了报告的客观性
will be a key driver for the speed of
key driver 偏向业务增长动力，不如 determinant 严谨

items.en: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh tried to thread the needle
items.why: 用 thread the needle 来形容在复杂对立的目标间走钢丝、巧妙平衡，极其生动地道。中国人写审计或尽调报告时，往往会平庸地用 try to balance different factors，显得没有画面感。
items.when: 描述管理层或监管机构在多重压力下试图兼顾各方、寻找微妙平衡的场景。
items.slot: [Management / The auditor] tried to thread the needle by […]
swap: sought to balance competing interests（略显生动，但不如原词形象）
attempted to navigate the tricky situation（偏口语化，不够专业）

items.en: without tipping his hand on where rates would go in the future
items.why: tip one's hand 意为“提前泄露意图或底牌”，用在此处精准描绘了央行官员在政策沟通中保持模糊的艺术。中国人通常会写成 without revealing his future plans，显得苍白死板。
items.when: 写尽调报告分析某公司或高管在谈判、监管沟通中刻意隐瞒下一步动向时。
items.slot: [without revealing / without tipping] his hand on […]
swap: without disclosing his intentions（过于直白，缺乏专业财经新闻的张力）
while keeping his future strategy confidential（略显冗长，不如原词精炼）

items.en: The Korean export price indexes capture export prices for DRAM and semiconductors more broadly.
items.why: 用 capture 代替通常容易想到的 reflect 或 show，显得更精准、更具统计专业性，把价格指数动态捕捉微观品类的动作生动化了。中国人写报告常单调地用 reflect。
items.when: 在描述某项经济统计指标、指数能够准确覆盖或反映特定产品类别时套用。
items.slot: The […] price indexes capture […] prices for […] and […] more broadly.
swap: The […] price indexes reflect […] prices for […] (reflect 较平庸，缺乏 capture 的主动捕捉感)
The […] price indexes track […] prices for […] (track 侧重追踪动态，不如 capture 概括性强)

items.en: A summary of the principal risk factors that might cause our actual results to differ from our forward-looking statements is set forth below.
items.why: 用 is set forth below 代替简单的 is listed below 或 is shown below，极具SEC官方文件的规范感和权威性。中国人写作习惯用以下列出，显得偏口语或不够专业。
items.when: 在正文中引出下文的表格、清单或详细条款时套用。
items.slot: A summary of the principal risk factors that might cause our actual results to differ from our forward-looking statements is […]
swap: is presented below (较为中性，缺乏 set forth 的法律效力感)
is detailed below (偏向于强调细节全面)

items.en: Such risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the following:
items.why: 用 include, but are not limited to 既做到了穷尽列举前的风险隔离，又完美兼顾了灵活性。中国人常直译为 are not limited to，容易忽略 include 的动词搭配，导致结构散乱。
items.when: 在合同、尽调报告或财务批注中列举风险或免责事项时套用。
items.slot: Such […] include, but are not limited to, the following:
swap: comprise, without limitation, the following (偏向法律条款风格)
encompass, but are not restricted to, the following (用词较重，强调范围广泛)

items.en: But the Fed’s meeting was followed by mixed news
items.why: 巧妙使用被动语态将前置动作作为主语的背景承接，使两句话在逻辑上无缝衔接。中国人写审计或尽调报告时，常常会写成 'The Fed met, and then the next day there was mixed news'，显得零散且缺少学术和专业报告的连贯感。
items.when: 在财报或尽调报告中描述紧接着发生的事件、决议后的市场反应时
items.slot: [...] was followed by [...]
swap: came right after (口语化，不够正式严谨)
led to subsequent (逻辑主客体颠倒，不如原句被动结构客观)

items.en: inflation is still well above its 2% target
items.why: 副词 'well' 大大增强了程度修饰，比单纯用 'is still above' 更有视觉感和冲击力。中国人写此类偏差时往往只用 'is significantly higher than' 或 'is still above'，缺乏这种简洁有力的程度副词点缀。
items.when: 在尽调报告中描述财务指标、预算或监管红线严重偏离目标时
items.slot: [...] is still well above its [...] target
swap: is significantly higher than the target (学术词汇堆砌，不够生动直接)
is still above the target (缺少 well 的程度强调，语气较弱)

items.en: embed not only compute and memory costs but also include the providers markups
items.why: 用 embed... not only... but also... 替代了呆板的 include 或 contain，生动地表现出成本被『内嵌』进价格中。中国学习者常写成 prices include both... and...，显得平淡且缺乏画面感。
items.when: 在财务报告中描述某个复杂总价（如总成本、总报价）的构成成分时套用。
items.slot: embed not only [...] but also [...]
swap: comprise both [...] and [...] (显得更加传统和学术，但不如 embed 有层次)
factor in [...] alongside [...] (侧重于强调主动计入，而非自然内含)

items.en: as the binding constraint on adoption shifts from building capacity to paying for this intermediate input
items.why: 精准运用了 from... to... 结构来勾勒核心矛盾的动态转移。binding constraint 一词极具专业感。中国学习者常写成 changes from... to...，无法准确传达『硬约束』的动态演变过程。
items.when: 在分析商业模式、资源瓶颈或主要成本驱动因素的演变时套用。
items.slot: as the binding constraint on [...] shifts from [...] to [...]
swap: as the primary bottleneck in [...] evolves from [...] into [...] (evolves 比 shifts 稍显缓慢，适用长期趋势)
as the critical limitation on [...] transitions from [...] over to [...] (transitions 略显繁琐，不如原句干净)

items.en: we or our clients may be subject to regulations related to the processing of certain types of personal and sensitive information.
items.why: 用 be subject to 精准表达“受……约束/管辖”，这是法律和审计英语的高频黄金短语，避免了中国人在写受监管时常误用的 be controlled by 或 be limited by。
items.when: 描述企业或其客户受到特定法律、监管或合同条款约束时。
items.slot: we or our clients may be subject to regulations related to […]
swap: we or our clients may be restricted by […] (restricted by 侧重于限制，不如 subject to 准确涵盖法律管辖)
we or our clients are under the control of […] (under the control of 过于绝对且不够专业)

items.en: And the outcome of this debate could change how the Fed thinks about where it sets interest rates.
items.why: 用名词短语 the outcome of 引出核心影响，比用动词 led to 或 result in 更具客观冷静的审计报告风格。中国人在写尽调时常习惯用主谓句表达结果，显得拖沓
items.when: 在分析某项争议、新规或审计发现对未来决策的潜在冲击时
items.slot: The outcome of this [dispute / investigation / audit] could [significantly alter / impact] how [management / the board] approaches [...]
swap: This debate will result in changes to... (过于直接，缺乏专业报告的客观距离感)
As a result of this debate, they might change... (口语化，主谓结构不够紧凑)

items.en: I wanted to highlight the importance of financial inclusion
items.why: 用过去时 wanted 表达委婉客气的态度，比生硬的 want 显得更加职业；中国人常写成 I want to stress，显得过于直接和强势。
items.when: 在审计或尽调报告的开场白、访谈纪要中，向管理层强调某项核心议题时使用。
items.slot: I wanted to highlight the importance of [...]
swap: I'd like to emphasize [...] (语气更显直接)
We seek to underscore [...] (多用于书面正式报告)

items.en: The income channel captures a central transmission mechanism through which
items.why: 用 captures 替代常规的 reflects 或 shows，动词极具画面感，把抽象的机制说成是被捕捉到的核心路径。中国人写报告常爱用 is, reflects 等苍白系动词，显得平淡。
items.when: 在财务/审计报告中引入某个分析框架或传导路径时
items.slot: [某某指标/渠道] captures a central transmission mechanism through which [...]
swap: The income channel reflects a central transmission mechanism (reflects 过于被动，缺乏力量感)
The income channel shows a central transmission mechanism (shows 显得口语化，不够专业)

items.en: the Federal Reserve has a role to play in encouraging responsible innovation while maintaining a safe and sound banking system
items.why: 巧妙运用了 'have a role to play in doing' 这一地道句型，比直译的 'should do' 或 'is responsible for' 显得更有层次感和官方庄重感；中国人写报告时容易干巴巴地用 'should encourage'。
items.when: 在界定某机构、部门或政策在推进某项复杂工作时的职责与定位时套用。
items.slot: [...] has a role to play in encouraging [...] while maintaining [...]
swap: is responsible for encouraging [...] while maintaining [...]（过于生硬直接，缺乏官方声明的缓冲感）
should actively promote [...] while preserving [...]（动词直接堆砌，不如 have a role to play 优雅）

items.en: They know their customers, their communities, and their risk appetite better than we do
items.why: 利用排比列举 ('customers, communities, risk appetite') 增强说服力，最后用 'better than we do' 作对比，克制却有力地划清了监管与经营的边界。中国人常写成 'they know... well because...'，缺乏这种对比衬托的修辞效果。
items.when: 在解释为何放权给被审计单位或业务团队时套用。
items.slot: They know their [...], their [...], and their [...] better than we do
swap: They have a deeper understanding of [...] than regulators do（用词较长，不如 know... better 简练有力）
Their familiarity with [...] exceeds ours（过于书面和学术，不符合高管讲话或政策声明的风格）

items.en: population of clients that were using our services
items.why: 用 'population of' 来指代特定统计口径下的客户群体，比笼统的 'clients' 或 'all clients' 更有统计学和精算报告的严密感。中国人写财报往往只用 clients，缺乏这种群体边界的暗示。
items.when: 在定义审计样本、客户基数或特定队列（cohort）时。
items.slot: the population of [clients/users/assets] that were [action] during [...]
swap: the group of clients (group 显得不够正式和专业)
all clients (无法体现 cohort 的筛选和限定范围)

items.en: reduce homeowners’ costs in the form of lower property taxes
items.why: 中国人写这类财务或税务影响时，常直译为 by reducing property taxes 或 through lower taxes，显得生硬呆板。而用 in the form of 则精准描绘了利益传导的具象载体，即『以……的形式表现出来』，极具专业报告的质感。
items.when: 在财务尽职调查或审计报告中描述某项政策、交易或减免带来的具体财务影响的表现形式时。
items.slot: [reduce / generate / provide] [costs / benefits / returns] in the form of [...]
swap: by means of lower property taxes (显得过于书面化和机械)
through lower property taxes (平淡无奇，缺乏专业财税文书的质感)

items.en: Sixty percent of voters must approve the amendment in order for it to become part of the Florida Constitution
items.why: 中国人在写前置条件或生效要件时，极易写成带有 so that 或 if 引导的从句，句式冗长。这里用 in order for + 名词 + to do 结构，紧凑且逻辑极其严密，完美契合审计和法律合规报告中对法定生效条件的表述习惯。
items.when: 在审计和尽调报告中阐述某项交易、决议或修正案生效的法定前置条件时。
items.slot: [specific threshold or action] must [happen / be met] in order for [the agreement / amendment / transaction] to [...]
swap: so that it can become part of the Florida Constitution (口语化色彩较重，不够严谨)
if it is to become part of the Florida Constitution (显得冗长且主观色彩偏强)

items.en: AI applications hold real promise for expanding access to financial services
items.why: 中国人常写 will definitely improve 或 have great potential to，显得过分绝对或平淡。用 hold real promise 既表达了监管机构对技术创新的肯定，又通过 real 进行了适度克制，在专业报告中显得客观且有前瞻性。
items.when: 在审计或咨询报告中评估某项新兴技术、新产品或新战略的未来商业价值时套用。
items.slot: [...] hold real promise for [...]
swap: will significantly improve（语气太绝对，失去了监管报告应有的谨慎）
show great potential to（略显平庸，不如 hold real promise 具有金融商务感）

items.en: to help banks more effectively reach low- and moderate-income consumers
items.why: 中国人容易写成 better reach，显得口语化。用 more effectively reach 配合行业标准术语 low- and moderate-income consumers，精准、专业，符合金融合规与普惠金融的正式语境。
items.when: 在分析企业如何触达特定客户群体、提升运营效率或执行普惠政策时套用。
items.slot: to help [...] more effectively reach [...]
swap: better reach（略显口语化，不够严谨正式）
more efficiently target（侧重点变为内部效率，不如 effectively reach 准确传达业务触达）

items.en: using AI in this context—in a way that has more direct impact on credit decisions affecting individual customers—presents more substantial legal compliance challenges
items.why: 中国人写因果或条件限制时常堆砌 if 或 because，而这里用破折号作插入语进行精准限定（in this context — in a way that...），层层递进，把合规风险的触发场景交代得极其严密。
items.when: 在尽调报告中指出某项具体业务操作、技术应用或特定场景会引发特殊合规/法律风险时套用。
items.slot: using [...] in this context—in a way that has [...]—presents more substantial [...] challenges
swap: using [...] here will cause legal compliance problems（过于直白粗糙，缺乏专业报告的严谨度）
if we use [...] for credit decisions, there are compliance issues（句式零散，缺乏统摄全局的专业感）

items.en: tend to support commodity prices while compressing sovereign spreads
items.why: 用 tend to 替代绝对化的 will，显得客观严谨；结尾用 while 加现在分词表伴随结果，比用并列句 and 紧凑得多。国人常写成 are easy to support 并用 and cause。
items.when: 写宏观经济影响或财务分析时，描述双重效应或伴随结果
items.slot: tend to [...] while [...]ing [...]
swap: will support ... and compress ... (语气太绝对，缺乏学术严谨性)
support ... at the cost of compressing ... (侧重点过于偏向负面代价)

items.en: what level of oversight is appropriate for different AI applications
items.why: 用 appropriate 修饰 oversight，比直接说 how much oversight 显得专业且精确。中国人常写成 how to supervise，缺乏监管合规报告的正式感。
items.when: 在报告中讨论对不同业务模块应实施多大程度的管控或审计时套用。
items.slot: what level of oversight is appropriate for different […] applications
swap: what degree of supervision is suitable for diverse [...] operations
suitable 稍显口语化，不如 appropriate 正式
how much control is required across various [...] systems
how much 偏日常，缺乏审计报告的客观严谨度

items.en: receive an appropriately calibrated supervisory and regulatory touch
items.why: calibrated touch（经过校准的监管尺度）极其精妙，避免了非黑即白的粗暴表述。中国人写这种句子往往用 control 或 management，很难写出这种分寸感。
items.when: 在审计报告中建议对低风险或创新业务采取差异化、非一刀切的监管或复核力度时套用。
items.slot: receive an appropriately calibrated supervisory and regulatory […]
swap: be subject to a tailored oversight and control approach
approach 略显平淡，没有 calibrated touch 形象
get a customized audit and review treatment
get 过于口语化，不符合正式审计文风

items.en: leverage their existing risk-management frameworks, adding appropriate enhancements and controls
items.why: 用 leverage 代替简单的 use，用分词结构 adding... 顺畅地带出附加动作，避免了句式碎片化。中国人常写成 use their frameworks and add...，显得冗长且缺乏专业腔调。
items.when: 在审计建议中要求被查单位利用现有内控体系并进行针对性补充时套用。
items.slot: leverage their existing […] frameworks, adding appropriate enhancements and controls
swap: utilize their current [...] systems, incorporating necessary improvements
utilize 虽正式但不如 leverage 在财经语境中老练
apply their established [...] structures, supplementing suitable safeguards
supplementing 比 adding 稍高级，但原词更为高频

items.en: while accounting for and servicing know-your-customer (“KYC”) and know-your-business (“KYB”) requirements
items.why: 用 while 引导分词短语表示伴随，比用 and 连接两个动词更显紧凑；中国人在写报告时常堆砌动词，缺乏这种主次分明的逻辑层次感。
items.when: 在描述主营业务或核心职责同时兼顾其他合规要求时套用。
items.slot: while accounting for and servicing […] requirements
swap: while addressing […] requirements (强调解决具体问题)
while taking into account […] requirements (略显冗长，不如 accounting for 精准)

items.en: increase the current homeowner’s homestead tax exemption to
items.why: 句式结构精炼，通过名词所有格和精确的数值走向表达清晰，避免了中式英语中冗长的从句和介词堆砌。
items.when: 在财务与税务分析中，描述某项扣除额、限额或估值从当前基数调整至新标准时。
items.slot: increase the current […] to […]
swap: raise the current […] up to […] (up to 在正式报告中略显累赘)
adjust the current […] to reach […] (reach 破坏了直接指向目标的干脆感)

items.en: such as potential output, trend inflation, the natural rate of interest, and the equilibrium real exchange rate
items.why: 长串举例时，中国人常把每个词用逗号隔开但漏掉 and，或者在最后一项前加 and 时位置不对。原句用 'such as A, B, C, and D'（带 Oxford comma 逗号），在严谨的专业金融和审计报告中体现出极高的语法规范性。
items.when: 在财报附注、尽调报告中罗列风险点、关键财务指标或核心假设时套用。
swap: like [...], [...], [...] (like 偏口语化，专业报告更倾向用 such as)
including [...] (没有 such as 罗列具体小项时那么顺畅自然)

items.en: In addition, we extend the standard framework by incorporating a block that captures the relationship
items.why: 中国人写递进时习惯用 Furthermore 或 Moreover，显得有些生硬。'In addition, we [动作] by [动名词]' 是标准的国际专业报告过渡句式，其中用 'by incorporating' 清晰交代了技术路径或增补手段，逻辑极为严密。
items.when: 在审计报告的审计范围扩充段落，或尽调报告中写到在基础模型上增加了额外分析维度时套用。
items.slot: In addition, we extend [...] by incorporating [...]
swap: Furthermore, we add [...] (Furthermore 略显突兀，且 add 不如 incorporate 专业)
Moreover, we also use [...] (Moreover 语气较重，且 also 与 incorporate 搭配显得冗余)

items.en: building toward a unified consumer experience that supports multi-product journeys
items.why: 用 build toward 替代简单的 achieve 或 reach，生动传达了业务推进是一个阶段性、累积并朝着宏大战略目标演进的过程，极具动态感。
items.when: 描述企业从单一产品向多产品协同、平台化演进的战略路径时。
items.slot: building toward a unified […] experience that supports […]
swap: aiming at creating a single user experience (aiming at 显得不够笃定，不如 building toward 有推进感)
to build an integrated consumer journey (用不定式表目的略显单薄，无法体现前文提到的渐进过程)

items.en: something that will likely have great consequences for financial inclusion and our economy more broadly in the years ahead is artificial intelligence
items.why: 用 have great consequences for 来表达重大影响，比中国职场人常用的 will heavily influence 更具学术感和官方报告的厚重感。同时插入语 in the years ahead 放在经济体后面，节奏更自然。
items.when: 在财务尽职调查或宏观审计报告中，评估某项新兴技术、监管政策或市场趋势的深远影响时。
items.slot: something that will likely have great consequences for [...] and [...] more broadly in the years ahead is [...]
swap: will heavily influence (...) — 中文直译味太浓，缺乏官方文件的正式感
will dramatically impact (...) — 副词修饰动词略显口语化，不如名词词组沉稳

items.en: As I have explored in a number of speeches over the past several years
items.why: 用 have explored in a number of 比简单的 mentioned in many 显得资深且有积累。中国人写报告常爱用 many speeches，而 a number of 更加职业且正式。
items.when: 在审计报告前言、尽调访谈综述或专业文章开篇，引用前期研究或多次调研成果时。
items.slot: As I have explored in a number of [...] over the past several years
swap: As I mentioned in many [...] — 口语感强，缺乏审计报告应有的严谨与专业度
As I have discussed across several [...] — 稍显单薄，没有 a number of 涵盖的面广

items.en: But it is also the case that AI may instead exacerbate inequality
items.why: 用 it is also the case that 优雅地引入转折和对立观点，避免了生硬的 However, AI may...。这种句式在美联储和四大审计报告中极为常见，能展现客观、平衡的分析态度。
items.when: 在财务尽调或审计风险评估中，需要客观指出潜在负面影响、对立风险或不利假设时。
items.slot: But it is also the case that [...] may instead [...]
swap: However, [...] may [...] — 过于直接生硬，缺乏专业报告委婉而客观的论证语气
On the other hand, [...] will [...] — 语气绝对化，不符合审计报告谨慎的风险提示原则

items.en: If passed, Amendment 3 would lower the cap
items.why: 精简的条件状语从句省略（If it is passed 的省略），极具专业法律和政策文书的干练感。中国人常写成全句 If it is passed, 或者用多余的状语，显得不够地道紧凑。
items.when: 在财务尽职调查或审计报告中，假设某项法案、条款或拟议政策通过时使用
items.slot: If passed, […] would [行动/调整] […]
swap: Should it pass, [...] (语气更正式，商务报告中常用)
If approved, [...] (动词用 approved 代替 passed，强调审批结果)

items.en: we are able to benefit from a substantial volume of high-intent consumer traffic with no incremental acquisition costs
items.why: 用 benefit from 搭配具体的业务资产（high-intent traffic）和成果，比中国人在财务或业务报告中常用的 obtain 或 gain 显得更加自然且具有专业黏性，突出了模式的协同性。
items.when: 描述企业依靠现有资源或网络优势获得免费或低成本业务增长时
items.slot: we are able to benefit from [...] with no incremental [...]
swap: we can acquire [...] without additional [...] (听起来像是直接买量，缺乏原句的借势感)
we can leverage [...] at zero extra [...] (语气偏向营销口号，不如原句严谨)

items.en: As more financial services firms become Blend customers or deploy additional products through our software platform
items.why: 用 As 引领动态发展的条件，比生硬的 conditional clause (If...) 更能体现业务规模扩大与客户行为之间的自然演进和因果联系。
items.when: 说明业务指标增长如何驱动生态系统协同演进时
items.slot: As more [...] become [...] or deploy [...] through our [...]
swap: If more [...] sign up as [...] and use [...] (用 if 显得过于绝对且带有假设性，不如 as 贴合实际业务增长)
When additional [...] adopt [...] and implement [...] (when 的时间先后感太强，不如 as 强调伴随发生)

items.en: We believe this shared success model creates a powerful network effect that will continue to expand our serviceable addressable market over time
items.why: 主谓宾结构干净利落，用 create a network effect 代替了解释性的长篇大论，末尾加 over time 表现趋势，比单纯用 grow 更有画面感。
items.when: 总结核心商业模式并展望其长期市场空间时
items.slot: We believe this [...] model creates a powerful [...] that will continue to [...] over time
swap: We think this business model will help us grow our market over time (动词 think 偏口语，grow our market 过于平淡)
It is believed that this model can expand our market continuously (被动语态显得游离，失去了管理层的自信语气)

items.en: Should the U.S. government require artificial intelligence companies to transfer half of their stock to a sovereign wealth fund
items.why: 用 require sb. to do 精准表达监管合规层面的强制要求，避免了中国写作者常误用的 force sb. that 或 make sb. to do 等语法错误。
items.when: 在审计报告或尽调条款中提出合规整改或强制要求时。
items.slot: Should the [...] government require [...] companies to [...]?
swap: mandate that [...] transfer [...] (语气更显官方强制，但结构稍显死板)
compel [...] to transfer [...] (动词色彩过重，不如 require 正式)

items.en: a government-run fund that invests surplus state revenues for long-term savings and economic stability
items.why: 用 surplus state revenues 代替泛泛的 money 或 funds，专业词汇精准度极高，中国写作者容易写成 extra government money。
items.when: 在财务报告中描述政府或企业的闲置资金与专项盈余配置时。
items.slot: a [...] fund that invests surplus [...] revenues for [...] and [...]
swap: allocates excess government income [...] (excess 不如 surplus 正式)
deploys remaining state funds [...] (remaining 显得口语化)

items.en: continues to rest on the fundamental strengths of the U.S. economy
items.why: 用 'rest on' 比常用的 'depend on' 或 'rely on' 更有金融报告的稳重感，显得支撑根基深厚，中国人常写成 depend heavily on。
items.when: 在审计报告或尽调中分析某项资产、估值或商业模式的底层支撑时。
items.slot: [...], which continues to rest on the fundamental strengths of [...]
swap: depends heavily on (语气太重且口语化，缺乏客观分析感)
is anchored in (过于文学化，不符合严肃财务报告文风)

items.en: At the same time, he noted that technological innovation
items.why: 用 'At the same time' 做转折引入新维度，既自然又具权威观点平衡感，中国审计师常机械地用 'However' 或 'In addition'。
items.when: 在尽调报告中需要转换视角，指出利好背后的潜在风险或新技术带来的新变量时。
items.slot: At the same time, [he/management] noted that [...]
swap: However (转折过于生硬，缺乏客观评述的缓冲感)
In addition (纯粹表并列，无法体现兼顾两面辩证看的专业思维)

items.en: lead to more competition, which generally leads to better outcomes for both consumers and society as a whole
items.why: 用 'lead to better outcomes for' 代替空洞的 'be good for' 或 'benefit'，显得对宏观影响的评估极具专业厚度，中国人常写成 be good for both sides。
items.when: 在评估某项业务整改、市场准入或技术应用对生态各方的整体影响时。
items.slot: lead to [...], which generally leads to better outcomes for both [...] and [...]
swap: benefit both sides (过于笼统，缺乏商务报告应有的具体层面分析)
result in positive effects on everyone (用词拖沓，不符合专业英文精炼习惯)

items.en: Balancing those scales of costs and benefits involves examining whether the benefits are broadly shared or concentrated.
items.why: 用 balancing those scales 这种隐喻开篇，把抽象的权衡利弊具象化，比干巴巴地用 weighing 或 considering 更生动有画面感。中国人写财报常直译为 considering both sides，略显平淡。
items.when: 在审计报告或尽调总结中，需要引出对复杂利弊、风险与回报进行权衡的段落时
items.slot: Balancing those scales of [...] involves examining whether [...]
swap: Weighing the pros and cons requires assessing if [...]（更为传统直接，缺乏隐喻色彩）
Evaluating the trade-offs entails looking into whether [...]（偏向学术，不如原文流畅）

items.en: Past experience has shown that technological leaps forward can raise living standards.
items.why: 用 past experience has shown 代替主观的 we know 或 history tells us，既客观又具权威性。中国人写报告常喜欢用 it is well known，显得不够严谨专业。
items.when: 在尽调报告中引用历史规律、行业惯例或过往数据来支撑当前论点时
items.slot: Past experience has shown that [...] can [...]
swap: History indicates that [...] tend to [...]（语气稍显生硬，不如 past experience 地道）
It is widely known that [...] will [...]（主观色彩较浓，缺乏官方文件的稳健感）

items.en: increase the value we deliver to our customers
items.why: 使用定语从句 we deliver to our customers 紧凑地修饰 value，动作感极强。中国人常写成 improve customer value 或 enhance value for customers，不如这种结构直观地强调“向客户交付的价值”。
items.when: 在讨论产品战略、客户关系或商业回报时，表达为客户创造和提升价值的举措。
items.slot: increase the value we deliver to our […]
swap: enhance the value provided to our customers (被动式，不如主动的 we deliver 有温度)
maximize customer value (过于绝对和空洞，缺乏 deliver 所传达的具体行动感)

items.en: highlighted the central role of U.S. dollar funding in the international banking system
items.why: 用名词短语 central role of 来替代动词化的表述，使得结论更加客观且具有权威感。中国人的直觉常写成 play a very important role in，显得口语化且缺乏分析力度。
items.when: 在审计报告或尽调总结中强调某项资产、资金或技术在整个体系中的核心地位时
items.slot: highlighted the central role of […] in the international [system / market]
swap: underscored the pivotal importance of […] - 语气更重，强调刻不容缓或风险极高
emphasized the critical function of […] - 侧重功能性而非宏观战略地位

items.en: Even as new technologies reshape how dollars are transferred and intermediated
items.why: 用 Even as 引导让步状语从句，既承认了技术变革的现实，又自然引出核心结论。中国财务人员容易用 Although 或 While，往往流于表面，不如 Even as 更有动态的临场感。
items.when: 在讨论宏观趋势、技术冲击或市场变革时，需要衬托出某种底层结构或核心机制依然稳固的语境
items.slot: Even as [new technologies / market trends] reshape how […]
swap: While ongoing structural shifts alter how […] - 语气偏中性，缺乏 Even as 的戏剧张力
Despite the fact that emerging innovations transform how […] - 略显冗长，不如原句紧凑

items.en: Wealth inequality is a function of the distribution of ownership of assets
items.why: 用 'is a function of' 代替常见的 'depends on' 或 'is caused by', 显得极有数学感和严谨的经济学素养。中国人写财报常习惯用简单的 'depends on', 显得口语化且缺乏因果分析的深度。
items.when: 在财务审计报告中分析某项财务指标波动或经济现象的深层驱动因素时
items.slot: [Financial metric or economic phenomenon] is a function of [underlying driver …driver …and driver …]
swap: depends heavily on (语气更为主观且缺乏学术感)
is directly caused by (过于绝对，缺乏经济学中多因素共振的严谨度)

items.en: we may be subject to claims that our technology or services infringe or misappropriate
items.why: 用 subject to claims that 将面临诉讼风险隐患的被动状态刻画得极其地道，动词短语比直接用 may be sued 更有画面感。中国人写风险时常拼凑出 are possible to receive lawsuits 这种中式英语。
items.when: 在审计或尽调报告中披露潜在法律纠纷、知识产权侵权或合同违约风险时套用。
items.slot: we may be subject to claims that our [...] infringe or misappropriate [...]
swap: we might face lawsuits that our [...] break the rules（lawsuits 搭配 break 极不专业，错用动词）
others might sue us because our [...] use their things（表达极其幼稚，缺乏法律文书的专业度）

items.en: Failure to adequately protect our intellectual property could adversely affect
items.why: 将 failure to do 作为主语直接凝练成名词性结构，配合 adversely affect 展现了风险披露的高级感。中国人习惯写成 If we fail to protect our IP well, it will be bad for us，完全失去了财报的精炼感。
items.when: 在风险提示、尽调报告总结部分，警示某项核心管理疏漏将带来的严重负面后果时使用。
items.slot: Failure to adequately [...] could adversely affect [...]
swap: If we don't protect [...] well, it will hurt [...]（从句头重脚轻，副词 well 极度口语化）
Not protecting [...] properly might cause bad results to [...]（主语结构松散，bad results 词汇贫乏）

items.en: I’ve spent nearly 20 years studying sovereign wealth funds
items.why: 用现在完成时搭配具体时长，清晰说明研究经历的持续性，中国人常误用一般过去时或省略具体时长，导致表述模糊。
items.when: 学术报告或专业文章开头介绍自身研究背景的场合
items.slot: I’ve spent nearly […] years studying […]
swap: I have spent almost two decades researching […]：语气更正式，适合正式报告
I have been researching […] for nearly 20 years：强调研究的延续性动作

items.en: Specific laws define how they receive the cash they invest
items.why: 用从句衔接规则与动作，避免重复表述，结构紧凑，中国人常拆分为多个短句，显得冗余。
items.when: 阐述规则、流程或机制的场合
items.slot: […] define how […]
swap: Clear regulations stipulate the process by which […]：“stipulate”更正式，适合财经报告
Specific rules outline the manner in which […]：“outline”清晰，适合尽职调查文档

items.en: provides a powerful boost to imports of high-technology capital goods
items.why: 动宾搭配精准且力度感十足，用 provides a powerful boost to 代替泛泛的 increases，使经济增长或拉动效应的表述更具专业质感。中国人常写成 makes imports grow fast。
items.when: 在财务尽职调查报告中分析某项新技术、政策或投资对特定供应链、进出口或板块的驱动作用时。
items.slot: provides a powerful boost to [...]
swap: drives a significant increase in (语气偏中性，稍显平淡)
spurs rapid growth in (强调刺激作用，但力度略逊)

items.en: bears the hallmarks of an investment-specific technology shock
items.why: 用 bears the hallmarks of 替代简单的 looks like 或 is characterized by，极具学术与央行报告的洞察力。中国人常写成 has the characteristics of。
items.when: 在审计分析或行业研究中，为某种复杂的经济现象、财务特征定性时。
items.slot: bears the hallmarks of [...]
swap: exhibits the key features of (偏学术说明，画面感不如 hallmarks)
is characteristic of (略显平淡，缺乏修辞张力)

items.en: reaping those efficiency gains requires continuous and substantial investment
items.why: 动名词短语 reaping those efficiency gains 作主语，比用条件句 If we want to get efficiency gains 紧凑得多，且搭配 substantial investment 显得极具专业财务感。中国人常写成 Getting these benefits needs much money。
items.when: 在尽调报告中评估某项资本开支（Capex）的必要性或回报前提时。
items.slot: reaping those [...] requires continuous and substantial investment
swap: capturing these productivity benefits demands significant capital outlays (更偏技术与财务审计口吻)
achieving these cost savings calls for heavy spending (语气稍显口语化)

items.en: Spending by households and businesses has been resilient
items.why: 该写法用现在完成时加resilient，精准表达支出的持续性与抗波动属性，中国人常写“is very strong”，不够贴合财经语境中对经济主体稳定性的专业描述
items.when: 描述家庭或企业支出、活动等经济指标的稳定状态时使用
items.slot: [...] by households and businesses has been resilient
swap: has remained robust（更强调抗冲击的稳定性，比resilient更侧重抵御不利因素的能力）
has stayed strong（语气更平实，适合非正式报告）

items.en: inflation and monetary policy are at a crossroads
items.why: 用“at a crossroads”比喻政策/经济处于关键转折点，比直白的“are facing a critical situation”更生动专业，符合权威财经报告的措辞风格
items.when: 描述政策方向、经济走势处于关键抉择节点的场合
items.slot: [...] and [...] are at a crossroads
swap: are standing at a pivotal juncture（更正式，强调节点的关键性）
are at a critical turning point（更侧重转折的变化性）

items.en: harness AI and buffer the economy and workers
items.why: 用两个精准动词并列（harness表主动利用，buffer表缓冲风险），中文常直接用“利用AI、缓冲经济和工人”，英文并列动词更紧凑正式，符合财经报告的简洁要求
items.when: 在财经报告中描述某政策或工具的双重作用（利用某事物同时缓冲负面影响）时套用
items.slot: harness […] and buffer the economy and workers
swap: leverage AI and protect the economy and workers：leverage与harness同义，protect侧重主动防御，语气比buffer稍弱
utilize AI and shield the economy and workers：utilize更正式，shield比buffer更侧重抵御风险，语气更强烈

items.en: expanding our footprint in both new and existing markets
items.why: "expand footprint"是凝练专业的商业表达，形象描述市场布局拓展，中国人常直译"expand our market coverage"，不够简洁专业
items.when: 商业报告中描述市场拓展、业务布局的场合
items.slot: expanding our footprint in both new and existing […]
swap: expanding our market coverage in both new and existing […] (直译，不够凝练)
extending our market reach in both new and existing […] (同义但正式度略弱)

items.en: try to treat only where surveys turn up a problem
items.why: 用“only where”精准限定动作的适用场景，避免绝对化表述，比中文常写的“只在有问题的地方处理”更简洁严谨，适合正式报告的限定性描述。
items.when: 在报告中描述动作的触发条件或适用范围时套用。
items.slot: try to […] only where […] turn up a problem
swap: attempt to address issues only where surveys reveal a problem (更正式，适配审计报告语境)
strive to treat problems only where surveys show an issue (语气更积极，适合正面表述)

items.en: have been progressing swiftly over the past year
items.why: 正式报告中描述近期工作进展，中国人常写“have developed very fast in the last year”，口语化且不够正式，“progressing swiftly”是地道的财经表达，符合专业报告的语气
items.when: 正式报告中总结过去一段时间的工作进展情况
items.slot: [our efforts/this project] have been progressing swiftly over the past […months/fiscal year]
swap: have been advancing rapidly over the past year（语气更积极，适合突出成果的推进）
have been moving forward quickly over the past year（更侧重流程的推进，适合描述执行类工作）

items.en: due to lower capacity utilization and weather effects
items.why: 使用行业标准术语“capacity utilization”（产能利用率），精准解释成本/收入变动原因，中文常写得笼统，比如“因为资源用得少和天气问题”，不够专业。
items.when: 用于财务报告中说明财务或运营差异的原因时。
items.slot: due to [specific factor …e.g., lower capacity utilization] and [specific factor …e.g., weather effects]
swap: stemming from reduced capacity utilization and weather-related impacts（用“stemming from”更正式，“reduced”替代“lower”）
as a result of lower capacity utilization and weather-related effects（用“as a result of”强化因果逻辑，更清晰）

items.en: through the recent U.S. monetary policy tightening cycle
items.why: 该短语清晰界定了分析的时间与政策背景范围，中国人写财经报告常模糊时间边界，直接写“近期”缺乏明确指向，此写法更严谨。
items.when: 撰写涉及特定政策周期的财经分析、对比研究时套用。
items.slot: through the recent U.S. monetary policy […] cycle
swap: during the recent U.S. monetary policy tightening phase（语气更侧重政策阶段而非循环周期）
over the recent U.S. monetary policy tightening period（语气更侧重时间跨度而非特定周期）

items.en: highlights a remedy that probate judges use sparingly
items.why: 用定语从句修饰“remedy”，简洁说明措施使用频率，比中文拆分的表述更紧凑，符合正式财经报告的表达习惯。
items.when: 用于正式报告中指出某一措施的使用情况时套用。
items.slot: highlights a remedy that […] use sparingly
swap: points out a solution that judges rarely deploy ：“points out”更直接，“deploy”更专业
emphasizes a remedy that judges seldom employ ：“emphasizes”更侧重强调程度，“seldom employ”更口语化

items.en: stopped defending Trump’s public charge policy in court
items.why: 中文表达“停止为某政策在法庭上辩护”时易啰嗦重复，而英文用此短语直接点明动作和场景，简洁精准，中国人常写冗余表述。
items.when: 撰写政府政策法律相关的英文报告时，描述停止某项法律辩护的场景。
items.slot: stopped defending […] in court
swap: ceased defending […] in legal proceedings（更正式，适合官方正式报告）
halted defending […] in court（语气随意，不适合正式报告）

items.en: the cartons used in our baby personal care line are environmentally-friendly, Forest Stewardship Council (“FSC”)-certified, and/or made from 100% recycled, PCW (pre/post consumer waste) materials
items.why: 用"and/or"灵活表述产品属性的可选性，同时明确认证与材料来源，逻辑清晰；中国人常直接用"是环保的、FSC认证的、由100%回收材料制成"，缺少灵活连接，逻辑层次弱。
items.when: 正式报告中列举产品属性或合规要求时套用
items.slot: the [product type] used in our [product line] are [attribute …], [certification …]-certified, and/or made from [material specification] materials
swap: the [product type] used in our [product line] are [attribute 1], [certification 1]-certified, and made from [material specification] materials（语气更确定，适合必须满足的要求）
the [product type] used in our [product line] feature [attribute 1], hold [certification 1], and/or are produced with [material specification] materials（更强调产品特点，语气更积极）

items.en: taking actions to increase revenue growth through improved benefits options and risk management capabilities
items.why: 中国人写英文报告常直接用take actions to increase revenue，缺少对动作路径的清晰衔接，这里用through引出核心举措，逻辑更连贯严谨，符合正式报告要求
items.when: 撰写公司战略规划类英文报告（如SEC 10-K、年报）时可套用
items.slot: taking actions to increase […] through improved […] and […] capabilities
swap: implement initiatives to boost revenue growth via enhanced benefit options and risk management functions（initiatives比actions更贴合战略层面正式举措，via比through更书面正式）
undertake measures to lift revenue growth through upgraded benefit options and risk management abilities（undertake measures比take actions更正式，upgrade比improve更突出升级属性）

items.en: best in benefits, best in platform, best in service
items.why: 中文通常会用“在福利、平台、服务方面做到最好”这种重复结构，而这种平行的“best in X”句式更简洁有力，符合英文正式报告的节奏，避免冗余重复的表达，同时清晰传递三个核心目标。
items.when: 用于撰写企业战略定位、核心竞争力或目标愿景的正式报告场景，如SEC filings、年度报告等。
items.slot: best in […], best in […], best in […]
swap: top-tier in […], leading in […], best-in-class in […]: 该替换用“top-tier（顶级）、leading（领先）、best-in-class（同类最佳）”替代原句的“best in”，语气更侧重行业层级和差异化，适合需要突出竞争优势的场景
best in […], leading in […], top in […]: 该替换调整了表述顺序，用不同的形容词搭配，语气更灵活，适合需要避免重复的语境

items.en: the increased financial exposure some employees may face
items.why: 用省略引导词的定语从句后置修饰核心名词，避免中文式前置长定语的臃肿，符合英文正式报告的简洁性；中国人常写“员工可能面临的增加的财务风险”，前置定语冗长且不符合英文正式文体习惯
items.when: 撰写财务报告中描述主体面临的风险/敞口相关内容时套用
items.slot: the [adjective] [noun] some […] may face
swap: the heightened financial exposure some employees might confront（更正式，适合审计报告）
the greater financial risk some employees could encounter（更偏向风险表述，语气稍弱）

items.en: directs the U.S. Department of Justice ("DOJ") and the U.S. Federal Trade Commission ("FTC") to establish
items.why: 用正式动词directs（而非口语化的tells），搭配官方机构全称加缩写的规范写法，符合SEC报告的正式性，中国人常写得过于随意或机构名称不规范
items.when: 正式监管报告、官方公告中描述机构发布指令的内容时使用
items.slot: [Authoritative Body] directs the [Full Official Name 1] ("[Abbreviation 1]") and the [Full Official Name 2] ("[Abbreviation 2]") to establish […]
swap: instructs (语气稍弱，偏向一般指令，不如directs正式)
mandates (语气更强，更具强制性，适合法定强制指令)

items.en: with a view to optimize their product selection and maximize their yield and profitability
items.why: 用介词短语引出目的，比中国人常用的直接用“to”更正式贴合专业报告语境，中国人常写的“to”过于直白，缺乏正式感
items.when: 在财务报告或正式商务文本中引出目的状语的场合
items.slot: with a view to optimize […] and maximize […]
swap: for the purpose of optimizing […] and maximizing […]：更侧重明确目的的正式性，比原短语稍显生硬
in order to optimize […] and maximize […]：更口语化，不如原短语贴合SEC报告的正式语气

items.en: there can be no assurance that Corteva will be successful in this regard
items.why: 用委婉的不确定性表述，是专业报告常用的对冲写法，比中国人常写的“we are not sure”更严谨符合SEC披露要求，更正式
items.when: 在财务报告或正式披露中表达对未来事项无法保证的场合
items.slot: there can be no assurance that […] will be successful in this regard
swap: no assurance can be given that […] will be successful in this regard：语序稍显生硬，不如原短语自然流畅
we cannot guarantee that […] will be successful in this regard：更偏向口语化，不符合专业报告的正式性

items.en: may affect Corteva's ability to safely operate in
items.why: 用“may affect”委婉表达潜在影响，避免绝对化表述，符合SEC报告的谨慎性要求，中国人常直接写“会影响”，语气过于绝对，不符合专业报告的严谨性。
items.when: 正式报告中描述潜在、非确定的业务影响的场合。
items.slot: may affect [Company]'s ability to [verb phrase] in […]
swap: could impact [Company]'s capacity to [verb phrase] in […]（"could"比"may"语气更弱，更委婉；"impact"比"affect"更侧重冲击性）
might influence [Company]'s ability to [verb phrase] within […]（"might"比"may"更正式；"influence"比"affect"更侧重间接影响）

items.en: we caution that actual results may differ materially
items.why: 用"caution that"加"differ materially"的结构，比中国人常写的直白警告更专业，"materially"（重大地）精准符合SEC报告的表述要求，避免模糊的"不同"表述。
items.when: 财务报告中警示实际经营结果与预期存在重大差异的场合。
items.slot: we caution that actual results may differ materially from […]
swap: we warn that actual results could differ significantly from […]（语气更直接，不如原句专业严谨）
we advise that actual outcomes may differ materially from […]（"advise"偏建议，不符合风险警示的语境）

items.en: carry a higher and more stable margin profile
items.why: This concise phrase uses “profile” to frame margin’s two key characteristics (higher + stable), making the expression structured and professional. Chinese writers usually translate this literally as “利润率更高且更稳定”, which is less formal and lacks standardized financial writing framing.
items.when: When comparing financial metrics (like margin) between different product lines or segments in formal filings.
items.slot: carry a higher and more stable margin profile than […]
swap: boast a stronger and more consistent margin profile (slightly conversational, for investor presentations)
exhibit a better and more reliable margin profile (simpler, for internal summary reports)

items.en: See Item 1A, "Risk Factors," for further discussion of risks related to protecting our intellectual property
items.why: 这里用标准的正式交叉引用指引格式，符合SEC报告的规范要求，比口语化表述更专业，中国人写英文报告常忽略这类标准指引，显得不够合规。
items.when: 撰写正式合规报告、监管文件时，指引读者查看特定章节的场合。
items.slot: See Item [X], "[Section Name]," for further discussion of […]
swap: Refer to Item 1A, "Risk Factors," for more details（更简洁但不够正式）
Check Item 1A, "Risk Factors," for additional discussion（过于随意，不适合合规文件）

items.en: If we are ultimately unable to maintain profitability at the level anticipated by analysts and our stockholders
items.why: 中文常写“如果我们无法维持盈利”，但明确了盈利基准是分析师和股东的预期，让风险表述更具体，符合尽职调查的严谨要求
items.when: 披露未达利益相关方预期的风险时适用
items.slot: If we are ultimately unable to maintain profitability at the level anticipated by […].
swap: If we fail to sustain profitability as expected by analysts and investors.（更简洁，不够正式）
Should we not maintain profitability at the level analysts expect.（倒装条件句，语气更正式但稍显生硬）

items.en: pose a greater risk of loss to the DIF
items.why: 这个动宾结构明确了机构对存款保险基金的风险指向，中国人常直译用“cause a greater risk of loss to the DIF”，原表达更正式专业，贴合金融监管报告的措辞
items.when: 描述金融机构对特定监管主体的风险影响时套用
items.slot: pose a greater risk of loss to the […]
swap: present a higher risk of loss to the DIF（present侧重客观呈现风险，适合数据支撑的风险描述）
create a larger risk of loss for the DIF（create侧重主动造成风险，适合描述机构行为带来的影响）

items.en: due to changes in the types of merchandise sold between periods
items.why: 中文常写“因为不同时期销售商品类型的变化”，此处用due to衔接原因，结构清晰，符合正式报告的逻辑连接规范。
items.when: 正式报告中解释某一情况的原因时套用。
items.slot: due to changes in the types of merchandise sold between […] periods
swap: owing to variations in the categories of goods sold across different periods（owing to更正式，variations强调差异，categories比types更正式）
as a result of shifts in the kinds of products sold over successive periods（as a result of侧重结果关联，shifts强调转变，products比merchandise更常用）

items.en: by (i) providing marketing services for the refined products output of the Tyler Refinery
items.why: 用by引导动名词短语明确说明收入来源的方式，结构清晰正式，符合专业报告规范；中国人常直译“通过提供XX服务”，未用列点形式，不够简洁有条理。
items.when: 正式财务报告中说明业务收入的实现方式时套用
items.slot: by (i) providing […] for the […] of the […]
swap: through (i) providing marketing services
through侧重强调实现方式的路径，语气比by更侧重操作过程，适合需突出路径的场景
via (i) providing marketing services
via更简洁紧凑，语气更正式，适合短篇幅的业务说明

items.en: as well as at terminals owned by third parties
items.why: 用as well as连接并列的地点，避免重复介词at，结构流畅紧凑；中国人常直译“还有在第三方拥有的码头”，重复介词，不够简洁。
items.when: 正式报告中列举并列的地点或主体时套用
items.slot: as well as at terminals owned by […]
swap: and also at terminals owned by third parties
and also语气更口语化，不如as well as正式，适合非正式场合
in addition to terminals owned by third parties
in addition to侧重补充说明，逻辑上更侧重附加项，适合不同的并列逻辑

items.en: is structured as a corporation with no publicly traded equity
items.why: 用structured as描述公司架构属性，比中国人常用的is a corporation without更专业，突出结构层面的特征，适合披露公司法律架构
items.when: 正式报告中说明公司法律结构的场合
items.slot: is structured as a corporation with no […]
swap: organized as a corporation with no publicly traded equity（侧重组织架构，表述稍不同）
formed as a corporation lacking publicly traded equity（侧重形成方式，语气正式）

items.en: when events or changes in circumstances indicate that the carrying value may not be recoverable
items.why: 用“may”委婉表达不确定性，符合正式报告的严谨性，中国人常直接用绝对表述如“cannot be recoverable”，显得武断
items.when: 正式财务报告中描述资产减值测试触发条件的场合
items.slot: when events or changes in circumstances indicate that the […] may not be recoverable
swap: when events or changes in circumstances suggest that the carrying value might not be recoverable（用suggest替代indicate，语气更委婉，弱化判断性）
when events or changes in circumstances signal that the carrying value could not be fully recoverable（用signal替代indicate，语气更正式，增加“fully”强化程度）

items.en: by comparing the property’s probability-weighted future undiscounted cash flows to its current carrying value
items.why: 用“probability-weighted”精准定义现金流的计算逻辑，符合财务报告的专业性，中国人常直接写“future cash flows”，缺少关键限定，表述模糊
items.when: 财务报告中描述资产减值测试的现金流计算方法的场合
items.slot: by comparing the […]’s probability-weighted future undiscounted cash flows to its current carrying value
swap: by comparing the property’s weighted probability future undiscounted cash flows to its current carrying value（语序调整，将“weighted probability”前置，表述稍显随意）
by comparing the property’s probability-weighted future non-discounted cash flows to its current carrying value（用“non-discounted”替代“undiscounted”，用词差异，正式度相近）

items.en: Changes in these assumptions or analysis may cause material changes in the carrying value of the properties
items.why: 用“may cause”委婉表述潜在影响，避免绝对化，符合SEC报告的合规要求，中国人常直接写“will cause changes”，过于武断
items.when: 正式财务报告中披露假设变动对资产价值影响的场合
items.slot: Changes in these assumptions or analysis may cause material changes in the carrying value of the […]
swap: Changes in these assumptions or analysis might result in material changes in the carrying value of the properties（用“result in”替代“cause”，语气更正式，弱化直接性）
Changes in these assumptions or analysis could lead to material changes in the carrying value of the properties（用“lead to”替代“cause”，语气更弱，更显谨慎）

items.en: as the Company does not receive significant revenue from its business operations
items.why: 用as引导原因状语，简洁衔接逻辑，比because更符合正式报告书面语气，避免过于口语化
items.when: 用于正式报告中说明前文动作的原因
items.slot: […], as the Company does not receive significant revenue from its business operations
swap: because the Company does not generate meaningful revenue from its operations（更强调“产生”而非“收到”，语气稍重）
since the Company has no material revenue from its business（更简洁，用会计术语material替代significant）

items.en: There is no guarantee that the Company will be successful in arranging financing on acceptable terms
items.why: 用模糊性表达避免绝对化，符合SEC报告谨慎性要求，中文常直接写“公司无法保证”，此表述更委婉正式，降低法律风险
items.when: 用于正式报告中说明融资、业绩等不确定性事项
items.slot: There is no guarantee that the Company will be successful in […] on acceptable terms
swap: It is not guaranteed that the Company will successfully arrange financing on reasonable terms（更强调被动性，语气稍弱）
The Company cannot ensure it will secure financing on favorable terms（更主动，但不够正式）

items.en: achieve a mix of fixed and variable rate debt
items.why: 用“achieve a mix of”精准表达构建合适组合的意图，比中式英语常用的“get a combination of”更专业，契合财经语境中对债务结构调整的正式表述。
items.when: 可套用在财务报告中描述构建特定类型债务或资产组合的场合。
items.slot: achieve a mix of […] and […] rate debt
swap: attain a combination of […] and […] rate debt（更侧重达成目标的过程）
establish a mix of […] and […] rate debt（更侧重主动建立组合的动作）

items.en: a minimum ratio of CET1 to risk-weighted assets
items.why: 中文常直接写「最低比例」，此处用「a minimum ratio of X to Y」结构，明确对应「X对Y的比例」，避免歧义，符合正式报告的精准性要求
items.when: 用于金融监管文件、财务报告中说明指标比例的场合
items.slot: a minimum ratio of […] to […]
swap: a floor ratio of […] to […]（更正式，适用于监管文件）
the minimum required ratio of […] to […]（更侧重合规要求）

items.en: could also cause clients to move their investments to lower margin products
items.why: 用cause sb to do sth清晰表达因果，搭配lower margin products精准使用财经术语，比中国人常写的口语化表述更专业简洁。
items.when: 撰写英文财经报告中描述市场因素导致的客户行为变化时套用。
items.slot: could also cause clients to move their investments to […]
swap: might prompt clients to shift their investments to lower margin products：prompt更侧重触发，shift更专业
could lead clients to transfer their investments to lower margin products：transfer更侧重资金转移

items.en: in terms of capital, resources, AUC, transaction volume and range of product offerings
items.why: ‘in terms of’是正式书面语中精准限定比较维度的常用短语，中国人常使用‘in the aspect of’这类直译表达，不如其自然贴合SEC报告的正式语境，且更简洁
items.when: 撰写正式财务报告、对比不同主体的规模或能力维度时可套用
swap: with regard to capital, resources, AUC, transaction volume and range of product offerings（语气更侧重关联关系，比‘in terms of’更正式）
as measured by capital, resources, AUC, transaction volume and range of product offerings（侧重用这些指标衡量，更具量化属性）

items.en: Existing and future clients may seek lower cost options
items.why: 用‘Existing and future’并列修饰名词，简洁覆盖两类主体，避免分开表述的冗长（如‘current clients and future clients’），符合正式报告的紧凑性要求
items.when: 撰写涉及现有和未来主体的商业报告、客户分析时可套用
items.slot: [Existing and future] [….] may seek [….]
swap: Current and prospective clients may seek lower cost options（‘prospective’比‘future’更正式，侧重潜在的未来主体）
Existing and potential clients may seek lower cost options（‘potential’更侧重可能性，比‘future’更灵活）

items.en: could adversely impact our operations and/or financial results.
items.why: 用“adversely impact”精准表达不利影响，比中国人常写的“会产生不好的影响”更简洁专业，符合财经报告的正式语气。
items.when: 撰写风险因素分析时，描述对业务或财务结果的不利影响的场合。
items.slot: could adversely impact our […] and/or financial results.
swap: could negatively affect our operations and/or financial performance（用affect替换impact，更正式）
might harm our operations and/or financial results（语气更弱，适合风险预警表述）

items.en: management reviews deposit flows, loan demand, cash levels, and changes in several market interest rates
items.why: 用并列名词短语清晰罗列审查维度，逻辑明确，中国人常写‘management checks deposit flows, loan demand...’用词较口语化，专业度不足
items.when: 用于正式报告中描述管理层的常规审查动作
items.slot: management reviews […] , […] , […] , and […]
swap: management examines deposit flows, loan demand...（语气更正式，适合审计报告）
management assesses deposit flows, loan demand...（侧重评估，适合财务分析报告）

items.en: based on competitor pricing and the credit risk of the borrower
items.why: 用‘based on A and B’结构明确说明决策依据，并列成分逻辑对等，中国人常写‘according to competitor pricing and borrower's credit risk’用词冗余，结构不够紧凑
items.when: 用于正式报告中说明产品定价或策略的依据
items.slot: based on […] and […]
swap: dependent on competitor pricing and the borrower's credit risk（侧重依赖，语气不如前者中性）
grounded in competitor pricing and the credit risk of the borrower（更书面化，适合学术类报告）

items.en: We are preparing to implement a comprehensive suite of private banking products and services in fiscal year 2026
items.why: “comprehensive suite”比“a full set of”更正式，强调配套设计的严密性；中国写作者通常直译“一套完整产品”，丢失“suite”隐含的“集成套件”感。
items.when: 在年报或项目计划中预告将推出一整套互为补充的产品或服务时。
items.slot: We are preparing to implement a comprehensive suite of […] in fiscal year […]
swap: a full range of (强调种类齐全，但不如suite突出各部分的有机搭配)
an end-to-end solution (侧重端到端，更偏向单一整合方案而非多个产品组合)
a complete set of (最直白，缺乏商业文件所需的专业质感)

items.en: to better serve our customers and grow our non-interest revenue
items.why: 用“to better serve … and grow …”一个不定式带出双重目的，比“in order to improve service to customers and to increase non‑interest income”紧凑；“better serve”是地道搭配，中国学生易说“improve service”。
items.when: 介绍一项新举措如何同时提升客户体验和财务指标时。
items.slot: to better serve our […] and grow our […]
swap: to enhance customer service and boost non-interest revenue (更书面，但boost稍显营销口吻)
aiming to improve the customer experience while increasing non-interest income (while引出两个动作，语气更松散)
with the goal of better serving customers and expanding revenue streams (streams涵盖更宽，但不如grow直接)

items.en: our private banking line of business will bridge the gap between high-net-worth depository customers, small business owners or commercial customers, and corporate trustee opportunities for the Bank
items.why: “bridge the gap”用比喻说明填补业务空白，比“connect”形象；between后并列三项，用逗号分隔再加“and”使列举清晰，中文习惯罗列时易忽略这种层次。
items.when: 在阐述新业务能打通原本隔离的客群或机会，创造协同价值时。
items.slot: […] will bridge the gap between […], […], and […]
swap: close the divide between (强调分歧、对立，语气较严肃，适用于明显隔阂)
link … with … (仅表示连接，缺少“原先存在缺口”的意味)
create synergy among (强调协同，但没有暗示此前存在不连通的情况)

items.en: could cause actual results to differ materially from those in any forward-looking statement
items.why: 用“differ materially from”精准表达财务报告中要求的“实质性差异”，中国人常直接写“be different from”，表述笼统，不符合专业报告的精准性要求。
items.when: 撰写财务报告中前瞻性声明的风险提示内容时套用。
items.slot: could cause actual results to differ materially from those in any forward-looking statement related to […]
swap: might result in actual outcomes differing significantly from those in any forward-looking statement（“differ materially”比“differ significantly”更贴合SEC专业术语，语气更严谨）
could lead to actual results being materially different from those in any forward-looking statement（“differ materially”比“being materially different”更简洁，更符合正式报告的措辞习惯）

items.en: undertakes no obligation to update any forward-looking statement
items.why: 用“undertakes no obligation”正式表达“不承担义务”，中国人常写“has no duty”，语气不够正式，不符合SEC filing的规范表述。
items.when: 财务报告中声明前瞻性声明的更新义务时套用。
items.slot: undertakes no obligation to update any forward-looking statement to reflect developments that occur after […]
swap: does not have a duty to revise any forward-looking statement（“undertakes no obligation”比“has no duty”更贴合监管文件的正式措辞，更具法律严谨性）
is not obligated to update any forward-looking statement（“undertakes no obligation”比“is not obligated”更书面化，更符合专业报告风格）

items.en: it will receive 100% of any Class B distributions made by MAIT.
items.why: 用过去分词短语作后置定语修饰名词，避免定语从句的冗长，结构紧凑，中国人常写“distributions that are made by MAIT”，更啰嗦
items.when: 用于正式报告中描述权益或资金的分配流向
items.slot: it will receive …% of any [Class X] distributions made by [Entity].
swap: it will receive all Class B distributions issued by MAIT.（“issued”比“made”更贴合证券发行场景，更正式）
it will get 100% of any Class B distributions from MAIT.（“from”更简洁，适合内部非正式报告）

items.en: designed to improve operating flexibility, increase reliability, position transmission capacity for future load growth and facilitate response to system events
items.why: 采用平行结构的不定式短语作后置定语，避免拆分多个分句，符合英文正式报告的凝练表达，中文常拆成多个独立分句，英文用并列不定式结构更紧凑，减少冗余
items.when: 撰写项目计划、方案的目的说明时套用
items.slot: [plan] designed to improve […], increase […], position […] for […] and facilitate […]
swap: intended to enhance operating flexibility, boost reliability, allocate transmission capacity for future load growth and support response to system events（语气更正式，enhance比improve更强调效果提升）
created to advance operating flexibility, strengthen reliability, align transmission capacity with future load growth and ease response to system events（语气偏向战略层面，align比position更强调匹配度）

items.en: including the risk of potential breakdown or failure of equipment or processes due to aging infrastructure
items.why: 用名词性短语分层列举风险，比中文常直接罗列更清晰严谨，避免冗余动词，中国人写英文常直接用“have risks like”，不够专业凝练
items.when: 用于财务/审计报告中列举业务相关风险因素时
items.slot: including the risk of potential […] or failure of […] due to […]
swap: including risks such as potential breakdown or failure of equipment or processes（替换后更简洁，适合短报告，语气平实）
including the potential risk of breakdown or failure of equipment or processes（替换后更强调风险可能性，语气稍强）

items.en: weather-related incidents and other natural disasters can disrupt transmission systems
items.why: 用合成形容词“weather-related”修饰名词，比中文常直译“incidents related to weather”更紧凑专业，符合英文报告风格，中国人写英文常拆分表述，不够凝练
items.when: 用于财务报告中描述与特定因素相关的事件时
items.slot: […] incidents and other natural disasters can disrupt […] systems
swap: weather-related events and other natural disasters can disrupt transmission networks（替换后用events替代incidents，语气更通用）
weather-related occurrences and other natural disasters can disrupt transmission systems（替换后用occurrences替代incidents，更正式）

items.en: could be adversely affected by unexpected or uncontrollable events occurring on the systems of such third parties
items.why: 用被动语态客观表述潜在影响，避免主动语态的主观性，符合SEC报告的中立正式要求，中国人写英文常常用主动语态“will affect”，不够严谨
items.when: 用于财务尽职调查/审计报告中描述外部因素对主体的潜在影响时
items.slot: could be adversely affected by unexpected or uncontrollable events occurring on the systems of such […]
swap: may be negatively impacted by unforeseen or uncontrollable events occurring on the systems of such third parties（替换后用may替代could，语气更弱）
might be adversely impacted by unforeseeable or uncontrollable events occurring on the systems of such third parties（替换后用might替代could，更委婉）

items.en: We also have items not directly attributable to an operating segment.
items.why: 用“not directly attributable to”精准表达财务项的归属关系，是SEC报告标准专业术语，中文常直接写“不能直接归属于”，英文表述更契合正式财务文件的措辞规范。
items.when: 在财务报告中区分无法直接归属到特定业务部门的项目时使用。
items.slot: We also have items not directly attributable to [… ].
swap: that cannot be directly traced to（更强调追溯性，适用于需明确溯源的场景）
not directly assignable to（assignable更偏向分配属性，适用于需明确分配规则的场景）

items.en: For a detailed breakdown of the composition of our loan portfolio
items.why: 用“For a detailed breakdown of + 名词”清晰指引读者查找详细内容，符合SEC报告的规范，中文常直接说“详见贷款组合构成的详细拆分”，英文的指引结构更简洁正式。
items.when: 用于财报中指引读者查看附注或详细数据。
items.slot: For a detailed breakdown of the composition of our […]
swap: For a granular breakdown of our loan portfolio’s composition（granular强调颗粒度更细，适合更细节的指引）
For a detailed analysis of our loan portfolio composition（analysis侧重分析，breakdown侧重拆分，语气不同）

items.en: such as U.S. Treasury securities and GNMA securities
items.why: 用such as紧跟被修饰名词，明确举例范围，中国人写英文常误用like或把例子后置，such as更符合正式报告的严谨性，无歧义。
items.when: 正式报告中举例说明名词时套用。
items.slot: such as […] and […]
swap: including U.S. Treasury securities and GNMA securities（语气宽泛，适合列举部分案例）
like U.S. Treasury securities and GNMA securities（更口语化，适合非正式文档）

items.en: must compete with other branded, biosimilar, or generic products
items.why: 该写法明确列举竞品的三类具体类型，表述精准且符合正式报告的专业规范；中国人常笼统写“compete with other products”，缺少分类，不够严谨。
items.when: 撰写行业竞争分析、产品市场定位相关的正式报告、财务尽职调查文档时套用。
items.slot: […] must compete with other branded, biosimilar, or generic products
swap: face competition from other branded, biosimilar, or generic products（语气更侧重被动面临竞争，原句侧重主动参与竞争）
have to compete against other branded, biosimilar, or generic products（语气稍口语化，正式度略低于原句）

items.en: terms such as "anticipates," "believes," "could," "estimates," "expects," "forecasts," "goals," "guidance," "intends," "may," "objectives," "plans," "possible," "potential," "projects," "seeks," "should," "targets," "will," or variations of these terms
items.why: 用正式“such as”列举术语，术语加引号明确标识，补充变体说明覆盖范围，中国人常误用口语化“like”或省略变体，该写法精准全面符合SEC要求
items.when: 正式报告中列举特定术语（如前瞻性陈述标识词）时
items.slot: terms such as "[Term1]," "[Term2]," ..., "[TermN]," or variations of these terms
swap: terms including "anticipates," "believes," ..., "will," or their variants: 表述简洁，适合篇幅紧张的正式文件
terms like "anticipates," "believes," ..., "will," or related terms: 语气稍口语化，适合非监管类正式报告

items.en: in the following sections of this Annual Report on Form 10-K
items.why: 中文常写“在本年报的以下部分”，该表述使用了监管文件的标准术语“Form 10-K”，精准明确，符合专业报告的规范。
items.when: 用于监管报告中指定具体的报告章节位置。
items.slot: in the following sections of this Annual Report on Form …-K
swap: in the subsequent sections of this Annual Report on Form 10-K (subsequent比following更正式，适用于更严谨的监管语境)
in the below sections of this Annual Report on Form 10-K (below更简洁，适合篇幅较短的报告)

items.en: In the absence of significant revenue and profits
items.why: 是正式财经报告中常用的严谨表达，替代口语化的'without'，中国人常直接用'without'，不够贴合正式报告语境。
items.when: 正式财务报告中描述企业缺乏某项关键指标（如收入、利润）的场合。
items.slot: In the absence of […], we will be completely dependent on […].
swap: Without significant revenue and profits（语气更直接，不够正式）
Given the lack of significant revenue and profits（侧重客观缺失，与原句条件语气不同）

items.en: more likely to be affected by adverse personal circumstances
items.why: 体现概率性而非绝对性，中国人常直接写“will be affected”，过于绝对，不符合财报审慎性原则
items.when: 描述风险或影响的概率性表述场合
items.slot: more likely to be affected by […]
swap: could be impacted（语气更委婉，用于初步评估）
may be influenced（更中性，用于非核心风险）

items.en: included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K
items.why: 清晰指明补充信息的位置，避免了用“mentioned in other parts”这类模糊表达，中国人常使用不明确的指代，增加读者查找难度。
items.when: 在官方报告中引导读者查找同一报告内的补充信息时使用。
items.slot: [补充信息] is included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form …-K
swap: appearing elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K: 更简洁，稍不正式
found elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K: 口语化，用于非监管文件

items.en: contain uncertainties that may materially affect actual results
items.why: 用副词"materially"精准修饰影响程度，比中国人常用的"greatly"更符合SEC报告的专业表述，避免模糊，体现财务报告的严谨性
items.when: 在财务报告中描述不确定因素对结果的潜在影响时使用
items.slot: contain uncertainties that may materially affect […] results
swap: carry uncertainties that could significantly impact actual outcomes（用carry替代contain，语气更弱，impact替代affect，表述更委婉）
involve uncertainties that may substantially influence actual results（substantially替代materially，influence替代affect，侧重影响的实质性）

items.en: See Item 1A. - Risk Factors in this Annual Report on Form 10-K
items.why: 用"See"直接指引到具体报告章节，比中国人常用的"Please refer to"更简洁专业，符合正式报告的高效表述习惯
items.when: 在财务报告中引用其他章节的详细内容时使用
items.slot: See Item […] in this Annual Report on Form 10-K
swap: Refer to Item […] within this Annual Report on Form 10-K（更正式，用within替代in，语气更严谨）
Check Item […] in this Annual Report on Form 10-K（语气随意，不适合正式报告，仅用于非正式场景）

items.en: applies to all AES employees and employees of AES subsidiaries
items.why: 中文对应正式报告的适用范围，常有人用“is applicable to”，但此写法用“applies to”更简洁，无冗余，符合SEC报告的简洁正式风格。
items.when: 正式报告中说明规则、标准要求的适用对象时使用。
items.slot: [Rule/Standard] applies to all [Group …] and [Group …], as well as [Group …]
swap: is applicable to all [Group 1] and [Group 2], as well as [Group 3]：更书面化，语气更正式，适合监管报告
covers all [Group 1] and [Group 2], as well as [Group 3]：侧重覆盖范围，语气稍宽泛，适合非监管类内部报告

items.en: associated with cooling and in the winter months associated with heating
items.why: 采用平行结构的后置定语，避免重复“associated with”，句式简洁对称，符合英文正式写作的平行原则，比中国人常写的“which are associated with cooling and which are associated with heating”更紧凑。
items.when: 适用于正式报告中描述并列的关联事项时，保持句式的平行性以提升可读性。
items.slot: […] associated with […] and […] associated with […]
swap: linked to cooling and in the winter months linked to heating（“linked to”与“associated with”同义，语气稍弱）
related to cooling and in the winter months related to heating（“related to”更通用，不如“associated with”贴合业务关联的紧密性）
correlated with cooling and in the winter months correlated with heating（“correlated with”侧重统计关联，不如“associated with”贴合业务归属）

items.en: can also be impacted by service territory economic activity and the number of retail customers we have
items.why: 使用被动语态客观陈述业务影响因素，避免使用主观主语（如“we”），符合SEC报告的中立、客观风格，比中国人常写的“service territory economic activity and the number of retail customers we have also impact”更正式、客观。
items.when: 适用于正式财经报告中描述业务被外部因素影响时，保持中立语气以符合专业报告要求。
items.slot: […] can also be impacted by […] and […]
swap: can also be affected by service territory economic activity and the number of retail customers we have（“affected”更通用，专业语境中“impacted”更贴合业务层面的影响）
may also be influenced by service territory economic activity and the number of retail customers we have（“may”语气更弱，适合不确定性更高的语境）
are also impacted by service territory economic activity and the number of retail customers we have（去掉“can”，语气更肯定，适合确定性较高的影响）

items.en: eliminates duplication of upload and data entry while reducing errors
items.why: 用while引导的伴随状语简洁表达措施的双重效果，中国人常拆成两个独立分句更啰嗦
items.when: 写专业报告描述某举措带来的双重益处时套用
items.slot: eliminates duplication of […] and […] while reducing […]
swap: removes redundancy of upload and data entry while cutting errors（语气更口语化）
eliminates redundant uploads and data entries while lowering mistakes（更简洁的名词形式）

items.en: These arrangements provide a number of additional benefits
items.why: Chinese writers often use vague expressions like '带来很多好处' when describing business gains, while this phrase uses precise wording to clearly state advantages, avoiding ambiguity.
items.when: When explaining the advantages of a business arrangement or partnership.
items.slot: These arrangements provide a number of additional benefits, including […], […], […], […].
swap: offer a variety of extra benefits (more casual, less formal for official reports)
deliver several supplementary benefits (more formal, suitable for strict regulatory documents)

items.en: increase our share of our customers’ total rental spend
items.why: 用具体的“total rental spend”替代模糊的“customers’ spending”，表述精准，符合SEC报告的严谨性，中国人常写“increase our share of customers’ spending”，不够具体。
items.when: 用于撰写市场份额、客户支出相关的业务指标表述场合
items.slot: increase our share of our customers’ total […] spend
swap: grow our share of customers’ total rental expenditure（更正式，适合年报表述）
boost our share of customers’ total rental spending（更强调增长幅度，适合业绩表述）

items.en: including refineries and petrochemical operations, industrial manufacturing including automotive and aerospace, power, energy, renewables, metals and mining, agriculture, pulp, paper and wood and food and beverage
items.why: 用including分层列举行业，逻辑清晰，中国人常直接罗列行业，缺少分层显得杂乱
items.when: 撰写业务覆盖的行业范围时
swap: such as refineries and petrochemical operations, industrial manufacturing, power, energy, renewables, metals and mining, agriculture, pulp, paper and wood, and food and beverage（更简洁，去掉重复的including）
like refineries and petrochemical operations, etc.（更随意，不适合正式报告）

items.en: represented approximately 25% of our equipment rental revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025
items.why: 用approximately体现量化的严谨性，避免绝对化，中国人常直接写25%，正式报告中不够专业
items.when: 撰写财务数据占比时
items.slot: represented approximately […]% of our […] revenue for the year ended […]
swap: accounted for roughly 25% of our equipment rental revenue for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025（用fiscal year替代calendar year，更符合财务术语）
constituted about 25% of our equipment rental revenue for the year ending December 31, 2025（用ending替代ended，时间范围表述不同）

items.en: has remained conservative when considering rates and rate increases
items.why: 该写法用现在完成体搭配“when considering”清晰传递决策时的审慎态度，符合正式报告的专业语气；中文常直接生硬直译或用简单的“considering”，缺乏时态带来的语境连贯性。
items.when: 用于正式财务报告中描述决策制定时的审慎原则。
items.slot: The Company has remained conservative when considering […] and […].
swap: has exercised caution when considering […] and […]（语气更侧重主动采取谨慎措施）
has taken a conservative approach to considering […] and […]（更强调决策方法而非状态）

items.en: an increase of $125 million, or 27%, compared to the prior-year quarter
items.why: 中文财务写作常直接写“同比增长1.25亿美元，27%”，该写法将绝对值与百分比并列，用“compared to the prior-year quarter”明确对比基准，结构清晰，便于读者快速对比数据
items.when: 适用于季度财务业绩同比增长的披露场景
items.slot: an increase of […], or […], compared to the prior-year quarter
swap: a rise of $125 million, or 27%, versus the prior-year quarter（versus比compared to更正式，适合SEC类报告）
a 27% increase of $125 million, compared to the prior-year quarter（语序调整，突出百分比增长幅度）

items.en: adjusted net income for the fourth quarter of $71.6 million, or $1.16 per diluted share
items.why: 中文常写“第四季度调整后净利润7160万美元，每股摊薄收益1.16美元”，该写法将“adjusted”置于指标前，明确是调整后指标，用“or”并列每股数据，避免歧义，符合专业报告规范
items.when: 适用于非GAAP调整后财务指标的披露场景
items.slot: adjusted […指标] for the […quarter] of […], or $[…] per diluted share
swap: adjusted net profit for the fourth quarter amounting to $71.6 million, or $1.16 per diluted share（amounting to比of更正式，强调金额属性）
adjusted net income in the fourth quarter of $71.6 million, or $1.16 diluted per share（语序调整，突出期间的位置）

items.en: Net income for the year ended December 31, 2025 was $246.6 million, or $4.01 per diluted share
items.why: 用“核心指标 + for + 截止日期的年度 + was + 总数值, or + 单位数值”的名词性结构，比中国人常用的“Net income in 2025 was...”更准确体现财务报告的时间边界，清晰拆分每股收益的数值，符合专业报告规范。
items.when: 用于财务报告中披露年度核心指标（如净利润、每股收益）时。
items.slot: Net income for the year ended […] was $[…] million, or $[…] per diluted share
swap: Net earnings for the year ended […] were $[…] million, or $[…] per diluted share（用earnings替代income，部分地区财务报告常用表述）
Net profit for the year ended […] was $[…] million, or $[…] per basic share（用basic替代diluted，区分不同类型的每股收益）

items.en: Adjusted net income for the year ended December 31, 2025 was $260.2 million
items.why: 用“Adjusted + 核心指标”的属性修饰结构，明确区分常规净利润与调整后净利润，比中国人直接写的“adjusted net profit”更符合SEC报告的规范术语，避免指标混淆。
items.when: 用于财务报告中披露经调整的非公认会计准则（GAAP）指标时。
items.slot: Adjusted net income for the year ended […] was $[…] million
swap: Adjusted net earnings for the year ended […] were $[…] million（用earnings变体，部分报告的常用表述）
Adjusted operating income for the year ended […] was $[…] million（调整不同类型的收入指标，适配不同披露场景）

items.en: net sales for the fourth quarter were $504 million
items.why: 中文财务写作常把时间放句首，英文此处将核心指标“net sales”放句首，符合英文“先核心信息”的表达逻辑，中国人写英文常语序颠倒导致不地道。
items.when: 财务报告中陈述特定期间核心指标数值的场合。
items.slot: [net sales/gross profit] for the [first/second/third/fourth] quarter were $[…] million
swap: the fourth quarter net sales amounted to $504 million（用amounted to更正式，适合年报）
$504 million was the net sales for the fourth quarter（强调数值，适合数据对比场景）

items.en: purchasing financial instruments, such as prepaid variable forward contracts, equity swaps, collars, and exchange funds
items.why: 中文罗列金融工具常生硬堆砌，此处用“such as [A], [B], [C], and [D]”的正式罗列结构，逻辑清晰，符合财经报告的规范表述。
items.when: 罗列具体金融工具名称的场合
items.slot: purchasing financial instruments, such as […], equity swaps, collars, and exchange funds
swap: acquiring financial instruments, including prepaid variable forward contracts, equity swaps, collars, and exchange funds：“acquiring”比“purchasing”更正式，适用于非直接购买的金融工具获取
buying financial instruments, like prepaid variable forward contracts, equity swaps, collars, and exchange funds：“like”比“such as”更口语化，仅适用于非正式的列举场景

items.en: via direct connection with the point of care
items.why: 用介词短语「via」清晰说明业务实现路径，比中国人常写的「通过直接连接」更简洁正式，符合SEC报告的严谨措辞要求。
items.when: 用于说明产品、服务的实现方式或业务路径的场合。
items.slot: via [direct/secure/...] connection with the [target/...]
swap: through direct connection with the point of care（更侧重物理连接，via更侧重渠道属性）
by direct connection with the point of care（语气更被动，正式度稍低）

items.en: power our patented risk adjustment methodology with dynamic intervention planning
items.why: 用动词「power」搭配修饰语「patented」「dynamic」传递产品赋能作用，比中国人常直译的「支持我们的专利风险调整方法」更具商业力量感，符合英文报告的积极表达习惯。
items.when: 用于介绍产品核心功能、核心价值的场合。
items.slot: power our [patented/core/...] [risk adjustment/...] methodology with [dynamic/customized/...] planning
swap: drive our patented risk adjustment methodology with dynamic intervention planning（更侧重驱动效果，power更侧重赋能）
fuel our patented risk adjustment methodology with dynamic intervention planning（更侧重动力属性，使用场景更窄）

items.en: Our revenue arrangements commonly include support and maintenance, software as a service (“SaaS”), private cloud hosting, network & processing solutions, marketing impressions, data, software licenses, and professional services
items.why: 用“commonly include”明确是常规包含的内容，避免绝对化，中国人常直接写“include”，表述不够严谨
items.when: 在财务报告中列举业务收入的常规组成部分时使用
items.slot: Our revenue arrangements commonly include […]
swap: Our revenue arrangements typically include […]（“typically”更侧重典型情况，“commonly”侧重普遍情况，语气略有差异）
Our revenue arrangements generally include […]（“generally”更侧重整体情况，与“commonly”的使用场景略有不同）

items.en: transition, analyze and coordinate care and improve the quality, efficiency and value of healthcare delivery across the care community
items.why: 使用平行并列动词结构，逻辑清晰简洁，中国人常重复使用不定式符号“to”，结构冗余，不够简洁
items.when: 在正式报告中描述解决方案的功能时使用
items.slot: enable our customers to […], […], and […], and […] the […]
swap: transition, analyze, coordinate care, and improve the quality, efficiency and value of healthcare delivery across the care community（将逗号替换为“and”，更简洁）
facilitate our customers to transition, analyze and coordinate care and improve the quality, efficiency and value of healthcare delivery across the care community（“facilitate”比“enable”更侧重辅助，正式程度略低）

items.en: Forward-looking statements can be identified by words such as “anticipate,” “believe,” “estimate,” “expect,” “guidance,” “intend,” “may,” “outlook,” “plan,” “predict,” “project,” “target,” “potential,” “will,” “would,” “could,” “should,” “continue,” “contemplate,” “aim,” “strive,” “goal,” “seek,” “forecast” and other similar expressions
items.why: 该写法用被动句式清晰定义了识别特定表述的方法，符合正式报告的严谨性，中国人常直接用主动式如“You can identify forward-looking statements by...”，语气生硬不够正式
items.when: 用于正式报告中定义特定术语的识别方式时套用
items.slot: Forward-looking statements can be identified by words such as […] and other similar expressions
swap: Forward-looking statements are identifiable via terms like “anticipate,” “believe,” etc.（更简洁，适合短篇幅报告）
You can tell forward-looking statements from other text by words such as […]（主动式，语气口语化，不适合正式披露）

items.en: Investors are cautioned that forward-looking statements are inherently uncertain
items.why: 用被动式发出正式警示，避免直接指向读者的生硬感，中国人常写“We caution investors that...”，语气过于直接，不符合SEC报告的正式语境
items.when: 用于正式报告中向受众发出合规性警示时套用
items.slot: [Recipients] are cautioned that […] are inherently uncertain
swap: We hereby caution recipients that […] carry inherent uncertainty（主动式，针对性更强，适合特定受众）
It is important to note that […] are inherently uncertain（中性表述，警示性稍弱）

items.en: A number of factors could cause actual results to differ materially from these statements, including, but not limited to
items.why: 用“including, but not limited to”明确列举的开放性，中国人常直接写“including”，易被误解为列举全部因素，该写法更严谨，符合披露要求
items.when: 用于正式报告中列举影响结果的因素，需说明列举不完整的场景时套用
items.slot: A number of factors could cause actual results to differ materially from these statements, including, but not limited to […]
swap: Various factors might lead actual outcomes to differ significantly from these statements, such as […]（用“various”和“might”更灵活，适合非强制披露）
Many factors could result in actual results being materially different, including […]（省略“but not limited to”，适合内部报告）

items.en: Adjusted Net Income and Adjusted EBITDA (as defined in “Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations”)
items.why: 中国人写财务术语时常直接使用不标注定义来源，原文明确标注术语出处，符合SEC披露的合规要求，避免不同解读的歧义。
items.when: 财务报告中首次出现需定义的专业术语的场合。
items.slot: [Adjusted Net Income] and [Adjusted EBITDA] (as defined in “Item …Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations”)
swap: Adjusted Net Income and Adjusted EBITDA (see Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations)（用see简化表述，更简洁）
Adjusted Net Income and Adjusted EBITDA (per definitions in Item 7 of MD&A)（用MD&A缩写，更符合行业惯例）

items.en: The system is guided by an executive committee
items.why: 采用被动语态弱化主观主体，增强正式报告的客观性与严谨性；中文写作常直接使用主动语态，不符合SEC等正式报告的规范。
items.when: 适用于正式合规报告中，描述体系或流程的治理主体时。
items.slot: […] is guided by […]
swap: The executive committee guides […]（主动语态，语气偏主观，不适合正式报告）
[…] is overseen by […]（替换动词为overseen，更侧重监督职能）

items.en: applying defined controls to engage employees and manage injury risk
items.why: 用不定式清晰说明动作的目的，结构紧凑简洁，符合正式报告的写作要求；中文写作常使用冗余连接词，导致句子冗长。
items.when: 适用于正式报告中，说明所采取措施的具体目的时。
items.slot: applying […] to […] and […]
swap: using […] to engage […] and manage […]（替换动词为using，语气更侧重工具使用）
implementing […] for engaging […] and managing […]（替换动词为implementing，更侧重执行落地）

items.en: return cash to our shareholders through payment of dividends and stock buybacks
items.why: 用‘through + 名词短语’表方式，比中文直译常用的动名词结构更正式简洁，符合SEC报告的书面语规范，中国人常使用更口语化的表达
items.when: 商业报告中描述向股东返还资金方式的场合
items.slot: return cash to our shareholders through […]
swap: return cash to our stockholders via dividend payments and share repurchases（stockholders和share repurchases更符合美股术语，via更正式）
distribute cash to our shareholders via dividends and stock repurchases（distribute更侧重分配，repurchases更正式）

items.en: Restructuring expenses reflect costs associated with our efforts of continuously improving operational efficiency and expanding globally in order to remain competitive in our end-user markets.
items.why: 中文常直接写「重组费用包括与我们...相关的成本」，用「reflect costs associated with」更符合英文财报正式语气，清晰关联费用与战略动作，逻辑更顺
items.when: 用于SEC 10-K等正式财报中说明费用的性质及关联动作
items.slot: [Expense Category] reflect costs associated with our efforts of [action …] and [action …] in order to remain competitive in our [target market]
swap: Restructuring expenses represent costs related to our efforts of continuously improving operational efficiency and expanding globally to stay competitive in our end-user markets.（用represent替换reflect，语气稍弱，正式度略低）

Restructuring expenses include costs linked to our efforts of continuously improving operational efficiency and expanding globally for competitiveness in our end-user markets.（用include替换reflect，linked to替换associated with，更简洁）

items.en: compared to the cost of a new well
items.why: 用“compared to”明确对比对象（成本），逻辑清晰，中国人常写“than a new well”易歧义，缺少对比的核心维度
items.when: 正式报告中做成本或数值对比时套用
items.slot: […] compared to the cost of a new […]
swap: in relation to the cost of a new well（更书面化的对比表述）
versus the cost of a new well（更偏向数据对比的专业语气）

items.en: derives all or substantially all of its income
items.why: “substantially all”是财经精准表述，指几乎全部但留有余地，比中国人常用的“almost all”更专业严谨，符合审计/尽职调查的精准性要求
items.when: 正式报告中描述主体收入来源比例时套用
items.slot: derives all or substantially all of its income from […]
swap: gets all or almost all of its income（口语化，不够正式）
obtains all or nearly all of its income（“nearly”语气不如“substantially”专业）

items.en: operate at scale across the U.S. and U.K.
items.why: 中文作者常写“在…拥有大规模业务”，表述较繁琐；“operate at scale”简洁正式，符合监管报告的专业语气。
items.when: 描述公司在特定区域的运营规模时套用。
items.slot: operate at scale across […]
swap: conduct large-scale operations in (表述较繁琐，不够凝练)
operate on a large scale in (语气稍显口语化，正式度不足)

items.en: our strategy is centered on building density within defined markets
items.why: 中文作者常用“我们的策略聚焦于”，“is centered on”更正式，能突出策略的核心地位，适合SEC这类监管文件。
items.when: 陈述公司核心业务策略时套用。
items.slot: our strategy is centered on […]
swap: our strategy focuses on (较常用，正式度略低)
our core strategy is focused on (冗余，'centered'已体现核心含义)

items.en: allowing us to better serve customers, improve retention and increase share of garage across the vehicle ownership lifecycle
items.why: 中文作者常拆分多个句子表述策略带来的好处，用现在分词短语可将动作与结果紧密连接，行文流畅简洁，避免冗余。
items.when: 连接业务举措与预期成果时套用。
items.slot: allowing us to […], […], and […]
swap: which enables us to better serve customers, improve retention and increase share of garage across the vehicle ownership lifecycle (用定语从句，句子更长)
helping us better serve customers, improve retention and increase share of garage across the vehicle ownership lifecycle (正式度不足，不适合监管文件)

items.en: improving appointment access, billing accuracy, workflow management and service-to-sales integration
items.why: 用动名词短语列举运营改进的具体维度，结构清晰正式，中国人常罗列零散动词，不如该写法流畅专业
items.when: 撰写业务运营改进、流程优化部分，需要列举具体成效时套用
items.slot: improving [operational area …], [operational area …], [operational area …] and [operational area …]
swap: enhancing appointment access, billing accuracy, workflow management and service-to-sales integration（enhancing更侧重提升幅度，语气比improving更强）
boosting appointment access, billing accuracy, workflow management and service-to-sales integration（boosting更具动态感，侧重推动增长）

items.en: We design products and services as solutions for clients’ cash and liquidity, asset accumulation, retirement, protection, income generation and disbursement and estate and wealth transfer needs.
items.why: 该写法将产品服务定位为解决客户多维度需求的方案，用并列名词短语清晰罗列需求类型，逻辑严谨专业；中国人常直接写“we provide products to meet clients' needs”，缺乏具体需求分类，表述笼统。
items.when: 适用于财务报告中说明业务服务的定位与覆盖的客户需求场景。
items.slot: We design products and services as solutions for clients’ […] needs.
swap: We develop products and services to address clients’ […] needs（更正式，address比design更侧重解决需求）
We create products and services that solve clients’ […] needs（更口语化，语气较随意）

items.en: The financial solutions we offer through our advisors include our own products and services as well as other providers’ products.
items.why: 用定语从句明确服务提供渠道，用as well as清晰区分自有与第三方产品，层次分明；中国人常写“our products and others' products”，缺乏正式连接结构，不够严谨。
items.when: 适用于财务报告中说明产品的来源构成。
items.slot: The financial solutions we offer through our […] include our own products and services as well as other providers’ products.
swap: The financial solutions provided via our advisors encompass our own products and services in addition to other providers’ products（更正式，encompass和in addition to更符合报告语气）
