The financial solutions we provide through our advisors include our own products and services plus other providers’ products（更简洁，plus比as well as更口语化）

items.en: We distribute our life and disability income insurance, as well as annuity products, through our advisor channel under the RiverSource ® brand.
items.why: 清晰列明分销的产品类型、渠道及所属品牌，信息完整；中国人常写“we sell insurance products through our channel”，缺乏具体产品和品牌说明，表述模糊。
items.when: 适用于财务报告中说明产品的分销方式。
items.slot: We distribute our […] products, as well as […] products, through our advisor channel under the […] brand.
swap: We market our life and disability income insurance, in addition to annuity products, via our advisor channel under the RiverSource ® brand（更正式，market和via更专业）
We sell our life and disability income insurance, plus annuity products, through our advisor channel under the RiverSource ® brand（更简洁，plus更常用）

items.en: organized as Luxembourg-based investment companies with variable capital
items.why: 中文常把组织形式放在名词前作定语，如“卢森堡注册的可变资本投资公司”，但英文用后置的过去分词短语，避免头重脚轻，符合正式报告的语法规范
items.when: 在报告中说明实体的注册地、组织形式等属性时套用
items.slot: organized as […]-based investment companies with […]
swap: structured as Luxembourg-based investment companies with variable capital（侧重架构设计）
formed as Luxembourg-based investment companies with variable capital（侧重设立主体）

items.en: available on our website at www.virtus.com under "Investor Relations."
items.why: 用被动语态"available"比中国人常用的主动语态"you can find"更正式客观，符合SEC报告的中立立场，避免第二人称的使用。中国人常写得太随意，不够正式。
items.when: 正式年报、合规文件中指引投资者查找补充信息时使用。
items.slot: available on our website at www.[…].com under "[…]"
swap: accessible via our website at www.[…].com under "[…]" 更简洁，介词使用更正式
can be found on our website at www.[…].com under "[…]" 更口语化，适合内部文件

items.en: generally earned if the returns on the portfolios exceed agreed upon periodic or cumulative return targets
items.why: 用“generally”明确该费用是常规情况，“agreed upon”强调是双方约定的标准，表述更符合正式报告的严谨性；中国人常直接写“if returns exceed targets”，未体现常规性和约定属性，不够规范。
items.when: 用于描述费用、收益的触发条件，尤其是涉及双方约定的条款时。
items.slot: generally earned if the returns on […] exceed agreed upon […] targets
swap: typically earned when（更偏向描述一般情况，不如generally贴合正式报告的表述）
usually earned if（语气较口语化，正式报告中generally更合适）

items.en: provides for rate declines or “breakpoints” as asset levels increase to certain thresholds
items.why: 用“provides for”正式表述条款包含的内容，“as”清晰引导费率调整的触发场景，使费用结构的描述更精准；中国人常直接写“has rate declines when assets reach thresholds”，不够正式和贴合合同条款的表述。
items.when: 用于描述合同条款、费用结构中随条件变化的规则时。
items.slot: provides for rate declines or “breakpoints” as […] levels increase to certain thresholds
swap: includes rate reductions or “breakpoints” when（rate reductions侧重减少幅度，不如rate declines贴合费率调整的表述）
specifies lower rates or “breakpoints” as（specifies侧重明确规定，不如provides for贴合条款包含的内容）

items.en: Our owned and under control lot position was 60,916 as of December 31, 2025
items.why: 中文常写“截至2025年12月31日，我们的自有和受控地块数量为60,916个”，该写法用"as of"明确时间点，避免歧义，符合英文财经报告的时间表述规范
items.when: 撰写财经报告时，用于陈述截至某一时间点的资产数量或规模
items.slot: Our owned and under control lot position was [number] as of [December …20XX]
swap: As of December 31, 2025, our owned and controlled lot position stood at 60,916（调整语序，更正式）
At December 31, 2025, our owned and under control lot position was 60,916（用At替代as of，更简洁）

items.en: could cause actual results to differ materially from those contained in any forward-looking statement
items.why: 中文常写“导致实际结果与前瞻性陈述有重大差异”，此写法用“differ materially”是英文正式报告的标准措辞，比“have big differences”更专业严谨，符合报告的正式语气。
items.when: 风险因素部分描述潜在影响时使用。
items.slot: cause actual results to differ materially from those contained in any […]
swap: lead actual outcomes to vary significantly from those in any forward-looking statement：原写法的“differ materially”更贴合正式报告的严谨措辞，vary significantly的表述稍显模糊；
result in actual outcomes to differ greatly from those in any forward-looking statement：differ greatly的程度表述不如materially专业。

items.en: generated $20.9 billion, or 83%, of its total revenue during 2025
items.why: 用“or [百分比]”补充量化数据的占比，让财务数据更清晰，中国人写常只放数字，缺少补充说明导致读者感知弱
items.when: 财报中披露业务收入占比的场合
items.slot: generated $[...], or [...]%, of its total revenue during [...]
swap: represented $[...], or [...]%, of its total revenue in [...]（represented更偏向占比的陈述，generated更强调创造的收入）
accounted for $[...], or [...]%, of its total revenue in [...]（accounted for更偏向会计计入，适合不同报告语境）

items.en: expects its seasonality trends to evolve as it continues to expand its global operations
items.why: 用as引导伴随状语说明趋势变化的原因，逻辑更完整，中国人写常省略原因，仅写预期导致逻辑不清晰
items.when: 财报中描述业务趋势变化的前瞻性陈述场合
items.slot: expects its [...] trends to evolve as it continues to expand [...] operations
swap: anticipates its [...] trends to change as it continues to grow [...] operations（anticipate比expect更正式，change比evolve更偏向简单变化）
foresees its [...] trends to develop as it continues to expand [...] operations（foresee更强调预见，develop比evolve更偏向发展）

items.en: see Item 1A, “Risk Factors” in this Annual Report on Form 10-K
items.why: 中文常写“详见本报告第1A项‘风险因素’”，英文用“see + 具体章节 + 报告名称”的格式更正式精准，符合SEC报告规范，避免模糊表述
items.when: 撰写正式财务年报等文件，需交叉引用具体章节内容的场合
items.slot: see Item […] in this Annual Report on Form 10-K
swap: refer to Item […] of this Annual Report on Form 10-K，语气更偏向主动指引查阅，比see稍正式
consult Item […] in this Annual Report on Form 10-K，更强调需主动查阅，适合需明确指引的场景

items.en: We expressly disclaim any obligation to update these forward-looking statements
items.why: 中文常写“我们不承担更新前瞻性陈述的义务”，英文用“expressly disclaim any obligation”明确且正式，避免模糊否定，符合监管文件的严谨性，比直接说“don't have obligation”更专业
items.when: 撰写含前瞻性陈述的正式报告，需明确排除自身更新义务的场合
items.slot: We expressly disclaim any obligation to update these […]
swap: We explicitly decline any responsibility for updating these forward-looking statements，用“explicitly decline responsibility”替换，语气更偏向主动拒绝责任，比disclaim稍弱
We hereby disclaim any duty to update these forward-looking statements，增加“hereby”更具法律效力，适合需明确法律声明的场景

items.en: could have a material adverse impact on gross margins
items.why: 用情态动词could搭配正式商务措辞，比中国人常用的绝对化表达如‘will cause’更审慎，符合SEC报告的严谨性，避免武断结论。
items.when: 财务尽职调查或审计报告中描述潜在风险对财务指标的影响时。
items.slot: could have a material adverse impact on […]
swap: might have a materially negative effect on […]（语气更弱，更强调可能性而非确定性）
may result in a material adverse effect on […]（更明确体现因果逻辑）

items.en: We generally have constructed or acquired towers that accommodate multiple tenants
items.why: 用"generally"作为情态副词，明确表达公司的常规业务做法，避免绝对化，中国人常写"We constructed or acquired many towers with multiple tenants"，缺少正式的情态表达，不够严谨
items.when: 用于正式报告中描述公司的常规业务模式
items.slot: We generally have constructed or acquired […] that accommodate multiple tenants
swap: We typically have built or purchased towers which host several tenants："typically"比"generally"更偏向一般情况，语气稍随意，不如"generally"符合监管报告的正式性
We usually have erected or bought towers that hold various tenants："erected""bought""hold""various"替换后词汇更口语化，不符合SEC报告的专业措辞

items.en: derives its revenues from the sale of franchise and development rights
items.why: 中国人常写口语化的“gets its revenue from”，此表达是财报正式语境中说明收入来源的标准说法，更专业严谨
items.when: 用于财务报告中说明业务板块的收入来源
items.slot: [...] derives its revenues from the sale of [...] and [...]
swap: generates its revenue from the sale of [...] and [...]（更侧重收入的产生过程）
obtains its revenue from the sale of [...] and [...]（更侧重收入的获取）

items.en: contribute to our royalty revenues, franchisee marketing fund contributions, and commissary revenue
items.why: 中国人常写非正式的“help get”类表达，此表达是财报中说明业务间关联的标准用词，更符合专业语境
items.when: 用于财务报告中说明某类销售额对其他收入项的贡献
items.slot: contribute to our [...], [...], and [...]
swap: add to our [...], [...], and [...]（更侧重数值上的增加）
support our [...], [...], and [...]（更侧重对资金的支持）

items.en: lead to efficiencies in both attracting and servicing of students
items.why: 该结构用‘lead to efficiencies in both...and...’清晰表达双维度效率提升，比中国人常写的‘make both attracting and serving students more efficient’更正式，结构更严谨，符合英文财报写作规范
items.when: 适合在企业报告中描述某一举措带来的多维度效率提升的场合
items.slot: lead to efficiencies in both […] and […] of […]
swap: result in improved efficiency in both […] and […]（语气更偏向实际价值优化，适合强调效率提升的成果）
bring about greater efficiencies in both […] and […]（语气更偏向积极影响，适合强调举措的正面作用）

items.en: serve as a primary point of contact for prospective students
items.why: 中文常写“是潜在学生的主要联系人”，口语化且不够正式，此处用“serve as a primary point of contact”更符合正式报告的专业语气，精准定位角色功能
items.when: 正式报告中描述岗位/角色的核心联络职责时套用
items.slot: serve as a primary point of contact for […]
swap: act as the main point of contact for […]（更口语化，适合非正式内部文档）
function as the primary liaison for […]（更侧重跨方联络属性，适合多主体场景）

items.en: helping students transition smoothly into their first class
items.why: 中文常写“帮助学生适应第一堂课”，口语化且不够精准，此处用“transition smoothly into”体现流程的顺畅性，符合正式场景的专业表述
items.when: 正式报告中描述新成员/新用户的过渡流程时套用
items.slot: helping […] transition smoothly into their […]
swap: assisting […] in making a smooth transition to their […]（更侧重“协助过程”的动作）
supporting […] to move seamlessly into their […]（更侧重“无缝衔接”的流畅度）

items.en: The Inflation Beneficiaries ETF had net assets of $1.4 billion and $1.1 billion at December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
items.why: 用respectively对应两组时间和金额，避免重复表述，紧凑专业；中国人常分开写，冗余且不符合正式报告风格。
items.when: 披露基金或投资产品的资产规模及对应时间时套用
items.slot: [Fund Name] had net assets of [Amount …] and [Amount …] at [Date …] and [Date …], respectively.
swap: [Fund Name] had net assets of $1.4 billion and $1.1 billion as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.（用as of替换at，符合财务报告常用表述）
[Fund Name] reported net assets of $1.4 billion and $1.1 billion at December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.（用reported替换had，更正式）

items.en: under certain other antitrust and foreign investment laws
items.why: 中文常直接写“根据某些其他反垄断和外国投资法律”，此处用介词under更符合正式报告中法规适用的标准表述，简洁且专业，避免冗余。
items.when: 撰写正式报告时提及适用的相关法规条款时使用。
items.slot: under certain other […] and […] laws
swap: pursuant to certain other antitrust and foreign investment laws（更正式，多用于法律文书，严谨性高于under）
as per certain other antitrust and foreign investment laws（偏日常商务用语，正式程度弱于under，不适合SEC类官方报告）

items.en: the absence of any law or order prohibiting the consummation of the Mergers
items.why: 中文常写“没有任何禁止合并完成的法律或命令”，此处用名词化结构the absence of替代动词表述，更符合正式报告的客观、紧凑的风格，避免主观化表达。
items.when: 撰写报告中陈述不存在某项障碍或限制时使用。
items.slot: the absence of any […] or […] prohibiting the consummation of the […]
swap: there is no law or order that prohibits the consummation of the Mergers（动词结构，更口语化，不适合正式报告）
no law or order exists that prohibits the consummation of the Mergers（稍正式，但不如名词化结构紧凑）

items.en: For additional information regarding the risks and uncertainties related to the Merger Agreement and the Mergers
items.why: 中文常写“关于与合并协议及合并相关的风险和不确定性的更多信息”，此处用For additional information regarding是正式报告中标准的衔接表述，清晰指引读者查看后续内容，比普通的“关于更多信息”更规范。
items.when: 撰写报告时需要指引读者查看更多相关内容时使用。
items.slot: For additional information regarding the risks and uncertainties related to the […] and the […]
swap: To find more details about the risks and uncertainties associated with the Merger Agreement and the Mergers（更口语化，不适合官方报告）
For more information on the risks and uncertainties related to the Merger Agreement and the Mergers（更简洁，但regarding的正式度高于on）

items.en: due to health, food safety or other reasons
items.why: 平行列举原因，用词简洁清晰；中国人常写得冗余，比如“因为健康、食品安全或其他方面的原因”
items.when: 用于正式写作中列举多个相关的原因或因素
items.slot: due to [reason …], [reason …] or other reasons
swap: because of health, food safety and other reasons (连词误用，or应表示其他可选原因，此处and改变语义)
on account of health, food safety or other factors (用词稍显正式，不如原句常用)

items.en: Changes to financial aid programs that restrict student eligibility or reduce funding levels
items.why: 用定语从句后置修饰核心名词“Changes”，避免头重脚轻，符合英文正式写作结构，中国人常将定语前置或拆分句子，显得冗长
items.when: 正式报告中描述对核心项目的变更内容时套用
items.slot: Changes to […] programs that restrict […] or reduce […]
swap: Modifications to financial aid programs which limit student eligibility or lower funding levels；用Modifications更正式，which替换that稍显严谨
Alterations to financial aid programs that cut student eligibility or decrease funding levels；Alterations侧重局部变更，cut比reduce更口语化

items.en: See Item 1A. “Risk Factors” and Item 7, “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations”
items.why: 用“See + 章节标识”清晰指引读者到对应内容，符合SEC报告规范，中国人常误用口语化的“you can look at”，不够正式简洁
items.when: 正式报告中引用其他章节内容时套用
items.slot: See Item […] “[…]” and Item […] “[…]”
swap: Refer to Item 1A. “Risk Factors” and Item 7, “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations”；Refer to比See更正式，适合审计报告语境
Consult Item 1A. “Risk Factors” and Item 7, “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations”；Consult更侧重专业咨询，适合尽职调查报告

items.en: in each case for two years in a three-year period
items.why: 中文常简化表述为“连续两年”，英文用该短语精准界定时间范围，避免“连续”的歧义，符合审计/合规文档对时间条件的严谨要求。
items.when: 撰写涉及合规时间要求的财务报告或审计说明时套用。
items.slot: in each case for […] years in a three-year period
swap: in each instance for two consecutive years within a three-year window：consecutive强调连续性，window比period更具灵活性
in each scenario for two years over a three-year span：scenario侧重具体场景，span比period更口语化

items.en: See Item 1A. “Risk Factors” and Item 7. “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations”
items.why: 中文常直接写“见风险因素和管理层讨论”，英文用“See Item X. “[Section Name]””的格式，符合SEC报告的正式交叉引用规范，清晰准确。
items.when: 撰写正式合规报告（如SEC 10-K）中的交叉引用内容时套用。
items.slot: See Item […]. “[…]” and Item […]. “[…]”
swap: Refer to Item 1A. “Risk Factors” and Item 7. “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations”：Refer比See更正式，适合高阶合规文档
Please consult Item 1A. “Risk Factors” and Item 7. “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations”：consult更书面，语气更谨慎

items.en: Adtalem’s business operations are subject to numerous risks and uncertainties
items.why: 中文常直接写“面临许多风险和不确定性”，用“are subject to”更正式严谨，契合SEC报告的专业语境，比直白表述更符合英文正式文书的措辞习惯。
items.when: 正式报告中描述主体业务受外部因素约束的场合，如风险披露、业务概述。
items.slot: [...]’s business operations are subject to numerous risks and uncertainties
swap: are exposed to numerous risks and uncertainties（语气稍弱，侧重被动暴露，正式度略低）
face a variety of risks and uncertainties（更偏向口语化，正式度不足）

items.en: before making an investment decision with respect to
items.why: 中文常写“在做投资决定之前”，用“with respect to”替代“about”更正式，契合SEC报告的书面语要求，中国人易误用口语化介词导致不够专业。
items.when: 正式报告中给投资者的建议场合，如风险提示前的引导语。
items.slot: before making an investment decision with respect to [...]
swap: prior to making an investment decision regarding（更简洁，正式度相当）
before making an investment decision on（口语化，正式度低）

items.en: Revenue is typically lower in the first and third quarters and higher in the second and fourth quarters, reflecting client spending patterns during the year, as well as additional project work that usually occurs in the fourth quarter.
items.why: 现在分词“reflecting”平滑补充解释原因，避免because/since等连词带来的停顿感；“as well as”连接两个原因比and更正式。中国学生常拆成两句或生硬用“This is because...”，打断行文。
items.when: 描述数据后需自然带出原因的分析性段落。
items.slot: [Main clause], reflecting [reason 1]..., as well as [reason 2]...
swap: ..., due to... and...（直接但生硬，不如reflecting连贯）
..., which is attributable to...（更正式但冗长，适合极正式报告）
..., a reflection of...（名词化，但需调整主句结构）

items.en: Certain global events targeted by major marketers for advertising expenditures, such as the FIFA World Cup and the Olympics, and certain national events, such as the U.S. election process, may affect our revenue year-over-year in certain businesses.
items.why: “year-over-year”是标准财务英语副词，简洁表达“同比”。中国学生可能写“compared with the same period of last year”，冗长且不够精炼。
items.when: 进行同比分析时，用于替换冗长的比较短语。
items.slot: [Subject] may affect/change [something] year-over-year [in...].
swap: on a year-on-year basis（英式，稍正式但多词）
compared with the same period a year earlier（口语化，解释性强，缺专业感）
yoy（缩写，适用于图表或非正式沟通）

items.en: did not have a material effect on our business, results of operations or financial condition
items.why: 这是财务报告中表述无重大影响的标准正式措辞，精准使用专业术语"material"（重大的）；中国人常写"has no big impact on"，既不正式也未用专业术语，不够严谨
items.when: 撰写审计说明、10-K报告等正式财经文件，说明某事项未对业务、经营成果或财务状况产生重大影响时使用
items.slot: did not have a material effect on our […] , results of operations or financial condition
swap: did not materially affect our business, operating results or financial position: 用副词"materially"修饰动词"affect"，比原短语更简洁，适合动词主导的句式
had no material impact on our business, operating results or financial condition: 用"impact"替代"effect"，语气更直接，部分正式报告中常用"impact"表述影响

items.en: Additional information regarding the impact of government regulations on our business is included in
items.why: 这是正式报告中指引读者获取补充信息的规范表达，结构清晰；中国人常写"More info about regulations is in"，表述模糊且不够正式，不符合专业报告写作规范
items.when: 在SEC filings、年度报告等正式财经文件中，指引读者查看其他章节补充信息时使用
items.slot: Additional information regarding the impact of […] on our business is included in Item 1A, “Risk Factors - Legal and Regulatory Risks .”
swap: Further details on the effects of government rules on our business are provided in: 用"further details"替代"additional information"，"effects"替代"impact"，"provided in"替代"included in"，语气更主动
Supplementary information about how government regulations affect our business is contained in: 用"supplementary"替代"additional"，"how...affect"替代"the impact of...on"，表述更口语化，适合部分非严格正式场景

items.en: Each of the Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off and the Reclassification
items.why: 用“Each of”明确指代并列的两个独立交易，避免模糊指代，中国人常省略“Each of”直接并列，易混淆主体独立性
items.when: 用于列举多个需分别明确的并列主体（如交易、项目）时
items.slot: Each of the […] and the […]
swap: Both the Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off and the Reclassification（语气侧重两者整体，弱化个体独立性）
The Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off along with the Reclassification（语气侧重补充关系，明确性弱于Each of）

items.en: agreed with the nontaxable characterization of the transaction
items.why: 用“characterization”（定性）精准表述交易的税务属性，符合SEC报告专业语境，中国人常误用“nature”或生硬直译，专业度不足
items.when: 用于审计或合规文件中，描述监管方对交易的定性意见时
items.slot: agreed with the nontaxable characterization of the […]
swap: accepted the nontaxable characterization of the transaction（语气更被动，未体现双向沟通属性）
concurred with the nontaxable nature of the transaction（用“nature”替代“characterization”，专业精准度稍弱）

items.en: recognizes the majority of its revenue and expenses in connection with
items.why: 用「in connection with」精准连接收支与对应事项，比中文常直译的「关于」更符合正式报告的专业语气，避免模糊
items.when: 用于正式财务报告中说明收支与相关业务事件的关联
items.slot: recognizes the majority of its revenue and expenses in connection with […]
swap: accounts for most of its revenue and expenses related to […]（用accounts for替代recognizes，related to替代in connection with，更偏向会计核算表述）
recognizes most of its revenue and expenses associated with […]（associated with比in connection with语气稍口语化，适合简化表述）

items.en: lower during the first quarter as compared to the rest of the quarters
items.why: 用「as compared to」清晰对比两期间数值差异，比中文常直译的「与…相比更低」更符合正式书面语，避免歧义
items.when: 用于正式财务报告中对比不同季度的财务数据
items.slot: […] during the […] quarter as compared to the rest of the quarters
swap: less during the first quarter versus the other quarters（less替代lower，versus替代as compared to，更简洁）
lower in the first quarter relative to the remaining quarters（relative to替代as compared to，remaining替代rest，更正式）

items.en: financial performance, sustained profitability, market capitalization, technology-driven business model, consistent growth in client accounts and assets
items.why: 该部分用平行结构列举核心指标，逻辑清晰符合英文正式写作习惯，中国人常杂乱罗列或用重复表述，缺乏平行感。
items.when: 用于正式报告中列举支撑结论的多项核心依据，如业绩、指标、优势等场合。
items.slot: […], sustained profitability, market capitalization, technology-driven business model, consistent growth in client accounts and assets
swap: financial results, ongoing profitability, market cap, tech-enabled business model, steady expansion of client accounts and assets 用词更简洁，适合篇幅有限的报告
financial performance, persistent profitability, market value, technology-powered business model, consistent growth of client accounts and assets 用persistent替代sustained，语气更侧重稳定性

items.en: offering multi-custody solutions, advanced reporting, global support, benchmarks, risk metrics, GIPS® verified returns and powerful on-the-go analytics.
items.why: 用现在分词作伴随状语紧凑衔接产品多项功能，避免重复主语，中国人写英文报告常拆分多个独立短句，显得冗余拖沓。
items.when: 介绍金融产品或服务功能的场合
items.slot: offering […], […], […], […], […], GIPS® verified returns and powerful on-the-go analytics.
swap: which provides multi-custody solutions, advanced reporting, global support, benchmarks, risk metrics, GIPS® verified returns and powerful on-the-go analytics.（用定语从句衔接，语气更正式）
delivering multi-custody solutions, advanced reporting, global support, benchmarks, risk metrics, GIPS® verified returns and powerful on-the-go analytics.（用delivering替换offering，更侧重功能交付）

items.en: designed to help advisors with customer portfolio performance reporting, market updates and ticker-specific news.
items.why: 用过去分词短语作后置定语修饰产品，比定语从句更简洁凝练，符合英文报告正式风格，中国人常写冗长定语从句（如which is designed to...），不够紧凑。
items.when: 描述金融工具或服务设计目的的场合
items.slot: designed to help […], […], and […],.
swap: which is intended to help […], […], and […],.（用定语从句，语气更正式）
created to assist […], […], and […],.（用created替换designed，更侧重工具创建初衷）

items.en: In addition, the factors described under “Risk Factors” and “Discussion of Critical Accounting Estimates” in this Form 10-K
items.why: 用“In addition”清晰衔接上下文，“described under”精准对应文件章节表述，符合SEC规范，中国人常直接写“另外”但英文更正式严谨。
items.when: 财务报告中补充说明相关章节内容的场合。
items.slot: In addition, the factors described under “[Section Name …]” and “[Section Name …]” in this Form …-K
swap: Furthermore, the factors outlined in the “Risk Factors” and “Critical Accounting Policies” sections of this Form 10-K（用Furthermore更书面，outlined侧重概述）
Additionally, the factors detailed in the “Risk Factors” and “Key Accounting Estimates” sections within this Form 10-K（用Additionally替代In addition，detailed强调详细说明）

items.en: The Company is under no obligation to update forward-looking statements
items.why: 用“is under no obligation”正式明确声明义务边界，避免模糊，中国人常直接写“没有义务”但英文适配商务法律语境，精准界定责任。
items.when: 财务报告中明确公司不承担更新前瞻性表述义务的场合。
items.slot: The Company is under no obligation to update forward-looking statements, whether as a result of [reason …] or [reason …]
swap: shall not be required to update forward-looking statements, whether due to new information or otherwise（用shall not be required更具法律约束力，适配合规文件）
has no duty to update forward-looking statements, whether from new information or other causes（用has no duty更简洁，适配投资者摘要）

items.en: based on market conditions, pricing, and other commercial factors
items.why: 中文常写“根据市场情况、定价和其他商业因素”，此写法用并列名词短语清晰列出决策依据，符合专业写作的规范，逻辑层次明确
items.when: 撰写融资决策、项目选择等需要说明决策依据的正式报告场合
items.slot: based on […], […], and other commercial factors
swap: in light of market dynamics, pricing structures, and additional business considerations（更正式，替换部分词汇避免重复）
depending on market situations, pricing, and other business factors（更口语化，适合非正式沟通）

items.en: combination of fixed-rate debt and, where variable-rate debt is utilized, Secured Overnight Financing Rate ("SOFR") swaps and caps
items.why: 中文常直接写“固定利率债务和使用浮动利率债务时的SOFR互换及上限组合”，此写法用插入语补充说明适用场景，结构严谨，符合金融专业报告的表达习惯
items.when: 撰写金融机构、REIT等的利率风险管理相关正式报告的场合
items.slot: combination of fixed-rate debt and, where variable-rate debt is utilized, […] swaps and caps
swap: mix of fixed-rate obligations and, when variable-rate debt is employed, SOFR swaps and caps（用obligations、employed替换更正式，适配顶级报告）
blend of fixed-rate debt and, if variable-rate debt is used, SOFR swaps and caps（更简洁，适合篇幅较短的报告）

items.en: Although the substantial majority of our revenue in 2025 was from customers other than governmental entities
items.why: 中文常用「大部分收入」这类口语化表达，此处用「substantial majority of our revenue」是正式财经报告中表述收入占比的标准写法，既准确又符合SEC文件的严谨性，避免模糊表述。
items.when: 适用于撰写企业年度报告、尽职调查说明或审计文件中，表述收入来源结构占比的场合。
items.slot: Although the substantial majority of our revenue in […] was from customers other than […]
swap: While the vast majority of our revenue in […] came from customers not affiliated with governmental entities ——「vast majority」侧重数量上的极大多数，语气比「substantial majority」稍弱，更适合非严格强调规模实质性的场合。
Where the overwhelming majority of our revenue in […] originated from clients not belonging to governmental bodies ——「overwhelming majority」语气最强，侧重占比的压倒性，适合需突出绝对多数的场景。

items.en: we are subject to various statutes and regulations that apply to companies doing business with governments
items.why: 中文常用「受各种法规约束」这类直白表达，此处用「be subject to various statutes and regulations」是法律与商业报告中描述合规义务的正式措辞，符合SEC文件的专业规范，避免口语化。
items.when: 适用于撰写企业合规披露、尽职调查风险提示或审计说明中，表述企业受法规约束情况的场合。
items.slot: we are subject to various statutes and regulations that apply to companies doing business with […]
swap: we are bound by a range of statutory provisions and rules applicable to entities conducting business with governmental bodies ——「be bound by」更强调受法规约束的义务属性，语气比「be subject to」稍强，适合需突出合规责任的场景。
we are exposed to multiple laws and regulations applicable to firms engaging in business with government entities ——「be exposed to」侧重被动接触法规，语气较中性，适合描述潜在合规风险的场合。

items.en: For a discussion of risks related to government contracting requirements, please refer to “Item 1A. Risk Factors.”
items.why: 中文常用「关于相关风险，请参见」这类生硬表述，此处用「For a discussion of […] related to […] please refer to […]」是专业报告中交叉引用的标准正式写法，清晰指引读者定位对应内容，提升报告的逻辑性与可读性。
items.when: 适用于撰写SEC文件、尽职调查或审计报告中，引用其他章节内容的场合。
items.slot: For a discussion of risks related to […] please refer to "Item […]. Risk Factors."
swap: To learn more about risks associated with government contracting requirements, kindly consult "Item 1A. Risk Factors." ——「To learn more about」语气稍友好，适合内部文档，「kindly consult」比「please refer to」更委婉，适合面向多方的正式披露。
For further details on risks linked to government contracting requirements, please check "Item 1A. Risk Factors." ——「further details」比「discussion」更侧重细节，「check」比「refer to」更口语化，适合非正式的专业文档。

items.en: focus on improving returns on capital, as well as earnings margin
items.why: 用"focus on + doing"结构明确核心工作，比中文常直译的"我们关注提高资本回报率和利润率"更简洁，符合英文正式报告的凝练风格
items.when: 财务报告中说明核心战略重点的场合
items.slot: focus on improving […] , as well as […]
swap: concentrate on enhancing returns on capital, and earnings margin（语气更正式，适合严肃的年报）
lay emphasis on boosting returns on capital, alongside earnings margin（语气稍弱，适合内部报告）

items.en: such as supply chain optimization, automation and productivity capital expenditures, e-commerce and digital go-to-market, restructuring, product complexity reduction, improved footprint utilization, strategic pricing and portfolio management
items.why: 用"such as"引导的并列举例结构，比中文常直译的"比如供应链优化、自动化等"更符合英文正式写作的列举规范，逻辑清晰
items.when: 财务报告中列举具体落地举措的场合
swap: including supply chain optimization, automation and productivity capital expenditures, etc.（更简洁，适合简短说明）
for instance, supply chain optimization, automation and productivity capital expenditures（更正式，适合专业报告）

items.en: enhance shareholder returns through the productive re-deployment of free cash flow
items.why: 中文常直接写“提升股东回报”，此写法明确了通过自由现金流的有效再部署实现，更具体清晰，避免空泛。
items.when: 撰写公司资本回报策略相关内容时套用。
items.slot: enhance shareholder returns through the productive re-deployment of […]
swap: boost shareholder returns via effective redeployment of free cash flow（boost比enhance更具动作感，via比through稍显正式）
increase shareholder returns through efficient reallocation of excess cash（increase比enhance更直白，excess cash替换free cash flow更侧重超额部分）

items.en: prioritizes deploying free cash flow toward high-return and high-confidence organic reinvestments
items.why: 中文常写“优先用自由现金流做高回报投资”，此写法用“prioritizes deploying... toward...”明确动作优先级与方向，还加了“high-return and high-confidence”修饰，更严谨专业。
items.when: 撰写资本配置优先级相关内容时套用。
items.slot: prioritizes deploying free cash flow toward high-return and high-confidence […]
swap: focuses on using free cash flow for high-yield, high-certainty organic reinvestments（focuses on比prioritizes语气稍弱，high-yield是更常用金融术语）
emphasizes deploying free cash flow to high-return, high-certainty organic investments（emphasizes比prioritizes侧重强调而非优先级，to替换toward更简洁）

items.en: committed to returning excess capital to shareholders through growing dividends and opportunistic share repurchases
items.why: 中文常写“致力于回报股东”，此写法明确是“超额资本”而非所有资本，还说明了具体方式，更精准专业。
items.when: 撰写股东回报策略相关内容时套用。
items.slot: committed to returning excess capital to shareholders through […]
swap: focused on distributing surplus capital to shareholders via increasing dividends and opportunistic share buybacks（distributing比returning更侧重分配动作，buybacks比repurchases更常用）
dedicated to returning surplus capital to shareholders through growing dividends and opportunistic share repurchases（dedicated比committed语气更坚定，surplus比excess稍正式）

items.en: We are one of several companies competing for new business within the furniture industry.
items.why: 该写法用“one of several”客观界定自身在行业竞争中的位置，避免绝对化表述，符合正式报告的谨慎性；中国人常直接写“We are a company competing in...”，表述主观且缺乏行业格局的客观性。
items.when: 用于财务报告、商业计划中介绍自身行业竞争地位的场合。
items.slot: We are one of several companies competing for […] within the […].
swap: We are among a number of companies vying for new business in the furniture sector. 中文：“among a number of”和“vying”语气偏口语化，不如原句正式严谨；
We are one of multiple firms competing for new business in the furniture industry. 中文：“multiple firms”偏向更正式的商务语境，原句的“several companies”更通用灵活；

items.en: Many of our competitors offer similar categories of products, including office seating, systems and freestanding furniture, casegoods, storage products, as well as residential, education and healthcare furniture solutions.
items.why: 该写法用“including... as well as...”清晰分层罗列产品类别，结构清晰；中国人常直接用“such as”或简单逗号罗列，缺乏层级感，显得杂乱。
items.when: 用于年报、产品说明中介绍竞品或自身产品范围的场合。
items.slot: Many of our competitors offer similar categories of products, including […], as well as […].
swap: Many competitors provide comparable product lines, like office seating, systems and freestanding furniture, casegoods, storage products, plus residential, education and healthcare furniture solutions. 中文：“like”和“plus”更随意，不符合正式报告的语气；

Numerous competitors offer similar product categories, including office seating, systems and freestanding furniture, casegoods, storage products, and residential, education and healthcare furniture solutions. 中文：用“and”代替“as well as”会让长列表读起来更紧凑，原句更强调补充的产品类别；

items.en: increased market pricing pressure and other factors could make it difficult for us to win new business with certain customers and within certain market segments at acceptable profit margins.
items.why: 该写法用“could make it difficult”委婉披露潜在风险，既说明问题又不绝对化，符合SEC报告的谨慎性要求；中国人常直接写“will make it hard”，表述绝对，不符合正式报告的规范。
items.when: 用于年报、尽职调查报告中披露潜在业务风险的场合。
items.slot: increased […] and other factors could make it difficult for us to win new business with certain customers and within certain market segments at acceptable profit margins.
swap: rising market pricing pressure and other elements might make it challenging for us to secure new business with specific clients and in particular market segments at satisfactory profit margins. 中文：“might make it challenging”比原句语气更弱，风险程度表述更轻；

higher market pricing pressure and other factors could make it hard for us to win new business with some customers and in some market segments at acceptable profit margins. 中文：“hard”比“difficult”更口语化，原句更正式；

items.en: designed to improve the regulation, supervision, and risk management
items.why: 中文常用定语从句“旨在改善…的”，英文用过去分词短语作后置定语，避免冗余从句，更简洁正式，符合SEC报告要求。
items.when: 正式报告中修饰名词（如措施、框架等），说明其目的时套用。
items.slot: designed to improve […]
swap: intended to enhance the regulation, supervision, and risk management（intended更侧重意图，enhance比improve稍正式）
created to boost the regulation, supervision, and risk management（created更突出措施的创设目的，语气不同）

items.en: In underwriting loans, primary emphasis is placed on
items.why: 采用正式被动结构，避免第一人称，符合财经报告客观性；中国人常写主动句（如“we place primary emphasis on”），正式度不足。
items.when: 撰写金融行业正式报告、尽职调查文档时套用。
items.slot: In [business activity], primary emphasis is placed on […]
swap: we place primary emphasis on […]（中文：主动句带主语，不够客观正式，适合内部非正式沟通）
primary focus is laid on […]（中文：用focus替换emphasis，更侧重聚焦核心，语气稍弱）

items.en: Interest rates charged by the Bank vary with degree of risk
items.why: 用“vary with”精准表达“随…变化”，后置定语“charged by the Bank”清晰修饰rates，结构专业；中国人常写“change with”，专业度不足。
items.when: 描述金融费率、价格随风险等因素变动时套用。
items.slot: […] vary with degree of […]
swap: fluctuate based on the level of […]（中文：fluctuate侧重波动，不如vary通用，适用于价格大幅变动场景）
change in accordance with the degree of […]（中文：in accordance with略显冗长，不够简洁）

items.en: Important factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from our expectations
items.why: 用定语从句精准限定导致结果差异的重要因素，比中文常省略限定词的写法更严谨，避免歧义
items.when: 写风险提示、业绩说明类报告，说明影响结果的因素时套用
items.slot: Important factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from our […]
swap: Key factors that might lead actual outcomes to vary significantly from our projections（中文：用Key、might、lead、vary、projections替换对应词，语气更正式）
Material factors that could make actual results differ substantially from our forecasts（中文：用Material、substantially、forecasts替换对应词，更侧重实质性影响）

items.en: are expressly qualified in their entirety by these cautionary statements
items.why: 用被动语态+明示全部约束的表述，明确前瞻性内容受全部警示声明限制，比中文常写的“受相关声明约束”更无漏洞
items.when: 写SEC合规文件、正式报告，声明表述的约束性时套用
items.slot: […] are expressly qualified in their entirety by these cautionary statements
swap: are explicitly conditioned in full on these cautionary statements（中文：用explicitly、conditioned、full替换对应词，更侧重条件关系）
are formally limited in their entirety by these cautionary disclosures（中文：用formally、limited、disclosures替换对应词，更正式）

items.en: in the context of these risks and uncertainties
items.why: 用“in the context of”明确要求在整体语境下评估，比中文常写的“考虑这些风险”更符合英文报告规范
items.when: 评估前瞻性表述、业绩预测类内容时套用
items.slot: You should evaluate all forward-looking statements made in this Form 10-K in the context of these […]
swap: You should assess all forward-looking statements in this filing against the backdrop of these risks and uncertainties（中文：用assess、against the backdrop of、filing替换对应词，更侧重背景参照）
You should review all forward-looking statements herein in light of these risks and uncertainties（中文：用review、herein、in light of替换对应词，更简洁）

items.en: could cause actual events or results to differ materially from
items.why: 该写法用“differ materially from”精准表达“重大差异”，比中国人常写的“be different from”更符合财经报告的专业严谨性，避免模糊表述
items.when: 用于财务报告、审计说明中描述实际结果与预期的差异时
items.slot: could cause actual events or results to differ materially from […]
swap: might lead to actual events or results to vary significantly from（“vary significantly”稍口语化，正式报告中“differ materially”更常用）
could result in actual events or results being materially different from（结构稍长，不如原句简洁）

items.en: has been ranked #1 in customer experience by Trust Builder for each of the past four years
items.why: 用被动语态突出排名结果，避免主观主语，符合正式报告客观性，中国人常主动语态太主观
items.when: 正式报告中展示第三方机构排名时
items.slot: has been ranked #…in [metric] by [entity] for each of the past [number] years
swap: has been ranked first in customer experience by Trust Builder over the past four years（更书面，first比#1正式）
has secured the top rank in customer experience from Trust Builder for each of the past four years（更强调主动获得的结果）

items.en: may be impacted by a variety of factors
items.why: 用委婉的情态被动表述替代绝对语气，符合SEC财报的审慎性要求；中国人常写will be affected by many factors，语气过于肯定，缺乏不确定性缓冲
items.when: 用于财报中描述事件受多种不确定因素影响的场合
items.slot: [...] may be impacted by a variety of factors, including [...]
swap: could be influenced by a range of factors（语气更弱，更显不确定性）
might be affected by numerous factors（用词偏口语，不如原表述正式）

items.en: We operate within a rapidly evolving energy and technology environment.
items.why: 用“rapidly evolving”修饰环境，精准体现动态变化的持续性，中文常直接写“快速发展的环境”，缺少这种体现持续演进的细节，表达更笼统。
items.when: 撰写行业报告时描述自身所处的动态行业环境。
items.slot: We operate within a rapidly evolving […] environment.
swap: We operate within a fast-changing energy and technology landscape.（landscape侧重行业格局，比environment更正式，适合描述行业整体态势）
We operate within a dynamically evolving energy and technology space.（space更偏向口语化的领域，不如environment正式，适合非正式报告）

items.en: influencing how organizations plan, procure and deploy power infrastructure
items.why: 用现在分词短语作伴随状语，紧凑衔接前文的影响因素，避免重复主语，中文习惯用独立分句表达，结构松散，英文这种写法更凝练。
items.when: 描述某因素对主体行为的影响时使用。
items.slot: influencing how […] plan, procure and deploy […] infrastructure
swap: impacting how organizations design, source and roll out power infrastructure.（design比plan更侧重设计环节，source比procure更侧重采购渠道，roll out比deploy更侧重落地执行，语气更活泼）
affecting how companies plan, acquire and implement power infrastructure.（companies比organizations更口语化，acquire比procure更宽泛，implement比deploy更侧重内部执行）

items.en: heightened scrutiny from both commercial and residential customers
items.why: 用“heightened”修饰“scrutiny”，比中国人常用的“increased”更正式精准，契合SEC公开报告的专业严谨调性，避免口语化表达
items.when: 正式公开报告中描述各方关注度、审查力度提升的场合
items.slot: heightened scrutiny from both […] and […]
swap: increased scrutiny from both commercial and residential customers（语气平实，缺乏专业报告的正式感）
elevated scrutiny from both commercial and residential customers（侧重层级提升，未体现程度加剧的动态）

items.en: prompting utilities to explore more flexible and capital-efficient ways
items.why: 用“prompting”体现动因的推动性，比中国人常写的“making”“leading to”更精准专业，符合正式报告的措辞要求
items.when: 正式报告中描述市场/环境因素推动主体采取行动的场合
items.slot: prompting […] to explore more flexible and capital-efficient ways
swap: leading utilities to explore more flexible and capital-efficient ways（侧重结果而非主动推动的动因）
causing utilities to explore more flexible and capital-efficient ways（略带负面色彩，不如prompting中性）

items.en: provided by our wholly-owned subsidiary AppFolio Insurance Services, Inc.
items.why: 中文常直接写“由我们的全资子公司AppFolio保险服务公司提供”，此处用过去分词短语作后置定语，结构紧凑，避免冗余，符合正式报告的简洁要求
items.when: 正式报告中说明产品/服务提供主体的场合
items.slot: provided by our wholly-owned subsidiary […]
swap: offered by our wholly-owned subsidiary AppFolio Insurance Services, Inc.（offered语气较provided弱，provided更侧重供应的正式性）
supplied by our wholly-owned subsidiary AppFolio Insurance Services, Inc.（supplied多用于物资供应，此处为服务，provided更合适）

items.en: As used herein, “Amazon.com,” “we,” “our,” and similar terms include Amazon.com, Inc. and its subsidiaries, unless the context indicates otherwise.
items.why: 中国人写正式报告时常省略指代术语的范围界定，易引发歧义，此处用“As used herein”清晰限定指代对象，逻辑严谨。
items.when: 正式年报、法律文件中界定指代术语时套用。
items.slot: As used herein, “[…],” “[…],” “[…],” and similar terms include […] and its subsidiaries, unless the context indicates otherwise.
swap: For the purposes of this document, “[…],” “[…],” “[…],” and related terms refer to […] and its affiliates, unless the context requires a different meaning（更偏向法律文件的正式表述）
In this report, “[…],” “[…],” “[…],” and analogous terms include […] and its subsidiaries, unless the context specifies otherwise（“analogous”比“similar”更正式）

items.en: See Item 1A of Part I — “Risk Factors.”
items.why: 中国人写正式报告引用其他章节时常模糊标注，此处明确标注章节位置，便于读者快速定位，符合合规报告规范。
items.when: 正式年报、合规报告中引用其他章节内容时套用。
items.slot: See Item […] of Part […] — “[…].”
swap: Refer to Item […] of Part […] titled “[…]”（“titled”更清晰说明章节主题）
Consult Item […] of Part […] — “[…]”（“consult”比“see”更书面化）

items.en: Based on the information currently known to us
items.why: 用被动语态加限定词体现信息的时效性与局限性，避免绝对化，中国人常直接写“根据我们目前所知”，英文表述更严谨符合专业报告要求
items.when: 正式报告（如风险披露、声明类文件）中引出基于当前信息的判断
items.slot: Based on the information currently known to us, we believe that […]
swap: To the best of our current knowledge, 更简洁，语气稍口语化，适合非正式专业表述
Given the information available to us now, 语气更平实，强调信息可得性

items.en: did not impact our Consolidated Financial Statements or our reportable segments
items.why: 用精准的动词短语明确说明变动的影响边界，中国人常写“不会影响”这类口语化表达，此处更符合财报正式用语的严谨性
items.when: 用于正式财务报告中说明会计调整或业务变动对核心报表的影响
items.slot: […] did not impact our Consolidated Financial Statements or our reportable segments
swap: had no effect on our Consolidated Financial Statements or our reportable segments（语气更委婉，适合强调非重大影响的场景）
did not affect our Consolidated Financial Statements or our reportable segments（表述更简洁，正式报告中可通用）

items.en: Refer to note C, "Revenue Recognition," for additional information
items.why: 用正式的交叉引用短语指引读者查看相关附注，中国人常写“请参见”的直译，此处符合SEC报告的规范用语
items.when: 用于正式报告中指引读者查阅相关附注或补充资料
items.slot: Refer to note […], " […] ," for additional information
swap: See note C, "Revenue Recognition," for more details（表述更简洁，适合内部非正式报告）
Please consult note C, "Revenue Recognition," for further information（语气更礼貌，适合需要委婉指引的场景）

items.en: Refer to “Currency Rate Fluctuations,” for additional information
items.why: 中文常写“详见‘汇率波动’，获取更多信息”，用“Refer to”是SEC财报标准的交叉引用表述，简洁正式，符合监管报告的规范
items.when: 用于财报中指向其他章节补充相关信息的场合
items.slot: Refer to “[…] ,” for additional information
swap: See “Currency Rate Fluctuations,” for more details（更口语化，正式度不足）
Consult “Currency Rate Fluctuations,” for additional information（偏向咨询，不适合报告引用）

items.en: a non-GAAP measure that is a component of Realized Income
items.why: 用定语从句精准说明非GAAP指标的从属关系，中国人常直接简化为“a non-GAAP measure of Realized Income”，易造成从属关系模糊。
items.when: 定义专业财务术语（如非GAAP指标）的场合。
items.slot: a non-GAAP measure that is a component of […]
swap: a non-GAAP metric that forms part of Realized Income（metric比measure更侧重财务指标，语气更正式）
a non-GAAP measure which is a component of Realized Income（用which替换that，更符合正式书面语规范）

items.en: is used to assess core operating performance by determining whether recurring revenue, primarily consisting of management fees and fee related performance revenues, is sufficient to cover operating expenses and to generate profits
items.why: 用by引导的方式状语明确评估逻辑，插入语补充收入构成，结构清晰，中国人常省略插入语或简化为“assess core performance by checking revenue”，逻辑不完整。
items.when: 说明财务指标用途及判断依据的场合。
items.slot: is used to assess core operating performance by determining whether […]
swap: is employed to evaluate core operating performance by verifying if recurring revenue（employ比use更正式，verify比determine更侧重验证）
is utilized to assess core operating performance by checking whether recurring revenue（utilize更书面，check更口语化）

items.en: FRE differs from income before taxes computed in accordance with GAAP as FRE excludes net performance income, investment income and adjusts for certain other items that we believe are not indicative of our core operating performance
items.why: 用differs from明确差异，as引导原因状语说明差异原因，中国人常直接写“FRE is different from GAAP income because it excludes…”，不够正式且逻辑衔接弱。
items.when: 对比非GAAP与GAAP财务指标差异的场合。
items.slot: […] differs from […] computed in accordance with GAAP as […] excludes […] and adjusts for […]
swap: […] is distinct from income before taxes calculated under GAAP since […] excludes […]（distinct比differs更正式，calculated under比computed in accordance with更简洁）
[…] differs from GAAP income before taxes because […] excludes […]（更简洁，适合非正式报告）

items.en: Additional information with respect to operations by geographic area appears in Note 2 of the Consolidated Financial Statements included in Item 8 of this report.
items.why: 用正式介词短语“with respect to”引出信息主题，比中国人常用的口语化“about”更符合SEC报告的正式语气，避免生硬语序。
items.when: 正式财务报告中，指引读者到特定附注查找相关主题补充信息时使用。
items.slot: Additional information with respect to […] appears in Note […] of the Consolidated Financial Statements included in Item […] of this report.
swap: Concerning operations by geographic area, additional information appears in Note 2...（更简洁，适合短篇幅指引）
Regarding operations by geographic area, additional information is presented in Note 2...（更通用，适用于各类正式报告）

items.en: Refer to Item 7A, Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures about Market Risk, for further discussion regarding the Company's foreign exchange risk.
items.why: 用“Refer to […] for further discussion regarding”的结构明确指引读者到特定章节获取相关讨论，比中国人常用的简单“See Item 7A”更规范，符合SEC报告的披露要求。
items.when: 正式财务报告中，指引读者到特定项目章节获取某一主题详细讨论时使用。
items.slot: Refer to Item […], Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures about […], for further discussion regarding the Company's […] risk.
swap: See Item 7A for more details on the Company's foreign exchange risk（更简洁，适合内部报告）
Please refer to Item 7A for additional discussion about the Company's foreign exchange risk（更礼貌，适合面向投资者的报告）

items.en: Future efforts to expand our business may impact our ability to compete for business
items.why: 用"Future efforts to expand our business"明确限定动作范围，比直接写"Expanding our business"更精准避免歧义；中国人常写"Expanding our business may affect our competitiveness"，不够正式且限定模糊
items.when: 用于正式报告中描述未来业务扩张可能带来的潜在影响时
items.slot: Future efforts to expand our […] may impact our ability to compete for […]
swap: Future plans to expand our business could affect our ability to compete for contracts（"could"语气更弱，"plans"比"efforts"更侧重已规划动作）
Upcoming expansion initiatives may hinder our ability to compete for business（"hinder"比"impact"更具负面指向，"initiatives"比"efforts"更正式）

items.en: expose us to operating environments with complex, changing, and in some cases, inconsistently-applied legal and regulatory requirements
items.why: 用"in some cases, inconsistently-applied"精准描述法规执行的不一致性，比笼统写"unclear"更具体；中国人常写"face complex and changing laws"，缺少对执行层面的精准描述，不符合SEC报告严谨性
items.when: 用于正式报告中描述新区域或海外业务面临的法规环境挑战时
items.slot: expose us to operating environments with complex, changing, and in some cases, inconsistently-applied legal and regulatory requirements in […]
swap: expose us to operating environments with complex, evolving, and sometimes inconsistently-enforced legal and regulatory requirements（"evolving"比"changing"更侧重动态变化，"enforced"比"applied"更贴合法规执行场景）
expose us to operating environments with complex, shifting, and occasionally inconsistently-implemented legal and regulatory requirements（"shifting"比"changing"更具不确定性，"implemented"比"applied"更正式）

items.en: failure to remain compliant with them could limit our ability to continue doing business in these locations
items.why: 用"failure to remain compliant with them"明确指出合规失败的后果，比写"if we don't comply"更正式书面；中国人常写"if we don't follow the rules, we can't do business here"，过于口语化不符合正式报告要求
items.when: 用于正式报告中描述合规失败可能带来的业务限制时
items.slot: failure to remain compliant with […] could limit our ability to continue doing business in these locations
swap: non-compliance with them would restrict our ability to continue operating in these locations（"non-compliance"比"failure to remain compliant"更简洁正式，"restrict"比"limit"更具约束感）
failing to comply with them would hinder our ability to continue doing business in these areas（"failing to comply"更直接，"hinder"比"limit"更侧重阻碍，"areas"比"locations"更通用）

items.en: Through a dedicated global team of approximately 51,000 associates, process expertise and advanced technologies
items.why: 用“Through + 并列支撑资源”清晰引出业务交付依托，“approximately”比“about”更书面严谨，中国人常写“With our global team of about 51,000 employees...”，“Through”更具动态性，体现资源对业务的支撑作用
items.when: 介绍公司业务交付核心支撑资源的场合，比如年报的运营能力部分
items.slot: Through a dedicated global team of approximately […] associates, process expertise and advanced technologies
swap: With a dedicated worldwide team of roughly 51,000 employees, process know-how and cutting-edge technologies
差在“Through”比“With”更具动态性，“expertise”比“know-how”更正式，“advanced”比“cutting-edge”更中性严谨，适合正式报告

items.en: help state agencies determine eligibility, streamline enrollment, adjudicate claims and meet requirements
items.why: 用对称并列动词短语清晰罗列功能，逻辑层次分明，中国人写英文常罗列时结构零散，此结构更易读。
items.when: 撰写报告中列举产品/服务具体作用的场合。
items.slot: help […] determine eligibility, streamline enrollment, adjudicate claims and meet requirements
swap: assist state agencies in determining eligibility, streamlining enrollment, adjudicating claims and meeting requirements（动名词结构繁琐，不如原句简洁）
aid state agencies to determine eligibility, streamline enrollment, adjudicate claims and meet requirements（“aid”语气较弱，不如“help”贴合商务常用语气）

items.en: We measure success in “Growth” through revenue retention, our net Annual Recurring Revenue ("ARR") activity metric and new business signings, among other metrics.
items.why: measure success in … through … 结构清晰，将模糊的“成功”与具体指标挂钩；among other metrics 收尾，既留有余地又显示严谨。中国报告常写 We use … to measure success 或直接用 The success is measured by …，不够精炼且易漏掉 among other 的周全表达。
items.when: 阐述如何用量化指标衡量某战略目标或维度时，尤其需要列举非穷尽的关键指标。
items.slot: We measure success in “[...]” through [...], our [...] and [...], among other metrics.
swap: We assess our “Growth” performance by tracking … along with other measures. — assess 偏定性评估, by tracking 不如 through 直接；along with 不如 among other 正式
We gauge success in “Growth” using … and a number of other indicators. — gauge 偏口语, using 欠精准, a number of 不及 among other 简洁
We define success in “Growth” as reflected in … amongst other metrics. — define as reflected in 绕口且弱化了指标的直接作用

items.en: launched our AI Experience Center in our Florham Park, NJ headquarters
items.why: 用“launched”准确描述商业项目推出动作，搭配地点状语清晰，比中国人常写的“we opened our AI Experience Center at our headquarters in Florham Park, NJ”更专业，符合SEC报告正式措辞
items.when: 用于描述推出新商业实体、中心等的场景
items.slot: launched our […] in our Florham Park, NJ headquarters
swap: opened our AI Experience Center at our Florham Park, NJ headquarters（“opened”偏向普通开业，不如“launched”贴合商业项目）
established our AI Experience Center in our Florham Park, NJ headquarters（“established”偏向长期设立，不如“launched”贴合新推出）

items.en: which we believe represents the vast majority of total expenditures in the hospice market
items.why: 该写法用“we believe”限定判断，避免绝对化，符合专业合规报告要求，中国人常直接写“which represents”，过于绝对易有风险
items.when: 撰写涉及公司主观判断的行业数据归属、市场份额分析时使用
items.slot: which we believe represents the vast majority of total expenditures in the […] market
swap: which we consider to be the vast majority（更侧重公司主观认定，语气稍强）
which is believed by us to account for most（被动语态，更正式，适合严格合规报告）

items.en: as of 2024 (the most current information available)
items.why: 用“as of”精准限定数据时间节点，括号补充说明数据最新性，避免模糊；中国人常直接写“in 2024”，缺少对数据时效性的严谨补充。
items.when: 撰写财务报告中需明确数据时间及最新性的场合。
items.slot: as of […] (the most current information available)
swap: as of the fiscal year ended 2024 (the latest data available)，更强调财年属性，适合年报类正式报告
as of 2024 (the most recent information on hand)，语气偏向内部实操表述，适合内部报告

items.en: highlighting home health care’s savings potential for the healthcare system
items.why: 用现在分词作结果状语，简洁衔接前文数据与结论，避免重复主语；中国人常写“this shows that home health care has savings potential”，表述更啰嗦。
items.when: 撰写报告中用数据引出结论的逻辑衔接场合。
items.slot: highlighting […]’s […] potential for the […]
swap: demonstrating […]’s […] potential for the […]，用“demonstrating”替换，语气更侧重实证支撑
illustrating […]’s […] potential for the […]，用“illustrating”替换，语气更侧重举例说明

items.en: based on current expectations, estimates, assumptions, and projections
items.why: 中文常重复用同类词冗余，英文用并列专业名词简洁精准，中国人易写得拖沓
items.when: 财务报告中说明假设依据时使用
items.slot: based on current expectations, estimates, assumptions, and projections about […]
swap: based on current expectations, estimates, assumptions, and forecasts（forecasts侧重短期预测，比projections更具体）
derived from our current expectations, estimates, assumptions, and projections（derived from强调来源，比based on更正式）

items.en: could differ materially from the results contemplated by these forward-looking statements
items.why: 中文常生硬写“可能不同”，英文用could委婉、materially强调重大差异、contemplated正式专业，中国人易写得不够严谨
items.when: 财务报告中说明实际与预测差异时使用
items.slot: Our actual results could differ materially from the results contemplated by these forward-looking statements regarding […]
swap: may differ significantly from the results described in these forward-looking statements（may语气稍弱，significantly偏口语化）
might differ materially from the results outlined in these forward-looking statements（might更委婉，outlined侧重概述）

items.en: See the discussion under the headings “Risk Factors” and “Forward-Looking Statements” below
items.why: 中文常啰嗦写“详见下文部分”，英文用See简洁、under the headings明确指向章节，符合SEC报告规范，中国人易写得模糊
items.when: 财务报告中交叉引用章节内容时使用
items.slot: See the discussion under the headings “[…]” and “[…]” below
swap: Refer to the discussion in the sections titled “Risk Factors” and “Forward-Looking Statements” below（Refer to更正式，sections侧重内容部分）
Please refer to the discussion under the headings “Risk Factors” and “Forward-Looking Statements” below（加Please更礼貌，适合监管报告）

items.en: subject to an annual, bi-annual or quarterly minimum royalty payment
items.why: 用并列的时间状语清晰限定最低许可费的支付周期，表述精准专业；中国人常写得冗长模糊，如“每年或每半年或每季度付最低许可费”不够凝练
items.when: 撰写许可协议的费用条款时
items.slot: subject to an annual, bi-annual or quarterly minimum royalty payment for […]
swap: with a minimum royalty payment due annually, semi-annually or quarterly for […]（bi-annual换为semi-annual，更通用）
subject to an annual, semi-annual or quarterly minimum royalty payment in […]（调整介词搭配，适配不同语境）

items.en: acts as our exclusive licensing agent for the Playboy brand trademarks and intellectual property
items.why: 用“exclusive licensing agent”明确代理的专属属性，表述严谨；中国人常写“是我们唯一的许可代理”，口语化且不够专业
items.when: 描述品牌代理关系时
items.slot: acts as our exclusive licensing agent for […] brand trademarks and intellectual property
swap: serves as our sole licensing agent for […] brand trademarks and intellectual property（exclusive换为sole，同义更简洁）
functions as our exclusive licensing representative for […] brand trademarks and intellectual property（agent换为representative，适配不同代理层级）

items.en: calculated as a percentage of net revenue from wholesale and/or retail sales
items.why: 用“calculated as a percentage of”清晰界定费用计算基数，表述具体；中国人常写“基于净收入”，未明确计算方式
items.when: 撰写许可费、分成等费用的计算规则时
items.slot: calculated as a percentage of net revenue from […]
swap: determined as a percentage of net revenue from […]（calculated换为determined，语气更正式）
computed as a percentage of net revenue from […]（calculated换为computed，适配技术类报告）

items.en: in "Item 1A. Risk Factors" in this Annual Report on Form 10-K
items.why: 用规范格式引用SEC报告的具体章节，比中国人常写的“在本年报的风险因素部分”更符合专业报告的引用规范，清晰明确，便于读者定位。
items.when: 撰写SEC报告或专业年报的引用部分时套用。
items.slot: in "Item [X]. [Section Name]" in this [Report Type, e.g., Annual Report on Form …-K]
swap: within "Item 1A. Risk Factors" of this Annual Report on Form 10-K（within更正式，of更常用在所属关系）
in "Item 1A. Risk Factors" of this 10-K filing（filing比report更专业，语气更正式）

items.en: revenues were $11.3 million and $8.7 million for 2025 and 2024, respectively
items.why: 用respectively清晰对应两个数值与两个年份，避免重复表述，逻辑严谨，中国人常重复写两个分句，不如此简洁对应
items.when: 财务报告中并列多组对应数据（如数值与年份、项目与期间）的场合
items.slot: revenues were […] and […] for […] and […] , respectively
swap: revenues stood at […] and […] in […] and […] respectively ：语气更正式，侧重“数值为”的表述
revenues totaled […] and […] for the years ended […] and […] respectively ：更贴合年报“截至某年度”的表述习惯

items.en: cost of revenues were $2.1 million and $3.2 million for 2025 and 2024, respectively
items.why: 用respectively明确对应时期与数值的关系，避免重复，比中国人常写的分述更简洁规范
items.when: 财务报告中并列对应多个报告期的财务数值时套用
items.slot: cost of revenues were $[…] million and $[…] million for […] and […] respectively
swap: cost of revenues amounted to $[…] million in […] and $[…] million in […]，缺少明确对应暗示，衔接稍弱
cost of revenues were $[…] million for […] and $[…] million for […]，未用respectively，易混淆对应关系

items.en: is contained in Item 1A. "Risk Factors" in this Annual Report
items.why: 用被动语态+明确章节编号指引，是英文正式报告中指引内容来源的标准写法，严谨准确，符合SEC报告格式要求。中国人常直译“is in the Risk Factors part of this annual report”，不够正式规范。
items.when: 正式报告中指引某内容的具体位置时套用。
items.slot: is contained in Item 1A. […] in this Annual Report
swap: is included in Item 1A. "Risk Factors" in this Annual Report → 用included替换contained，更侧重内容的包含而非容纳；
appears in Item 1A. "Risk Factors" of this Annual Report → 用appears替换is contained，更侧重内容的呈现状态

items.en: available sources for services, components, supplies, logistics and manufacturing
items.why: 用“available sources for”明确限定资源范围，列举清晰严谨，符合财务报告精准性要求，中国人写英文时常直接罗列却未限定范围
items.when: 描述可获取的各类资源范围时套用
items.slot: available sources for […], components, supplies, logistics and manufacturing
swap: accessible sources for services, components, supplies, logistics and manufacturing（侧重资源可接触性，与原词“可获取性”不同）
available resources for services, components, supplies, logistics and manufacturing（侧重资源本身，而非来源渠道）

items.en: Approximately 3.4% of our sales in fiscal year 2025 were denominated in foreign currencies.
items.why: 中文常直接写“大概有3.4%”，此处用正式财报用语Approximately，精准且符合SEC公开报告规范，避免口语化；中国人易写About或模糊的“大概”，专业性不足。
items.when: 公开财报中披露特定项目占比的场合。
items.slot: Approximately […]% of our sales in fiscal year […] were denominated in foreign currencies.
swap: Roughly 3.4% of our sales in fiscal year 2025 were denominated in foreign currencies.（Roughly更口语化，适合内部报告而非公开SEC财报）
Approximately 3.4% of our fiscal 2025 sales were denominated in foreign currencies.（更简洁，适合篇幅受限的报告）

items.en: Significant non-functional balances include accounts receivable due from some of our international customers.
items.why: 中文常写“重要的非功能性余额包括…”，此处用Significant是SEC财报列举重要项目的标准术语，比普通Important更贴合美国会计准则正式表述；中国人易用Important，不够适配财报语境。
items.when: 财报中列举重要账户或余额的场合。
items.slot: Significant non-functional balances include […] due from some of our international customers.
swap: Material non-functional balances include accounts receivable due from some of our international customers.（Material是财报中更常用的“重要”术语，侧重对决策的影响，Significant侧重规模）
Key non-functional balances include accounts receivable due from some of our international customers.（Key更口语化，适合内部报告而非公开SEC财报）

items.en: Our FSS International segment provides a similar range of services as those provided to our FSS United States segment clients
items.why: 这个写法用「similar range of services as those provided to」清晰对比两个业务线的服务范围，中国人常写「provides similar services as」过于简略，缺少指代避免歧义，更符合正式报告的严谨性
items.when: 用于正式报告中对比两个业务单元的服务内容时套用
items.slot: Our FSS […] segment provides a similar range of services as those provided to our FSS […] segment clients
swap: offers a comparable suite of services to those delivered to our FSS […] segment clients（用comparable替代similar，suite替代range，delivered替代provided，更偏向服务套餐的表述，语气稍正式）
delivers a similar set of services as those offered to our FSS […] segment clients（用delivers替代provides，set替代range，更偏向业务交付的表述，语气稍口语化）

items.en: operations in 15 countries outside the United States
items.why: 这个写法用具体数字加限定范围清晰说明国际运营的规模，中国人常写「many countries outside the US」表述模糊，缺少量化信息，不符合SEC报告的严谨要求
items.when: 用于正式报告中说明业务覆盖的国家数量时套用
items.slot: operations in […] countries outside the United States
swap: operations in fifteen countries beyond the United States（用fifteen替代15，beyond替代outside，更偏向书面化表述）
operations in a total of 15 countries outside the United States（加「a total of」强调总数，适合需要突出总规模的场景）

items.en: keep them highly engaged through our mobile app
items.why: 用keep+宾语+形容词+介词短语的结构，清晰表达提升用户活跃度的方式，中国人常写make them active through app，表达不够精准。
items.when: 描述提升平台用户粘性的措施时套用。
items.slot: keep them highly engaged through our […]
swap: maintain their high engagement via our […]（更正式，适合书面报告）
ensure their strong engagement through our […]（更强调主动保障）

items.en: generate incremental recurring revenue by offering them paid subscription services
items.why: 用incremental和recurring明确收入的增量性和持续性，中国人常只写generate revenue，缺乏对收入性质的精准描述。
items.when: 描述业务带来的新增持续性收入时套用。
items.slot: generate incremental recurring revenue by offering them […]
swap: produce additional recurring revenue by providing them […]（produce侧重产出，语气稍弱）
drive incremental recurring revenue by offering them […]（drive更强调推动增长，适合业务计划）

items.en: In June 2025, we entered into a partnership agreement with ADT
items.why: 用正式商务表述"entered into a partnership agreement"替代中文常直译的"签了合作协议"，更符合SEC报告的正式性，主语明确且符合财报写作规范，避免口语化
items.when: 正式商务合作的公告或财报披露场合
items.slot: In […] [日期], we entered into a partnership agreement with [合作方名称]
swap: signed a partnership agreement with [合作方名称]（语气更直接，适合非监管报告）
concluded a partnership arrangement with [合作方名称]（语气更侧重达成结果，适合正式报告）

items.en: A significant portion of our revenue depends upon
items.why: 使用精准量化术语「significant portion」替代模糊的「a lot of」，符合财务报告的精准要求，中国人常使用模糊词汇，缺乏专业严谨性
items.when: 财务报告中描述收入等核心指标的占比时套用
items.slot: A significant portion of […] depends upon […]
swap: A substantial part of our revenue relies on（同义替换，更正式）
A notable share of our revenue is dependent on（稍正式，适合披露关键部分）
A large segment of our revenue depends on（范围稍宽，适合非核心部分）

items.en: Approximately 3.8% of our sales in fiscal year 2026 were denominated in foreign currencies.
items.why: 中文写正式财报时常用主动语态“我们2026财年约3.8%的销售额为外币计价”，原句用被动语态“were denominated”更符合SEC报告的客观中立要求，避免主观主体，增强权威性。
items.when: 用于正式财务报告中披露涉及外币计价的销售比例数据时。
items.slot: Approximately […]% of our sales in fiscal year […] were denominated in foreign currencies.
swap: Roughly 3.8% of our sales in fiscal 2026 were priced in foreign currencies. 语气较随意，适合内部报告，正式度不足
About 3.8% of our sales for FY2026 are denominated in foreign currencies. 用缩写FY更简洁，但正式度略低，不符合SEC filings规范

items.en: as a result, our profitability is exposed to currency fluctuations.
items.why: 中文写报告时常直接用“因此”衔接因果关系，原句用“as a result”作为正式书面衔接词，更符合英文财报的逻辑表达习惯，避免生硬直译。
items.when: 用于财务报告中说明某一因素导致的业务影响时。
items.slot: [...] , as a result, our profitability is exposed to currency fluctuations.
swap: Consequently, our profitability is subject to currency fluctuations. 语气更正式，但衔接稍显生硬，不如原句自然
Thus, our profitability is affected by currency fluctuations. 用词宽泛，未体现“被动暴露”的精准含义

items.en: ranged from approximately $1,000 for the Phlebotomy program (lasting approximately 8 weeks) to approximately $99,000 for the Dental Hygiene program (lasting approximately 90 weeks)
items.why: 中文常用“从...到...不等”表述范围，英文用ranged from...to...更正式，搭配approximate体现谨慎性，符合SEC报告的专业要求，避免模糊性。
items.when: 在正式财务报告中列示某类项目的数值范围时套用。
items.slot: ranged from approximately […] for the […] program (lasting approximately […] weeks) to approximately […] for the […] program (lasting approximately […] weeks)
swap: varied between approximately […] for the […] program (lasting approximately […] weeks) and approximately […] for the […] program (lasting approximately […] weeks)，差在ranged from侧重整体区间，varied between侧重个体变化
fell within the range of approximately […] to approximately […] for the […] and […] programs，差在前者是动态范围描述，后者是静态区间界定

items.en: average annual revenue per Concorde student was approximately $30,000, net of scholarships or grants funded by the institution
items.why: 中文常直接写扣除后的结果但不明确扣除项，英文用net of...作为财务术语，简洁清晰地说明扣除项，避免歧义，符合正式报告的严谨性。
items.when: 在财务报告中计算某指标的净额（扣除特定项目后）时套用。
items.slot: average annual revenue per […] student was approximately $[…], net of […] funded by the institution
swap: average annual revenue per […] student was approximately $[…], after deducting […] funded by the institution，差在net of是标准会计术语，更正式，after deducting更口语化
average annual revenue per […] student was approximately $[…], less […] funded by the institution，差在net of专业且精准，less偏向普通减少，不适合正式财务报告

items.en: approximately 16% of Concorde’s active students received a Concorde-funded scholarship or grant
items.why: 中文常把主体放前面导致头重脚轻，英文用“X% of Y received Z”结构，将核心统计比例前置，语序更符合英文正式报告习惯，清晰突出关键数据。
items.when: 在运营或财务报告中列示某群体的比例数据时套用。
items.slot: approximately […]% of […]’s active students received a […]-funded scholarship or grant
swap: nearly […]% of […]’s active students were recipients of a […]-funded scholarship or grant，差在received更主动体现学生动作，were recipients更偏向静态状态
about […]% of […]’s active students obtained a […]-funded scholarship or grant，差在received更正式，obtained更偏向普通获取，不适合正式报告

items.en: have the experience necessary to effectively implement our growth and diversification strategy
items.why: 该写法用"have the experience necessary to..."清晰界定主体的资质能力，比中文常直接写"有经验实施..."更正式严谨，且"necessary"强化了经验的必要性，逻辑更完整。
items.when: 用于正式报告中描述团队或主体具备完成战略/任务所需的核心资质，适合财务尽职调查或审计报告。
items.slot: have the experience necessary to effectively implement our […] and […] strategy
swap: are equipped with the experience required to effectively execute our […] and […] strategy（语气更强调合规性的资质配备，适合法定披露文件）
possess the requisite experience to effectively roll out our […] and […] strategy（语气更简洁凝练，适合篇幅紧凑的报告）

items.en: For discussion of the risks relating to the attraction and retention of management and executive management employees
items.why: 用"For discussion of..."引出关联内容的指引，比中文常直接写"关于...的风险讨论"更正式规范，符合SEC等法定披露文件的表述要求，且"relating to..."明确了风险的关联对象，逻辑清晰。
items.when: 用于在正式报告中指引读者查看特定风险的详细内容，适合金融、审计类的法定披露或专业报告。
items.slot: For discussion of the risks relating to the attraction and retention of […] and […] employees
swap: For further information on the risks associated with the attraction and retention of […] and […] employees（语气更偏向补充说明，适合需要细化指引的报告）
To learn more about the risks concerning the attraction and retention of […] and […] employees（语气更口语化，仅适合内部非正式报告）

items.en: mixed, reflecting a decline in both net income and total assets
items.why: 用现在分词短语衔接结果，比中国人常写的“mixed because net income and total assets declined”更紧凑，逻辑连贯，提升专业报告的简洁度
items.when: 用于描述业绩结果及对应原因的场合
items.slot: […] , reflecting a decline in both […] and […]
swap: mixed, due to a decline in both net income and total assets （用due to衔接，稍显口语化）
mixed, as a result of a decline in both net income and total assets （用as a result of衔接，更冗长）

items.en: compared to $91.9 million for the year ended December 31, 2024
items.why: 中文财务写作常直接写“和2024年全年的9190万美元相比”，冗余且不正式，这里用“compared to + 数据 + for the period ended…”的结构，简洁专业，符合SEC报告的正式性要求。
items.when: 财务报告中对比两个不同期间的财务数据（如费用、收入）的场合。
items.slot: compared to $[…] million for the period ended […]
swap: in contrast to $[…] million for the period ended […]（语气更侧重对比的差异性，适合突出数据变动）
as compared with $[…] million for the period ended […]（更强调两者间的对应对比关系，适合严谨的财务分析）

items.en: subsequent to the Barstool Acquisition on February 17, 2023 and prior to the Barstool divestiture on August 8, 2023
items.why: 用“subsequent to”和“prior to”精准限定时间区间，正式且简洁，中文常需用从句，英文介词短语更紧凑，符合SEC报告的严谨性
items.when: 财报中需明确某事件的特定时间范围（如收购后至剥离前的期间）时套用
items.slot: subsequent to the […] on […] and prior to the […] on […]
swap: following the […] on […] and before the […] on […]（语气偏日常，不如原结构正式）
after the […] dated […] and prior to the […] dated […]（稍显繁琐，冗余度更高）

items.en: fluctuate due to specific holidays or other significant events
items.why: 使用“due to”引出原因，是正式书面语，适合报告语境，中国人常使用更口语化的“because of”，不够正式。
items.when: 正式报告中说明业务波动的诱因时套用。
items.slot: fluctuate due to […]
swap: experience fluctuations caused by specific holidays or other significant events（用“experience”更主动，侧重经历波动）
be subject to fluctuations resulting from specific holidays or other significant events（被动式，侧重波动的状态）

items.en: See “Item 1A. Risk Factors” of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for additional information.
items.why: 使用简洁正式的指引表达，符合SEC报告规范，中国人常写“For more information, please look at Item 1A...”，不够凝练专业。
items.when: 正式年报、合规文件中指引读者查阅其他章节时套用。
items.slot: See “[…]” of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for additional information.
swap: Refer to “Item 1A. Risk Factors” of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for further details.（用“refer”更正式，“further details”侧重细节）
Please consult “Item 1A. Risk Factors” in this Annual Report on Form 10-K for more information.（用“consult”更正式，语气更礼貌）

items.en: recorded an impairment loss of approximately $66 million
items.why: 这是SEC报告中标准的会计处理表述，准确专业，中国人常写"had a loss of about $66 million due to impairment"，不够规范，适合审计或10-K类文件。
items.when: 财务报告中确认减值损失的场合。
items.slot: recorded an impairment loss of approximately $[…] million
swap: recognized an impairment loss of approximately $66 million (用会计术语recognized替代recorded)
recorded an impairment charge of approximately $66 million (用charge强调费用属性)

items.en: Following completion of our Esterhazy K3 expansion project
items.why: 用介词短语作状语，比中文常用的“在我们的Esterhazy K3扩建项目完成后”更简洁正式，符合英文报告的书面表达习惯，避免冗余的分句结构。
items.when: 正式报告中描述某一事项完成后的后续情况时套用。
items.slot: Following completion of our […] expansion project
swap: Upon completion of our […] expansion project（语气更简洁，侧重动作完成的瞬间）
Subsequent to our […] expansion project’s completion（语气更正式，侧重时间上的先后关系）

items.en: a third-party audit assessed our Esterhazy Facility’s nameplate capacity
items.why: 用“third-party audit”明确审计主体的独立性，比“第三方审计”的直译更符合英文专业术语，“assessed”比“calculated”更贴合审计的专业判断属性，正式且精准。
items.when: 审计相关报告中描述第三方对设施产能等指标的评估时套用。
items.slot: a third-party audit assessed our […] Facility’s nameplate capacity
swap: an independent third-party audit evaluated our […] Facility’s rated capacity（增加“independent”强调独立性，“evaluated”比“assessed”更侧重价值判断）
a third-party auditor appraised our […] Facility’s nameplate capacity（用“auditor”明确主体，“appraised”更侧重估值类的评估）

items.en: To date, we have been unable to rely upon this audit as a basis for an increase
items.why: “To date”比“Until now”更正式，符合SEC报告的书面语要求，“rely upon”比“depend on”更书面，整体表述严谨，避免绝对化用词，适合说明未完成的事项。
items.when: 正式报告中说明到目前为止尚未完成某一动作或达成某一目标时套用。
items.slot: To date, we have been unable to rely upon this […] as a basis for an increase
swap: As of the present, we have not been able to rely on this […] as a basis for an increase（“As of the present”比“To date”更侧重当前时点，“rely on”比“rely upon”稍口语化但仍正式）
Up to this point, we have been unable to use this […] as a basis for an increase（“Up to this point”更强调阶段性，“use”比“rely upon”更侧重实际使用而非信任）

items.en: strive for zero harm to people and zero environmental incidents
items.why: 用“strive for + 具体量化目标”替代模糊的“attach importance to safety”，更具体可衡量，符合专业报告严谨性，中国人常写空泛表述
items.when: 撰写企业安全、ESG相关正式报告时套用
items.slot: strive for zero […] to […] and zero […]
swap: aim for zero harm to personnel and zero environmental accidents（语气更正式，偏向合规表述）
pursue zero harm to employees and zero environmental incidents（语气更侧重主动推进）

items.en: established a structured approach to effectively manage and control risk
items.why: 用“established a structured approach to do sth”清晰说明结构化属性与目的，替代中式英语的空泛表述，符合英文正式报告逻辑
items.when: 撰写企业内控、风险管理相关正式报告时套用
items.slot: established a structured approach to effectively manage and control risk for […]
swap: implemented a systematic framework to effectively manage and control risk（更强调体系落地，偏实操表述）
developed a structured methodology to effectively manage and control risk（更侧重方法专业性，偏学术表述）

items.en: support a safe work environment and establish a continuous improvement cycle
items.why: 结构对称的并列表述，逻辑递进，替代中式英语的生硬直译，更简洁专业
items.when: 撰写企业运营、安全管理相关正式报告时套用
items.slot: support a safe […] and establish a continuous improvement cycle
swap: foster a safe work environment and build a continuous improvement loop（“foster”侧重培育，“loop”表述更灵活）
maintain a safe work environment and establish a continuous improvement process（“maintain”侧重维持，“process”更偏向流程）

items.en: The pace of change in networking continues to increase
items.why: 用"the pace of change"替代常用的"the speed of change"，更贴合正式报告中描述趋势变化的语境，避免口语化，精准且专业。中国人常直接用"speed"，不如"pace"在行业报告中常用。
items.when: 可套用在科技、金融等行业的正式报告中，描述领域发展变化的速度。
items.slot: The pace of change in […] continues to […]
swap: The speed of change in […] continues to […]（"speed"侧重物理速度，不如"pace"贴合趋势变化的语境）
The rate of change in […] continues to […]（"rate"侧重变化比率，不如"pace"涵盖整体变化进程）

items.en: Exponential growth in video and mobile data consumption is continuing to revolutionize
items.why: 用"Exponential growth"描述数据增长的量级，比"rapid growth"更精准，符合SEC报告的严谨性，清晰体现增长的指数级特征。中国人常写"rapid growth"，未体现量级的特殊性。
items.when: 可套用在描述数据、用户量等指标指数级增长的正式财经或行业报告中。
items.slot: Exponential growth in […] is continuing to […]
swap: Rapid growth in […] is continuing to […]（"rapid"仅指速度快，未体现增长的指数性）
Massive growth in […] is continuing to […]（"massive"侧重规模大，不如"exponential"精准描述增长的数学特征）

items.en: changing the network architecture needed to support consumer demand
items.why: 用现在分词短语作结果状语，结构紧凑连贯，避免拆分句子的冗余，符合英文正式报告的简洁性。中国人常分开写两个独立句子，不如这种结构逻辑紧密。
items.when: 可套用在描述某一趋势带来后续影响的正式报告中。
items.slot: [...] is changing the [...] needed to support [...]
swap: [...] is causing changes to the [...] needed to support [...]（"causing changes to"比直接用"changing"更啰嗦，不够简洁）
[...] is resulting in changes to the [...] needed to support [...]（"resulting in changes to"同样冗余，不如"changing"直接）

items.en: We are pursuing strategic initiatives aimed at optimizing our utilization of resources
items.why: 用“aimed at”衔接战略举措与目标，比直接用“to”更正式书面，符合SEC财报的严谨语境，中国人常写“to optimize our utilization of resources”，过于直白，缺乏正式感。
items.when: 用于公司披露战略规划、资源优化举措的场合。
items.slot: We are pursuing strategic initiatives aimed at optimizing our utilization of […]
swap: undertaking strategic initiatives designed to optimize our utilization of […]（语气更正式，侧重计划的针对性）
implementing strategic initiatives intended to optimize our utilization of […]（语气更中性，侧重动作的目的性）

items.en: increasing transparency and control over indirect procurement spend
items.why: 用并列名词短语“transparency and control”作宾语，结构工整紧凑，避免冗余，中国人常写“increasing transparency and improving control”，拆分后略显繁琐，不符合财报简洁性要求。
items.when: 用于列举采购环节改进举措的场合。
items.slot: increasing transparency and control over […] spend
swap: enhancing transparency and oversight over indirect procurement spend（用oversight替代control，更侧重监督而非直接管控，语气更温和）
boosting transparency and management over indirect procurement spend（用management替代control，更侧重过程管理，语气更宽泛）

items.en: lower costs and streamlining and optimizing our period overhead cost structure
items.why: 用并列动名词短语“streamlining and optimizing”衔接成本优化的连续动作，逻辑连贯，符合财报中描述运营改进的正式表达，中国人常写“reduce costs and streamline and optimize our period overhead cost structure”，用动词原形不如动名词贴合正在推进的举措语境。
items.when: 用于披露运营成本优化、期间费用结构调整的场合。
items.slot: lower costs and streamlining and optimizing our […] cost structure
swap: reduce costs and simplifying and refining our period overhead cost structure（用simplifying替代streamlining，侧重简化流程，refining替代optimizing，侧重细化调整，语气更具体）
cut costs and rationalizing and adjusting our period overhead cost structure（用cut替代lower，语气更侧重削减，rationalizing替代streamlining，侧重合理化调整，语气更偏向合规性）

items.en: as compared to an increase of 4.3% in 2024
items.why: 用“as compared to”衔接两个期间的业绩对比，逻辑清晰且正式，中国人常写“和2024年的4.3%相比”，易显中式直译。
items.when: 正式报告中对比两个期间业绩数据的场合
items.slot: as compared to an increase of […] in […]
swap: in contrast to，同义，更强调对比差异的显著性
versus，同义，更简洁，适合紧凑文本

items.en: which included operational growth of 5.3% and a positive currency impact of 0.7%
items.why: 中文常直接表述为“增长6%，其中运营增长5.3%、汇率影响0.7%”，但英文用“which included”引导非限定性定语从句，清晰拆分增长的驱动因素，结构严谨且符合正式报告逻辑，避免句子冗长杂乱。
items.when: 用于财务报告中拆分营收增长的具体构成（如运营增长、汇率影响等）时。
items.slot: which included operational growth of […]% and a positive currency impact of […]%
swap: including operational growth of […]% and favorable currency impact of […]%（favorable比positive更贴合财务语境中“有利影响”的常用表述）
consisting of operational growth of […]% and a positive foreign exchange impact of […]%（foreign exchange是财务领域“外汇”的标准术语）

items.en: the net impact of acquisitions and divestitures on the worldwide Innovative Medicine segment operational sales growth was a positive 1.2%
items.why: 中文常直接写“并购和剥离的影响是正的1.2%”，但英文明确标注“net impact”（净影响），并限定影响对象为“worldwide Innovative Medicine segment operational sales growth”，清晰界定影响的范围和维度，符合SEC报告的精准性要求。
items.when: 用于披露并购、剥离等资本运作对特定业务板块财务指标的净影响时。
items.slot: the net impact of acquisitions and divestitures on the worldwide […] segment operational sales growth was a positive […]%
swap: the combined impact of acquisitions and divestitures on the global […] segment operational sales growth was a favorable […]%（combined比net更侧重合并后的总影响，语气稍弱）
the net effect of acquisitions and divestitures on the worldwide […] segment operational sales growth was a positive […]%（effect与impact同义，替换后表述更简洁）

items.en: We offer a broad portfolio of products to diverse aftermarket channel customers
items.why: 用「broad portfolio of products」替代中文式的「很多产品」，更贴合财报专业表述，精准体现产品组合的广度，避免口语化
items.when: 公司业务介绍、产品布局说明的正式报告场合
items.slot: We offer a broad portfolio of products to diverse […] customers
swap: We provide a wide range of products to various […] customers（语气更平实，适合内部报告）
We supply an extensive selection of products to different […] clients（更侧重品类丰富性，适合营销类报告）

items.en: Our net sales have historically been, and remain, highly correlated with industrial activity and utilization
items.why: 用平行结构「have historically been, and remain」清晰体现从过去到现在的持续状态，避免时态混乱，中国人常直接用「have been and are」不够正式
items.when: 描述公司业务指标长期趋势的正式报告场合
items.slot: Our […] have historically been, and remain, highly correlated with […] and […]
swap: Our […] have historically been, and continue to be, closely linked to […] and […]（替换remain为continue to be，侧重未来延续性）
Our […] have long been, and still are, strongly associated with […] and […]（用long been替代historically been，更简洁）

items.en: this reputation has been built over more than 110 years since Gates’ founding in 1911
items.why: 用被动完成时「has been built」客观中立陈述声誉形成过程，符合财报中立性要求，中国人常主动说「我们建立了声誉」不够客观
items.when: 描述公司品牌、声誉形成的正式报告场合
items.slot: this reputation has been built over more than […] years since […]’ founding in […]
swap: this brand reputation has been established for more than […] years since […] was founded in […]（替换built为established，更侧重品牌建立）
this reputation has been developed over more than […] years since […]’ inception in […]（替换founding为inception，更正式书面）

items.en: mitigating the risk of equipment failure for end users
items.why: 英文用现在分词作伴随状语，比中文常平铺的“降低终端用户设备故障的风险”更连贯，符合正式报告的逻辑结构
items.when: 撰写服务带来的风险防控类正式报告时使用
items.slot: while mitigating the risk of […] for […]
swap: reducing the risk of (更简洁，适合短句子)
lessening the likelihood of (更侧重可能性，适合风险表述)

items.en: the years ended December 31, 2025 and December 31, 2024
items.why: 中国人写财务报告时间范围常简化为「for 2025 and 2024」，不够正式且不符合SEC报告的严谨规范，该结构用「ended + 具体日期」明确是年度末期间，专业度更高
items.when: 财务尽职调查或审计报告中明确对应特定年度的期间时使用
items.slot: the years ended December …, [YYYY1] and December …, [YYYY2]
swap: the fiscal years ending on December 31, 2025 and 2024：语气偏向通用正式，前者更贴合SEC法定报告的表述
for the periods ended December 31, 2025 and 2024：侧重期间而非年度，适用场景稍窄

items.en: The majority of our revenue is driven by standardized processes and enabled by software.
items.why: 用被动语态客观说明收入的驱动因素，正式且符合财报语境，中国人常写主动句（如“We get most revenue from...”），不够专业严谨。
items.when: 财报中描述收入核心来源与驱动因素的场合
items.slot: The majority of our revenue is driven by […] and enabled by […].
swap: Most of our revenue is generated by standardized processes and supported by software. （用generate替代driven、supported替代enabled，语气更口语化，适合非核心正式段落）
Our revenue is mostly driven by standardized processes and enabled by software. （调整语序更简洁，适合短篇幅财报摘要）

items.en: the more individual jobs we receive in a given time period, the more efficiently we can sort and route jobs with homogeneous production processes to given nodes of our internal production systems or of our third-party supply chain
items.why: 用“the+比较级，the+比较级”结构紧凑体现规模与效率的正相关，专业且逻辑清晰，中国人常写直白的因果句（如“As we get more jobs, we are more efficient”），不够凝练正式。
items.when: 财报中描述业务规模与运营效率关系的场合
items.slot: the more […] we receive in a given time period, the more efficiently we can […] to […].
swap: as we receive more individual jobs in a given period, we can sort and route jobs with homogeneous production processes more efficiently. （用as引导从句，语气更直白，适合解释性段落）

the greater number of jobs we receive in a given time frame, the more effectively we can sort and route homogeneous production jobs to our internal or third-party nodes. （用time frame替代time period、effectively替代efficiently，语气更强调效果）

items.en: We believe that our strategy of systematizing our service and production operations enables us to deliver value to customers much more effectively than traditional competitors.
items.why: 用“strategy of+动名词短语”明确策略内容，对比结构清晰体现竞争优势，正式且有说服力，中国人常写简单句（如“Our strategy helps us serve customers better”），不够具体专业。
items.when: 财报中阐述核心竞争策略及其客户价值的场合
items.slot: We believe that our strategy of systematizing our […] enables us to deliver value to customers much more effectively than […].
swap: We think our strategy of systematizing service and production operations allows us to deliver more customer value than traditional competitors. （用think替代believe、allows替代enables，语气更口语化，适合内部报告）

We are confident that our strategy of systematizing service and production operations helps us deliver value to customers far more effectively than traditional competitors. （用we are confident替代we believe，语气更肯定，适合强调核心竞争力）

items.en: with a focus on breast cancer and other breast conditions
items.why: 用介词短语「with a focus on」明确业务核心方向，避免重复主语，比中文常直译的「we focus on...」更简洁，符合英文正式报告的书面语风格
items.when: 介绍公司核心业务领域的场合
items.slot: with a focus on [target area …] and other [related areas]
swap: focused on [target area 1] and other [related areas]（更紧凑，省略冗余的介词with a）
primarily focused on [target area 1] and other [related areas]（增加primarily，突出核心领域的优先级）

items.en: compared to a 0.27% change in the placebo group
items.why: 该写法用‘compared to’清晰对比实验组与对照组的量化结果，符合SEC报告的正式性；中国人常直接用‘while’连接，表述不够严谨正式。
items.when: 财务或审计报告中对比不同组别（如实验组与对照组）的量化数据时套用。
items.slot: compared to a […]% change in the […] group
swap: in contrast to a 0.27% change in the placebo group（语气更正式，适配正式报告语境）
as opposed to a 0.27% change in the placebo group（语气稍强，用于强调数据差异）

items.en: indicating that substantial MBD reductions were achieved at relatively low systemic exposure
items.why: 用‘indicating that’自然衔接数据推导的结论，‘relatively’体现结论的严谨性（避免绝对化）；中国人常直接用‘so’或‘thus’，少了模糊限制，不够专业。
items.when: 报告中从数据推导初步结论时套用。
items.slot: indicating that substantial […] were achieved at relatively low […]
swap: suggesting that substantial MBD reductions were achieved at relatively low systemic exposure（语气更委婉，适合初步结论表述）
showing that substantial MBD reductions were achieved at relatively low systemic exposure（语气稍强，用于明确结论）
