items.en: No meaningful differences in adverse events were observed between the 1 mg dose group and placebo
items.why: 用‘between…and…’明确对比主体，‘No meaningful differences’是专业报告的标准表述；中国人常直接说‘there are no differences’，不够严谨专业。
items.when: 报告中对比两组或多组的指标差异时套用。
items.slot: No meaningful differences in […] were observed between the […] and […]
swap: No clinically meaningful differences in adverse events were observed between the 1 mg dose group and placebo（增加‘clinically’，适配医学/临床相关报告）
No statistically meaningful differences in adverse events were observed between the 1 mg dose group and placebo（增加‘statistically’，适配统计相关报告）

items.en: where we perform testing that hospitals do not perform in their own in-hospital labs.
items.why: 用where引导定语从句清晰说明服务场景，比中国人常写的“which is the testing that hospitals don’t do in their own labs”更简洁，符合正式报告逻辑
items.when: 正式报告中解释业务范围或特定服务的场合
items.slot: where we perform […] that hospitals do not perform in their own […].
swap: in which we perform […] that hospitals do not conduct in their own […].（conduct更偏向管理层面，原句侧重操作）
during which we perform […] that hospitals do not run in their own […].（run更偏向运营，原句侧重执行）

items.en: using blood specimens, as opposed to testing by more costly or invasive methods
items.why: 中文常直接用“使用血液样本，而非更昂贵或侵入性的方法”，英文用“as opposed to”清晰明确地对比替代方案，逻辑更严谨，符合财报的专业表述要求。
items.when: 在报告中说明产品/服务的替代方案、技术优势时套用。
items.slot: using […] as opposed to testing by more costly or invasive methods
swap: via […] rather than testing via more costly or invasive means (更简洁，语气更正式)
with […] instead of testing with more expensive or invasive approaches (语气稍灵活，适合非核心对比)

items.en: helps primary care physicians comprehensively screen for autoimmune disorders
items.why: 中文常写“帮助初级护理医生全面筛查自身免疫疾病”，英文用“helps […] comprehensively screen for […]”的正式结构，明确服务的价值，符合财报中功能说明的规范。
items.when: 在报告中说明产品或服务的核心功能、对客户的价值时套用。
items.slot: helps primary care physicians comprehensively screen for […]
swap: assists primary care physicians in comprehensively screening for […] (更正式，适合高阶报告)
aids primary care physicians to comprehensively screen for […] (语气稍柔和，适合非硬性功能说明)

items.en: which increase the need to migrate non-core functions to outsourced providers
items.why: 用非限定性定语从句衔接前文因果，逻辑紧凑，避免中文常出现的分句割裂，符合正式报告的逻辑表达。
items.when: 描述前文因素带来的后续影响、结果时套用。
items.slot: which increase the need to migrate [...] to outsourced providers
swap: thereby increasing the need to migrate [...] to outsourced providers（用分词短语更简洁，语气更连贯）
thus leading to an increased need to migrate [...] to outsourced providers（用thus leading to明确因果，语气稍重）

items.en: from our acquisition of Healthcare Staffing Professionals, Inc. in early 2025
items.why: 用“from”清晰连接“业绩来源”与“收购事件”，逻辑连贯且简洁，比中国人常用的“due to our acquisition”更符合正式报告的严谨凝练风格。
items.when: 用于财务报告中说明业绩增长或成果的来源时。
items.slot: […] from our acquisition of [Company Name] in [time period]
swap: due to our recent acquisition（稍显口语化，不如正式）
as a result of our acquisition（更侧重因果逻辑，语气稍重）

items.en: Benefits include energy cost savings, lower capital expenditure requirements, high availability of resources, better desktop management, increased security and improved disaster recovery.
items.why: 中文常按“好处包括：节能、降低资本支出等”的语序直译，英文用“Benefits include […]”的结构清晰规整，符合美式商务报告的写作习惯，便于读者快速抓取要点
items.when: 在正式报告中列举产品或服务的具体益处时套用
items.slot: Benefits include […]
swap: Key advantages are […]（更侧重核心优势提炼，适合报告摘要部分）
The benefits of this offering include […]（更侧重关联产品，适合产品说明章节）

items.en: expenses for R&D were $3.3 million compared to $3.0 million
items.why: 中文常直接罗列“研发费用为330万美元，2024年为300万美元”，英文用compared to连接，对比逻辑更清晰，符合财务报告正式对比要求。
items.when: 财务报告中对比前后期间费用、收入等量化数据时套用。
items.slot: expenses for […] were $[X] million compared to $[Y] million
swap: costs related to R&D totaled $3.3 million versus $3.0 million，区别是用totaled和versus，语气更简洁紧凑；
R&D expenses amounted to $3.3 million versus $3.0 million，区别是用amounted to更侧重金额的合计属性。

items.en: Expenditures on R&D are expensed as they are incurred
items.why: 中文常写“研发支出在发生时费用化”，英文用被动语态+as they are incurred结构，更符合会计报告正式表述，准确说明费用确认规则，专业度更高。
items.when: 财务报告中说明研发支出等费用的会计处理规则时套用。
items.slot: Expenditures on […] are expensed as they are incurred
swap: Costs for R&D are recognized as expenses when incurred，区别是用recognized as expenses贴合会计准则标准术语；
R&D expenditures are charged to expense as incurred，区别是用charged to expense更简洁，是会计报告常用省略式表述。

items.en: relating to manufacturing in and sourcing from foreign countries
items.why: 正式报告中用「relating to」引出相关主题比常用的「about」更严谨，避免模糊指代，中国人常直接用「about」不够合规正式。
items.when: 撰写财务报告、合规文件时，引出与前文相关的具体内容。
items.slot: relating to […]
swap: as it relates to […]（更强调内容间的关联）
with respect to […]（更正式的书面语）

items.en: See Note 20 — Industry Segments and Geographic Area Information in the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements
items.why: SEC报告中引用附注的标准规范写法，清晰标注附注编号与标题，中国人常写「Check Note 20」不够正式合规。
items.when: 在财务报告、审计文件中引用附注内容时使用。
items.slot: See Note […] — […] in the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements
swap: Refer to Note […] — […] in the Consolidated Financial Statements’ Notes（更简洁的表述）
Please consult Note […] — […] in the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements（语气更委婉）

items.en: We have in the past experienced, and may continue to experience
items.why: 用插入式时间限定明确区分历史与未来状态，比直接写"We experienced and may experience"更严谨，符合正式报告的谨慎性；中国人常省略时间限定，表述过于绝对
items.when: 财务报告中描述历史已发生及未来可能持续的业务情况时套用
items.slot: We have in the past experienced, and may continue to experience, […]
swap: We have experienced in the past and may continue to experience […]（语气更平实，少插入语的流畅感）
We have experienced historically and may continue to experience […]（用historically替代in the past，更正式）

items.en: Global supply chain issues and increased demand have in the past led to, and may continue to lead to
items.why: 用插入式结构拆分历史与未来因果，避免绝对化判断，符合SEC披露要求；中国人常写"Global supply chain issues and increased demand led to"，未覆盖未来影响，表述不完整
items.when: 财务报告中说明外部因素的历史及未来潜在影响时套用
items.slot: […] have in the past led to, and may continue to lead to, […]
swap: […] have historically led to, and may continue to lead to […]（更简洁，少插入语停顿）
[…] led to in the past and may continue to lead to […]（更口语化，不适合正式报告）

items.en: There can be no assurance that we will be able to maintain our margins
items.why: 用委婉否定避免绝对承诺，符合SEC谨慎披露原则；中国人常写"We cannot guarantee that we will maintain our margins"，语气更直接，不够委婉
items.when: 财务报告中说明无法保证未来业绩或结果时套用
items.slot: There can be no assurance that we will be able to […]
swap: We cannot guarantee that we will be able to […]（语气更直接，正式性稍弱）
There is no certainty that we will be able to […]（书面化更强，语气稍重）

items.en: connecting 159 million fans to over 11,000 artists at 55,000 events in 2025
items.why: 用具体量化数据支撑业务规模，比中文常用的模糊表述（如“大量粉丝”）更具说服力，符合专业报告的严谨性。
items.when: 描述业务规模、合作方数量等量化指标时套用。
items.slot: connecting […] million fans to over […] artists at […] events in […]
swap: linking […] million fans to over […] artists at […] events in […]（语气更偏向连接关系而非规模展示）
connecting approximately […] million fans to more than […] artists at […] events in […]（语气更委婉，适合不确定的近似数据）

items.en: Our core businesses surrounding the promotion of live events
items.why: 用介词短语“surrounding...”修饰核心业务，比中国人常用的定语从句（如“which are around...”）更简洁正式，符合财报写作的凝练要求
items.when: 用于SEC 10-K等财报中说明公司核心业务的范围
items.slot: Our core businesses surrounding the promotion of […]
swap: Our core businesses related to the promotion of live events
related to语气更通用，surrounding更贴合业务围绕特定领域的场景

items.en: we serve artists, venues, and sports teams and leagues
items.why: 用动词“serve”精准描述公司对客户的服务关系，比中国人常用的“provide services to”更凝练正式，符合英文财报的简洁风格
items.when: 用于财报中说明公司服务的客户群体
items.slot: we serve […], venues, and sports teams and leagues
swap: we provide services to artists, venues, and sports teams and leagues
provide services to表述冗余，serve更符合正式报告的凝练要求

items.en: All skilled nursing facilities, owned, leased or managed by us
items.why: 用过去分词短语作后置定语修饰名词，比中文对应常用的定语从句表达更简洁紧凑，避免冗余的关系词和be动词重复
items.when: 正式报告中描述设施/资产的权属或管理状态的场合
items.slot: All […] facilities, owned, leased or managed by us
swap: All skilled nursing facilities that are owned, leased or managed by us（更啰嗦，正式度稍弱）
All skilled nursing facilities which are owned, leased or managed by us（冗余度更高，不如原句简洁）

items.en: All but eight (seven owned and one managed)
items.why: 用“All but + 数字”的正式表达清晰说明整体中排除的数量，搭配括号补充细节，比中文对应常用的“except for + 数字”表达更符合SEC报告的正式简洁风格
items.when: 正式报告中描述整体项目里排除特定数量的场合
items.slot: All but […] (seven owned and one managed)
swap: Except for eight (seven owned and one managed)（语气稍弱，正式度略低）
All except eight (seven owned and one managed)（正确但“all but”更常用在正式文书）

items.en: with Medicare comprising the majority of their revenue
items.why: 用“with + 名词 + 现在分词”的复合结构作伴随状语，紧凑补充前文的附属信息，比中文对应常用的并列分句更符合正式报告的紧凑性要求
items.when: 正式报告中补充说明前文内容的附属情况（如收入构成）的场合
items.slot: with […] comprising the majority of their revenue
swap: and Medicare comprises the majority of their revenue（变成并列分句，稍显冗余，破坏句子紧凑性）
with Medicare constituting the majority of their revenue（同义替换，语气相近）

items.en: the reduction of or failure by advertisers to maintain or increase their advertising budgets
items.why: 中文常拆分多个分句表述“广告预算减少或未能维持/增加”，此处用平行名词结构并列多个风险点，简洁严谨，符合SEC报告的正式风格。
items.when: 用于正式报告中并列描述多个相关的风险因素。
items.slot: the reduction of or failure by […] to maintain or increase their […] budgets.
swap: a reduction in or failure of advertisers to sustain or raise their ad budgets（用“in”替代“by”，“sustain”替代“maintain”，“ad”替代“advertising”，更简洁）
a decrease in or inability of advertisers to keep up or grow their ad budgets（用“decrease”替代“reduction”，“inability”替代“failure”，语气更弱）

items.en: set forth under the headings “ Risk Factors ”, “ Mana g ement’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations ”, “ Business ”, and “ Properties ”
items.why: 该写法明确标注内容所在章节，是专业报告定位信息的标准表述，中国人常写“in the sections”，不够精准
items.when: 在报告中说明特定内容的章节位置时使用
items.slot: set forth under the headings “ [Heading 1] ”, “ [Heading 2] ”, ..., “ [Heading N] ”
swap: listed under the captions “ Risk Factors ”, ..., “ Properties ”（“captions”更正式，适用于法律文件）
contained in the sections “ Risk Factors ”, ..., “ Properties ”（更简洁，适用于常规报告）

items.en: Following the closing of the transactions described above (collectively, the “Simson Share Transactions”)
items.why: 用分词短语开头交代背景，比中文常用的“在上述交易完成后”更简洁正式，符合SEC报告的严谨风格，中国人常写冗长的时间状语，此写法更紧凑。
items.when: 正式财务报告开头交代交易背景的场合
items.slot: Following the closing of the transactions described above (collectively, the “[…] Transactions”)
swap: Upon completion of the transactions referenced above (collectively, the “[…] Transactions”)，语气更简洁，适合更紧凑的监管报告
Subsequent to the closing of the transactions noted above (collectively, the “[…] Transactions”)，语气更正式，适合审计说明

items.en: Viking did not sell or purchase any shares in connection with the Simson Share Transactions
items.why: 用“in connection with”明确事项关联关系，避免歧义，中国人常写“related to”过于随意，此短语更符合财务报告的正式性。
items.when: 财务报告中说明某主体与特定交易关联情况的场合
items.slot: […] did not sell or purchase any shares in connection with the Simson Share Transactions
swap: […] did not acquire or dispose of any shares in relation to the Simson Share Transactions，用acquire/dispose更专业，适合审计报告
[…] did not transfer any shares in connection with the Simson Share Transactions，更简洁，适合快速说明

items.en: Camber no longer consolidates Simson-Maxwell’s financial results in its consolidated financial statements
items.why: 使用专业术语“consolidates”准确表达合并报表动作，比中文常用的“合并”更精准，符合SEC报告的专业表述要求，中国人常误用普通动词表达专业动作。
items.when: 财务报告中说明合并范围变化的场合
items.slot: […] no longer consolidates […]’s financial results in its consolidated financial statements
swap: […] ceased consolidating […]’s financial results in its consolidated financial statements，用ceased强调动作终止，更适合审计说明变化
[…] does not consolidate […]’s financial results in its consolidated financial statements，更简洁，适合快速披露

items.en: could have a material adverse impact on our businesses
items.why: "material adverse impact"是SEC财报指定的标准术语，比中国人常写的"big bad influence"更专业合规，准确对应重大不利影响的监管要求
items.when: 撰写英文财报时，描述风险可能造成的重大不利后果的场合
items.slot: could have a material adverse impact on our […]
swap: could result in a significant negative effect on our businesses（"significant"不如"material"符合SEC术语规范）
might cause a material negative impact on our operations（"operations"替换"businesses"，适用范围更窄）

items.en: We continue to monitor developments in laws, rules and regulations.
items.why: 用“continue to monitor”体现动作的持续性，比中文常直接写的“我们监控”更能体现专业报告中动态跟进的审慎性，避免静态表述的生硬感。
items.when: 在专业报告中描述持续进行的合规监测类动作时套用。
items.slot: We continue to monitor developments in […].
swap: We are continuously monitoring developments in […].（更强调动作正在进行的状态）
We remain engaged in monitoring developments in […].（更正式，突出主动参与性）

items.en: Refer to “Violations of laws or regulations, as well as new laws or regulations or changes to existing laws or regulations or to interpretations thereof, could adversely affect our businesses” within “Risk Factors” in Item 1A of this report for additional information.
items.why: 用完整的引用格式明确标注引用内容和位置，比中文常直接写的“详见风险因素”更符合SEC报告规范，专业且清晰。
items.when: 在专业报告中需要交叉引用其他章节内容时套用。
items.slot: Refer to “[…]” within “Risk Factors” in Item […] of this report for additional information.
swap: Please see the discussion of “[…]” in “Risk Factors” in Item […] of this report for further details.（更礼貌，用please see替代refer to）
For more information, see the section titled “[…]” in Item […] of this report under “Risk Factors”.（更简洁，调整语序）

items.en: See "Item 1A. Risk Factors – Risks Related to Our Business – We depend on a select number of customers for a significant portion of our revenue" and "PART II – Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data – Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements – Concentrations."
items.why: 清晰标注交叉引用的具体章节路径，方便读者定位；中文常写“详见相关章节”，未明确具体位置，不够精准。
items.when: 财务报告中引用其他章节内容、需指引读者查阅时使用。
items.slot: See "[Section …Full Path]" and "[Section …Full Path]"
swap: Refer to "Item 1A. Risk Factors – Risks Related to Our Business – We depend on a select number of customers for a significant portion of our revenue" and "PART II – Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data – Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements – Concentrations."：更正式，适合SEC文件的严谨风格

Please see "Item 1A. Risk Factors – Risks Related to Our Business – We depend on a select number of customers for a significant portion of our revenue" and "PART II – Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data – Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements – Concentrations."：更礼貌，适合非强制引用的场景

items.en: including in the section entitled "Forward-Looking Statements" included in this Form 10-K.
items.why: 中国人常写“including the part called Forward-Looking Statements”，此处用“entitled”更正式，符合合规文件中引用特定章节的规范，避免口语化的“called”。
items.when: 正式报告中引用特定命名章节时套用。
items.slot: including in the section entitled "[Section Name]" included in this Form …-K.
swap: including the section titled "Forward-Looking Statements" within this Form 10-K；用“titled”替换“entitled”，更简洁，适合内部报告。
including the section named "Forward-Looking Statements" in this Form 10-K；用“named”替换“entitled”，更随意，适合非正式文件。

items.en: the "Company," "we," "our" and "us" which terms, unless the context otherwise requires, refer to
items.why: 该写法通过限定指代术语的适用规则，避免正式报告中代词指代模糊的问题，中国人常直接重复公司全称，易显冗余或指代不清
items.when: 正式报告开头定义公司指代术语的场合
items.slot: the "[…]," "[…]," "[…]," and "[…]," which terms, unless the context otherwise requires, refer to
swap: hereinafter referred to as the "Company," "we," "our" and "us" (the "Terms")
中文：用"hereinafter referred to"更简洁正式，适合短指代定义
the terms "Company," "we," "our" and "us" (collectively, the "Reference Terms")
中文：用"collectively"明确集合指代，更清晰

items.en: New England, the New York/New Jersey metro area, the Mid-Atlantic, the Pacific Northwest, and Northern and Southern California, as well as in our expansion regions of Raleigh-Durham and Charlotte, North Carolina, Southeast Florida, Dallas and Austin, Texas, and Denver, Colorado
items.why: 采用分层列举核心业务区域和扩张区域的结构，逻辑层级清晰，中国人常将所有区域混排，缺乏层次感
items.when: 正式报告中列示业务覆盖范围的场合
items.slot: […], the […], the […], the […], and […], as well as in our expansion regions of […], […], […], and […]
swap: covering areas including […], […], […], and […], plus our expansion markets of […], […], […], and […]
中文：用"covering areas including"和"plus"替换，语气更简洁
operating in […], […], […], and […], as well as our growth regions of […], […], […], and […]
中文：用"operating in"和"growth regions"替换，更侧重运营属性

items.en: have offered, and will continue to offer, the opportunity for superior risk-adjusted returns over the long-term on apartment community investments relative to other markets
items.why: 使用插入语衔接过去和未来的回报情况，时态一致且流畅，专业术语"risk-adjusted returns"准确规范，中国人常直接说"high long-term returns"，缺乏专业严谨性
items.when: 正式报告中描述投资机会或业绩预期的场合
items.slot: have […], and will continue to […], the opportunity for superior risk-adjusted returns over the long-term on […] investments relative to other markets
swap: have provided, and will keep delivering, the chance of better risk-adjusted returns in the long run compared to other markets
中文：用"provided/delivering"替换"offered"，"better"替换"superior"，语气更平实
have generated, and will continue to generate, the opportunity for above-market risk-adjusted returns over the long term for […] investments
中文：用"generated"替换"offered"，"above-market"替换"relative to other markets"，更突出对比优势

items.en: subject to the factors described below and our future liquidity and capitalization
items.why: 中国人常直接写“根据以下因素及未来流动性和资本情况”，用主动或简单介词结构，此处用“subject to + 名词短语”的正式结构，更符合SEC报告的严谨书面语风格，明确限定政策变更的前提条件。
items.when: 撰写公司重大政策（如分红政策）的变更前提时使用。
items.slot: subject to the factors described below and our future […]
swap: depending on the factors outlined below and our future liquidity and capital structure（用depending on替换subject to，语气更偏向基于现有结构，原句更强调受约束的前提）
in light of the factors set out below and our future liquidity and capitalization levels（用in light of替换subject to，更强调基于现有水平的考量，原句更正式）

items.en: Any future determination to pay dividends to shareholders will be at the sole discretion of the Company’s Board of Directors
items.why: 中国人常写“我们未来决定是否向股东分红”，用主动主语we，此处用名词性结构“determination”做主语，更客观正式，符合SEC报告的中立书面语要求，避免主观表述。
items.when: 撰写公司重大决策（如分红）的权限归属时使用。
items.slot: Any future determination to […] will be at the sole discretion of the Company’s Board of Directors
swap: Any future decision regarding dividend payments to shareholders shall rest solely with the Company’s Board of Directors（用decision替换determination，shall比will更偏向法定权限，语气更正式）
Any future choice to distribute dividends to shareholders will be entirely within the Company’s Board of Directors’ discretion（用choice替换determination，distribute替换pay，语气更灵活）

items.en: the implications of the payment of dividends by the Company to its shareholders or by the Company’s subsidiaries
items.why: 中国人常按中文语序直译“公司向股东或子公司支付股息的影响”，此处用“of + 名词短语”的正式结构，清晰界定影响的主体和对象，符合英文正式报告的表达逻辑。
items.when: 撰写支付股息的相关影响时使用。
items.slot: the implications of the payment of dividends by the Company to its shareholders or by the Company’s […]
swap: the consequences of dividend distributions made by the Company to its shareholders or its subsidiaries（用consequences替换implications，distributions替换payment，更强调实际结果）
the effects of paying dividends by the Company to its shareholders or its subsidiaries（用effects替换implications，更偏向具体效果）

items.en: See Part I, “Cautionary Statement About Forward-Looking Statements,” of this Annual Report on Form 10-K
items.why: 中文常冗余表述为“详见本年报第一部分中关于前瞻性陈述的警示说明”，英文用“See + 精准章节路径”简洁专业，符合SEC报告规范，中国人写英文常出现冗余问题
items.when: 撰写SEC合规报告、正式年报时引用特定章节
items.slot: See Part […], “[…],” of this Annual Report on Form 10-K
swap: Refer to Part […], “[…],” in this Annual Report on Form 10-K（更正式）
Please consult Part […], “[…],” of this Annual Report on Form 10-K（语气更委婉）

items.en: applicable to our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows
items.why: 中文常写“适用于我们的业务、财务状况、经营成果和现金流”，英文用并列形容词短语紧凑精炼，中国人写英文常添加多余动词如“apply to”，此处更简洁
items.when: 正式报告中描述事项适用范围时套用
items.slot: applicable to our […], […], […], and [….]
swap: relevant to our […], […], […], and [….]（侧重相关性）
pertinent to our […], […], […], and [….]（更正式）

items.en: See also Part II, Item 7 "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" of our Form 10-K
items.why: 中文常省略SEC报告的“Item”编号或格式混乱，英文用“See also + 精准章节编号+标题”清晰合规，符合SEC披露要求
items.when: 正式合规报告中引用其他特定项目章节时套用
items.slot: See also Part […], Item […], "[…]" of our Form 10-K
swap: Also refer to Part […], Item […], "[…]" in our Form 10-K
Please also consult Part […], Item […], "[…]" of our Form 10-K

items.en: proved the viability and potential of RNC tobacco products
items.why: 这个表达用“prove + 抽象名词短语 + of 宾语”的结构，比中国人常写的“证明了RNC烟草产品的可行性和潜力”更简洁正式，符合SEC报告的书面语要求，避免重复动词，用名词化结构提升紧凑度
items.when: 撰写行业报告、公司年报中关于产品测试结果的部分时套用
items.slot: Our pilot VLN ® cigarette retail programs during […] proved the viability and potential of […]
swap: demonstrated the feasibility and potential of → 语气更偏向实证展示，比proved更委婉，适合未完全确认的场景
validated the viability and promise of → 语气更偏向验证后的认可，比proved更具肯定性
confirmed the feasibility and potential of → 语气更偏向已验证后的确认，比proved更有确定性

items.en: the appeal to consumers of having a choice
items.why: 这个结构用“appeal to sb of doing sth”表达“做某事对某人的吸引力”，比中国人常写的“对消费者的吸引力是有选择”更符合英文正式报告的措辞，用of结构避免动词冗余，更紧凑流畅
items.when: 撰写年报中关于产品对用户吸引力的部分时套用
items.slot: the appeal to consumers of having a choice in […]
swap: the attraction for consumers of having a choice of → 更偏向普通吸引力，语气较平淡
the appeal of having a choice to consumers → 语序调整，更口语化，不适合正式报告
the allure for consumers of having a choice → 更强调诱惑力，语气比appeal更强

items.en: an aging population that appreciates the convenience of gaming entertainment close to home
items.why: 中国人常写“old people who like playing games at home”，此处用“aging population”是正式人口学术语，“appreciates”比“likes”更书面，“convenience of gaming entertainment close to home”表述更具体专业，符合财经报告语境。
items.when: 撰写人口结构对行业影响的正式报告时使用。
items.slot: an aging population that appreciates the convenience of […] close to home
swap: a growing senior demographic that values the ease of gaming entertainment near one’s residence（“senior demographic”更正式，“values”比“appreciates”更中性，“near one’s residence”更书面）
an aging population that enjoys the accessibility of gaming entertainment nearby（“enjoys”更口语化，“accessibility”侧重可及性）

items.en: Additional discussion of the risks summarized in this risk factor summary, and other risks that we face
items.why: 采用名词化结构（discussion作主语）替代主动语态的we will discuss，更符合专业报告的客观中立风格；中国人常写“we will further discuss the risks...”，主语为人，弱化了报告的客观性。
items.when: 在专业报告中引出后续对某类事项的进一步讨论时套用。
items.slot: Additional discussion of the risks summarized in […] and other risks that we face can be found below under the heading “[…]”
swap: We will further discuss the risks summarized in […] and other risks that we face (主动语态，主语为人，客观性不足)
Further discussion on the risks summarized in […] and other risks we face (介词on替代of，语气稍弱)
Additional discussion about the risks summarized in […] and other risks we face (介词about不如of正式，不适合SEC报告)

items.en: together with other information in this Form 10-K and our other filings with the SEC
items.why: 用together with衔接关联信息，比简单的and更正式，体现信息的关联性；中国人常直接写“and other information”，语气平淡，缺乏专业报告的衔接质感。
items.when: 在专业报告中关联当前文件与其他相关文件的信息时套用。
items.slot: together with other information in this Form […] and our other filings with the [SEC/regulator]
swap: and other information (语气平淡，缺乏关联性体现)
as well as other information (语气偏口语化，不如together with正式)
along with other information (语气稍弱，不如together with适合正式报告)

items.en: In keeping with the increased emphasis on cost-effectiveness in healthcare delivery
items.why: 衔接自然正式，贴合专业报告语境，中国人常直接用"Because of..."开头，生硬且不够正式
items.when: 撰写正式财经报告开头衔接行业背景时套用
items.slot: In keeping with the increased emphasis on […] in […]
swap: In line with the growing focus on cost efficiency in healthcare provision（更简洁，适合篇幅紧凑的报告）
Consistent with the rising priority on cost-effectiveness in healthcare delivery（语气更强调与行业趋势的一致性）

items.en: For more information on these risks, see the information under the captions “ Risks Relating to Our Operations Business—Segments of our business are significantly dependent on major contracts with GPOs, IDNs, and certain other distributors and purchasers” in Item 1A. Risk Factors of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.
items.why: 指引清晰规范，符合SEC报告正式要求，中国人常写"you can find more details in the risk factors"，随意且不够正式
items.when: 在正式报告中指引读者查阅特定章节内容时套用
items.slot: For more information on these […], see the information under the captions “ […] ” in Item [X]. [Section Name] of this [Report Name].
swap: To learn more about these risks, refer to the details under the heading “ Risks Relating to Our Business—Segments Dependent on Key Contracts ” in Part 1A. Risk Factors of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.（更简洁，避免重复"information"）

For additional details on these risks, see the section titled “ Risks Related to Our Operations—Business Segments Dependent on Major Contracts ” in Item 1A. Risk Factors of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.（更强调章节标题的正式性）

items.en: work closely with our suppliers to help ensure availability and continuity of supply
items.why: 中国人常写“cooperate closely with suppliers to ensure supply availability and continuity”，用“work closely with”更自然地道，“help ensure”比直接“ensure”更谨慎，避免绝对化
items.when: 正式报告中描述与合作方（如供应商）的协作措施时套用
items.slot: work closely with our suppliers to help ensure availability and continuity of […] supply
swap: collaborate closely with our suppliers to help guarantee availability and continuity of raw materials and component supply（collaborate更侧重深度协作，比work更正式）
partner closely with our suppliers to help ensure availability and continuity of raw materials and component supply（partner更强调伙伴关系，语气更亲和）

items.en: Refer to “Risks Relating to Our Business and Financial Performance – We have experienced disruptions in our supply chain”
items.why: 中国人常写“See the risks in our business and financial performance section”，用“Refer to”是SEC报告规范的引用表述，明确标注风险标题层级，避免歧义
items.when: 正式合规报告（如SEC filings）中引用其他章节具体内容时套用
items.slot: Refer to “Risks Relating to […] – […]”
swap: See “Risks Relating to Our Business and Financial Performance – We have experienced disruptions in our supply chain”（See更口语化，适合非正式报告引用）
Please refer to “Risks Relating to Our Business and Financial Performance – We have experienced disruptions in our supply chain”（加Please过于礼貌，不符合SEC报告的简洁正式风格）

items.en: based on the consideration specified in the applicable agreement
items.why: 用过去分词短语后置修饰名词，简洁明确，避免冗长从句；中国人常写"based on the consideration that is specified in the applicable agreement"，表述更啰嗦
items.when: 用于财务报告中说明收入或费用确认的依据
items.slot: based on the consideration specified in the applicable […] agreement
swap: on the basis of the consideration set forth in the relevant agreement（"set forth"比"specified"更强调正式列明，"relevant"比"applicable"更宽泛）
using the consideration outlined in the applicable agreement（"using"不如"based on"正式，适合内部文档）

items.en: The board of directors is committed to rewarding shareholders directly through cash dividends and share repurchase authorizations.
items.why: This uses formal, compliant corporate language standard in SEC filings. Chinese writers often use vague phrases like "董事会决心回报股东" instead of this precise, structured wording.
items.when: When writing official corporate governance or dividend policy statements in regulatory filings.
items.slot: The board of directors is committed to rewarding shareholders directly through […] and […].
swap: The board of directors is dedicated to returning value to shareholders via cash dividends and share repurchase programs (more concise for internal reports vs formal regulatory language)
The board of directors has a commitment to rewarding shareholders directly through cash dividends and share repurchase authorizations (slightly more explicit for stakeholder communications)

items.en: Through 2025, the company has increased the annual cash dividend rate for 65 consecutive years, a record we believe is matched by only seven other publicly traded U.S. companies.
items.why: This uses specific numbers and hedge language to highlight a rare achievement, standard in financial disclosures. Chinese writers often omit context or use less precise phrasing like "连续65年分红增长" without noting rarity.
items.when: When presenting long-term corporate track records in annual reports or filings.
items.slot: Through […], the company has increased the annual cash dividend rate for […] consecutive years, a record we believe is matched by only […] other publicly traded U.S. companies.
swap: As of 2025, the company has raised its annual cash dividend rate for 65 straight years, a milestone we think is shared by just seven other U.S. public firms (more conversational for investor presentations)

Up to 2025, the company has lifted its annual cash dividend rate for 65 consecutive years, a benchmark we consider to be equaled by only seven other publicly traded U.S. companies (more formal for legal disclosures)

items.en: the 2025 increase to the regular dividend reflected confidence in our outstanding capital, liquidity and financial flexibility, as well as progress of our initiatives to improve earnings performance while growing insurance premium revenues.
items.why: This uses balanced, qualified reasoning to explain a decision, avoiding overstatement. Chinese writers often use absolute claims like "分红增长证明我们很强" instead of listing concrete, hedged factors.
items.when: When explaining strategic decisions like dividend increases in official financial reports.
items.slot: the […] increase to the regular dividend reflected confidence in our […], as well as progress of our initiatives to […].
swap: the 2025 hike to the regular dividend signaled confidence in our strong capital, liquidity and financial flexibility, plus progress of our efforts to boost earnings while expanding insurance premium revenues (more concise for press releases)

the 2025 increase to the regular dividend demonstrated confidence in our exceptional capital, liquidity and financial flexibility, as well as advancement of our projects to enhance earnings performance while increasing insurance premium revenues (slightly more formal for regulatory filings)

items.en: Total investments increased by 12% during 2025 on a fair value basis.
items.why: 中文常省略计量基础直接写“总投资增加了12%”，此处明确“on a fair value basis”避免歧义，符合专业报告的严谨性。
items.when: 财务报告中披露资产变动数据时使用。
items.slot: Total [investments] increased by […%] during […] on a [fair value basis].
swap: Total investments rose by 12% in 2025 measured at fair value（用rose替代increased，measured at更简洁，语气更正式）
Overall investments grew by 12% during 2025 based on fair value（grew更口语化，based on与on a...basis同义）

items.en: Net income rose by $101 million in 2025, compared with 2024
items.why: 用「rose by + 金额 + 时间 + compared with 时间」结构，清晰对比两年损益数据，比中国人常写的「net income increased 101 million from 2024 to 2025」更正式、符合财报英文规范，避免歧义。
items.when: 财报、审计报告中对比不同年度核心财务指标变动的场合。
items.slot: Net income rose by $[…] million in [year], compared with [prior year]
swap: Net income increased by $[…] million in [year], relative to [prior year]（语气更正式，适合监管文件）
Net income grew by $[…] million in [year], compared to [prior year]（更口语化，适合内部报告）

items.en: including a $44 million increase in net investment gains on an after-tax basis
items.why: 用「on an after-tax basis」明确金额计算口径，避免歧义，中国人常直接写「after-tax net investment gains」，但此处结构更清晰，适合财报说明调整项口径。
items.when: 财报中说明损益项目税后调整项的场合。
items.slot: including a $[…] million increase in [item] on an after-tax basis
swap: including a $[…] million after-tax increase in [item]（结构更紧凑，适合篇幅有限的报告）
with a $[…] million increase in [item] on an after-tax basis（语气更平缓，适合补充说明）

items.en: partially offset by a decrease in property casualty underwriting income of $62 million after taxes
items.why: 用「partially offset by」清晰表达两个损益项目的反向抵消关系，中国人常写「同时，承保收入减少」，不够简洁，适合财报说明损益抵消项。
items.when: 财报中说明损益项目被反向项目部分抵消的场合。
items.slot: partially offset by a [increase/decrease] in [item] of $[…] million after taxes
swap: partially countered by a [increase/decrease] in [item] of $[…] million after taxes（同义词替换，正式度一致）
partially offset by a $[…] million [increase/decrease] in after-tax [item]（结构更紧凑）

items.en: maintaining an adequate cushion against potential adverse events
items.why: 中文常直接表述为“应对潜在风险”，此写法用“adequate cushion”的具象化表达，更符合财经报告的专业严谨性，准确传递风险防护的储备属性。
items.when: 撰写公司资本或流动性管理的风险应对部分时套用。
items.slot: maintaining an adequate cushion against potential […] events
swap: holding a sufficient buffer against potential adverse scenarios（更侧重风险场景的覆盖）
maintaining an appropriate safety margin against potential negative events（更强调安全边际的属性）

items.en: the exercise of creditor rights, remediation, and in select cases, workouts of distressed credits
items.why: 用并列名词短语结构列举措施，替代中文常拆分的动词结构，更简洁凝练，符合SEC报告的正式表述风格。
items.when: 列举企业风险管理具体措施的正式报告中套用。
items.slot: [Action …], [Action …], and in select cases, [Action …]
swap: the enforcement of creditor rights, resolution, and occasionally, restructurings of troubled credits（偏向法律术语，语气更硬）
exercising creditor rights, fixing issues, and sometimes, restructuring distressed credits（更口语化，适合内部简报）

items.en: A description of risks that could cause our results to vary appears under "Risk Factors"
items.why: 采用正式的被动结构，清晰指引读者定位相关内容，符合SEC报告的规范；中文常写“风险描述见风险因素章节”，表述过于口语化，不够正式。
items.when: 在正式报告中指引读者查看其他章节的相关内容时套用。
items.slot: A description of […] appears under "[…]"
swap: Details of such risks are provided in the "Risk Factors" section（用details替代description，表述更简洁）
Information regarding relevant risks is located in the "Risk Factors" portion（用information替代description，located替代appears，表述更灵活）

items.en: See the section of this annual report entitled “Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations – Liquidity and Capital Resources.”
items.why: 中国人写正式报告引用章节常直接写“详见年报Item7”，此处用“See the section of this annual report entitled [完整标题]”更严谨，明确标注报告类型和章节正式标题，符合SEC合规文件规范，避免指代模糊。
items.when: 撰写SEC合规报告、年度报告或正式尽职调查文件时，引用内部章节内容的场合。
items.slot: See the section of this annual report entitled “[…]”.
swap: Refer to the corresponding section in this annual report titled “[…]” (用refer替代see，语气更书面正式，适合高阶合规文件)
Please consult the relevant section of this annual report named “[…]” (用consult强调查阅动作，适合审计场景，语气更主动)

items.en: Immediately following the closing of the Tralliance Purchase Transaction
items.why: 中文常写直白的时间状语，此处用正式介词短语结构，符合SEC报告的严谨性，避免口语化表达
items.when: 描述重大交易完成后的公司状态时使用
items.slot: Immediately following the closing of the […] Transaction
swap: Immediately after the completion of the Tralliance Purchase Transaction（语气更直接，适合简洁报告）
Upon the closing of the Tralliance Purchase Transaction（更简洁，适合正式文件）

items.en: no source of revenue other than under the “net revenue” earn-out arrangement with Tralliance Registry Management
items.why: 中文常写直白的主谓结构，此处用正式限定表述，明确收入来源边界，符合合规报告的严谨要求
items.when: 说明公司收入来源单一或受限的情况时使用
items.slot: no source of revenue other than under the “[…]” earn-out arrangement with […]
swap: no revenue sources except via the “net revenue” earn-out arrangement with Tralliance Registry Management（语气稍口语化，不适合正式报告）
no other revenue sources than those from the “net revenue” earn-out arrangement with Tralliance Registry Management（更强调来源具体性，略显冗余）

items.en: makes it difficult for investors to evaluate our future performance
items.why: 中文常写主动主谓结构，此处用形式主语结构，避免主观指代，更客观正式，适合审计报告
items.when: 描述公司业务状况对第三方评估的影响时使用
items.slot: makes it difficult for […] to evaluate our future performance
swap: renders it challenging for investors to assess our future performance（语气更正式，适合高端报告）
creates difficulty for investors to evaluate our future performance（更强调难度存在，略显生硬）

items.en: Such forward-looking statements should, therefore, be considered in light of
items.why: 中文常直接写“应考虑各类风险”，此处用“be considered in light of”更正式严谨，符合财务报告专业语气，插入语therefore衔接自然，避免生硬。
items.when: 撰写SEC filings、审计报告等正式合规文件，提及前瞻性陈述的风险提示时。
items.slot: Such forward-looking statements should, therefore, be considered in light of […]
swap: must be evaluated against […]（语气更强，强调必须评估，更具强制性）
shall be viewed in the context of […]（侧重结合具体背景，语气更柔和正式）

items.en: See "Item 1. Business—REIT Status" and notes 2 and 10 to our consolidated financial statements
items.why: 用See加具体章节和报表附注编号，规范清晰，中文常写“详见第1项业务中的REIT状态及合并财务报表附注2和10”，英文的格式完全符合SEC报告的正式引用规则，避免歧义。
items.when: 正式报告中引用其他章节或财务附注的场合
items.slot: See "Item […]" and notes […] to our consolidated financial statements
swap: Refer to "Item […]" and notes […] to our consolidated financial statements（Refer to更正式，适合书面指引）
Consult "Item […]" and notes […] to our consolidated financial statements（Consult语气更专业，适合尽职调查场景）

items.en: Approximately 56% and 71% of our towers are located in the 50 and 100 largest U.S. basic trading areas ("BTAs"), respectively.
items.why: 用respectively对应两组百分比和对应范围，避免重复表述，逻辑清晰简洁；中国人常直接分开写两组数据，易显冗余。
items.when: 列举两组一一对应的百分比或排名数据的正式报告场合
items.slot: Approximately […]% and […]% of our […] are located in the […] and […] largest U.S. […] areas ("[…]"), respectively.
swap: Roughly 56% and 71% of our towers are in the 50 and 100 largest U.S. basic trading areas, respectively.（更偏向口语化，正式报告用原写法更严谨）
About 56% and 71% of our towers are situated in the 50 and 100 largest U.S. basic trading areas, respectively.（situated比located稍书面化，原写法更通用）

items.en: We derive approximately 40% of our towers Adjusted Site Rental Gross Margin from towers located on land that we own, including through fee interests and perpetual easements, and we derive approximately 60% of our towers Adjusted Site Rental Gross Margin from towers located on land that we lease, sublease, manage or license.
items.why: 采用平行结构（We derive X% from A, and we derive X% from B），结构对称，可读性强；中国人常重复主语或换结构破坏平行，易显杂乱。
items.when: 正式报告中表述同一指标的不同来源占比的场合
items.slot: We derive approximately […]% of our towers Adjusted Site Rental Gross Margin from towers located on land that we […], including through […], and we derive approximately […]% of our towers Adjusted Site Rental Gross Margin from towers located on land that we […], […], […], or […].
swap: Roughly 40% of our towers Adjusted Site Rental Gross Margin comes from owned land towers, and roughly 60% comes from leased/subleased/managed/licensed land towers.（更简洁，原写法更正式）
About 40% of our towers Adjusted Site Rental Gross Margin is derived from owned land towers, and about 60% is derived from other land towers.（被动语态，原主动语态更符合报告写作的主动性）

items.en: weighted based on towers Adjusted Site Rental Gross Margin
items.why: 用过去分词短语作后置定语，简洁修饰前面的合同期限，避免冗余从句；中国人常写which is weighted based on...，更繁琐。
items.when: 正式报告中修饰数据计算权重的场合
items.slot: weighted based on […] Adjusted Site Rental Gross Margin
swap: which is weighted based on towers Adjusted Site Rental Gross Margin（定语从句，更口语化，原写法更简洁）
calculated with reference to towers Adjusted Site Rental Gross Margin（不同动词，原写法更贴合权重表述）

items.en: significant working relationships with tenants, municipalities, and landowners
items.why: 用significant替代常见的important，更符合正式报告的书面语风格，精准体现关系的重要性且不口语化，中国人常使用过于简单的important。
items.when: 撰写企业合作资源相关的正式报告内容时套用。
items.slot: significant working relationships with […]
swap: strong collaborative partnerships with（更强调协作属性，语气偏行动）
established working ties with（更强调已建立的状态，语气偏稳定）

items.en: We compete with other developers, owners, operators, and acquirers
items.why: 中国人写企业竞争相关英文常使用被动表述如“We face competition from”，此处用主动的“We compete with”更突出企业作为竞争主体的姿态，简洁专业，符合正式报告表述习惯
items.when: 撰写企业业务描述章节中涉及竞争主体的内容时
items.slot: We compete with other [developers, owners, operators, and acquirers of …]

swap.zh: 前者更主动贴合企业主体，后者偏被动，正式报告中前者更合适
前者更简洁，后者稍显冗余，专业度略逊

items.en: For a more extensive discussion of these factors
items.why: 用正式过渡短语引出更详细内容，比中国人常写的“If you want more details”更贴合SEC报告的书面语气，过渡自然专业
items.when: 正式报告中引导读者查看更详细内容的场合，如财报中指向风险因素章节的地方
items.slot: For a more extensive discussion of […]
swap: For a detailed discussion of these items（更简洁）
For further discussion of these factors（行业更常用的正式表达）

items.en: excluding the Tilden mine located in the Upper Peninsula of Michigan
items.why: 中文常直接表述为“不包括密歇根上半岛的Tilden矿”，"excluding"明确排除范围，后置位置定语清晰说明排除对象，避免范围歧义，符合正式报告范围界定规范
items.when: 正式报告中界定数据统计或预测的排除范围时使用
items.slot: excluding the […] located in the […]
swap: excluding […] situated in the […]（更书面化的位置表述）
excluding […] which is located in the […]（侧重定语从句的正式表述）

items.en: transferred 11 projects, which contain 2,109,000 square feet and had costs of $279,082,000 at the date of transfer
items.why: 用非限制性定语从句补充被转移项目的核心量化数据，避免句子冗长松散，信息层级清晰，中国人常直接用多个并列分句罗列数据，显得杂乱
items.when: 用于正式报告中，补充主体动作涉及对象的关键属性
items.slot: transferred […] projects, which contain […] and had costs of […] at the date of transfer
swap: transferred 11 projects including 2,109,000 square feet with costs of $279,082,000 at transfer（更紧凑，减少从句使用）
transferred 11 projects that have 2,109,000 square feet and costs of $279,082,000 on the transfer date（用限定性从句，语气更口语化）

items.en: began construction of a redevelopment project and six development projects
items.why: 用专业财经术语表达项目启动，比中国人常写的“started building”更精准契合财报语境，正式且专业
items.when: 用于正式财经报告中，描述建筑类项目的启动动作
items.slot: began construction of a […] project and […] projects
swap: commenced construction of a redevelopment project and six development projects（更正式，偏法律/监管报告风格）
launched construction of a redevelopment project and six development projects（稍口语化，偏向商业新闻报道）

items.en: See “ Item 1A. Risk Factors ” in this Annual Report for a discussion
items.why: 这是正式报告中标准的交叉引用写法，中国学习者常写模糊的“参见相关部分”，此写法明确标注章节和报告名称，精准清晰。
items.when: 在年度报告、合规文件等正式文本中引用特定章节时使用。
items.slot: See “ […] ” in this Annual Report for a discussion
swap: Refer to “ […] ” in this Annual Report for details（更简洁，正式度稍低）
For details on related content, see “ […] ” in this Annual Report（结构反转，更口语化）

items.en: may not be as effective at mitigating trading losses
items.why: 用“as effective at”的比较结构，清晰对比不同市场条件下策略的有效性，逻辑严谨，符合财经报告的准确性要求，中文常直接写“效果不如”，缺乏明确的比较框架
items.when: 用于正式报告中对比同一策略在不同条件下效果的场合
items.slot: [...] may not be as effective at mitigating [...] trading losses
swap: are less effective in reducing trading losses（less effective更直接，语气稍弱于原句的委婉性）
are not as efficient at curbing trading losses（efficient侧重效率，不如effective贴合效果层面）

items.en: require financial commitments to multilateral actions intended to support market stability
items.why: 用正式名词短语financial commitments和multilateral actions，代替口语化表达，符合SEC报告的专业措辞，中国人常使用简单直白的说法，不够正式。
items.when: 用于财务报告中描述机构需承担的与市场稳定相关的资金义务。
items.slot: require financial commitments to multilateral actions intended to […]
swap: necessitate financial obligations to collaborative measures designed to […]（necessitate比require更正式，obligations更侧重法律义务）
call for financial pledges to joint initiatives aimed at […]（pledges更侧重承诺，initiatives更侧重主动举措）

items.en: Cautionary Statements for Purposes of the “Safe Harbor” Provisions
items.why: 用“for purposes of”明确限定短语的适用目的，比单纯的“for”更严谨，符合监管文件精准界定范围的要求，中国人常直接用“for”，此处用法更精准
items.when: 撰写正式法律或监管相关的声明、条款时的场合
items.slot: […] for purposes of the “Safe Harbor” Provisions
swap: Cautionary Statements for the “Safe Harbor” Provisions（省略目的限定，不如原句精准）
Cautionary Statements with respect to the “Safe Harbor” Provisions（侧重关联而非目的，不如原句明确）

items.en: we have introduced AI tools to streamline certain high-volume office and administrative tasks
items.why: 用不定式（to streamline）明确引入工具的核心目的，比中文常直接罗列动作更简洁清晰，避免冗余，符合英文正式报告的表达习惯
items.when: 正式报告中介绍新举措、工具应用场景时使用
items.slot: we have introduced […] to streamline certain high-volume office and administrative tasks
swap: we have rolled out AI tools with the aim of streamlining certain high-volume office and administrative tasks
we have launched AI tools to help streamline certain high-volume office and administrative tasks

items.en: leading to an accumulation of excess local currency balances
items.why: 用现在分词作结果状语，比用“and”连接分句更简洁紧凑，逻辑关系更清晰，适合正式报告的因果表述
items.when: 描述某一行为导致的后续结果时
items.slot: leading to an accumulation of excess […] balances
swap: which leads to an accumulation of excess local currency balances（稍显冗长，不如原表达简洁）
resulting in excess local currency balances accumulating（结构不自然，不符合正式写作规范）

items.en: regulations, including environmental requirements, and changes in safety or other equipment standards
items.why: 用including补充说明法规的具体类型，比直接罗列更清晰，中国人常直接用逗号分隔或冗余的定语从句，显得啰嗦
items.when: 撰写合规相关的影响因素时套用
items.slot: regulations, including […] requirements, and changes in safety or other equipment standards
swap: regulations such as environmental requirements, and changes to safety or equipment standards（用such as替代including更简洁，to替代of更符合正式报告介词习惯）
rules including environmental requirements, and shifts in safety or equipment standards（rules比regulations更宽泛，shifts比changes更强调动态变化）

items.en: may be required to take our rigs out of service
items.why: 用被动语态加情态动词，既表可能性又显客观性，符合正式报告语气，中国人常直接用主动we may need to，不够正式
items.when: 撰写主体可能被要求采取的行动时套用
items.slot: may be required to take our […] out of service
swap: might be obliged to remove our […] from service（obliged比required更强调义务，remove比take out更正式）
could be mandated to put our […] out of service（mandated更强调官方强制，适合监管场景）

items.en: compared to $49,591 for the same period in 2024
items.why: 用“compared to”衔接同期数据对比，中性正式，逻辑清晰，中国人常直接写“vs 2024年的49591”，不够规范严谨。
items.when: 财务报告中不同会计期间核心数据对比时套用。
items.slot: compared to $[…] for the same period in […]
swap: versus $49,591 in the 2024 corresponding period：用“versus”但搭配的“corresponding period”略显冗余，正式度稍弱
as opposed to $49,591 for the same period in 2024：语气偏对立，不如原短语中性客观，不符合报告语气

items.en: There can be no assurance that financing will be available when needed, on favorable terms, or at all.
items.why: 这是正式报告常用的模糊限定表达，避免绝对化，比中国人常写的直白表述更符合英文监管文件的严谨正式语气。
items.when: 撰写SEC 10-K等正式英文报告、审计说明时，用于表达不确定性的表述。
items.slot: There can be no assurance that […] will be available when needed, on favorable terms, or at all.
swap: It is not guaranteed that financing will be accessible when required, on beneficial terms, or at all.（语气偏向日常陈述，不如原句正式严谨，不符合监管文件要求）
No assurance can be given that financing will be available when needed, on favorable terms, or at all.（语序调整后语气稍弱，原句更符合SEC报告惯用结构）

items.en: We expect to require significant additional capital to fund both our revenue-generating activities and our public benefit initiatives.
items.why: 用expect明确表达管理层的预期需求，比中国人常写的口语化“We need a lot of extra capital”更符合正式报告的客观专业语气，结构清晰。
items.when: 撰写公司年报、融资说明等正式英文报告时，用于表达资金需求的预期。
items.slot: We expect to require […] to fund both […] and […]
swap: We anticipate needing significant additional capital to finance both our revenue-generating activities and our public benefit initiatives.（anticipate更侧重预测，原句更侧重明确的需求必要性）
We expect to need significant additional capital to fund both our revenue-generating activities and our public benefit initiatives.（need语气稍弱，原句更强调需求的紧迫性）

items.en: steady operating results continued to be driven by
items.why: 用被动结构连接业绩与驱动因素，正式专业，符合报告语境；中国人常直接用主动句（如“our steady operating results continued because of”），语气生硬，不够严谨。
items.when: 撰写季度/年度业绩报告，描述核心业绩驱动因素的场合。
items.slot: [Our] steady operating results continued to be driven by […]
swap: Our steady operating results were driven by […]（缺少“continued”，弱化了业绩的延续性）
Our steady operating results remained driven by […]（用“remained”替代“continued”，语气更静态，缺乏动态感）

items.en: due to the record closings in the first quarter
items.why: 用due to引出变动的具体原因，结构紧凑专业，符合财报正式写作要求，中文常写“因为第一季度创纪录的成交”，英文用due to更简洁正式。
items.when: 用于财报中说明某项指标变动的具体原因。
items.slot: [...] decreased/increased [...] due to [specific reason]
swap: as a result of the record closings in the first quarter（更书面化，语气更正式）
because of the record closings in the first quarter（稍口语化，适合内部报告）

items.en: near-term payback and long-term residual cash flow upside
items.why: 该写法用对称时间维度修饰不同收益类型，“residual”体现剩余现金流、“upside”体现上行潜力，比中国人常写的“short-term payback and long-term cash flow”更具专业深度。
items.when: 描述投资回报的时间分布与类型时套用。
items.slot: […] and long-term residual cash flow upside
swap: near-term payback and long-term residual cash flow potential（potential更中性，适合保守表述）
short-term payback and long-term residual cash flow upside（short-term更直接，适合内部报告）
near-term payback and long-term residual cash flow upside potential（重复冗余，不如原句简洁）

items.en: at what management believes are attractive price points
items.why: 该写法通过“what management believes”限定主观判断，避免绝对化，符合SEC报告审慎合规要求，中国人常直接写“at attractive price points”，缺乏专业风险对冲意识。
items.when: 描述估值、定价等涉及主观判断的内容时套用。
items.slot: at what management believes are […] price points
swap: at what the company believes are attractive price points（用company代替management，范围更广）
at what we believe are attractive price points（用we更直接，适合内部报告）
at what analysts believe are attractive price points（用analysts增加第三方视角，增强客观性）

items.en: We intend to actively drill and develop select assets
items.why: 用“intend to actively”明确体现主动规划的动作，比中国人常写的“we will drill”更具计划性和主动性；“select assets”比“some assets”更精准专业，符合财经报告语境
items.when: 撰写企业未来业务规划类英文报告时套用
items.slot: We intend to actively drill and develop select […]
swap: We plan to proactively drill and develop chosen assets: plan比intend更侧重具体落地的计划，proactively比actively更强调前置主动的动作，chosen比select稍显口语化
We aim to actively drill and develop selected assets: aim比intend更侧重目标导向，selected和select语义接近但稍正式

items.en: See Item 1A - Risk Factors : Our Insurance Subsidiaries Must Comply With Extensive Government Regulations .
items.why: 中文常直白写“详见第1A项风险因素”，这里用SEC标准的章节引用格式，专业度高，避免引用歧义
items.when: 撰写正式报告中引用其他章节内容时
items.slot: See Item [X] - [Section Name] : […]
swap: Refer to Item [X] - [Section Name] : […] (refer to比see更正式，适合严谨的审计报告)
Please consult Item [X] - [Section Name] : […] (please consult语气更礼貌，适合非强制引用场景)

items.en: Depending on factors relating to our operations, the real estate industry and the macroeconomic environment
items.why: 中文常直接将影响因素放在句中或句末，用「受…影响」结构，此处用前置的「Depending on factors relating to…」符合英文正式报告逻辑，清晰限定后续结果的前提，避免主语模糊
items.when: 撰写正式财务报告或监管文件，需说明某事项受多种内外部因素制约的场合
items.slot: Depending on factors relating to […], [… may not be successful…]
swap: Subject to factors including […], […]
更正式，常用于监管类报告；
In light of factors related to […], […]
更侧重依据，适合说明决策前提

items.en: may result in increased claims, damage to our reputation or other material impacts on Stewart
items.why: 中文常直接用「会导致」表达确定结果，此处用「may result in」体现SEC报告要求的谨慎性，避免绝对化表述，符合风险披露规范
items.when: 正式报告中披露潜在风险或可能产生的非确定性结果的场合
items.slot: may result in […, … or other material impacts on […]
swap: could lead to […, … or other material impacts on […]
语气比may稍弱，适合风险程度较低的表述；
might give rise to […, … or other material impacts on […]
更正式，常用于涉及法律或声誉的风险表述

items.en: if we are unable to effectively use technology to address regulatory changes and increase productivity
items.why: 用正式的“be unable to”表达能力不足，“address”对应专业的“处理”监管变化，“increase productivity”是财务常用表述，结构清晰符合SEC风险披露要求，中文常写得更口语化，此表述更严谨。
items.when: 撰写财务报告中描述业务风险或挑战的条件场合。
items.slot: if we are unable to effectively use […] to address regulatory changes and increase productivity
swap: if we fail to effectively utilize technology to handle regulatory shifts and boost productivity（fail to比be unable to更主动，utilize比use更正式，shifts比changes更具动态性）
if we cannot effectively employ technology to tackle regulatory alterations and raise efficiency（cannot更口语化，tackle比address更随意，alterations正式度略低）

items.en: compared to $5,168,607, (8.4% of sales) for fiscal year 2024
items.why: 中文常直接罗列不同年份数据，此处用"compared to"衔接对比年份，清晰区分不同期间数据，符合英文报告的对比逻辑，避免混淆
items.when: 财务报告中对比不同会计期间的财务数据时套用
items.slot: compared to $[…], ([…] of sales) for fiscal year […]
swap: versus $[…], ([…] of sales) for fiscal year […]
"versus"更简洁，常用于正式报告的对比表述
in contrast to $[…], ([…] of sales) for fiscal year […]
"in contrast to"语气更强，突出数据间的差异

items.en: The increase is primarily due to bonuses paid during the year ended May 31, 2025.
items.why: 中文常直接写"增长主要是由于支付了奖金"，此处用"primarily due to"明确核心原因，用过去分词短语修饰时间，简洁准确，避免冗余从句
items.when: 财务报告中说明财务数据变动的主要原因时套用
items.slot: The increase is primarily due to […] during the year ended […].
swap: The increase is mainly attributable to […] in the period ended […].
"attributable to"更正式，常用于审计类报告
The rise is primarily caused by […] during the year ending […].
"caused by"稍口语化，适合内部报告场景

items.en: estimates are used for, but not limited to
items.why: 这个写法用“for, but not limited to”清晰界定了估算的核心用途与范围边界，既点明主要应用场景，又避免列举不全的问题，中国人常直接用“such as”或仅列部分项目，显得不够严谨，不符合正式报告的规范。
items.when: 正式财务报告、审计说明等需要严谨界定事项范围的场合
items.slot: […] are used for, but not limited to, […]
swap: are utilized for, but not limited to（utilized比used更正式，适合高阶官方报告）
are applied in, but not restricted to（restricted比limited语气稍强，侧重限定程度）

items.en: The various estimates and assumptions taken into account include
items.why: 这个写法用“various”明确了涉及的估算与假设的数量，“taken into account”清晰说明其被纳入考量的状态，比中国人常写的“some estimates and assumptions”更具体严谨，避免模糊表述。
items.when: 正式报告中说明涉及的因素、假设等内容的场合
items.slot: The various [estimates/ key factors/ assumptions] taken into account include […]
swap: The numerous estimates and assumptions taken into consideration include（numerous比various更侧重数量多，语气稍重）
The different estimates and assumptions considered include（considered比taken into account更简洁，适合较短段落）

items.en: The Company derives its revenue from several sources.
items.why: 用derive...from...清晰点明收入来源，比中文直接写“公司收入来自几个来源”更正式专业，符合财报语境，避免口语化。
items.when: 撰写财报或公开业务报告介绍收入构成的开篇时套用。
items.slot: The Company derives its revenue from […] sources.
swap: The Company generates its revenue from multiple sources.（generate更侧重主动创造营收，比derive多一层价值创造意味）
The Company obtains its revenue from a number of sources.（obtain更偏向被动获取，语气稍弱，适合保守表述）

items.en: Revenue from fixed-fee arrangements is recognized over time as performance obligations are satisfied
items.why: 用被动语态避免主观主语，符合财经报告的客观性，中国人常写主动句如“We recognize revenue...”过于主观
items.when: 撰写收入确认相关的专业报告
items.slot: Revenue from […] arrangements is recognized over time as performance obligations are satisfied
swap: Revenue from fixed-fee arrangements is recognized over time when performance obligations are satisfied（用when替代as，语气更绝对，适合明确规则类表述）
Fixed-fee arrangement revenue is recognized over time as performance obligations are satisfied（名词前置更简洁，适合摘要或标题类表述）

items.en: measures progress toward completion using either an input method
items.why: 用either...or...清晰列举两种方法，逻辑严谨无歧义，中国人常写“uses input method or output method”未用either，表述松散
items.when: 描述计量进度的方法选择场景
items.slot: measures progress toward completion using either an […] method
swap: measures progress toward completion by applying either an input method（用applying替代using，更强调动作流程，适合操作说明）
calculates progress toward completion via either an input method（用calculates替代measures，更贴合数值计算场景）

items.en: Changes in laws governing beverage containers and packaging
items.why: 用现在分词“governing”后置修饰“laws”，正式紧凑，符合英文正式报告的修饰习惯，中文常直接用“关于XX的法律”，不如英文结构专业严谨
items.when: 撰写行业监管政策变动相关的正式报告（如10-K、年报）时使用
items.slot: Changes in laws governing […] and […]
swap: Alterations to regulations governing beverage containers and packaging：“Alterations”更强调变更幅度，“regulations”更侧重行业具体规定，适合强调政策调整力度的场合
Shifts in statutes governing beverage containers and packaging：“Shifts”更侧重变化趋势，“statutes”更侧重法定条文，适合分析长期政策走向的场合

items.en: including deposit schemes, recycling mandates, recycled content requirements, ecotaxes, product stewardship obligations, PFAS restrictions, and prohibitions on certain plastics
items.why: 用平行名词短语列举具体措施，结构清晰正式，中文罗列易松散，英文平行结构更显专业
items.when: 列举监管相关具体条款或措施时使用
items.slot: including […], […], […], and […]
swap: such as deposit schemes, recycling mandates, recycled content requirements, ecotaxes, product stewardship obligations, PFAS restrictions, and prohibitions on certain plastics：“such as”侧重举例而非全部，适合列举部分措施
like deposit schemes, recycling mandates, recycled content requirements, ecotaxes, product stewardship obligations, PFAS restrictions, and prohibitions on certain plastics：“like”更口语化，仅适合非正式报告场景

items.en: may increase costs and require modifications to manufacturing, packaging, or distribution
items.why: 用“may”表可能性，并列两个动作结构对称，正式准确，中文常分开表述，英文紧凑且逻辑清晰
items.when: 分析监管措施带来的潜在业务影响时使用
items.slot: may increase costs and require modifications to […], […], or […]
swap: might drive up costs and necessitate adjustments to manufacturing, packaging, or distribution：“might”语气稍弱，“drive up”更口语化，“necessitate”更正式，适合严肃报告
could raise costs and call for changes to manufacturing, packaging, or distribution：“could”可能性稍强，“raise”更简洁，“call for”更主动，适合强调行动必要性的场合

items.en: meaning we are owned by our customers, whom we call members.
items.why: 用插入语直接解释机构属性，正式报告简洁明了，中国人常使用“that is to say”或拆分句子，显得繁琐
items.when: 正式报告中定义机构性质或术语的场合
items.slot: meaning we are owned by our customers, whom we call […].

swap.en: which means we are owned by our customers, referred to as […].
swap.zh: 用定语从句替换插入语，语气稍正式但句子更长

swap.en: in other words, we are owned by our customers, whom we call […].
swap.zh: 用短语开头，更口语化，适合较轻松的正式语境

items.en: eligible housing associates in Alaska, Hawaii, Idaho, Iowa, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, North Dakota, Oregon, South Dakota, Utah, Washington, Wyoming, and the U.S. Pacific territories of American Samoa, Guam, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.
items.why: 用完整列举法清晰界定服务覆盖范围，正式报告避免模糊，中国人常使用“相关地区”等模糊表述，不够精准
items.when: 正式报告中明确业务覆盖范围的场合
items.slot: eligible housing associates in […], […], […], and […], and the U.S. Pacific territories of […], […], and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.

swap.en: eligible housing associates located in the following regions: Alaska, Hawaii, Idaho, Iowa, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, North Dakota, Oregon, South Dakota, Utah, Washington, Wyoming, and the U.S. Pacific territories of American Samoa, Guam, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.
swap.zh: 用冒号引出列举，结构更清晰但稍显冗长

swap.en: eligible housing associates in Alaska, Hawaii, Idaho, Iowa, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, North Dakota, Oregon, South Dakota, Utah, Washington, Wyoming, and the U.S. Pacific territories (American Samoa, Guam, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands).
swap.zh: 用括号简化附属地区，表达更紧凑

items.en: Commercial banks, savings institutions, credit unions, insurance companies, and CDFIs may apply for membership.
items.why: 用并列列举清晰说明申请主体，正式报告逻辑清晰，中国人常使用“各类金融机构等”的模糊表述，不够具体
items.when: 正式报告中说明申请或参与主体的场合
items.slot: […], […], […], […], and […], may apply for membership.

swap.en: Entities including commercial banks, savings institutions, credit unions, insurance companies, and CDFIs are eligible to apply for membership.
swap.zh: 用概括性开头，更简洁但稍欠精准

swap.en: Commercial banks, savings institutions, credit unions, insurance companies, and CDFIs are permitted to apply for membership.

items.en: refer to the “ Affordable Housing and Community Investment ” section of Item 1
items.why: 用正式指引表述（refer to）替代直白的‘看’，符合SEC报告的规范；中国人常写‘请看第1项里的…部分’，不够简洁专业
items.when: 用于正式报告中指引读者查阅特定章节的场合
items.slot: refer to the “[…]” section of Item […]
swap: see the “ Affordable Housing and Community Investment ” section of Item 1（更口语化，适合非正式文档）
consult the “ Affordable Housing and Community Investment ” section of Item 1（偏向咨询，贴合度略低）

items.en: We are subject to laws, rules and regulations
items.why: 用"be subject to"准确表达受监管约束的中性状态，比中文常直译的"我们受...管辖"更符合英文正式报告的规范语气，避免主观化表述
items.when: 用于正式报告中说明主体适用的法律法规约束场景
items.slot: [...] are subject to laws, rules and regulations of [operating jurisdictions]
swap: We must comply with laws, rules and regulations (语气偏向主动合规，不如原句中性正式)
We are governed by laws, rules and regulations (语气偏行政管辖，不如原句贴合企业合规语境)

items.en: We regularly conduct risk assessments of our human capital needs.
items.why: 用“conduct risk assessments”比中式常用的“do risk assessments”更正式专业，符合SEC报告的严谨语境，且“regularly”明确评估频率，避免模糊表述。
items.when: 用于企业定期评估人力、财务等核心资源风险的正式报告场景。
items.slot: We regularly conduct risk assessments of our […] needs.
swap: We routinely perform risk assessments of our […] needs. （“routinely”侧重按流程常规执行，“perform”与“conduct”同义，语气稍弱）
We regularly carry out risk assessments for our […] needs. （“carry out”更口语化，不如“conduct”正式）

items.en: an expected shortage of trade professionals in the future
items.why: 用“expected shortage”明确是预期的未来情况，比中式的“will have less trade professionals”更正式严谨，符合风险披露的专业要求，清晰界定风险性质。
items.when: 用于企业披露未来可能面临的特定人才/资源短缺风险的正式报告场景。
items.slot: an expected shortage of […] in the future
swap: a projected shortage of […] in the future （“projected”侧重基于数据预测，语气更客观）
a foreseen shortage of […] in the future （“foreseen”更侧重预先察觉，不如“expected”通用）

items.en: Our debt is not backed by the U.S. government, but it does represent the joint and several obligation of the 11 FHLBanks.
items.why: 用“does”强调转折后的核心事实，既明确债务非政府担保属性，又清晰说明法律责任，比中国人常写的直白转折更严谨、有说服力。
items.when: 撰写金融机构债务属性说明的正式报告内容时套用。
items.slot: Our debt is not backed by the [U.S. government], but it does represent the joint and several obligation of the […FHLBanks].
swap: Our debt is not backed by the U.S. government, but it represents the joint and several obligation of the 11 FHLBanks.（去掉“does”后语气平实，正式性稍弱）
Our debt is not backed by the U.S. government; instead, it stands as the joint and several obligation of the 11 FHLBanks.（用分号替代but，结构更紧凑，书面感更强）

items.en: impact our results of operations, financial condition, and future prospects
items.why: 该写法用三个平行的专业财务术语并列，精准规范，符合SEC报告的正式语境；中国人写英文报告常并列结构不平行或用词零散，缺乏专业感。
items.when: 撰写财务报告或尽职调查的英文分析，描述因素对多维度财务指标的影响时使用。
items.slot: impact our results of operations, [financial metric …], and future prospects
swap: affect our operating results, financial position, and outlook（语气稍弱，用词更口语化，不如原写法正式专业）
influence our operating performance, financial status, and future outlook（用词不够精准，不符合SEC报告的标准术语）

items.en: specifically in the development of Android and iOS apps for mobile devices
items.why: 中文写英文报告时常直接用“focusing on Android and iOS app development”，此处用“specifically in the development of”更正式严谨，明确细分业务领域，符合SEC报告的正式性要求，避免表述模糊
items.when: 撰写正式行业业务范围说明的报告时套用
items.slot: specifically in the development of […] apps for mobile devices
swap: more specifically, focusing on the development of: 语气更侧重业务聚焦，适合强调核心业务时使用
specifically engaged in the development of: 更强调主体参与该业务，适合明确责任主体时使用

items.en: from around 200,000 in 2011 to around 1.6 million in 2015
items.why: 中文写英文报告时常直接用“from 200,000 in 2011 to 1.6 million in 2015”，此处加“around”体现数据近似性，符合SEC报告对数据表述的严谨性，避免绝对化误差
items.when: 撰写行业数据变化趋势的正式报告时套用
items.slot: from around […] in […] to around […] in […]
swap: approximately […] in […] through approximately […] in […]: 更正式的近似表述，适合监管报告场景
roughly […] in […] up to roughly […] in […]: 语气稍口语化，适合非监管类行业分析报告

items.en: The Google Play Store and Apple’s App Store are generally referred to herein as an “App Store”.
items.why: 中文写英文报告时常直接用“we call them App Store”，此处用“are generally referred to herein as”更正式规范，符合SEC报告的术语定义要求，明确术语指代，避免后续表述歧义
items.when: 在正式报告中定义缩写或统一术语指代时套用
items.slot: The […] and […] are generally referred to herein as an “[…]”.
swap: […] and […] will hereinafter be referred to collectively as “[…]”: 更强调后续统一使用该术语，语气更正式
[…] and […] are collectively called “[…]” in this document: 语气较随意，适合内部报告场景

items.en: in accordance with our risk profile and business size
items.why: 用正式介词短语明确动作依据，比中国人常用的口语化“according to”更严谨，精准对应自身风险轮廓与业务规模，避免模糊表述
items.when: 正式报告中说明措施制定依据的场合
items.slot: in accordance with our […] and […]
swap: pursuant to our risk profile and business size（更具法定合规属性，适合法律相关报告）
consistent with our risk profile and business size（侧重内部一致性，语气稍弱）

items.en: in the event of a cybersecurity threat or incident
items.why: 用正式表达替代中国人常写的口语化“when there is”，明确指代潜在特定风险事件，符合官方报告的严谨性
items.when: 报告中说明应对特定风险场景的场合
items.slot: in the event of a […] or […]
swap: in case of a cybersecurity threat or incident（更偏向日常场景，正式度稍低）
upon occurrence of a cybersecurity threat or incident（侧重事件发生后的即时性，语气更正式）

items.en: Expenditures related to corporate overhead and other related items are expensed
items.why: 用被动语态符合正式报告的客观性，related to精准限定支出范围，比中国人常用的冗长定语从句（如expenditures which are related to...）更简洁紧凑，避免重复表述
items.when: 用于正式财务报告中说明特定支出的会计处理（费用化）的场合
items.slot: Expenditures related to […] and other related items are expensed
swap: Expenditures pertaining to corporate overhead and other related items are expensed （pertaining to比related to更正式，多用于法律/财务文书）
Expenditures associated with corporate overhead and other related items are expensed （associated with语气宽泛，精准度低于related to）

items.en: The Company intends to evaluate and explore all available strategic options
items.why: 中文写作常使用单一动词描述动作，此处用「evaluate and explore」两个并列动词，全面体现对战略选项的深度考量，避免表述单薄，中国人常单写「evaluate」，未体现「探索」的动作维度
items.when: 用于撰写公司战略规划、业务布局类的英文报告（如SEC filings、年报）
items.slot: The Company intends to evaluate and explore all available strategic options for […]
swap: plans to assess and examine every possible strategic alternative（用「plans」替代「intends」更具确定性，「assess and examine」与「evaluate and explore」同义，「strategic alternative」与「strategic options」同义，语气更正式）
will consider and investigate all feasible strategic choices（用「will」替代「intends」更强调执行力，「consider and investigate」更侧重过程，「feasible」比「available」更突出可行性）

items.en: consistent with the preservation of principal, maintenance of liquidity and avoidance of speculation
items.why: 中文写作常使用零散的动词短语表述原则，此处用三个平行的名词短语，结构对称简洁，体现财经报告的严谨性，中国人常写动词短语，不够凝练
items.when: 用于撰写公司投资策略、资金管理类的英文报告
items.slot: consistent with the preservation of principal, maintenance of liquidity and avoidance of speculation for […]
swap: in line with the safeguarding of principal, upholding of liquidity and refraining from speculation（「in line with」与「consistent with」同义，「safeguarding」等词与原词近义，语气更正式）
aligned with the protection of principal, retention of liquidity and steering clear of speculation（「aligned with」更侧重一致性，「steering clear of」更口语化，正式报告用「avoidance of」更合适）

items.en: in conformity with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America
items.why: 该表述用正式介词短语“in conformity with”替代中式常用的“according to”，更契合美国SEC报告的专业正式语气，精准传达“合规遵循”的含义，比中式直译的“according to”更严谨专业。
items.when: 撰写美国SEC filings或正式财务报告中关于遵循会计准则的表述时使用。
items.slot: in conformity with accounting principles generally accepted in […]
swap: pursuant to accounting standards generally recognized in the United States: 用“pursuant to”替代“in conformity with”，语气更偏向“依据标准条款”，适合强调遵循标准法律属性的场景
in accordance with U.S. GAAP: 用缩写“U.S. GAAP”替代完整表述，更简洁，适合面向熟悉行业缩写的受众

items.en: Deferred tax assets and liabilities are recognized for
items.why: 用被动语态符合正式报告的客观性，中国人常直接写主动表述，不够正式严谨
items.when: 正式财务报告中确认资产负债类项目的依据时套用
items.slot: Deferred tax assets and liabilities are recognized for […]
swap: Deferred tax assets and liabilities shall be recognized for […]（shall更强调准则要求，语气更正式）
Deferred tax assets and liabilities are recorded for […]（recorded更侧重记录动作，语气稍弱）

items.en: using enacted tax rates in effect for the year
items.why: 用“in effect”明确税率的生效状态，避免歧义，中国人常省略这类限定词，表述不够精准
items.when: 财务报告中计量相关项目时涉及生效规则时套用
items.slot: using enacted tax rates in effect for the […]
swap: using enacted tax rates applicable to the […]（applicable更侧重适用范围，语气不同）
using enacted tax rates currently in effect for the […]（加currently更强调当前有效，语气更即时）

items.en: is recognized in income in the period that includes
items.why: 用定语从句明确期间范围，结构清晰，中国人常直接写更混乱的表述，逻辑不够明确
items.when: 财务报告中确认损益变动的期间时套用
items.slot: […] is recognized in income in the period that includes […]
swap: […] is recorded in income in the period that includes […]（recorded更侧重记录而非确认，语气不同）
[…] is recognized in profit or loss in the period that includes […]（profit or loss更侧重损益整体，适用范围更广）

items.en: have increased by an annual average of 1.27% per year
items.why: 用“annual average”精准限定增长的时间维度，中国人常直接写“increased by 1.27% per year”，缺少平均属性的限定，表述不够严谨，不符合专业报告的精准要求。
items.when: 财务尽职调查或审计报告中描述指标的年度平均增长情况时套用。
items.slot: have increased by an annual average of […]% per year
swap: have grown at an annual average rate of […]% per year（更正式的量化表达，侧重增长率的属性）
have seen an annual average increase of […]% per year（更被动的表述，适合非主语主导的语境）

items.en: net proceeds of approximately $1.44 billion after transaction costs
items.why: 精准界定财务指标的调整范围，避免歧义；中国人常直接写“约14.4亿美元”，未明确扣除项，易引发误解。
items.when: 撰写财务交易相关的收益、款项表述时套用。
items.slot: net proceeds of approximately […] billion after transaction costs
swap: net proceeds of roughly $1.44 billion net of transaction costs（net of比after更正式，适合监管报告，语气更严谨）
net proceeds of approximately $1.44b after transaction fees（fees侧重费用类，语气稍弱，适合内部报告）

items.en: Refer to Note 19. Discontinued Operations, of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements
items.why: 是专业报告标准的交叉引用格式，清晰指引读者查阅对应内容；中国人常写“please see the relevant note”，表述模糊，不符合监管报告规范。
items.when: 撰写年度报告、审计报告等专业文档需交叉引用附注内容时套用。
items.slot: Refer to Note […]. […], of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements
swap: Please refer to Note 19, Discontinued Operations, within the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements（更口语化，适合非正式报告，语气稍随意）
See Note 19 (Discontinued Operations) in the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements（更简洁，适合内部报告，省略冗余介词）

items.en: put in place additional mechanisms ensuring compliance with
items.why: “put in place + 机制”是正式书面语，用于表达建立合规措施，中国人常写“set up”，但“put in place”更强调措施的落地执行，更适合官方报告。
items.when: 用于描述为满足合规要求建立相关措施的场景。
items.slot: put in place additional mechanisms ensuring compliance with […]
swap: implement additional measures to comply with […]（“implement”侧重执行，“measures”比“mechanisms”更侧重具体动作）
establish extra mechanisms for compliance with […]（“establish”更强调初始建立，语气稍弱于“put in place”）

items.en: We believe we are a financially disciplined company
items.why: 用“We believe”弱化绝对表述，符合正式报告的审慎语气，中国人常直接写“We are a financially disciplined company”，过于绝对。
items.when: 写公司自我评价、业务定位的正式报告场合
items.slot: We believe we are a financially disciplined […] company
swap: We consider ourselves a financially disciplined company（更侧重自我认知，语气稍正式）
We view ourselves as a financially disciplined company（用view替换believe，视角更客观）

items.en: We seek to meet our risk-adjusted return objectives
items.why: 中文常直接写“我们要实现风险调整后回报目标”，用seek比want更正式专业，符合SEC报告的严谨语境，避免口语化
items.when: 撰写公司战略目标、业务规划的正式英文报告场合
items.slot: We seek to meet our […] objectives
swap: We aim to achieve our […] objectives（更直接，适合内部报告）
We endeavor to meet our […] objectives（更强调主动投入，适合对外正式报告）

items.en: continuing to hedge significant market risks associated with our existing annuity products
items.why: 中文常写“继续规避现有年金产品的重大市场风险”，用专业术语hedge（对冲）更精准，associated with比related to更正式，符合审计报告的专业表述
items.when: 撰写公司风险管理策略、措施的正式英文报告场合
items.slot: continuing to hedge significant market risks associated with our existing […] products
swap: maintaining hedges for significant market risks linked to our existing […] products（用名词hedges更简洁，适合摘要）
continuing to mitigate major market risks related to our current […] products（mitigate不如hedge专业，不够精准）

items.en: See Note 13 of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements
items.why: SEC报告中标准的交叉引用写法，清晰明确，比中国人常直译的“详见合并财务报表附注13”更规范专业，符合监管报告的格式要求
items.when: 在正式财务报告中引用附注或其他章节内容的场合
items.slot: See Note […] of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements
swap: Refer to Note 13 of the Consolidated Financial Statements’ Notes（refer to比see更正式，结构调整）
Please see Note 13 in the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements（增加please，语气更礼貌，适合面向读者的说明）

items.en: strive to optimize revenues by focusing on revenue management
items.why: 用by引导方式状语直接说明目标实现路径，避免冗余从句，中国人常写原因状语从句，此结构更简洁专业
items.when: 用于正式报告说明实现目标具体举措的场合
items.slot: strive to optimize […] by focusing on […]
swap: aim to optimize revenues via focusing on revenue management（用via替代by，更正式书面）
seek to optimize revenues through focusing on revenue management（用seek替代strive，更侧重主动尝试）

items.en: Other than four owned hotels, we currently do not manage our owned hotels
items.why: 用Other than开头明确例外情况，严谨规范，中国人常使用Except for，此表达更符合美式正式报告的专业语气
items.when: 用于正式报告说明例外情况的场合
items.slot: Other than […] , we currently do not […] our […]
swap: Except for four owned hotels, we currently do not manage our owned hotels（更通用，语气稍平实）
With the exception of four owned hotels, we currently do not manage our owned hotels（更书面正式，适合严谨报告）

items.en: Earnings drivers include RevPAR increases, unit growth, and royalty rate improvement.
items.why: 用名词短语直接点明盈利驱动核心，列举采用简洁名词结构，比中国人常用的“Earnings are driven by...”更正式简洁，契合财报写作的严谨性要求。
items.when: 用于财务报告中说明盈利驱动因素的章节
items.slot: Earnings drivers include […], […], and […].
swap: Key drivers of earnings include […], […], and […]. （更正式，适配SEC filings等顶级正式报告语境）
Factors driving earnings growth include […], […], and […]. （更侧重增长维度，适合强调业绩增长的分析）

items.en: Franchisors enjoy significant operating leverage in their business model
items.why: 用拟人化动词“enjoy”赋予商业模式优势更生动的表达，比中国人常用的“have”更具画面感，同时保持正式性，避免生硬表述。
items.when: 用于分析商业模式优势的部分
items.slot: […] enjoy significant operating leverage in their business model.
swap: Franchisors benefit from significant operating leverage in their business model. （更侧重“受益于”的逻辑，贴合业务实际）
Franchisors possess significant operating leverage within their business model. （更正式，适合书面报告的严谨表达）

items.en: which aids in reducing the impact of lodging industry economic cycles
items.why: 用“aids in reducing”这一正式动词短语表达积极作用，比中国人常用的“helps reduce”更符合SEC报告的正式语气，避免口语化。
items.when: 用于描述某举措带来的积极结果或缓解影响的部分
items.slot: […] which aids in reducing the impact of […][…].
swap: […] which helps mitigate the impact of […][…]. （“mitigate”更专业，适合财务风险相关的表述）
[…] which assists in lessening the impact of […][…]. （“assists”语气更温和，适合描述间接影响）

items.en: such as the Federal National Mortgage Association ("Fannie Mae")
items.why: 用“such as + 全称（缩写）”的格式举例，正式清晰，适合首次提及机构时的举例，中文常写“比如美国联邦国民抵押贷款协会（房利美）”，英文格式更规范，符合SEC报告要求
items.when: 撰写报告中举例说明具体机构或主体时使用
items.slot: such as the […] ("[…]"
swap: including the Federal National Mortgage Association (Fannie Mae)（including语气更弱，用于列举部分对象）
for example, the Federal National Mortgage Association (Fannie Mae)（for example更侧重单个例子，适合强调时）

items.en: Asset selection is a central component of our overall investment approach.
items.why: 中国人可能写成‘Asset selection is very important for our investment approach’，但 central component 将重要性具体化为整体中的核心部件，比单纯的 important 更精确，且用名词 component 更易衔接后续技术讨论。
items.when: 在尽职调查报告或投资分析中，说明某项工作或因素是全局策略的核心构成时。
items.slot: [...] is a central component of our overall [...] approach.
swap: is a key element of (但 key element 不如 central component 强调居于中心地位且搭配正式)
plays a central role in (侧重功能而非结构组成，且需改写句子)
is at the heart of (比喻用法，不如 component 正式具体)

items.en: Our investments consist predominantly of Agency RMBS which, in addition to carrying a GSE or U.S. Government guarantee against loss of principal, are considered a cornerstone of the U.S. financial system.
items.why: 中国学习者往往拆成简单句，如‘Our investments are mostly Agency RMBS. They carry a guarantee…’，而原文用 which 从句嵌套 in addition to carrying… 插入语，信息高度整合，尤其是 in addition to carrying 点出附带特征且不打断主谓搭配，逻辑紧凑。
items.when: 投资组合描述中，需一句话说清构成、附加属性与市场地位时，例如描述资产类型及其特殊保障。
items.slot: [Our/Their] investments consist predominantly of [...] which, in addition to [动名词短语], are considered a cornerstone of [...].
swap: comprise mainly (但 predominantly 更正式，且与 consist of 搭配严谨)
are viewed as a foundation of (foundation 不如 cornerstone 形象有力，后者特指‘基石’)
play a fundamental role in (需改变结构，且无法直接点出‘基石’地位)

items.en: All forward-looking statements are subject to risks, uncertainties and assumptions
items.why: 用“are subject to”清晰表述前瞻性声明受各类不确定因素约束，英文正式报告常用该结构，中国人常直接写“have risks”等不严谨表述
items.when: 撰写正式报告中关于前瞻性内容的约束条件时套用
items.slot: All forward-looking statements are subject to […].
swap: All forward-looking statements are governed by risks, uncertainties and assumptions. 更强调受规则/因素支配
All forward-looking statements involve risks, uncertainties and assumptions. 更突出内在包含性

items.en: could cause our actual results to differ materially from those expressed in or implied by these forward-looking statements
items.why: 用委婉情态“could”和精准表述“differ materially”平衡风险表述，既不绝对也不模糊，中国人常直接写“will differ”或“differ”太绝对或太笼统
items.when: 撰写正式报告中风险影响的具体表述时套用
items.slot: could cause our actual results to differ materially from those […].
swap: may cause our actual results to differ materially from those expressed in or implied by these forward-looking statements. 语气更委婉
might cause our actual results to differ materially from those expressed in or implied by these forward-looking statements. 语气更弱，更显谨慎

items.en: We track "Propane sales volumes," "Revenues – Propane and other gas liquids sales" and "Gross Margin – Propane and other gas liquids sales" by customer
items.why: 该写法清晰罗列具体追踪的财务指标，同时明确维度，中文常省略指标罗列或维度表述，逻辑更严谨，符合专业报告要求
items.when: 财务尽职调查或审计报告中，说明按特定维度拆分追踪财务指标的场景
swap: We monitor "Propane sales volumes," "Revenues – Propane and other gas liquids sales" and "Gross Margin – Propane and other gas liquids sales" by customer（monitor与track同义，语气更正式，适合更严谨的报告）
We track "Propane sales volumes," "Revenues – Propane and other gas liquids sales" and "Gross Margin – Propane and other gas liquids sales" per customer（per比by更侧重按单位划分，适合细分维度的场景）

items.en: The wholesale propane price per gallon is subject to various market conditions
items.why: 用“be subject to”正式表述指标受外部因素约束，中文常直接用“受...影响”，缺少商务报告的正式性，符合SEC等监管报告的措辞要求
items.when: 财务报告中说明价格、成本等指标受外部市场因素影响的场景
items.slot: The wholesale […] price per gallon is subject to various market conditions
swap: The wholesale […] price per gallon is exposed to various market conditions（exposed to更侧重暴露于风险，适合风险相关的报告场景）
The wholesale […] price per gallon is affected by various market conditions（affected by更口语化，适合内部报告而非监管报告）

items.en: propane prices tend to correlate with the fluctuations of these underlying commodities
items.why: 用“tend to correlate with”委婉体现趋势性，“underlying”明确大宗商品的基础属性，中文常直接说“丙烷价格与大宗商品波动相关”，缺少趋势性和属性说明，更严谨
items.when: 财务报告中说明价格与其他大宗商品相关性的场景
items.slot: [...] prices tend to correlate with the fluctuations of these underlying commodities
swap: propane prices tend to be correlated with the fluctuations of these underlying commodities（被动语态更正式，适合监管报告）
propane prices generally correlate with the fluctuations of these underlying commodities（generally比tend to更肯定，适合确定性较强的分析）

items.en: While forward-looking statements reflect our good faith beliefs
items.why: 用“reflect our good faith beliefs”（反映我们的善意信念）代替直接断言，显得客观且留有余地。中国起草者容易写成“We believe that...”或直接陈述，缺乏法律文件所需的谨慎语气。
items.when: 在报告中引述公司管理层的预测或展望时，需要提示这些仅为管理层看法而非事实保证。
items.slot: While […] reflect our good faith beliefs
swap: “are based on our current expectations and beliefs” – 语气更正式，明确基于当前预期，但弱化了“善意”。
“represent management's current views” – 强调仅是管理层当前观点，更直接地免责。
“we believe that...” – 中国人常用，但过于主观，法律文书中应避免使用第一人称断言。

items.en: For a further discussion of these and other factors that could impact our future results, performance or transactions, see the section entitled “Item 1A. Risk Factors.”
items.why: 用“see the section entitled...”规范地指引读者，避免口语化。中国财务人员容易写成“Please refer to the section 'Risk Factors'”，不够正式严谨。
items.when: 在报告中需要指引读者查阅其他章节以获取详细信息时。
items.slot: For a further discussion of […] that could impact our […], see the section entitled “[…].”
swap: “Please refer to the Risk Factors section for more details.” – 更直接，但不如原文有“进一步讨论”的层次。
“Additional information can be found in Item 1A. Risk Factors.” – 被动语气，更客观，但缺少了“for a further discussion”的引导。
“We encourage you to review the risk factors discussed in Item 1A.” – 使用了“encourage”，带有劝说意味，不如原文中立。

items.en: We have acquired and developed a high quality portfolio of office, retail and multifamily properties
items.why: 中文常直接罗列“收购并开发了高质量的办公、零售和多户住宅资产”，此写法用“acquired and developed”并列动作，“portfolio of”统一归类资产，更符合财经报告的正式性与专业性。
items.when: 撰写资产组合相关的正式报告时使用。
items.slot: We have acquired and developed a high quality portfolio of [asset type …], [asset type …] and [asset type …] properties
swap: We have built and purchased a premium portfolio of office, retail and multifamily properties. 替换后用premium强调资产稀缺性，built and purchased更侧重资产增值后的价值，语气更突出资产质量的层级
We have assembled and developed a top-tier portfolio of office, retail and multifamily properties. 替换后用assembled强调资产组合的整合性，top-tier比high quality更突出资产的高端定位，语气更具竞争力

items.en: located in affluent neighborhoods and sought-after business centers
items.why: 中文常写“位于富裕社区和热门商业中心”，此写法用“affluent”（正式财经用词，比rich专业）和“sought-after”（强调市场认可度，比popular更贴合商业逻辑），并列名词短语更简洁精准。
items.when: 描述资产位置的正式报告中使用。
items.slot: located in [adjective …] neighborhoods and [adjective …] business centers
swap: situated in prosperous neighborhoods and desirable business districts. 替换后用prosperous侧重区域经济繁荣，desirable比sought-after更直接表达吸引力，business districts比business centers更正式
positioned in wealthy areas and coveted commercial hubs. 替换后用positioned突出战略定位，coveted比sought-after更强调稀缺性，commercial hubs比business centers更突出核心地位

items.en: combines private capital and public sponsorship to serve a public purpose
items.why: 中文常直接译为「结合私人资本和公共赞助，服务公共目标」，但英文用不定式「to serve」衔接动作与目的，逻辑更清晰紧凑，符合正式报告功能描述的规范。
items.when: 用于正式报告中阐述机构核心运作逻辑与使命的场合。
items.slot: combines […] and […] to serve a public purpose
swap: unites private capital with public sponsorship for advancing a public mission（用unites替换combines，for advancing替换to serve，语气更侧重推进使命，适合强调主动性场景）
