blends private capital and public sponsorship to fulfill a public mission（用blends替换combines，fulfill替换serve，语气更侧重资源融合深度，适合强调整合的场景）

items.en: providing a secondary market for a variety of loans made to borrowers in rural America
items.why: 中文常译为「为美国农村借款人发放的各类贷款提供二级市场」，但英文用过去分词短语「made to borrowers in rural America」后置修饰loans，避免头重脚轻，符合英文正式写作结构习惯。
items.when: 用于正式报告中描述机构具体业务范围的场合。
items.slot: providing a secondary market for a variety of loans made to borrowers in […]
swap: offering a secondary market for diverse loans extended to rural U.S. borrowers（用offering替换providing，diverse替换a variety of，extended替换made，语气更正式，适合监管报告）
creating a secondary market for assorted loans issued to rural American borrowers（用creating替换providing，assorted替换a variety of，issued替换made，语气更侧重市场构建，适合业务战略描述）

items.en: We market a mix of products to lenders
items.why: 精准表达金融机构向客户推广产品的动作，比中国人常写的“we have many products for lenders”更符合正式报告的专业措辞，避免口语化。
items.when: 撰写金融机构产品服务相关的正式报告（如10-K、尽职调查报告）时套用。
items.slot: We market a mix of […] to […]
swap: We offer a range of products to lenders（语气更平实，适合内部报告而非公开披露）
We provide a variety of products to lenders（通用性强，正式度略低）

items.en: Our ability to increase sales to existing customers will depend on a number of factors, including our customers’ satisfaction with our platform and technologies, competition, pricing, and overall changes in our customers’ T&E spending levels.
items.why: 用 a number of factors, including 引出非穷尽列举，既强调多重依赖又保持客观；T&E 缩略词体现行业专业性。中国人常写 depend on factors such as...，但缺少 a number of 的量感；或列举时忘记使用缩略语。
items.when: 进行风险因素分析或条件列举时，如财务分析、审计风险披露。
items.slot: Our ability to [verb] will depend on a number of factors, including [factor …], [factor …], and [factor …].
swap: Our capacity to... is contingent upon a variety of factors, including...（contingent upon 更正式，适合法律文本）
Whether we can... hinges on multiple factors, such as...（hinges on 较生动，但稍非正式）

items.en: Risk of changes in product performance and competition
items.why: 中文常直接写「产品性能变化和竞争的风险」，此处用「Risk of [名词短语]」的正式结构，符合SEC合规报告的专业语气，避免口语化表述
items.when: 用于正式风险披露章节的风险项开头
items.slot: Risk of changes in […] and competition
swap: Risk related to shifts in product performance and competitive landscape（更侧重竞争格局的变化）
Risk arising from alterations in product performance and competitive dynamics（更强调变化的动态性）

items.en: we announce material financial information in SEC filings, press releases and public conference calls
items.why: 清晰明确信息发布的具体渠道，中国人常写得模糊，仅提及发布却不说明具体载体
items.when: 撰写公司信息披露相关的英文报告时套用
items.slot: we announce material financial information in […], […], and […]
swap: we may disclose material financial information via SEC filings, press releases, or public conference calls（语气更委婉，用disclose替代announce，via替代in）
we will make material financial information known through SEC filings, press releases, and public conference calls（语气更正式，make known更书面）

items.en: can be found in Liquidity and Capital Resources
items.why: 中文常写“可以在流动性和资本资源部分找到”，该表述是财经报告指引内容位置的标准正式说法，比口语化的“you can look in”更专业
items.when: 在财务报告中指引读者查找相关内容的具体章节时使用
items.slot: can be found in […]
swap: is located in […]（更书面化，语气更正式）
may be accessed in […]（强调内容可获取性，适用于需查阅的资料）

items.en: Note 13—Segment Information and Customer Concentration of our Notes to Financial Statements
items.why: 中文常写“我们财务报表附注中的第13号附注”，该结构清晰规范，符合SEC报告的统一格式，便于读者快速定位
items.when: 在财务报告中引用具体附注内容时使用
items.slot: Note […]—[…] of our Notes to Financial Statements
swap: Schedule […]—[…] of our Financial Statement Schedules（适用于引用附表而非附注）
Exhibit […]—[…] of our Exhibits to the Report（适用于引用报告附件）

items.en: intended to achieve the Company’s strategic goals of increasing sales demand, enhancing customer experience, optimizing internal cost efficiencies, and realigning its organization.
items.why: 中文常写“旨在实现公司的战略目标：提高销售需求、提升客户体验、优化内部成本效率、调整组织架构”，此处用平行结构的动名词短语，结构紧凑，符合正式报告的书面语规范，比定语从句更简洁。
items.when: 描述企业举措的战略目的，尤其是在SEC 10-K这类正式备案文件中。
items.slot: intended to achieve the Company’s strategic goals of [action …], [action …], [action …], and [action …].
swap: designed to meet the Company’s strategic objectives of boosting sales demand, improving customer experience, streamlining internal cost efficiencies, and realigning its organization.（designed侧重设计性，boosting比increasing更具主动性）

aimed at achieving the Company’s strategic goals of growing sales demand, enhancing customer experience, optimizing internal cost efficiencies, and repositioning its organization.（aimed at更直接，repositioning比realigning更侧重战略层面调整）

items.en: Cybersecurity risk management is part of the Company’s overall risk management.
items.why: 采用名词性结构作主语，正式严谨，符合英文财经报告的语体要求；中国人常直译主语或结构松散，缺乏正式性。
items.when: 用于正式财经报告中介绍某一管理模块与整体框架的关联时。
items.slot: Cybersecurity risk management is part of the Company’s overall […] management.
swap: Cybersecurity risk management falls under the umbrella of the Company’s overall risk management. （用“falls under the umbrella of”更正式，书面性更强）
Cybersecurity risk management is integrated into the Company’s overall risk management framework. （强调模块集成性，更具体明确）

items.en: including threats and incidents associated with the use of services provided by third-party service providers.
items.why: 用“including”引导补充说明，结构清晰，避免冗长定语从句堆砌；中国人常用直译的“比如”或繁琐从句，不够简洁。
items.when: 用于正式报告中列举核心内容的附属相关事项时。
items.slot: including threats and incidents associated with the use of services provided by […] service providers.
swap: such as threats and incidents linked to the utilization of services offered by third-party vendors. （“such as”侧重举例，“utilization”“vendors”更正式）
including related threats and incidents tied to the consumption of services from third-party providers. （“tied to”稍口语化，“consumption”侧重服务使用场景）

items.en: utilize two (2) factor authorization as well as login and password protections with email verifications.
items.why: 用“as well as”连接并列措施，结构对称正式；中国人常用“和”的直译，结构单调，语体不符。
items.when: 用于正式报告中列举并列的安全或合规措施时。
items.slot: utilize two (2) factor authorization as well as login and password protections with […] verifications.
swap: employ two-factor authentication along with login and password safeguards via email verification. （“employ”“authentication”“safeguards”“via”更正式书面）
make use of two (2) factor authorization in addition to login and password protections with email-based verifications. （“make use of”稍口语，“in addition to”替换“as well as”）

items.en: working capital requirements will continue to be funded through
items.why: 使用被动语态保持正式报告的客观性，避免过度使用第一人称“我们”，比中文常写的“我们的营运资金需求将继续通过…融资”更专业简洁。
items.when: 在正式财务报告中说明营运资金需求的融资方式时使用。
items.slot: [X] will continue to be funded through […]
swap: working capital requirements will continue to be financed via (更正式，适合审计报告，比原短语稍偏技术化)
we will continue to fund working capital requirements with (使用第一人称，客观性稍弱，不适合SEC这类监管文件)

items.en: a combination of our existing funds and further issuances of securities
items.why: 用“a combination of”清晰列举两类资金来源，比中文常写的直译表达更符合英文正式报告的习惯，精准且正式。
items.when: 在财务文件中列举多项资金或资源来源时使用。
items.slot: a combination of our existing […] and further […]
swap: a mix of our existing funds and additional securities issuances (更口语化，不适合监管类正式文件)
a blend of our current funds and new security issues (精准度稍低，不如原短语适合财务报告)

items.en: Special mention receivable in excess of collateral value
items.why: 这是SEC报告中标准的专业术语命名，用精准的名词短语定义特定财务项目，中国人常直译或用冗长表述，不如它简洁专业。
items.when: 财务报告中定义特定应收款项类财务项目时使用。
items.slot: […] receivable in excess of […] value
swap: Excess receivable over collateral value for special mention loans（中文：语序调整，更口语化，不如原术语正式）
Special mention loan receivable exceeding collateral value（中文：用分词结构，稍显冗长，不如原短语紧凑）

items.en: decreased the revolving credit facility from $600.0 million to $500.0 million
items.why: 该写法用“decreased...from...to...”结构清晰表述金融工具规模的缩减，比中文常直接表述“减少XX到XX”更符合英文正式报告的严谨性，明确了变动前后的具体数值
items.when: 正式财务报告中描述金融额度、资金规模的变动时套用
items.slot: decreased the [financial facility/asset] from $[X].… to $[Y].…
swap: reduced the revolving credit facility from $600.0 million to $500.0 million（同义，语气更简洁，适合紧凑的报告）
lowered the revolving credit facility from $600.0 million to $500.0 million（同义，语气更侧重数值下调，适合强调规模调整）

items.en: depends on our status as a partnership for federal income tax purposes
items.why: 用"depends on"明确因果关联，比中国人常写的"is related to"更精准正式，符合专业报告的严谨性
items.when: 在说明某事项的核心前提条件时套用
items.slot: depends on our status as […] for federal income tax purposes
swap: is contingent on our classification as […] for federal income tax purposes
前者偏口语化，后者更贴合监管文件的正式语境，严谨性更强

items.en: cash available for distribution to our unitholders could be reduced
items.why: 用"could be"表可能性而非绝对化的"will be"，体现专业写作的谨慎性，中国人常写绝对表述，易引发合规风险
items.when: 在说明潜在的不利财务影响时套用
items.slot: cash available for distribution to our unitholders could be […]
swap: cash available for distribution to our unitholders might be diminished
前者是财务报告中常用的谨慎表达，后者语气更弱，不够贴合正式披露的语境

items.en: Our activities, including our expansion activities, are highly regulated
items.why: 用插入语补充说明活动范围，避免监管描述的歧义，中国人常直接写"Our activities are highly regulated"，缺少限定不够严谨
items.when: 正式报告中描述业务受监管情况的场景
items.slot: Our activities, including […], are highly regulated
swap: are subject to extensive regulation（更侧重被动受约束，比"highly regulated"语气更客观）

items.en: See Item 1A. Risk Factors for further discussion
items.why: 用正式引用写法避免内容重复，符合SEC报告的专业规范，中国人常写口语化的"look at"，不够正式
items.when: 正式报告中引用其他章节内容的场景

swap: Refer to Item 1A. Risk Factors for additional details（"Refer to"更正式，"additional details"更简洁）

items.en: Additional information regarding our customer contracts can be found in

items.when: 正式财务报告中指引其他章节/附注信息位置时使用
items.slot: Additional information regarding […] can be found in […]
swap: Further details about our customer contracts are available in

items.when: 正式财务报告中引用具体附注内容时使用

Schedule指附表，多用于非核心附注内容，不如Note贴合常规财务附注引用

items.en: Often, the nature of our business results in short-term volatility in our net income
items.why: the nature of ... results in ... 用名词短语作主语，直接表达因果，比 because of ... our net income fluctuates 更紧凑、更客观；加上 Often 缓和绝对性，体现谨慎措辞。中国学习者易写成 Because of the nature of our business, our net income experiences short-term volatility，显得啰嗦且书面感弱。

items.en: through existing wells with existing equipment and operating methods

items.when: 正式报告中描述实现某目标的具体路径及伴随条件时套用。

items.slot: include the impact of the […] Controlling Interest Acquisition
swap: incorporate the impact of the […] Controlling Interest Acquisition（更正式，适配SEC报告）

items.en: due primarily to a full year of earnings from Medallion and EnLink

items.en: associated with the nonrecurring recognition of deferred revenue
items.why: 清晰说明业绩变动与特定非经常性事项的关联，比直译的“和…有关”更符合英文财报的正式性，明确了事项的非经常性属性，避免读者误解为经常性影响。

linked to the non-routine recognition of：语气稍正式，更侧重非常规属性，适合复杂财报语境

items.en: For further discussion of our Senior Secured Credit Facility
items.why: 用正式介词结构引出后续内容，比中国人常写的"To discuss more about our Senior Secured Credit Facility"更简洁专业，契合正式报告语气
items.when: 用于正式财经报告中引出特定项目的详细说明

items.en: Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Conditions and Results of Operations
items.why: 这是SEC 10-K中固定的标准章节名称，中国人写英文报告时常简化或自创，使用标准全称符合专业规范，增强权威性

items.en: consist of approximately 20% average net working interest

items.when: 在财务报告中说明资产权益占比的场合

items.en: Future reductions or changes in U.S. government spending

items.en: supporting new product introductions, expansion of existing customer relationships, and improved utilization of existing assets
items.why: 采用平行名词短语列举支撑事项，结构简洁对称，避免中文写作中零散罗列的问题，逻辑清晰专业
items.when: 用于描述某一举措带来的多项支撑性成果或行动
items.slot: supporting […], expansion of existing […], and improved utilization of existing […]
swap: enabling new product launches, growth of existing customer relationships, and optimized utilization of existing assets; 语气更侧重直接促成，比原句更强调动作的主动性
underpinning new product developments, expansion of existing client relationships, and enhanced utilization of existing assets; 语气更侧重基础支撑，适合描述长期稳定的作用

items.en: contributing to margin expansion and operating leverage over time
items.why: 用分词短语呈现长期结果，搭配"over time"明确时间维度，比中文常见的表述更简洁专业，符合SEC报告的正式性要求
items.when: 用于描述策略或行动随时间推移产生的长期积极影响
items.slot: contributing to […] and […] over time
swap: leading to margin expansion and operating leverage in the long run; 语气更强调因果的直接性，比原句更突出结果的必然性
driving margin expansion and operating leverage gradually; 语气更侧重渐进过程，适合描述缓慢积累的效果

items.en: collaborate to integrate customer requirements with the Company’s technical capabilities and manufacturing footprint
items.why: 用"collaborate to integrate"精准表达跨团队协同整合的动作，比中文常见的"一起整合"更具体专业，明确了整合的主体与对象
items.when: 用于描述不同部门协同整合需求与资源的动作
items.slot: collaborate to integrate […] with the Company’s […] and manufacturing footprint
swap: work together to align customer requirements with the Company’s technical capabilities and manufacturing footprint; 用"align"替代"integrate"，语气更侧重匹配适配，比原句更强调双方契合度
cooperate to integrate customer needs with the Company’s technical and manufacturing strengths; 用"cooperate"替代"collaborate"，语气偏向常规合作，协同深度稍弱

items.en: The top five customers accounted for approximately 51% of revenues for 2025
items.why: 中文财务报告常直接写“2025年前五大客户占收入51%”，缺少“approximately”体现专业披露的严谨性，避免绝对化表述，符合SEC报告的正式性要求
items.when: 适用于财务报告中披露收入构成、客户占比的场合
items.slot: The top five customers accounted for approximately […]% of revenues for […]
swap: roughly 51% of revenues for 2025（语气更偏向非正式披露，适合内部报告）
about 51% of revenues for 2025（更简洁，适合短篇幅的摘要披露）

items.en: by pursuing growth across a diversified set of customers
items.why: 中文常写“通过发展多元化客户”，用“by pursuing growth across”清晰连接“管理客户集中风险”的目标和具体策略，逻辑更连贯，符合英文正式报告的表达习惯
items.when: 适用于财务报告中说明应对风险的具体措施的场合
items.slot: by pursuing growth across a diversified set of […]
swap: via expanding growth across a diversified set of […]（更强调扩张动作，适合业务拓展类披露）
through pursuing growth among a diverse range of […]（“among”替换“across”，侧重群体内部覆盖，适用场景更窄）

items.en: derived from the sale of the remaining seed inventory
items.why: 用“derived from”清晰说明收入来源，正式专业，中国人常使用“came from”等口语化表达，不符合正式报告要求
items.when: 财务报告中说明收入、收益的来源构成时使用
items.slot: derived from the sale of the remaining […] inventory
swap: generated by the sale of the remaining seed inventory（generated侧重产生过程，derived侧重来源，正式度相当）
coming from the sale of the remaining seed inventory（更口语化，不适用于正式报告）

items.en: is recognized on shipment or receipt of product
items.why: 用“on + 名词”明确时间节点，比从句更简洁，中国人常写“when the products are shipped or received”更啰嗦
items.when: 财务报告中确认收入时间的说明场合
items.slot: is recognized on […] or […] of product
swap: is recognized when product is shipped or received（更口语化，适合非法定报告）
is recognized at shipment or receipt of product（省略冗余的“of”，更凝练）

items.en: adopt a multi-channel approach that includes print and digital advertising
items.why: 该表达简洁专业，符合商务报告正式语气，中国人常写“use a multi-channel method”，不如“adopt a multi-channel approach”地道。
items.when: 撰写营销方案、推广策略的场合。
items.slot: adopt a multi-channel approach that includes […]
swap: implement an omnichannel strategy（侧重全渠道整合，适合强调渠道协同的场景）
utilize a multi-pronged approach（侧重多手段结合，适合覆盖多维度动作的情况）

items.en: 27.2% for the fiscal year 2024 to 25.2% for the fiscal year 2025
items.why: 中文常重复表述财年或用“在…年”，英文采用平行结构“数值+for+财年”，避免冗余，正式报告中更紧凑清晰，符合SEC文件的简洁要求
items.when: 正式财务报告中对比两个财年的数值指标时使用
items.slot: […]% for the fiscal year […] to […]% for the fiscal year […]
swap: 27.2% in FY2024 versus 25.2% in FY2025（用FY缩写和versus替代to，语气更紧凑）
27.2% during fiscal 2024 compared to 25.2% in fiscal 2025（用during和compared to，语气稍委婉）

items.en: This decrease in gross margin occurred because our total revenues declined
items.why: 中文常以“我们”为主语表述因果，英文用名词短语“This decrease”作主语，避免第一人称，更符合SEC报告的客观正式性，因果逻辑清晰
items.when: 正式财务报告中说明指标变动原因时使用
items.slot: This decrease in […] occurred because […]
swap: Such decline in gross margin is attributable to a decrease in our total revenues（用be attributable to替代occurred because，更正式，适合监管文件）
The decline in gross margin resulted from our total revenues falling（用resulted from，更简洁，适合内部报告）

items.en: The Secure Core and Select Core riders offer the option of GWBs and GIBs that provide a specified level rate of protected income.
items.why: 用定语从句紧密串联产品名称与核心收益特征，逻辑连贯紧凑；中国人常拆分写为独立分句，读起来冗余，不如这种正式书面表达
items.when: 介绍金融附加 rider 产品核心收益条款的场合
items.slot: [Product Name …] and [Product Name …] riders offer the option of [GWB/GIB type …] and [GWB/GIB type …] that provide a specified level rate of protected income.
swap: [Product Name 1] and [Product Name 2] riders provide the choice of [GWB/GIB type 1] and [GWB/GIB type 2] with a specified level rate of protected income. （用provide the choice替换offer the option，语气更简洁直接）
[Product Name 1] and [Product Name 2] riders offer the choice of [GWB/GIB type 1] and [GWB/GIB type 2] that provide a specified level of protected income. （用offer the choice替换offer the option，语气更灵活）

items.en: is influenced by a number of factors such as
items.why: 用正式列举结构，“a number of”比“many”更正式，“such as”比“like”更符合正式写作规范，比中国人常用的“is affected by many factors like”更专业
items.when: 正式报告中列举影响因素的场合，如业务分析、市场分析
items.slot: is influenced by a number of factors such as […]
swap: is affected by various factors including […]（“various”比“a number of”灵活，“including”稍随意）
is impacted by a range of factors like […]（“impacted”不如“influenced”正式，“like”不符合正式写作）

items.en: could have an adverse impact on our financial performance
items.why: 用名词化短语“adverse impact”正式表达负面影响，符合SEC报告的正式语体；中国人写财务报告可能会用“will badly affect”等口语化表达，不够专业严谨
items.when: 撰写财务报告中风险因素的影响部分时套用
items.slot: […] could have an adverse impact on our […]
swap: might negatively affect our […]（语气更委婉，适合风险较低的表述）
would exert a detrimental influence on our […]（更正式书面，适合重大风险表述）

items.en: due to decreased demand for (or availability of) credit
items.why: 用“due to + 名词性短语”简洁表达原因，避免从句冗余，符合英文正式报告的凝练风格；中国人写对应内容可能会用“because demand for credit has decreased”等从句，不够简洁
items.when: 撰写财务报告中风险因素的原因分析部分时套用
items.slot: due to decreased […] for (or availability of) […]
swap: as a result of reduced demand for (or access to) credit（侧重“获取信贷的渠道”，比availability更侧重可获得性）
owing to lower demand for (or availability of) credit（语气稍轻，适合风险程度较低的原因）

items.en: governments may pass laws, or implement regulations, that modify rights and obligations under existing agreements
items.why: 用正式动词搭配“pass laws, implement regulations”及定语从句精准描述法规变化，符合SEC报告的专业合规表述；中国人写相关内容可能会用“the government might make laws or rules that change rights”等口语化表达，不够专业严谨
items.when: 撰写财务报告中合规风险的部分时套用
items.slot: […] may pass laws, or implement regulations, that modify rights and obligations under existing […]
swap: authorities might enact statutes, or issue regulations, that alter rights and obligations under existing contracts（用enact更正式，statutes更侧重成文法）
governments could adopt laws, or promulgate regulations, that adjust rights and obligations under existing agreements（用adopt、promulgate更正式，语气更委婉）

items.en: in response to a dealer or end-use customer default on a receivable
items.why: 中文常直译用“for”或“针对”，过于口语化，而“in response to”是正式专业用语，明确体现应对违约的逻辑，符合SEC报告的正式性
items.when: 用于正式财务报告、尽职调查报告中，描述某一行动的触发前提
items.slot: in response to […] default on a receivable
swap: in light of a dealer or end-use customer default on a receivable（语气侧重基于客观事实，而非主动应对，适合被动触发事项）
as a result of a dealer or end-use customer default on a receivable（语气侧重结果关联性，而非响应动作，适合描述因果关系）

items.en: is subject to the current market value of such collateral
items.why: 中文常直译用“depends on”，过于随意，“is subject to”是正式法规用语，体现事项受约束的严谨性，符合SEC报告要求
items.when: 用于正式报告中描述资产价值、风险等事项的约束条件
items.slot: is subject to the current market value of such […]
swap: depends on the current market value of such collateral（语气偏向一般描述，正式度不足）
is contingent on the current market value of such collateral（语气侧重偶然性，适用场景较窄）

items.en: All of the foregoing could increase losses on receivables and operating leases
items.why: 中文常写“以上所有情况”，用“All of the foregoing”指代前文内容，避免重复，正式简洁，符合专业报告的行文要求
items.when: 用于正式财务报告、审计报告中，总结前文所述内容并引出后续影响
items.slot: All of the foregoing could increase losses on […] and operating leases
swap: The above could increase losses on receivables and operating leases（“above”正式度不足，不如“foregoing”贴合专业报告语境）
All of the above could increase losses on receivables and operating leases（“foregoing”特指前文讨论内容，比“above”更精准）

items.en: As described in Note 2 to the financial statements
items.why: 中文常直接写“根据财务报表附注2”，此处用“As described in…”更正式，符合监管报告的严谨措辞，避免口语化
items.when: 正式财务报告、审计报告中引用附注内容的场合
items.slot: As described in Note […] to the financial statements
swap: As set out in Note […] to the financial statements：set out侧重有条理列明，语气稍正式于described
As noted in Note […] to the financial statements：noted更侧重被提及，语气较described弱

items.en: In line with our business plan, management expects further increases in operating expenses and capital expenditures related to (i) development activities typical of an early-stage company and (ii) marketing initiatives.
items.why: 用“In line with”比“According to”更自然，强调一致性而非单纯引述；中国人常用“According to our plan”，但“In line with”暗示行动与计划相契合，更符合商业语境。此外，“management expects further increases”比“we expect more increase”更正式，“further”比“more”更强调延续性。
items.when: 当需要说明某项措施或预期与公司战略/计划保持一致时，尤其适用于管理层讨论与分析（MD&A）部分。
items.slot: In line with our […] , management expects further increases in […] related to […] .
swap: “Consistent with our business plan”（与计划一致，用法相近，但更正式，常用于书面）
“As outlined in our business plan”（如计划所述，侧重描述而非一致，语气稍弱）

items.en: We plan to finance these expenditures through additional issuances of equity and debt securities.
items.why: 用“finance ... through ...”直接、简洁地表达融资手段，是比较地道的商业英语。中国人可能写成“raise funds by issuing ...”，略显口语化且不够专业。“additional issuances of equity and debt securities”名词化表达密集信息，比“issue more stocks and bonds”更符合报告文体。
items.when: 在讨论资本支出计划或融资策略时，比如描述如何为扩张、研发等提供资金。
items.slot: We plan to finance […] through additional issuances of […] and […] .
swap: “We intend to fund these expenditures by issuing additional equity and debt.”（fund by代替finance through，相近但by后更常接动名词）
“These expenditures will be financed through the issuance of additional equity and debt.”（被动语态，更侧重支出本身如何得到资金，客观正式）

items.en: Beyond that period, we will likely need to raise additional capital and generate increased revenues to meet our long-term operational needs.
items.why: “Beyond that period”是比“After that”更正式的时间衔接表达，适合年报。“will likely need to”用“likely”做模糊限制，避免绝对化语气，符合谨慎披露原则；中国学习者可能遗漏“likely”而显得过于肯定。“meet... operational needs”是满足需求的固定搭配，比起“satisfy... needs”更自然。
items.when: 当展望未来某段时间之后，表达不确定但很可能发生的情况时，例如风险因素或前瞻性声明部分。
items.slot: Beyond that period, we will likely need to […] and […] to meet our long-term […] needs.
swap: “Thereafter, we may need to raise additional capital and generate increased revenues to meet…” （Thereafter比Beyond that period稍简洁，may语气更弱）
“After that, we will probably need to…” （更口语化，不太适合正式报告）

items.en: compared to $30,620 during the year ended August 31, 2024
items.why: 用“compared to + 同期数据”清晰对比两个会计期间的财务数值，逻辑连贯，中国人常写“vs 2024年的30620”，过于口语化，不符合正式报告要求
items.when: 财务报告中对比不同期间财务数据的场合
items.slot: compared to $[…] during the year ended […]
swap: versus $[…] for the year ended […]（更简洁，适用于表格或紧凑文本）
as against $[…] in the prior year ended […]（更强调前一年的对比）

items.en: General and administrative and professional fee expenses incurred generally related to corporate overhead
items.why: 用“expenses incurred generally related to + 归类项”清晰说明费用的归属性质，避免模糊表述，中国人常生硬翻译为“管理和专业费用一般与公司管理费用有关”，不符合英文财报的正式措辞习惯
items.when: 财务报告中说明费用性质、归类的场合
items.slot: General and administrative and professional fee expenses incurred generally related to […]
swap: General and administrative and professional fee expenses incurred generally attributable to […]（用attributable to更正式，适用于监管文件）
General and administrative and professional fee expenses incurred typically linked to […]（用linked to更口语化，适用于非监管类文本）

items.en: Net charges of $76 million ($39 million after-tax)
items.why: 用规范结构清晰区分税前税后费用，中国人常直接写“净费用7600万美元，税后3900万”，缺少专业报告的紧凑性和格式严谨性。
items.when: 正式财务报告中披露费用的税前税后拆分情况时使用。
items.slot: Net charges of […] million ($[…] million after-tax)
swap: $76 million in net charges, of which $39 million is after-tax（更口语化，适合内部沟通）
Net charges totaling $76 million, with $39 million being after-tax（侧重总计，适合强调整体规模）

items.en: a primary force reshaping grid needs and investment planning
items.why: 中文常直接用“主要力量”，英文用“a primary force + 现在分词短语”作后置定语，简洁且逻辑清晰，避免冗余从句。
items.when: 描述某一因素对某领域的影响时可套用。
items.slot: a primary force reshaping […] needs and investment planning
swap: a key driver reshaping […] needs and investment planning (语气更侧重驱动作用，比force更主动)
a major factor reshaping […] needs and investment planning (语气更中性，侧重影响的重要性)

items.en: driven by transportation electrification, new residential housing, and increases in commercial and industrial consumption
items.why: 中文常直接罗列原因，英文用“driven by”引导的分词短语清晰点明因果关系，结构紧凑，符合正式报告的书面风格。
items.when: 说明某一趋势或数据的驱动因素时可套用。
items.slot: driven by […], […], and increases in commercial and industrial consumption
swap: fueled by […], […], and rises in commercial and industrial consumption (语气更侧重推动增长，比driven更有动力感)
spurred by […], […], and increases in commercial and industrial activity (侧重刺激作用，比consumption范围更广)

items.en: is needed to enable California to reach its 2030 and 2045 GHG reduction targets
items.why: 中文常直接说“需要来实现目标”，英文用“is needed to enable”更正式，符合SEC报告的专业语气，明确了目标的具体时间。
items.when: 说明政策或投资需达成特定目标时可套用。
items.slot: is needed to enable […] to reach its […] GHG reduction targets
swap: is required to help California achieve its 2030 and 2045 GHG reduction goals (语气更侧重强制要求，比need更正式)
is necessary to allow California to meet its 2030 and 2045 GHG reduction targets (语气更中性，侧重必要性)

items.en: SCE’s investments in the grid, utility owned storage capacity, and contracts for substantial new clean energy resources are key enablers of reliable economy-wide electrification
items.why: 用“key enablers”精准点明投资是推动核心目标的关键支撑，中国人常笼统用“key factors”，表述更贴合财经报告的正式性与精准性
items.when: 用于说明某项资产/投资对核心业务目标的支撑作用的场合
items.slot: […]’s investments in the grid, utility owned storage capacity, and contracts for substantial new clean energy resources are key enablers of reliable economy-wide electrification
swap: […]’s investments in the grid, utility owned storage capacity, and contracts for substantial new clean energy resources are critical drivers of reliable economy-wide electrification（“drivers”侧重驱动，“enablers”侧重使能，更精准）

[…]’s investments in the grid, utility owned storage capacity, and contracts for substantial new clean energy resources are core enablers of reliable economy-wide electrification（“core”比“key”更强调核心层级，语气更强）

items.en: As of December 31, 2025, SCE had completed construction at 572 sites to support 9,761 charge ports under its suite of light-duty Charge Ready programs
items.why: 用“As of + 日期”明确数据的时间锚点，搭配具体数字对应项目，中国人写英文易漏时间关联或数字对应关系，结构更严谨清晰
items.when: 用于披露截至特定日期的项目完成情况的场合
items.slot: As of […], SCE had completed construction at […] sites to support […] charge ports under its suite of light-duty Charge Ready programs
swap: At the end of […], SCE had completed construction at […] sites to support […] charge ports under its suite of light-duty Charge Ready programs（“At the end of”更口语化，正式报告用“As of”更合规）
As of […], SCE has completed construction at […] sites to support […] charge ports under its suite of light-duty Charge Ready programs（现在完成时更强调当前状态，原文过去完成时对应10-K报告时点，语气有差异）

items.en: More than 85% of SCE's planned capital investments are in its distribution grid and are essential to meeting grid reliability, resiliency, and readiness objectives
items.why: 用“essential to meeting”明确投资对目标的不可或缺性，中国人常写“are important for”，语气较弱，更符合监管报告对关键投资的定性
items.when: 用于说明某项投资对达成核心目标的必要性的场合
items.slot: More than […]% of SCE's planned capital investments are in its distribution grid and are essential to meeting grid reliability, resiliency, and readiness objectives
swap: Over […]% of SCE's planned capital investments are in its distribution grid and are critical to meeting grid reliability, resiliency, and readiness objectives（“Over”比“More than”更简洁，“critical”侧重紧要性，“essential”侧重必要性）
More than […]% of SCE's planned capital investments are in its distribution grid and are vital to meeting grid reliability, resiliency, and readiness objectives（“vital”侧重生命力，“essential”侧重核心必要性，语境有差异）

items.en: read carefully the factors described in “ Risk Factors”
items.why: 用described in明确引用章节，清晰指引读者，中国人常直接提章节名不说明内容关联，此写法符合SEC报告的引用逻辑
items.when: 撰写报告中指引读者到特定章节的内容时套用
items.slot: read carefully the factors described in “ […] ”
swap: review thoroughly the factors outlined in the “ Risk Factors” section（review替换read，section明确章节属性）
examine closely the factors detailed in the “ Risk Factors” subsection（examine更专业，subsection细分章节）

items.en: are dynamically managed in coordination with our investment team
items.why: 用副词+介词短语清晰说明管理的动态性与协作性，中文常简化为「由投资团队管理」，缺少精准的动态协同表述
items.when: 用于描述需说明跨部门协作的业务动态管理场景
items.slot: […] are dynamically managed in coordination with our [team/department]
swap: are actively managed in collaboration with our investment team（语气更强调主动协作的积极性）
are flexibly managed in conjunction with our investment team（语气更侧重管理的灵活适应性）

items.en: Actual results and outcomes may differ materially from
items.why: 用“differ materially from”精准表达重大差异，中国人常写“are different from”表述模糊，缺乏专业严谨性
items.when: 财务报告中表述预期与实际结果的差异时套用
items.slot: Actual results and outcomes may differ materially from […]
swap: Actual results may differ significantly from […]（significantly与materially同义，语气稍弱）
Actual results could differ materially from […]（could比may更委婉，更符合正式报告语气）

items.en: Forward-looking statements speak only as of the date of this Form 10-K
items.why: 明确前瞻性声明的时间边界，中国人常漏写时间限定，易引发歧义
items.when: 正式报告中界定前瞻性声明的时效范围时套用
items.slot: Forward-looking statements speak only as of the date of this […]
swap: Forward-looking statements are valid only as of the date of this […]（are valid比speak更正式，贴合监管文件语境）
Forward-looking statements apply only as of the date of this […]（apply更精准体现适用范围）

items.en: See Part I, Item 1A. “Risk Factors” of this Form 10-K for a further discussion regarding some of the factors that may cause actual results to differ materially from those that we anticipate.
items.why: 用“See […] for a further discussion”引导规范交叉引用，中国人常写“Please check […]”过于随意，不符合专业报告规范
items.when: 财务报告中交叉引用其他章节内容时套用
items.slot: See Part I, Item […] of this Form 10-K for a further discussion regarding some of the factors that may cause actual results to differ materially from those that we anticipate.
swap: Refer to Part I, Item […] of this Form 10-K for additional discussion on the factors that may cause actual results to differ materially from our expectations.（Refer to更正式，additional比further）
Consult Part I, Item […] of this Form 10-K for a more detailed discussion on factors leading to actual results differing materially from our anticipated outcomes.（consult更专业，more detailed比further）

items.en: including statements regarding our strategy, future operations, future financial position, future revenue, projected costs, prospects, plans, objectives of management and expected market growth
items.why: 用including衔接列举内容，层次清晰，符合正式报告的列举逻辑，中国人常直接用“and”罗列，结构松散
items.when: 正式报告中补充列举相关内容时套用
items.slot: including statements regarding [category …], [category …], [category …], [category …], [category …] and [category …]
swap: such as statements regarding [category 1], [category 2], [category 3], [category 4], [category 5] and [category 6]（语气侧重举例而非补充）
including statements concerning [category 1], [category 2], [category 3], [category 4], [category 5] and [category 6]（用concerning替换regarding，语气更正式）

items.en: leverages a variety of marketing and advertising vehicles
items.why: 中文常用“使用多种”，此处用leverages体现对营销资源的高效杠杆利用，更符合正式报告的专业感，避免口语化的use many
items.when: 撰写企业营销资源配置的正式报告场合
items.slot: [...] leverages a variety of [...] vehicles
swap: utilizes a range of marketing and advertising vehicles（utilizes侧重常规使用，leverages侧重高效杠杆利用）
employs multiple types of marketing and advertising vehicles（employs侧重主动采用，语气更正式）

items.en: by enabling process validation, digital traceability and repeatable production outcomes
items.why: 中文常用“通过做某事”简单解释机制，此结构清晰列出具体赋能能力，让特征到价值的逻辑关联更明确结构化
items.when: 解释某项能力如何带来特定结果时，适用于审计或财务尽职调查报告
items.slot: by enabling [specific capability …], [specific capability …] and [specific capability …]
swap: through facilitating [specific capabilities] (用facilitating替代enabling，动作更平缓)
via enabling [specific capabilities] (用via替代by，更简洁正式)

items.en: a significant driver of international expansion will be the geographic growth of our existing customer base
items.why: 用名词性结构作主语明确指出业务扩张的核心驱动因素，正式客观，符合SEC报告书面语风格，中国人常写we think international expansion is driven by...，语气偏主观且不够正式
items.when: 阐述业务扩张的核心驱动因素时套用
items.slot: a significant driver of […] will be the geographic growth of our existing customer base
swap: a key factor fueling international expansion is the geographic expansion of our current customer base（语气更偏向动态，强调因素的推动作用）
one major contributor to international growth is the geographic expansion of our existing client base（用词偏向贡献，弱化驱动的直接性）

items.en: Interest on the primary deposit account, if any, accrues daily and is paid monthly
items.why: 用if any作为插入语简洁限定“可能存在”的情况，比中文直接写“如果有”更符合英文正式报告的简洁性，避免绝对化表述
items.when: 正式财务报告中，描述可能存在但不确定的款项、权益等情况时使用
items.slot: […] on the […], if any, […] daily and is paid monthly
swap: […] on the […], if applicable, […] daily and is paid monthly（if applicable侧重适用场景，if any侧重是否存在）
[…] on the […], should any exist, […] daily and is paid monthly（should any exist更书面化但稍显生硬）

items.en: the Sponsor’s recourse is to remove the Depository
items.why: 用recourse这个专业术语表述法定追索权，比中文直白的“权利”更精准，符合财务法律文件的专业措辞要求
items.when: 正式财务或法律文件中，表述主体的法定追索权利时使用
items.slot: the […]’s recourse is to […] the […]
swap: the […] has the right to […] the […]（right更通用，recourse更侧重法定追索属性）
the […] may exercise its right to […] the […]（exercise更强调行使动作，recourse更侧重权利本身）

items.en: could materially and adversely affect the performance of the Shares
items.why: 用两个精准副词（materially表影响重大、adversely表负面影响）限定动作性质，既体现专业严谨性，又避免绝对化表述；中国人常直接写“affect”，过于笼统，不符合财务报告的精准要求。
items.when: 财务报告中描述某事项对主体业绩的重大负面影响时套用。
items.slot: could materially and adversely affect the performance of […]
swap: might significantly and negatively impact the performance of […]（语气更委婉，适合风险提示类表述）
could materially negatively affect the results of […]（更侧重经营结果而非业绩表现）

items.en: Changes to United States tariff and trade policies
items.why: 用名词短语作主语，简洁正式，符合SEC等监管报告的书面风格；中国人常使用从句（如“Because the U.S. changes its tariff policies”），冗余且不够正式。
items.when: 正式报告中描述外部政策变动等触发因素时套用。
items.slot: Changes to […] tariff and trade policies
swap: Modifications to U.S. tariff and trade policies（更简洁，适合篇幅紧凑的报告）
Alterations to United States’ tariff and trade policies（语气更正式，适合法律关联的表述）

items.en: changing supply and demand for a particular currency
items.why: 用现在分词“changing”修饰核心名词“supply and demand”，简洁表达“供求变化”的含义，中文常直译为“某一特定货币的供求变化”，但英文此写法更凝练，符合正式报告的正式性要求，避免冗余
items.when: 撰写涉及某类货币或商品供需变化的金融正式报告时套用
items.slot: changing supply and demand for a particular […]
swap: fluctuating supply and demand for a specific currency
fluctuating侧重供需的波动幅度，比changing更强调动态变化的剧烈程度，适合描述市场不稳定的场景
shifting supply and demand for a given currency
shifting侧重供需的转移趋势，适合分析供需结构变化的场景

items.en: governments from time to time intervene in the currency markets
items.why: 用频率短语“from time to time”（不时地）修饰动词“intervene”，准确描述政府干预的非持续性特征，中文常直译为“政府时不时干预货币市场”，英文此写法更符合正式报告的书面语规范，避免口语化
items.when: 撰写关于政府对市场的非持续性干预的金融合规报告时套用
items.slot: governments from time to time intervene in the […] markets
swap: governments periodically intervene in the currency markets
periodically侧重按周期的规律性干预，比from time to time更具规律性
governments occasionally intervene in the currency markets
occasionally侧重偶然的、不频繁的干预，语气更弱

items.en: Forward-looking statements can be identified by words such as “anticipate,” “expect,” “intend,” “plan,” “believe,” “seek,” “outlook” and “estimate” and other similar words
items.why: 这是官方报告中清晰列举识别特征的常用客观句式，中国人常使用“you can find words like”，被动语态的使用更符合官方报告的客观性与正式性。
items.when: 用于官方报告中列举某类内容的识别关键词时套用。
items.slot: [某类表述] can be identified by words such as […] and other similar words
swap: may be recognized via terms like (语气更委婉，适合较温和的表述)
are distinguishable by phrases such as (更侧重区分属性，书面性更强)

items.en: has incurred a negative cash flow from operating activities of $491,306
items.why: 中文常写“经营活动现金流为负，金额491,306美元”，此处用“incur a negative 财务指标 of 数值”的结构，incur比常用的“have”更专业，体现财务结果的被动发生属性，符合审计/财报正式语境，避免冗余
items.when: 在正式财报中描述经营活动现金流为负的具体数值的场合
items.slot: has incurred a negative cash flow from operating activities of $[…]
swap: generated a negative operating cash flow of $491,306（侧重主动生成，不如incur贴合财报中已发生结果的描述）
had a negative cash flow from operations of $491,306（更简洁，但正式度略低）

items.en: sets parameters for the Company's investment and capital allocation decisions
items.why: 用“sets parameters for”清晰界定决策的约束范围，比中国人常写的“sets rules for”更专业，符合金融行业对决策边界的表述习惯
items.when: 正式报告中描述决策的约束条件或范围时使用
items.slot: sets parameters for the Company's […] and […] decisions
swap: defines boundaries for the Company's […] and […] decisions（更偏向战略边界定义）
establishes guidelines for the Company's […] and […] decisions（语气偏向指导而非硬性参数）

items.en: comprising the Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer, Chief Development Officer, Chief Revenue Officer, Chief Clinical Director, Chief Research & Development Officer, Chief Creative Officer, and Vice President of International Operations
items.why: 中文列举常用‘包括’，但用comprising更简洁正式，符合英文报告的书面语规范，避免重复使用including的口语化倾向
items.when: 用于正式报告中列举某个整体的具体组成部分
items.slot: comprising the [Role 1], [Role 2], ..., and [Role N]
swap: including the Chief Executive Officer...：更通用，适合非极度正式的内部报告场景
consisting of the Chief Executive Officer...：更强调组成的唯一性，即该整体无其他额外角色

items.en: Operating expenses primarily consisted of legal and professional fees, marketing expenses, bank charges, software subscriptions, depreciation expense, and amortization expense.
items.why: 用“primarily consisted of”清晰说明费用主要构成，比中文常写的“主要包括”更贴合英文财报正式语境，且列表格式符合英文规范
items.when: 财务报告中说明费用、成本等项目的具体构成部分时
items.slot: […] primarily consisted of […], […], […], and […]
swap: Operating expenses were primarily composed of legal and professional fees, marketing expenses, bank charges, software subscriptions, depreciation expense, and amortization expense.（用composed of替代，正式度相当）
Operating expenses mainly included legal and professional fees, marketing expenses, bank charges, software subscriptions, depreciation expense, and amortization expense.（用included替代，更口语化，适合非严格财报）

items.en: further increases in operating expenses and capital expenditures
items.why: 中文常写“运营费用和资本支出将进一步增加”，用名词化结构更简洁正式，符合财务报告的书面风格，避免冗长的动词结构。
items.when: 正式报告中描述费用、支出等的增长趋势时使用。
items.slot: further increases in […] and […]
swap: additional rises in operating expenses and capital expenditures（更强调“额外”的增长）
subsequent increases in operating expenses and capital expenditures（更强调“后续”的增长）

items.en: our breakthrough tool that provides certain eligible clients with additional in-flight measurement and optimization capabilities
items.why: 用“breakthrough tool”精准定义产品的突破性属性，搭配“provides certain eligible clients with”清晰说明服务对象与核心价值，比中文常直译的冗长表达更紧凑，符合SEC报告的正式书面语要求。
items.when: 用于介绍核心产品/服务的独特价值、适用对象的场合。
items.slot: our breakthrough tool that provides certain eligible clients with additional […] capabilities
swap: our innovative tool that offers certain qualified clients with extra in-flight measurement and optimization capabilities (语气更偏向技术创新性，适合强调研发突破的部分)
our game-changing tool that delivers certain eligible clients with additional in-flight measurement and optimization capabilities (语气更具冲击力，适合突出产品的颠覆性影响)

items.en: give us both a radical cost-to-serve advantage and greater innovation velocity compared to traditional banks
items.why: 中国人常写bring us big advantages and faster innovation compared to traditional banks，本写法用both...and...明确并列的两类核心优势，radical比big更突出竞争层面的根本性优势，正式报告中更精准。
items.when: 金融报告中对比自身与传统同行的核心竞争优势时套用。
items.slot: give us both a radical cost-to-serve advantage and greater innovation velocity compared to traditional […]
swap: provide us with both a significant cost-to-serve edge and faster innovation speed (中文差：edge比advantage更侧重竞争壁垒，innovation speed比velocity更直白，适合更口语化的对比)
afford us both a fundamental cost-to-serve benefit and higher innovation pace (中文差：fundamental比radical更侧重基础层面，pace比velocity更简洁)

items.en: is complemented with a payments-based business model that is aligned with our members
items.why: 中国人常写our payments-based business model aligns with members and supports our advantage，本写法用be complemented with自然衔接前文的结构性优势与后文的支撑性业务模式，逻辑衔接更流畅，符合正式报告的严谨性。
items.when: 金融报告中衔接自身核心优势与支撑性业务模式时套用。
items.slot: is complemented with a payments-based business model that is aligned with our […]
swap: is supplemented by a payment-centric business model that aligns with our members (中文差：payment-centric比payments-based更突出业务核心，supplemented by比complemented with更侧重补充而非互补)
is accompanied by a payment-focused business model that is aligned with our members (中文差：accompanied by比complemented with更侧重伴随关系，focused比based更突出核心定位)

items.en: given the privileged repayment position for such products
items.why: 中国人常写because these products have a privileged repayment position，本写法用given引导的介词短语补充前提条件，比原因状语从句更简洁，符合SEC报告等正式文本的简洁要求。
items.when: 金融产品相关报告中补充支撑自身优势的前提条件时套用。
items.slot: given the privileged repayment position for such […]
swap: due to the preferential repayment standing for these products (中文差：due to比given更口语化，preferential standing比privileged position更侧重规则上的优先性)
on account of the advantageous repayment status for such products (中文差：on account of比given更正式，advantageous比privileged更侧重产品自身优势)

items.en: We designed our business to develop primary account relationships with our members, establishing Chime as their central financial hub.
items.why: 用现在分词短语“establishing ... as ...”补充说明结果，比用并列句或从句更简洁自然。中国学习者常写成“... and establish Chime as ...”，显得机械。
items.when: 表达某个行为带来附加结果或使某物成为某角色时。
items.slot: ..., establishing [...] as [...]
swap: “thereby establishing ... as ...”——加上 thereby，更正式强调因果关系，但稍显刻板
“which establishes ... as ...”——用 which 从句，松散且可能指代不明

items.en: These relationships also provide a privileged repayment advantage for liquidity products and rich, first-party data, including member income, spending, transaction, social graph, and other engagement data, which enables product innovation.
items.why: 用逗号并列两个形容词“rich, first-party”简洁修饰“data”；再通过“including ...”展开具体内容，使抽象数据具体化，且用“and other ...”保持开放性。中国学习者常平铺直叙“rich first-party data such as ...”，列举时结构生硬。
items.when: 描述具有多重属性的事物并举例说明其内容时。
items.slot: [adjective], [adjective] data, including [item1], [item2], [...] and other [...]
swap: “abundant, first-party data”——abundant 替换 rich，语义相近但不如 rich 生动
“in-depth, proprietary data”——更正式，但 proprietary 侧重所有权，与 first-party 意思略有差异

items.en: when Smart Cycle services are completed for a member
items.why: 用时间状语从句明确收入确认的具体时点，结构清晰严谨，避免模糊表述，符合SEC报告的要求
items.when: 用于财务报告中明确收入确认触发条件的场合
items.slot: when […] services are completed for a […]
swap: upon completion of […] services for a […]（更简洁的正式表达，适合精简文本）
at the time […] services are finalized for a […]（更强调流程完成的时点，适合强调节点）

items.en: net of expected changes and cancellations of services
items.why: 用财务标准表达“net of”明确扣除项，比直译的“扣除预期变更和取消”更专业，符合财经报告的措辞规范
items.when: 用于财务报告中说明扣除调整项后净额的场合
items.slot: net of expected […] and cancellations of […]
swap: net of anticipated modifications and cancellations of services（“anticipated”更正式，适合严谨报告）
net of projected changes and terminations of services（“terminations”替换“cancellations”，更正式）

items.en: providing us with significant flexibility over how much we invest in our R&D
items.why: 明确了灵活性的具体范围，避免模糊表述，比中文常用表述更严谨，符合财务报告对细节的要求
items.when: 用于财务报告中描述竞争优势带来的操作空间或决策自由度
items.slot: providing us with significant flexibility over how much we invest in our […]
swap: giving us substantial flexibility regarding the amount we invest in our R&D（giving比providing口语化，regarding不如over贴合财务语境）
affording us considerable flexibility about how much we invest in our R&D（affording侧重负担，不如providing贴合优势带来的空间）

items.en: investing free cash flow from our existing customer base in advertising and marketing
items.why: 这个表达清晰界定了资金来源（现有客户的自由现金流）和用途（广告营销），结构严谨，中国人常写“using our existing customers' free cash to do ads”，不够正式专业，不符合SEC报告的写作规范
items.when: 适用于撰写公司营销资金的来源与投向、资本配置的相关内容
items.slot: investing free cash flow from our existing customer base in […]
swap: deploying free cash flow from our existing customer base toward advertising and marketing（deploy更侧重资源的主动配置，比invest更灵活）
allocating free cash flow from our existing customer base to advertising and marketing（allocate更侧重预算层面的分配，适合财务报告表述）

items.en: Additional risks, beyond those summarized below or discussed elsewhere in this Annual Report
items.why: 用“beyond those summarized below or discussed elsewhere”明确区分当前列举与其他未覆盖的风险，逻辑衔接清晰，中国人常直接写“other risks”，表述模糊。
items.when: 列举风险或补充说明未提及内容时套用。
items.slot: Additional risks, beyond those summarized below or discussed elsewhere in this […]
swap: Additional risks not covered in the following or other sections of this document（用document简化表述，更通用）
Other risks beyond those listed here or mentioned elsewhere in this filing（用filing体现正式文件属性）

items.en: including those highlighted in the section titled " Risk Factors " contained within this Annual Report
items.why: 用“highlighted in the section titled [X] contained within [Y]”精准定位文件特定章节，比中国人常用的“like the Risk Factors in this report”更符合SEC报告的正式规范。
items.when: 正式报告中举例说明特定内容位置时套用。
items.slot: including those highlighted in the section titled " […] " contained within this […]
swap: including those addressed in the section named " Risk Factors " within this Annual Report（用addressed和named替换，语气更中性）
including those noted in the section called " Risk Factors " in this filing（用noted和called，表述更简洁）

items.en: Our customers range from small and medium-sized businesses to state and local governments and large, global enterprises
items.why: 用range from...to...清晰覆盖客户层级范围，比中国人常用的include...更具层次感和正式性，适配报告语境
items.when: 介绍客户群体覆盖范围的场合
items.slot: Our customers range from […] to […] and large, global enterprises
swap: cover […] to […] and large, global enterprises（cover更口语化，不如range正式）

items.para: We market and sell our products through our direct sales force and in partnership with our channel partners, including distributors, value-added resellers, systems integrators and original equipment manufacturer ("OEM") partners. items.en: Our partners generally do not stock inventory received from us.
items.why: generally 挡在 do not 前面，等于说「基本上不，但不敢说绝对没有」——一个词就把绝对化的风险挡掉了，而且 do not 仍然是明确否定，不含糊。中国人常写 Our partners do not stock inventory（说死了，出一个反例整句就假）或 In most cases, partners may not stock…（may not 变成「可能不允许」，意思都跑了）。另外 stock 直接当动词用，比 keep inventory in stock 省一半字。
items.when: 写你抽查过但没穷尽全部样本的事实结论时——尤其访谈或分析性复核得出的普遍情况。
items.slot: […] generally do not […] received from […].
swap: […] rarely […] — 更弱，暗示有例外且见过例外
[…] are not expected to […] — 这是「按安排不应该」，不是「事实上没有」，口径变了
Based on our enquiries, […] did not […] — 明确把结论绑在证据来源上，尽调报告里最稳
items.para: We market and sell our products through our direct sales force and in partnership with our channel partners, including distributors, value-added resellers, systems integrators and original equipment manufacturer ("OEM") partners. We also partner with various technology companies to sell our products. To facilitate channel coordination and increase productivity, we have established the Arista Partner Program, designed to engage partners who provide value-added services and extend our reach into the marketplace. Authorized training partners deliver technical training to our channel partners and end customers. Our partners typically receive an order from an end customer before placing an order with us, and we verify the end customer's identification before accepting such orders. Our partners generally do not stock inventory received from us.
items.srctitle: Arista Networks, Inc.  (ANET)  (CIK 0001596532)

items.en: I am delighted to be here at Stanford University today
items.why: 中国人常直接说I am glad to come here，用delighted比glad情感更饱满正式，搭配be here而非come here更贴合线下参会/演讲的场景，明确点明地点也符合正式发言的规范。
items.when: 正式场合开场表明受邀参会/到访的愉悦心情
items.slot: I am delighted to be here at […] today
swap: I am glad to come here today. 用词更口语化，情感强度弱且场景适配性差
It is a pleasure to join you at […] today. 更侧重与听众的互动感，少了个人亲临的直接感
items.para: Thank you for the kind introduction. I am delighted to be here at Stanford University today to discuss a topic that is central to the Federal Reserve's work: how policymakers analyze and respond to economic shocks in real time. 1

items.en: Regulation O has not been comprehensively updated since 1979.
items.why: 中国人常写的是“Regulation O was not updated comprehensively in 1979”或者“Regulation O hasn’t updated comprehensively since 1979”，原句用现在完成时的被动语态准确体现了规则至今未全面更新的状态，且“comprehensively”精准修饰“updated”，明确是全方面而非部分更新，表达更严谨。
items.when: 撰写监管规则、行业政策的历史沿革说明时套用

swap: Regulation X has not been fully revised since 2020.（用fully替换comprehensively，侧重完整修订而非全面更新）
[…] has not been updated in a comprehensive manner since […]（用介词短语替换副词，略显正式但稍显冗余）

items.en: The rule addresses a unique challenge for community banks,
items.why: 中国人常直译“this rule solves a special problem for small banks”，原句用“unique challenge”替代“special problem”，“unique”更强调该挑战是社区银行独有的，“address”比“solve”更贴合监管规则应对、处理行业难题的正式语境，“community banks”是行业标准译法，比“small banks”更精准。

items.en: We market and sell our products through our direct sales force and in partnership with our channel partners, including distributors, value-added resellers, systems integrators and original equipment manufacturer ("OEM") partners.
items.why: 用 including 引出列举，只列典型类别而不说"包括且仅包括"，既给读者画面感又不把话说死；OEM 首次出现时用括号定义缩写，全文以后直接用。中国人常写成 such as A, B, C and so on 或 all kinds of，或干脆罗列成完整句群，既啰嗦又丢失了"非穷尽列举"的法律弹性。

items.en: That led to the Medicare-Medicaid Anti-Fraud and Abuse Amendments of 1977
items.why: 中国人常写的是“This caused the 1977 Medicare-Medicaid Anti-Fraud and Abuse Amendments”，用“led to”比“caused”更正式且符合财经政策类文本的书面语气，更精准体现“政策出台是由需求推动逐步产生的因果关联”而非生硬的“导致”
items.when: 在财经/政策类写作中，描述某一需求、事件推动特定规则、法案出台的场合
items.slot: That led to the […] of […]
swap: This resulted in the […] of […]：更侧重客观结果，语气稍平实
This gave rise to the […] of […]：更强调催生的主动性，适合突出发起方的推动作用
items.para: A series of high-profile congressional investigations spurred demand for stronger Medicaid oversight and enforcement. That led to the Medicare-Medicaid Anti-Fraud and Abuse Amendments of 1977, which established the national Medicaid Fraud Control Units program.

items.en: We may also see increased consolidation among our component suppliers.
items.why: 中国人常写“we may face more supplier consolidation”，这里用“see increased consolidation among”更贴合财报里客观描述行业变化的中立语气，且“among”精准点明是供应商群体内部的整合，比笼统的表述更清晰。
items.when: 在财务尽职调查或审计报告里描述行业供应链的集中化趋势时套用。
items.slot: We may also see increased consolidation among […] suppliers.
swap: "We may witness growing consolidation within our supplier base" + 用“witness”比“see”更正式，“within our supplier base”比“among our component suppliers”更宽泛，适用范围更广
"There may be increased consolidation among our component suppliers" + 把主语换成there be句式，更侧重客观现象而非主体的观察视角
items.para: Our products rely on key components, including merchant silicon, integrated circuit components and power supplies, which are purchased from a limited number of suppliers, including certain sole source providers. We may also see increased consolidation among our component suppliers. In particular, we are primarily reliant upon our predominant merchant silicon vendor, Broadcom, for our switching chips. Generally, neither we nor our contract manufacturers have a written agreement with these component providers to guarantee the supply of the key components used in our products, nor do we have exclusive rights to such key components. Furthermore, our arrangements with contract manufacturers and suppliers typically do not impose purchase obligations for specific quantities beyond the amounts established in our submitted purchase orders or forecasts.
items.srctitle: Arista Networks, Inc.  (ANET)  (CIK 0001596532)

items.en: Generally, neither we nor our contract manufacturers have a written agreement with these component providers to guarantee the supply of the key components used in our products, nor do we have exclusive rights to such key components.
items.why: 中国人常分开写两个否定句，这里用“neither…nor…nor…”的连贯句式，清晰串联了两个无保障的风险点，逻辑更紧凑，符合英文财报的正式书面表达习惯，避免了重复啰嗦。
items.when: 在财务报告中并列陈述多项无合同保障的风险或合规缺陷时套用。
items.slot: Generally, neither […] nor […] have […] with […] to […] , nor do we have […] to […] .
swap: "Generally, we and our contract manufacturers lack written supply agreements with these component suppliers, and we also do not hold exclusive rights to these key components" + 拆分句式后逻辑连贯性下降，且用词更直白，不如原句正式严谨

"In general, neither we nor our contract manufacturers have secured written supply agreements for our key components, nor do we have exclusive usage rights" + 用“secured”强调“争取到”的动作，“usage rights”比“exclusive rights”更具体限定使用场景

items.en: have been locked in a tit-for-tat tariffs war
items.why: 中国人常写 "have a long-term dispute"。"locked in" 形象地传达出双方陷入僵局、动弹不得的胶着状态，比普通的 "in conflict" 更具表现力。
items.when: 用于描述目标公司与大客户、供应商或前员工之间长期未决、互不相让的法律诉讼或商业纠纷。
items.slot: have been locked in a [...]
swap: have been embroiled in a [...] (强调陷入混乱、难以脱身的负面处境)
are engaged in a protracted [...] (语气更正式，强调纠纷持续时间极长)
items.para: China's foreign ministry spokesperson Mao Ning described the tariffs as an "excuse for political manipulation". Washington and Beijing have been locked in a tit-for-tat tariffs war which is currently on hold.

items.en: Vietnam has attracted considerable attention as a potential major beneficiary of the 2018-19 U.S.-China tariff increases
items.why: 中国人常写 'Many people pay attention to...' 或 'X is considered to benefit from...'。原句用 'attracted considerable attention' 显得客观专业，并用 'potential major beneficiary'（潜在主要受益者）进行合理留白与避险（hedge），非常符合审计和尽调报告中对未确定性事实的陈述习惯。
items.when: 在尽调报告中描述某家公司、行业或资产因外部政策、市场变动而可能获得重大利好时。
items.slot: [...] has attracted considerable attention as a potential major beneficiary of [...]
swap: [...] is widely regarded as a key candidate to benefit from [...] (语气更肯定，强调市场共识)
[...] stands out as a prime prospect to gain from [...] (语气更积极，突出其优势地位)
items.para: In recent years, Vietnam has attracted considerable attention as a potential major beneficiary of the 2018-19 U.S.-China tariff increases, reflecting substantial trade diversion as exports shifted away from China (Alfaro and Chor, 2023; Freund et al., 2024). As shown in the left panel of Figure 1, U.S. imports from China declined sharply after the 2018-19 tariffs, while imports from Vietnam tripled by 2025.
items.srctitle: FEDS Note: Vietnam's Export Boom to the U.S.: The Role of Chinese Firms

items.en: analyze and respond to economic shocks in real time
items.why: 中国人常写 "analyze and solve problems immediately"，用词中式且不够严谨。原文用 "respond to"（应对）替代 "solve"（有些外部冲击无法被彻底“解决”，只能“应对”），用 "in real time" 替代 "immediately"，更契合现代企业风险管理的专业语境。
items.when: 用于尽职调查报告中，评价管理层对市场波动、系统故障、财务异动或外部风险的实时监控与应急响应能力。
items.slot: analyze and respond to [...] in real time
swap: monitor and mitigate [...] on an ongoing basis (语气更偏向持续性的日常风控，强调“持续监控与缓解”)
identify and address [...] promptly (语气更强调行动的迅速性，适合描述发现合规漏洞后的立即整改)

items.en: were replaced by a temporary 10% levy on
items.why: 中国人写税收或收费常套用 tax 或 fee，且句式易写成 changed to。这里用 replaced by a temporary... levy on，用 levy（征税/收费）替代 tax，且用 temporary 修饰，极其精准地描述了过渡性政策的更替。

items.when: 适用于尽职调查中评估关联方、实际控制人或高管对公司关键决策、关联交易的潜在干预风险。

items.en: a proposal to modernize its rule governing the extension of credit
items.why: 两点值得学。一是 governing 这个现在分词直接挂在 rule 后面当后置定语，一个 which/that 都不用就把「管什么的规则」说清楚了；中国人多半写成 the rule which is used to manage...，多三个词还更松。二是 the extension of credit 这种名词化：中文思维会写 how banks lend money to insiders，动词句一出来就必须交代主语、时态、对象，句子立刻长两倍。名词化让「授信」变成一个可以被 modernize、被 govern 的对象，正是监管和报告文体的骨架。
items.when: 写制度、政策、准则的适用范围，或在报告里说明某项内部规定管的是哪一类业务活动时。
items.slot: a proposal to […] its […] governing the […] of […]
swap: a proposal to revise the policy covering intercompany lending（covering 比 governing 中性，只说「涵盖」，不带「约束力」的意味）
the Group's policy on related-party transactions（最简，用 on 代替分词，适合正文里顺带一提，不用于正式定义）
the internal control framework that regulates the granting of credit（补回关系从句 + regulates，语气最重、最正式，用于强调这是硬约束）

items.en: bank executives, board members and major shareholders who could potentially influence a bank's lending decisions
items.why: 关键在 could potentially influence 这个双重降调：不说他们「已经」影响，只说「有可能有能力影响」——把话锁在「能力/风险」层面，不碰「事实/指控」。中国人写尽调和审计时常直接写 who influence 或 who control，等于替对方下了结论，一旦拿不出证据就是硬伤。另外前面那串三项并列本身就是在给 insiders 下定义，不另起一句 Insiders refer to...，省一整句还更紧。
items.when: 定义关联方、识别可能影响决策的人员、或描述一项尚未证实的风险敞口时。
items.slot: […], […] and […] who could potentially influence […]
swap: who are in a position to influence …（换成「处在能影响的位置上」，讲身份不讲动机，最中性，函证和关联方清单里常用）
who may be able to exert significant influence over …（贴 HKFRS 的 significant influence 措辞，正式度最高，但暗示已接近准则口径，慎用）
who could reasonably be expected to influence …（加 reasonably expected，把判断标准写成「合理预期」，适合要说明自己为什么这么划范围）
items.para: The Federal Reserve Board on Friday requested comment on a proposal to modernize its rule governing the extension of credit to bank "insiders"—bank executives, board members and major shareholders who could potentially influence a bank's lending decisions. The proposal updates outdated thresholds while maintaining safeguards against preferential treatment.
items.srctitle: Federal Reserve Board requests comment on a proposal to modernize its rule governing the extension of credit to bank "insiders"—bank executives, board members and major shareholders who could potentially influence a bank's lending decisions

items.en: The proposal updates outdated thresholds while maintaining safeguards against preferential treatment.
items.why: 一句话交代了「改了什么」和「什么没松」，靠的是 while + 动名词这个平衡结构，不用 but 也不用 at the same time。中国人爱写成两句：The proposal updates the thresholds. However, the safeguards remain unchanged. 拆开之后「改动是有边界的」这层意思就散了。还有 outdated 一个形容词就把「为什么要改」交代了，省掉一整句 because the thresholds were set many years ago。
items.when: 汇报一项调整、一次口径变更或一条建议时，需要同时安抚对方「原有控制没有被削弱」。
items.slot: The […] updates outdated […] while maintaining […] against […].
swap: … while preserving the existing controls over …（preserve 比 maintain 更强调「原样保留」，对方最在意别动控制时用）
… without weakening the controls over …（改成 without + 动名词，正面承诺变成否定式保证，语气更防守，回应质疑时用）
… while continuing to safeguard against …（把名词 safeguards 还原成动词，读起来更口语，适合邮件和口头汇报，不适合正式附注）
items.para: The Federal Reserve Board on Friday requested comment on a proposal to modernize its rule governing the extension of credit to bank "insiders"—bank executives, board members and major shareholders who could potentially influence a bank's lending decisions. The proposal updates outdated thresholds while maintaining safeguards against preferential treatment.
items.srctitle: Federal Reserve Board requests comment on a proposal to modernize its rule governing the extension of credit to bank "insiders"—bank executives, board members and major shareholders who could potentially influence a bank's lending decisions

items.en: how policymakers analyze and respond to economic shocks in real time
items.why: 这里用 how + 主语 + 动词的从句去当 discuss 的宾语，句子里的人和动作都还在（policymakers 在 analyze、在 respond），不是名词堆。中国人写报告爱换成 the analysis and response of policymakers to economic shocks，动作被压成名词、施动者退到 of 后面，句子发虚。另外 analyze and respond to 两个动词共用一个宾语，respond 自带的 to 保留、analyze 后面不加，这个细节很多人会写成 analyze and respond to 的镜像错误 analyze to。in real time 是三个词的定语，放句尾说明「时点」，不用写成 on a timely basis 那种套话。
items.when: 写目的段、范围段、议程时说明「本节讨论什么」，也用于向客户说明团队做了什么工作。
items.slot: how […] analyze and respond to […] in real time
swap: the way in which […] assess and respond to […] —— 更书面，语气重、节奏慢，适合正式报告不适合开场白
how […] identify and address […] —— 落点在「解决」，比 respond 更承诺结果
what […] do when […] arise —— 最口语，讲给非专业听众听时用，写进底稿偏随便
items.para: Thank you for the kind introduction. I am delighted to be here at Stanford University today to discuss a topic that is central to the Federal Reserve's work: how policymakers analyze and respond to economic shocks in real time. 1
items.srctitle: Jefferson, Navigating Economic Shocks: A Monetary Policymaker’s Perspective

items.en: neither we nor our contract manufacturers have a written agreement with these component providers to guarantee the supply of the key components used in our products, nor do we have exclusive rights to such key components.
items.why: 使用 “neither... nor..., nor do we...” 的双重否定倒装句式，极其严密地排除了“有书面协议保证供应”和“拥有独家权利”两种降低风险的可能性。中国人写审计报告时，往往会拆成两个平铺直叙的否定句（We don't have... and we also don't have...），缺乏这种一气呵成、逻辑严密的法律文本质感。
items.when: 在审计或尽调中披露目标公司与核心供应商之间缺乏合同约束力、存在供应中断风险时。
items.slot: neither [...] nor [...] have a written agreement with [...] to guarantee the supply of [...], nor do we have exclusive rights to [...].
swap: there are no binding commitments or exclusivity arrangements in place with [...] (语气更客观中立，常用作审计附注的陈述)
the Company lacks both contractual supply guarantees and exclusivity rights with respect to [...] (句式更紧凑，适合在PPT汇报或高管摘要中提炼要点)
items.para: Our products rely on key components, including merchant silicon, integrated circuit components and power supplies, which are purchased from a limited number of suppliers, including certain sole source providers. We may also see increased consolidation among our component suppliers. In particular, we are primarily reliant upon our predominant merchant silicon vendor, Broadcom, for our switching chips. Generally, neither we nor our contract manufacturers have a written agreement with these component providers to guarantee the supply of the key components used in our products, nor do we have exclusive rights to such key components. Furthermore, our arrangements with contract manufacturers and suppliers typically do not impose purchase obligations for specific quantities beyond the amounts established in our submitted purchase orders or forecasts.
items.srctitle: Arista Networks, Inc.  (ANET)  (CIK 0001596532)

items.en: our arrangements with contract manufacturers and suppliers typically do not impose purchase obligations for specific quantities beyond the amounts established in our submitted purchase orders or forecasts.
items.why: “impose purchase obligations”（强加购买义务）和 “amounts established in”（在...中确定的金额/数量）是极具专业度的合同术语。中国人通常会写成 “we do not have to buy more than what we ordered in POs”，显得非常业余。原文的写法精准界定了财务责任的边界。
items.when: 在财务尽调中分析目标公司的表外承诺（off-balance sheet commitments）或未来采购义务时。
items.slot: our arrangements with [...] typically do not impose purchase obligations for [...] beyond the amounts established in [...].
swap: the Company has no minimum purchase commitments exceeding the quantities specified in outstanding purchase orders (更偏向财务审计术语，强调‘最低采购承诺’)
contractual terms do not mandate any purchase volume in excess of the forecasted amounts (语气更正式，强调合同条款的强制性约束力)
items.para: Our products rely on key components, including merchant silicon, integrated circuit components and power supplies, which are purchased from a limited number of suppliers, including certain sole source providers. We may also see increased consolidation among our component suppliers. In particular, we are primarily reliant upon our predominant merchant silicon vendor, Broadcom, for our switching chips. Generally, neither we nor our contract manufacturers have a written agreement with these component providers to guarantee the supply of the key components used in our products, nor do we have exclusive rights to such key components. Furthermore, our arrangements with contract manufacturers and suppliers typically do not impose purchase obligations for specific quantities beyond the amounts established in our submitted purchase orders or forecasts.

items.en: Concerns about Medicaid’s “integrity ” became highly politicized in the debates surrounding the ACA.
items.why: 中国人写审计报告时，常写成 "Management was concerned about..." 或 "There are worries that..."。原句用 "Concerns about [Subject]" 作为主语，并用 "surrounding" 代替普通的 "about/related to"，显得极其客观、高级，避免了主观和口语化，非常适合描述审计中发现的争议性问题。
items.when: 用于描述各方对某一财务科目、合规问题或历史交易存在争议或高度关注的背景。
items.slot: Concerns about […] became highly […] in the debates surrounding […].
swap: Apprehensions regarding […] were intensely debated during […] (语气更偏向于“忧虑和激烈辩论”，适合描述审计委员会内部的争执)
Discussions over the validity of […] became highly contentious amid […] (语气更中性，强调“合规性讨论变得具有争议性”)
items.para: Concerns about Medicaid’s “integrity ” became highly politicized in the debates surrounding the ACA. Critics of Medicaid expansion argued that increasing the number of people who could get health insurance through the program would increase fraud and improper enrollment. Supporters of expanding Medicaid to help more Americans gain health insurance maintained that anti-fraud rhetoric often disguised ideological opposition to the program’s expansion.
items.srctitle: Trump administration is withholding more than $1B in Medicaid funds from California and Minnesota, in latest example of weaponizing real and imagined fraud

items.en: maintained that anti-fraud rhetoric often disguised ideological opposition to the program’s expansion
items.why: 中国人描述管理层的辩解时，常套用 "said that" 或 "argued that"，并用 "hide" 表示掩盖。原句用 "maintained that" 极其传神地表达了“坚持认为/始终主张”（常用于访谈或底稿记录），并用 "disguised"（伪装/掩盖）优雅地指出其真实意图被表面理由所遮蔽，比 "hide" 更有深度。
items.when: 用于在尽调报告中客观转述管理层、大股东或监管机构的某种一贯立场，或指出某种表面合规解释背后隐藏的真实财务动机。
items.slot: […] maintained that […] disguised […]
swap: […] asserted that […] masked the underlying […] (语气同样客观，用 masked 代替 disguised，同样高级且适合财务语境)
[…] contended that […] was merely a pretext for […] (语气更具批判性，直接指出对方的理由只是“借口”)
items.para: Concerns about Medicaid’s “integrity ” became highly politicized in the debates surrounding the ACA. Critics of Medicaid expansion argued that increasing the number of people who could get health insurance through the program would increase fraud and improper enrollment. Supporters of expanding Medicaid to help more Americans gain health insurance maintained that anti-fraud rhetoric often disguised ideological opposition to the program’s expansion.

items.en: provide valuable perspective and expertise to bank governance
items.why: 中国人常写 give good advice and help to manage the bank，口语化严重。用 provide valuable perspective and expertise（提供宝贵的视角与专业知识）显得极其高级，to bank governance（对银行治理）也比 manage 更有公司治理的高度。
items.when: 用于尽调报告中评估被调查公司董事会成员、高管背景及其对公司治理的实际贡献时。
items.slot: [...] provide valuable perspective and expertise to [...].
swap: [...] bring critical insights and technical know-how to [...] (语气更强调技术和洞察的深度)
[...] contribute essential oversight and industry experience to [...] (语气更偏向合规与监督，适合描述独立董事)
items.para: Regulation O has not been comprehensively updated since 1979. The rule addresses a unique challenge for community banks, where board members and executives are often local business owners and civic leaders who provide valuable perspective and expertise to bank governance and information on the local economy.
